sum: Short-period secondary microseisms (SPSM, 0.25–0.5 Hz) have traditionally been attributed to uniform generation along nearby coastlines. This study challenges that assumption by examining microseisms in the western Mediterranean Sea using Rayleigh-wave polarization analysis, Weakly Laterally Heterogeneous Media (WLHM) numerical source modeling, and inland amplitude attenuation across two orthogonal broadband seismic profiles in NE Iberia. The authors show that primary (0.05–0.1 Hz) and long-period secondary microseisms (0.1–0.25 Hz) originate in the North Atlantic Ocean, whereas SPSM are isolated within the Mediterranean Sea. Rather than following nearby shorelines or peak significant wave heights, SPSM sources are highly localized, dynamic, and strongly governed by bathymetry-dependent Rayleigh-wave excitation coefficients and convex coastal geometries like the Gulf of Lion. Combining polarization with bathymetric source modeling provides a novel framework to pinpoint high-frequency microseismic sources.
传统观点认为短周期次生微震（SPSM，0.25–0.5 Hz）均匀产生于邻近海岸线。本研究结合瑞利波极化分析、弱横向非均匀介质（WLHM）数值震源建模以及伊比利亚东北部两条正交宽频带测线的内陆振幅衰减分析，对西地中海微震进行了研究。结果表明，原生微震和长周期次生微震源于北大西洋，而SPSM则独立产生……

t: Combines multiresolution three-component Rayleigh-wave elliptical polarization analysis, Weakly Laterally Heterogeneous Media (WLHM) numerical PSD modeling with WAVEWATCH III ocean states, and geometric amplitude attenuation across orthogonal coastal arrays.
结合三分量瑞利波椭圆极化分析、基于WAVEWATCH III的WLHM数值建模以及正交海岸台阵的几何衰减分析。

Continuous broadband seismic records from western Mediterranean permanent networks (Spain, France, Italy) and two dense orthogonal coastal profiles (10 and 9 stations) deployed in NE Iberia during April 2024.
西地中海固定宽频带台网连续记录，以及2024年4月在伊比利亚东北部布设的两条密集正交测线（10和9个台站）数据。

Primary and long-period secondary microseisms originate in the North Atlantic, while SPSM arise within the Mediterranean (Pearson correlation 0.772) from localized, bathymetry-controlled spots like the Gulf of Lion (~30–40 km offshore).
PM和LPSM源于北大西洋，而SPSM产生于地中海内部（相关性0.772），如离岸30–40公里的狮湾等受地形控制的局部…
Numerical modeling is capped at 0.33 Hz due to Scholte wave transition above 0.3 Hz, and uses single spatially averaged Q and R^2 values across the entire year.
因0.3 Hz以上存在Scholte波转换，数值模拟上限为0.33 Hz，且全年采用单一空间平均Q和R^2值。

First combined application of Rayleigh-wave polarization, inland attenuation profiles, and WLHM source modeling in the Mediterranean, proving SPSM sources are localized by bathymetry rather than uniform along coastlines.
首次在地中海结合瑞利波极化、衰减测线与震源建模，证明SPSM震源受海底地形局部控制而非沿海岸均匀分布。

kc: Demonstrated that primary and long-period secondary microseisms recorded across the western Mediterranean originate in the North Atlantic, while short-period secondary microseisms (SPSM) are isolated within the Mediterranean Sea.
Proved via polarization, attenuation profiles, and numerical modeling that SPSM sources are spatially localized and dynamic rather than uniformly distributed along nearby shorelines.
Revealed that underwater bathymetry and convex shoreline geometries (such as the Gulf of Lion) strongly control SPSM source excitation and spatial distribution.
证明了西地中海记录到的原生微震和长周期次生微震源于北大西洋，而短周期次生微震（SPSM）则独立起源于地中海内部。
通过极化分析、衰减测线和数值模拟证明，SPSM震源在空间上是局部且动态的，而非沿着邻近海岸线均匀分布。
揭示了海底地形和凸形海岸线几何形态（如狮湾）强烈控制着SPSM震源的激发与空间分布。
me: Time-frequency Rayleigh-wave elliptical polarization analysis using the degree of polarization (DOP) on three-component seismograms to estimate back azimuths (BAZs).

Weakly Laterally Heterogeneous Media (WLHM) numerical modeling using WAVEWATCH III ocean wave data and bathymetry-dependent excitation coefficients to simulate secondary microseism power spectral density.
Inland Rayleigh-wave geometric amplitude attenuation analysis along coastal-parallel and coastal-orthogonal broadband station profiles to estimate offshore source distances.
利用三分量地震记录的极化度（DOP）进行时频瑞利波椭圆极化分析，以估算反方位角（BAZ）。
结合WAVEWATCH III海浪数据和依赖海底地形的激发系数，采用弱横向非均匀介质（WLHM）数值模拟方法计算次生微震功率谱密度。
利用平行和垂直于海岸线的宽频带台站测线进行内陆瑞利波几何振幅衰减分析，以估算离岸震源距离。
de: Continuous three-component broadband seismic records from 9 permanent stations across Spain, France, and Italy (networks CA, ES, FR, IV, GU) during 2020 and 2023.
Continuous data from two temporary broadband profiles deployed in NE Iberia in April 2024 (EPYSIM project): a 10-station NE–SW coastal-parallel profile and a 9-station NW–SE orthogonal profile.
Ocean wave model outputs (significant wave height and pressure source PSD 'p2l') from WAVEWATCH III.
2020年和2023年期间西班牙、法国和意大利9个固定宽频带地震台站（CA、ES、FR、IV、GU台网）的连续三分量记录。
2024年4月在伊比利亚东北部布设的两条临时宽频带测线（EPYSIM项目）连续数据：10个台站的NE–SW平行海岸测线和9个台站的NW–SE正交测线。
来自WAVEWATCH III海浪模型的输出数据（有效波高和压力源功率谱密度“p2l”）。
li: Numerical source modeling is restricted to frequencies up to 0.33 Hz because Rayleigh waves transition to Scholte waves above 0.3 Hz.

A single spatially averaged quality factor (Q=130) and coastal reflection coefficient (R^2) are used for the full-year simulation, causing minor amplitude over- or underestimations during individual storms.
Potential horizontal component misorientation or limited elliptically polarized signals at certain stations (e.g., RORO) may reduce polarization robustness.
由于0.3 Hz以上瑞利波会表现为Scholte波，数值震源建模的最大频率被限制在0.33 Hz。
全年模拟使用了单一的空间平均品质因子（Q=130）和海岸反射系数（R^2），导致个别风暴期间存在轻微的振幅高估或低估。
部分台站（如RORO）可能存在水平分量定向偏差或椭圆极化信号数量有限，这可能影响观测结果的稳健性。

tm.why: The paper characterizes the generation mechanisms, frequency splitting, and spatial source distribution of primary and secondary ambient seismic microseisms.
The study investigates ocean wave interactions, storm events, and bathymetric controls on microseism excitation in the Mediterranean Sea.
The authors analyze inland amplitude attenuation of Rayleigh waves along orthogonal broadband profiles and model the Rayleigh-wave quality factor Q.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all 4 figures, methodology, results, and discussion sections.

sum: This study analyzes earthquake source scaling from event-averaged down to subfault scales using an expanded USGS-NEIC catalog of 264 finite-fault models (M6.0–9.1, 1990–2025) inverted with the nonlinear Wavelet Inversion for SliP (WISP) code. Validated against independent Bayesian finite-fault inversions, the dataset incorporates teleseismic and regional strong-motion, GNSS, and InSAR observations. At the event-averaged scale, slip scales self-similarly with seismic moment (b = 0.343), whereas rise time scales sublinearly (b = 0.263), favoring pulse-like over crack-like ruptures. Novel subfault-scale analyses demonstrate that local rise time shows no correlation with slip, refuting the widely used kinematic modeling assumption that rise time is proportional to the square root of slip. Instead, larger subfault slips are accommodated by higher slip rates. Kinematic simulations of an M8.78 Cascadia megathrust earthquake show that removing the slip–rise time constraint increases local peak slip rates by ~50%, with major implications for ground-motion hazard.
本研究利用扩展的USGS-NEIC有限断层模型目录（1990–2025年间264个M6.0–9.1地震），结合非线性小波反演方法（WISP）及远震、强地面运动、GNSS和InSAR数据，系统评估了断层平均及子断层尺度的震源标度律。结果表明，事件平均滑动量符合自相似标度（b=0.343），而上升时间呈……

t: The study uses the nonlinear Wavelet Inversion for SliP (WISP) simulated annealing algorithm to estimate subfault slip, rake, rise time, and rupture onset time, plus Bayesian MCMC regression to quantify moment-scaling exponents.
采用非线性小波滑动反演（WISP）估计子断层滑动量、上升时间和起始时间，并用贝叶斯MCMC回归量化标度指数。

An expanded USGS-NEIC catalog of 264 finite-fault rupture models spanning M6.0–9.1 from 1990 to July 2025, including 20 events jointly inverted with regional strong-motion, GNSS, and InSAR observations.
1990至2025年7月USGS-NEIC的264个M6.0–9.1有限断层模型，含20个区域强震与大地测量联合反演事件…

Event-averaged rise time scales sublinearly with moment (b = 0.263) while slip is self-similar (b = 0.343). At subfault scales, rise time does not correlate with slip; removing τ_r ∝ √s increases simulated Cascadia peak slip rates by ~50%.
平均上升时间呈亚线性标度（b=0.263），滑动量保持自相似（b=0.343）；子断层上升时间与滑动量无关，移除该假设使…

Teleseismic and static InSAR data cannot resolve subfault rise times shorter than ~1–2 s without dense near-field strong-motion stations, and smaller events suffer from lower signal-to-noise ratios and inversion artifacts.
远震与静态InSAR难以分辨<1–2秒的短上升时间，且中小地震易受低信噪比和反演伪影影响。

Provides the first systematic subfault-scale scaling analysis across 264 M6–M9 nonlinear finite-fault models, empirically refuting the standard τ_r ∝ √s kinematic modeling assumption and quantifying its impact on rupture simulations.
首次在264个M6–M9模型上检验子断层标度律，从观测上推翻了τ_r∝√s的传统运动学假设并量化其影响。

kc: Expanded the USGS-NEIC finite-fault catalog by ~77% to 264 earthquakes (M6.0–9.1, 1990–2025), incorporating 20 joint inversions with regional strong-motion, GNSS, and InSAR data.
Validated WISP nonlinear finite-fault parameters against independent Bayesian inversions (Tohoku, Iquique, Maduo) and re-inverted the 2011 M9.1 Tohoku event to remove rise-time streaking artifacts.
Demonstrated that event-averaged rise time scales sublinearly with seismic moment (b = 0.263) while slip remains self-similar (b = 0.343), confirming pulse-like rupture behavior across magnitudes.
Refuted the common kinematic modeling assumption that subfault rise time scales with the square root of local slip (τ_r ∝ √s), showing instead that slip rate correlates linearly with slip.
Showed via M8.78 Cascadia kinematic rupture simulations that uncorrelated subfault rise times yield ~50% higher peak slip rates in high-slip patches than √s-scaled rise times.
将USGS-NEIC有限断层目录扩展了约77%至264个地震（M6.0–9.1，1990–2025），纳入了20个包含区域强震、GNSS和InSAR数据的联合反演结果。
通过对比独立的贝叶斯反演模型（东北、伊基克、玛多地震）验证了WISP非线性反演的可靠性，并重新反演了2011年M9.1日本东北地震以消除上升时间条带伪影。
证明事件平均上升时间随地震矩呈亚线性标度（b = 0.263），而滑动量保持自相似（b = 0.343），证实了跨震级的脉冲型破裂特征。
推翻了运动学模拟中常用的子断层上升时间与局部滑动量平方根成正比（τ_r ∝ √s）的假设，表明滑动速率与滑动量呈强正相关。
通过M8.78卡斯卡迪亚运动学破裂模拟表明，上升时间与滑动量无关的模型在高滑动区产生的局部峰值滑动速率比√s耦合模型高出约50%。
me: Nonlinear wavelet-domain simulated annealing finite-fault inversion (WASP/WISP) using an asymmetric cosine source-time function to solve for subfault slip, rake, rise time, and onset time.

Cross-validation of WISP subfault parameter distributions against independent nonlinear Bayesian finite-fault inversions (Minson et al., Duputel et al., BEAT) and comparison of teleseismic-only vs. joint datasets.
Bayesian log-log linear regression using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (NUTS in PyMC4) to estimate posterior distributions of moment-scaling exponents for mean slip, rise time, pulse length, and duration.
Subfault-level statistical binning by slip, magnitude, fault mechanism, hypocentral distance, depth, and onset/end times to evaluate local slip–rise time correlations and rupture style transitions.
Semi-stochastic kinematic rupture modeling of an M8.78 Cascadia subduction earthquake comparing prescribed τ_r ∝ √s correlation against slip-independent rise times.
采用基于非对称余弦震源时间函数的非线性小波域模拟退火有限断层反演（WASP/WISP），求解每个子断层的滑动量、滑动角、上升时间和破裂起始时间。
将WISP子断层参数分布与独立的非线性贝叶斯有限断层反演结果进行交叉验证，并对比纯远震反演与多数据联合反演的核密度分布差异。
利用PyMC4中的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NUTS）方法进行贝叶斯双对数线性回归，估计平均滑动量、上升时间、脉冲长度和持续时间的地震矩标度指数后验分布。
按滑动量、震级、断层类型、震源距、深度及破裂起止时间对子断层进行统计分箱分析，检验局部滑动-上升时间相关性及破裂模式转换。
开展M8.78卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带半随机运动学破裂数值模拟，对比给定τ_r ∝ √s相关约束与上升时间独立于滑动量两种情景下的破裂演化与滑动速率差异。
de: 264 finite-fault rupture models (M6.0–9.1) from the USGS-NEIC database spanning 1990 to July 2025 (concluding with the 2025 M8.8 Kamchatka earthquake).
20 finite-fault events in the augmented catalog jointly inverted with regional strong-motion, static/high-rate GNSS, and InSAR observations alongside teleseismic waveforms.
Independent Bayesian slip models for the 2011 M9.1 Tohoku, 2014 M8.2 Iquique, and 2021 M7.4 Maduo earthquakes, plus a teleseismic WISP re-inversion of the 2011 M9.1 Tohoku earthquake.
Near-field CCTV footage kinematic benchmark measurements from the 2025 M7.8 Myanmar supershear strike-slip earthquake on the Sagaing Fault.
Synthetic M8.78 Cascadia megathrust kinematic rupture simulations testing two different subfault rise-time parameterizations.
USGS-NEIC数据库中1990年至2025年7月（截至2025年M8.8堪察加地震）的264个有限断层破裂模型（M6.0–9.1）。
扩展目录中包含区域强地面运动、静态/高频GNSS、InSAR观测与远震波形联合反演的20个地震事件。
2011年M9.1日本东北、2014年M8.2伊基克和2021年M7.4玛多地震的独立贝叶斯滑动模型，以及2011年M9.1东北地震的WISP重反演数据。
2025年M7.8缅甸实皆断层超剪切走滑地震近场监控视频（CCTV）直接测量的破裂运动学基准数据。
测试两种不同子断层上升时间参数化方案的M8.78卡斯卡迪亚巨型逆冲地震合成运动学破裂模拟实验。
li: Most NEIC finite-fault models rely solely on teleseismic waveforms, which have limited high-frequency sensitivity and cannot reliably resolve short rise times (< 1–2 s) without dense near-field strong-motion stations.
Kinematic inversions suffer from trade-offs among slip, rise time, and rupture velocity, regularization effects, and potential numerical noise or artifacts, especially for smaller (M < 8) events.
WISP uses moment-tensor fault planes and a 1D velocity model without explicit 3D geological or topographic constraints, and normal-faulting earthquakes remain underrepresented (only 48 events).
Whether slip pulses are steady-state or growing during propagation cannot be conclusively resolved from composite multi-event scatter plots without normalized event-by-event analysis.
大多数NEIC模型仅依赖低频敏感的远震波形，在缺乏密集近场强震台网时难以可靠分辨小于1–2秒的短上升时间。
运动学反演存在滑动量、上升时间与破裂速度之间的折衷、正则化效应以及数值噪声或伪影，在较小震级（M < 8）事件中尤为明显。
WISP缺乏显式的地质或地形约束，且数据库中正断层地震样本较少（仅48个事件），限制了普适性结论。
由于不同震级和持续时间的混合效应，仅凭多事件散点图尚无法在不进行逐事件归一化分析的情况下确切区分稳态脉冲与生长脉冲。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates kinematic earthquake source scaling laws, rise times, slip rates, and pulse-like versus crack-like rupture behavior across 264 finite-fault models.

The authors evaluate how subfault rise-time assumptions alter peak slip rates by up to 50% in Cascadia kinematic rupture simulations, directly impacting high-frequency radiation and ground motion hazard.
The study uses Bayesian MCMC regression to estimate source scaling law posteriors and validates WISP finite-fault models against independent Bayesian inversions.

ev.notes: Full 44-page manuscript and Supporting Information PDF used, including main text, 8 main figures, Table S1, and 7 supplementary figures.

sum: This study presents an automatic workflow for detecting and classifying seismic events at Mount Etna, Italy. Utilizing PhaseNet and EQTransformer via the SeisBench platform, the authors perform automated P- and S-wave picking on continuous waveforms from January 2019 to June 2020. They systematically test several pretrained models, demonstrating that models trained on volcano-specific datasets significantly outperform those trained on tectonic-only data. To classify the detected events into volcano-tectonic (VT) and long-period (LP) categories, they implement a frequency-based algorithm using a modified frequency index. The workflow shows strong agreement with reviewed catalogs, highlighting the potential of pretrained deep learning models for semi-automated volcanic monitoring while emphasizing the necessity of site-specific validation.
本研究提出了一种用于意大利埃特纳火山地震事件自动检测和分类的工作流。该方法基于SeisBench平台，利用PhaseNet和EQTransformer对2019年1月至2020年6月的连续波形进行P波和S波自动拾取。通过测试多种预训练模型，发现火山特定数据集训练的模型性能显著优于仅用构造地震训练的模……

t: Automated P- and S-wave picking using PhaseNet and EQTransformer via SeisBench, combined with a modified frequency index algorithm for spectral classification of events.
利用SeisBench中的PhaseNet和EQTransformer进行自动震相拾取，并结合改进的频率指数算法进行事件…
Continuous seismic waveforms from Mount Etna, Italy, spanning January 2019 to June 2020, containing volcano-tectonic and long-period events.
意大利埃特纳火山2019年1月至2020年6月的连续地震波形，包含火山构造和长周期事件。
Models trained on volcano-specific datasets significantly outperform tectonic-only models, and the frequency-based classification shows strong agreement with reviewed catalogs.
火山数据集训练的模型性能显著优于构造模型，且基于频率的分类结果与人工目录高度一致。
Requires site-specific model validation and expert oversight to ensure reliable outcomes in complex volcanic settings.
在复杂的火山环境中，仍需要针对特定台站进行模型验证以及专家人工审核。
Systematic evaluation of SeisBench pretrained models on Mount Etna and integration of deep learning picking with a modified frequency index for automated classification.
系统评估了SeisBench预训练模型在埃特纳火山的效果，并将深度学习拾取与改进频率指数分类相结合。

kc: Developed an integrated deep learning workflow for automatic seismic phase picking and event association in active volcanic environments.
Demonstrated that pretrained deep learning models trained on volcano-specific datasets significantly outperform tectonic-trained models for volcanic event detection.
Implemented a modified frequency index algorithm to successfully classify detected events into volcano-tectonic (VT), long-period (LP), and other spectral types.
开发了一套集成深度学习的工作流，用于活动火山环境下的地震相自动拾取和事件关联。
证明了在火山特定数据集上训练的预训练模型在火山事件检测中显著优于仅在构造地震上训练的模型。
应用改进的频率指数算法，成功将检测到的事件分类为火山构造（VT）、长周期（LP）及其他频谱类型。
me: Utilized PhaseNet and EQTransformer via the open-source SeisBench platform for automated P- and S-wave arrival picking.
Evaluated and compared multiple pretrained deep learning models on continuous seismic waveforms.
Applied a frequency-based classification algorithm using a modified frequency index to distinguish event types based on spectral characteristics.
通过开源SeisBench平台利用PhaseNet和EQTransformer进行P波和S波到时的自动拾取。
在连续地震波形上评估并对比了多种预训练深度学习模型。
应用基于改进频率指数的频率分类算法，根据频谱特征区分不同的事件类型。
de: Used continuous seismic waveform data recorded at Mount Etna, Italy, from January 2019 to June 2020.
Analyzed both volcano-tectonic (VT) and long-period (LP) seismic events.
Validated the automated results against existing, manually reviewed seismic catalogs for Mount Etna.
使用了2019年1月至2020年6月期间意大利埃特纳火山记录的连续地震波形数据。
分析了火山构造（VT）和长周期（LP）地震事件。
将自动检测结果与现有的、经人工审核的埃特纳火山地震目录进行了对比验证。
li: Pretrained models require site-specific validation and cannot be applied blindly to new volcanic systems without performance assessment.
Expert oversight is still necessary to ensure reliable outcomes and correct potential false detections.
预训练模型需要针对特定台网进行验证，在未经性能评估的情况下不能盲目应用于新的火山系统。
仍需要专家监督以确保结果的可靠性并纠正潜在的误检。

tm.why: The paper evaluates deep learning tools like PhaseNet and EQTransformer for automatic picking and association of seismic phases.
The workflow is specifically designed and tested for detecting and classifying volcano-tectonic and long-period seismic events at Mount Etna.
The study focuses on the automatic detection and phase picking of seismic events to build or improve seismic catalogs.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from Seismological Research Letters and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study reports an extraordinary observation following the 2011 MW 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, where core-reflected shear waves (ScS) triggered a multiplate-interface slip event. The megathrust earthquake produced a strong ScS phase with peak-to-peak amplitudes exceeding 1 cm in Japan. Superposed on this waveform, GNSS data throughout Japan recorded an eastward steplike displacement of up to 5 to 6 mm. This displacement is attributed to slip on megathrust interfaces triggered nearly simultaneously by the arrival of the ScS wave. This newly recognized ScS-triggering mechanism represents a previously overlooked seismic hazard that can reactivate mainshock areas and surrounding megathrust interfaces.
本研究报道了2011年MW 9.0日本东北大地震后的一项重大发现：核幔边界反射剪切波（ScS）触发了多板块边界的滑动事件。该大地震在日本激发了峰值振幅超1厘米的强ScS震相。在波形叠加中，全日本的GNSS数据记录到了高达5至6毫米的向东阶跃式位移。该位移源于ScS波近乎同时抵达日本时触发的俯冲带界面……

t: Analysis of high-rate GNSS data and seismic waveforms to identify transient deformation superposed on the core-reflected ScS phase.
结合高频GNSS数据与地震波形分析，识别叠加在核幔反射ScS震相上的瞬态形变。
GNSS geodetic data and seismic waveforms across Japan capturing the 2011 MW 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake and its core-reflected ScS phase.
全日本的GNSS大地测量数据和地震波形数据，记录了2011年东北大地震及其ScS波。
Identification of an eastward steplike displacement of 5 to 6 mm recorded in GNSS data, indicating triggered slip on megathrust interfaces.
在GNSS数据中发现5至6毫米的向东阶跃式位移，表明ScS波触发了俯冲带界面滑动。
The analysis is focused on a single megathrust event, and the conditions required for such triggering remain to be fully generalized.
该研究仅针对单次特大地震，此类触发所需的具体物理条件仍需进一步推广研究。
Discovery of a previously unrecognized seismic hazard mechanism where core-reflected ScS waves trigger slip on megathrust interfaces.
首次发现核幔反射ScS波能够触发俯冲带界面滑动这一全新的地震灾害机制。

kc: Discovered that core-reflected ScS waves from a megathrust earthquake can trigger secondary slip on plate interfaces.
Identified an eastward steplike displacement of 5 to 6 mm in GNSS data across Japan superposed on the ScS waveform.
Revealed a previously unrecognized seismic hazard mechanism capable of reactivating megathrust interfaces.
首次发现大地震产生的核幔边界反射ScS波能够触发板块边界的二次滑动。
在全日本的GNSS数据中识别出叠加在ScS波形上的5至6毫米向东阶跃式位移。
揭示了一种全新且此前未被认识到的、能够重新激活俯冲带界面的地震灾害机制。
me: Analysis of high-rate GNSS displacement time series across Japan.
Seismic waveform analysis of the core-reflected ScS phase.
Modeling of triggered slip on multiplate megathrust interfaces.
分析全日本的高频GNSS位移时间序列。
对核幔边界反射ScS震相进行地震波形分析。
对多板块俯冲带界面上的触发滑动进行建模。
de: GNSS geodetic data recording deformation across Japan during and after the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake.
Seismic waveform data capturing the strong core-reflected ScS phase.
记录2011年东北大地震期间及之后全日本形变的GNSS大地测量数据。
捕获强核幔边界反射ScS震相的地震波形数据。
li: The study is based on a single extraordinary event (2011 Tohoku-Oki), and the general applicability to other subduction zones requires further observation.
该研究基于单次特大地震事件（2011年东北大地震），其在其他俯冲带的普适性仍需进一步观测验证。

tm.why: The paper analyzes a multiplate-interface slip event triggered by ScS waves following the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake.
It investigates triggered slip on megathrust interfaces, which is directly related to fault mechanics and triggering processes.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Science, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the lateral variations of heat flux across the Earth's core-mantle boundary (CMB). By analyzing the thermal and physical properties of the deep mantle, particularly beneath large low-shear-wave-velocity provinces (LLSVPs), the authors demonstrate that the CMB heat flux is highly heterogeneous. Crucially, the research suggests that the heat flux can become negative beneath these LLSVPs, meaning heat flows locally from the mantle back into the core, which has significant implications for core dynamics, geodynamo behavior, and mantle convection models.
本研究探讨了地球核幔边界（CMB）热流的横向变化。通过分析深部地幔（特别是大型低剪切波速度省 LLSVPs）的物理与热力学性质，作者展示了核幔边界热流具有高度的非均匀性。关键创新点在于，研究指出在这些低速省下方热流可能为负值，即热量局部从地幔倒流回地核。这一发现对理解地核动力学、地磁场发电机机制以及……

t: Numerical modeling of thermal transport and heat flux variations across the core-mantle boundary using mineral physics constraints.
利用矿物物理学约束，对跨越核幔边界的热输运和热流变化进行数值模拟。
Simulated thermal and seismic velocity profiles of the lower mantle, constrained by mineral physics and global seismic tomography models.
受矿物物理和全球地震断层扫描模型约束的下地幔热与地震波速模拟剖面。
Identification of negative heat flux zones beneath LLSVPs, where heat flows locally from the mantle into the core.
确定了LLSVPs下方存在负热流区域，即热量局部从地幔流入地核。
Relies on simplified assumptions of lower mantle mineralogy and thermal conductivity at extreme core-mantle boundary conditions.
依赖于极端核幔边界条件下下地幔矿物学和热导率的简化假设。
Demonstrating that heat flux can locally reverse direction (negative flux) beneath LLSVPs, challenging conventional uniform heat-loss models.
证实了LLSVPs下方的热流方向可以局部逆转（负热流），挑战了传统的均匀散热模型。

kc: Demonstrated that heat flux across the core-mantle boundary (CMB) is highly variable laterally.
Proposed that CMB heat flux can be negative beneath large low-shear-wave-velocity provinces (LLSVPs).
Provided new constraints on the thermal coupling between the Earth's core and deep mantle.
证实了跨越核幔边界（CMB）的热流在横向上具有高度可变性。
提出在大型低剪切波速度省（LLSVPs）下方，核幔边界热流可能为负值。
为地球核心与深部地幔之间的热耦合提供了新的约束条件。
me: Geodynamical modeling of core-mantle boundary thermal interactions.
Analysis of seismic velocity anomalies (LLSVPs) in relation to thermal conductivity and temperature gradients.
核幔边界热相互作用的地球动力学模拟。
结合热导率和温度梯度分析地震波速异常（LLSVPs）与热流的关系。
de: Numerical simulations and theoretical calculations of deep Earth thermal properties based on mineral physics and seismic observations.
基于矿物物理学和地震观测的地学深部热属性数值模拟与理论计算。
li: The exact thermal conductivity and mineralogical composition of LLSVPs remain subject to uncertainties in mineral physics data.
由于矿物物理学数据的不确定性，LLSVPs 的精确热导率和矿物组分仍存在一定限制。

tm.why: The paper investigates the heat flux across the core-mantle boundary beneath large low-shear-wave-velocity provinces (LLSVPs) in the deep mantle.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the published title, author list, and public metadata from Nature Geoscience (June 2026). No PDF was available, so figure analyses are omitted.

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric architecture beneath the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake doublet in southeastern Türkiye by integrating P- and S-wave receiver functions from 263 broadband and nodal stations with 3D magnetotelluric (MT) inversion from 50 broadband MT sites. The results reveal contrasting lithospheric structures beneath the two mainshocks. The first Mw 7.8 event nucleated within a high-resistivity domain featuring a sharp, shallow Moho (28–38 km) and shallow lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB, ~65 km) in the rigid Arabian plate. In contrast, the second Mw 7.7 event initiated near a steep resistivity boundary coinciding with a wider, deeper Moho and deeper LAB (60–100 km) in the weaker Anatolian block. Furthermore, several subvertical lithospheric-scale conductors (<100 Ω·m) extending from the deep crust to the upper mantle are identified along active fault traces, indicating mantle-rooted fluid pathways that mechanically weaken faults and control cascading earthquake sequences.
本研究结合263个宽频带和短周期节点台站的P波与S波接收函数及50个测点的三维大地电磁（MT）反演，揭示了2023年土耳其双震下方的岩石圈结构差异。首次Mw 7.8地震发震于阿拉伯板块的高阻区，具有尖锐且较浅的莫霍面和岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB，约65 km）；第二次Mw 7.7地震则起始于安纳托利……

t: The authors inverted 3D MT impedance and phase tensors using ModEM with galvanic distortion correction, and applied CCP stacking to P- and S-wave receiver functions to map the Moho and LAB.
利用ModEM对三维MT阻抗和相位张量进行带畸变校正反演，并对P波和S波接收函数进行CCP叠加成像莫霍面与LAB。
The dataset comprises 50 broadband MT sites deployed along three profiles in 2024, alongside 134 broadband seismic stations and 129 short-period nodal stations yielding 5499 PRFs and 3372 SRFs.
包含2024年布设的50个宽频带MT测点，以及134个宽频带台站和129个短周期节点台站提取的5499条PRF和3372…

The Arabian plate exhibits high resistivity, a sharp Moho (28–38 km), and a ~65 km LAB, whereas the Anatolian block shows a deeper LAB (60–100 km), weakened Moho amplitudes, and subvertical conductors (<100 Ω·m).
阿拉伯板块呈高阻、浅莫霍面和~65 km的LAB；安纳托利亚块体LAB更深（60–100 km），且断层下方存在<100…
MT sensitivity decreases at upper mantle depths (40–80 km), and migrated receiver function interface depths depend on the chosen 3D velocity model while LAB signals suffer from noise interference.
上地幔深度（40–80 km）MT分辨率降低，且接收函数偏移深度依赖参考速度模型，LAB信号易受噪声干扰。

This study provides the first MT dataset and integrated seismic-electrical lithospheric model across the 2023 Türkiye earthquake doublet, linking mantle-rooted fluid pathways to doublet nucleation and segmentation.
首次获得2023年土耳其双震区的MT数据并构建地震-电性联合岩石圈模型，揭示了地幔流体通道对双震的控制。

kc: Provides the first 3D electrical resistivity model of the lithosphere beneath the 2023 Türkiye earthquake doublet using 50 newly deployed broadband MT stations.
Maps high-resolution Moho and LAB topography across the Arabian plate and Anatolian block by combining 5499 PRFs and 3372 SRFs from broadband and dense nodal seismic arrays.
Identifies subvertical trans-lithospheric conductive channels (<100 Ω·m) beneath active faults and pull-apart basins, interpreted as mantle-rooted fluid migration pathways.

Proposes a two-stage lithospheric control mechanism where the first mainshock represents stress-driven failure of a rigid, resistive asperity, and the second is triggered along a fluid-weakened rheological boundary.
利用新布设的50个宽频带大地电磁测点，首次获得了2023年土耳其双震下方岩石圈的三维电性结构模型。
结合宽频带与密集节点台阵的5499条P波接收函数和3372条S波接收函数，精细刻画了跨越阿拉伯板块和安纳托利亚块体的莫霍面与LAB起伏。
在活动断层和拉分盆地下方识别出近垂直的穿岩石圈高导通道（<100 Ω·m），揭示了源自地幔的流体运移路径。
提出了双震的两阶段岩石圈控制机制：主震1为刚性高阻凹凸体的应力驱动破裂，主震2则在流体弱化的流变边界处被触发。
me: 3D magnetotelluric inversion of full impedance and phase tensors using ModEM with simultaneous galvanic distortion correction and ocean coast effect modeling.
Iterative time-domain deconvolution for P-wave receiver functions (PRFs) and generalized GC_SRF strategy for S-wave receiver functions (SRFs).
Common conversion point (CCP) volumetric stacking of PRFs and SRFs using the IASP91 velocity model with 3D velocity model comparisons.
使用ModEM程序对全阻抗张量和相位张量进行三维大地电磁反演，同时校正电流畸变并考虑海洋海岸效应。
采用时间域迭代反褶积方法提取P波接收函数（PRF），并利用广义GC_SRF策略提取S波接收函数（SRF）。
基于IASP91速度模型对PRF和SRF进行共转换点（CCP）三维叠加成像，并与三维速度模型进行对比验证。
de: 50 broadband magnetotelluric sites deployed in summer 2024 along three NW-trending profiles across the EAFZ and doublet epicenters (0.005–5000 s period).
134 permanent/temporary broadband seismic stations (YB and KO networks) and 129 short-period 5 Hz SmartSolo nodal stations (YA network, deployed May–August 2023).
5499 quality-controlled PRFs (epicentral distances 30°–90°, M > 5.5) and 3372 SRFs (epicentral distances 50°–90°, M > 5.5).
Sensitivity tests replacing deep crustal and upper mantle conductors with 200 Ω·m background resistivity to verify depth resolution.
2024年夏季沿三条穿过东安纳托利亚断裂带和双震震中的北西向测线布设的50个宽频带MT测点数据（周期0.005–5000 s）。
134个宽频带地震台站（YB和KO台网）以及2023年5-8月布设的129个5 Hz SmartSolo短周期节点台站（YA台网）。
经过严格质量控制的5499条高质量PRF（震中距30°–90°，M > 5.5）和3372条SRF（震中距50°–90°，M > 5.5）。
通过将深部地壳和上地幔高导体替换为200 Ω·m背景电阻率进行敏感性测试，以验证深部结构的分辨率。
li: MT resolution is reduced at uppermost mantle depths (40–80 km), where removing conductors yields only a subtle (14%) increase in RMS misfit.
LAB signals in receiver functions are weaker than Moho conversions and susceptible to noise interference, making them difficult to identify at individual stations without CCP stacking.
Migrated depths of lithospheric interfaces in CCP stacking are dependent on the assumed reference velocity model.
大地电磁在上地幔顶部（40–80 km）的分辨率有所降低，移除该深度的导体仅引起14%的均方根误差上升。
接收函数中的LAB信号比莫霍面转换波弱且易受噪声干扰，若不进行CCP叠加很难在单台记录中直接识别。
CCP叠加中岩石圈界面的偏移深度受所选取的参考速度模型影响。

tm.why: The study calculates 5499 P-wave and 3372 S-wave receiver functions and uses common conversion point (CCP) stacking to image the Moho and lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB).

The paper integrates seismic receiver functions and 3D magnetotelluric imaging to reveal contrasting lithospheric structures and mantle-rooted fluid pathways across the Arabian plate and Anatolian block.

The paper links deep lithospheric structural heterogeneity and fluid distribution to the nucleation, delayed triggering, and cascading rupture segmentation of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake doublet.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF provided and analyzed, including abstract, main text, 7 figures, and references.

sum: This study presents the first systematic test of lower mantle viscosity against dynamic topography, the geoid, and seismic heterogeneity using high-resolution, time-dependent mantle circulation models (MCMs) that assimilate tectonic histories. The authors show that model density structure and seismic heterogeneity fits depend strongly on the assumed viscosity profile. While lowering viscosity in the upper lower mantle (660-2000 km) reduces the typically overestimated dynamic topography amplitudes, it degrades the fit to the geoid and seismic heterogeneity. Their preferred viscosity profile successfully matches observed geoid amplitudes and S40RTS seismic heterogeneity. Additionally, incorporating a tomography-refined Pacific tectonic reconstruction improves geoid correlation by approximately 20%.
本研究首次利用同化板块构造历史的高分辨率时变地幔环流模型（MCMs），系统测试了下地幔粘度对动态地形、大地水准面和地震非均匀性的影响。研究表明，模型密度结构和地震非均匀性拟合高度依赖于粘度剖面。降低上部下地幔（660-2000 km）的粘度虽能降低通常被高估的动态地形振幅，但会降低对大地水准面和地震……

t: High-resolution, time-dependent mantle circulation models (MCMs) that assimilate tectonic histories to predict present-day mantle density structure, dynamic topography, the geoid, and seismic heterogeneity.
同化构造历史的高分辨率时变地幔环流模型，用于预测现今地幔密度、动态地形和大地水准面。
Global observations of dynamic topography, geoid amplitudes, seismic heterogeneity from the S40RTS tomography model, and alternative tectonic reconstructions.
全球动态地形、大地水准面观测数据，S40RTS地震层析成像模型及修正的板块构造重建方案。

A preferred viscosity profile fits geoid amplitudes and S40RTS heterogeneity; a tomography-refined Pacific tectonic reconstruction improves geoid correlation by ~20%, though reducing dynamic topography degrades other fits.
优选粘度剖面极好地拟合了大地水准面和S40RTS；层析成像修正的板块重建使大地水准面相关性提高20%。
MCMs typically overestimate dynamic topography amplitudes, and reducing them by lowering upper lower mantle viscosity degrades geoid and seismic heterogeneity fits.
模型通常高估动态地形振幅，通过降低粘度来修正该问题会降低大地水准面和地震拟合度。
The first systematic test of lower mantle viscosity against dynamic topography, the geoid, and seismic heterogeneity using high-resolution, history-assimilating MCMs.
首次利用高分辨率时变地幔环流模型，系统测试下地幔粘度对多种独立地球物理观测的影响。

kc: Conducted the first systematic test of lower mantle viscosity using high-resolution, time-dependent mantle circulation models (MCMs) against multiple independent observables.
Demonstrated that lowering viscosity in the upper lower mantle (660-2000 km) reduces dynamic topography overestimation but degrades geoid and seismic heterogeneity fits.
Identified a preferred mantle viscosity profile that provides an excellent fit to both observed geoid amplitudes and S40RTS seismic heterogeneity.
Showed that incorporating tomography-based refinements in Pacific tectonic reconstructions improves geoid correlation by approximately 20%.
首次利用高分辨率时变地幔环流模型（MCMs），针对多种独立观测数据系统测试了下地幔粘度。
证明了降低上部下地幔（660-2000 km）的粘度虽能减少动态地形的高估，但会降低大地水准面和地震非均匀性的拟合度。
确定了一个优选的地幔粘度剖面，该剖面能极好地拟合观测到的大地水准面振幅和S40RTS地震非均匀性。
表明在太平洋板块重建中引入基于层析成像的修正可将大地水准面相关性提高约20%。
me: Time-dependent mantle circulation modeling (MCM) with assimilation of tectonic reconstruction histories.
Joint evaluation of model predictions against dynamic topography, geoid, and seismic heterogeneity (e.g., S40RTS).
Sensitivity testing of viscosity profiles in the lower mantle (660-2000 km depth).
同化板块构造重建历史的时变地幔环流模拟（MCM）。
结合动态地形、大地水准面和地震非均匀性（如S40RTS）对模型预测进行联合评估。
下地幔（660-2000 km深度）粘度剖面的敏感性测试。
de: High-resolution global mantle circulation simulations.
Observational datasets of the Earth's geoid and dynamic topography.
Global seismic tomography model S40RTS for seismic heterogeneity comparison.
Alternative tectonic reconstruction models, including tomography-based refinements around the Pacific.
高分辨率全球地幔环流模拟。
地球大地水准面和动态地形的观测数据集。
用于地震非均匀性对比的全球地震层析成像模型S40RTS。
备选的板块构造重建模型，包括基于层析成像的太平洋周边修正模型。
li: Reducing dynamic topography amplitudes via lower viscosity in the upper lower mantle comes at the expense of poorer fits to the geoid and/or seismic heterogeneity.
MCMs still systematically overestimate dynamic topography amplitudes under standard viscosity assumptions.
通过降低上部下地幔粘度来减小动态地形振幅，是以牺牲大地水准面和/或地震非均匀性的拟合度为代价的。
在标准粘度假设下，地幔环流模型仍系统性地高估了动态地形振幅。

tm.why: The paper uses mantle circulation models to constrain mantle viscosity by comparing predictions against dynamic topography, the geoid, and seismic heterogeneity.
The study evaluates mantle circulation models against seismic heterogeneity from tomography models like S40RTS and tests tomography-based tectonic reconstructions.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from OpenAlex, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the onset and duration of thermal overturn in the early Moon during the crystallization of the lunar magma ocean. By incorporating a flow-through interface that allows material exchange via melting and crystallization at the magma ocean-cumulates boundary, the authors perform linear stability analyses and direct numerical simulations. They demonstrate that thermal overturn can initiate well before the final stages of magma ocean solidification, with durations ranging from ten thousand to tens of millions of years. The dominant degree-one convective mode could significantly influence early crustal growth asymmetry and potentially drive an early lunar core dynamo.
本研究探讨了月球岩浆洋结晶过程中早期月球热翻转的触发与持续时间。通过引入允许在岩浆洋与累积岩边界进行熔融-结晶物质交换的流过边界条件，作者开展了线性稳定性分析和直接数值模拟。结果表明，热翻转可在岩浆洋完全固结前很久就触发，持续时间从一万年到数千万年不等。占主导地位的一阶球谐函数对流模式可能显著影响早……

t: Linear stability analysis and direct numerical simulations of mantle convection incorporating a flow-through boundary condition at the magma ocean-cumulates interface.
结合岩浆洋-累积岩界面流过边界条件的月幔对流线性稳定性分析与直接数值模拟。
Synthetic data generated from numerical simulations of early lunar mantle convection and thermal evolution parameters.
通过模拟早期月球地幔对流和热演化参数生成的合成模拟数据。
Thermal overturn can initiate early and last from 10,000 years to tens of millions of years, dominated by a degree-one spherical harmonic mode.
热翻转可在早期触发并持续一万年至数千万年，且由一阶球谐函数对流模式主导。
The duration and convective mode depend heavily on the efficiency of the flow-through interface and the Rayleigh number.
翻转持续时间和对流模式高度取决于流过界面的效率以及瑞利数的大小。
Demonstrating that thermal overturn can occur prior to the final crystallization of the dense ilmenite-rich layer due to flow-through boundary effects.
证明了由于流过边界效应，热翻转可在富钛铁矿致密层最终结晶前触发。

kc: Demonstrated that lunar thermal overturn can initiate early during magma ocean crystallization rather than only at the very end.
Incorporated a realistic flow-through boundary condition allowing melting and crystallization at the cumulate interface.
Showed that the dominant degree-one convective mode can explain early crustal asymmetry and potentially power an early lunar dynamo.
证明了月球热翻转可在岩浆洋结晶早期触发，而非仅在最末期发生。
引入了允许在累积岩边界进行熔融和结晶的流过边界条件。
表明占主导地位的一阶对流模式可以解释早期月壳的不对称性，并可能为早期月球发电机提供动力。
me: Linear stability analysis of thermal convection in the lunar cumulate mantle.
Direct numerical simulations of mantle convection with a flow-through boundary condition.
月球累积岩地幔热对流的线性稳定性分析。
采用流过边界条件的月幔对流直接数值模拟。
de: Numerical experiments and theoretical scaling laws simulating the thermal evolution of the lunar magma ocean and cumulates.
模拟月球岩浆洋和累积岩热演化的数值实验与理论标度律。
li: The model relies on simplified thermodynamic assumptions regarding the melting-crystallization kinetics at the boundary.
该模型依赖于关于边界处熔融-结晶动力学的简化热力学假设。

tm.why: The paper models mantle convection, thermal overturn, and magma ocean crystallization in the early Moon.
The study focuses on planetary geodynamics, specifically the early thermal and structural evolution of the Moon.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from EPSL and Crossref.

sum: This study evaluates Google's Android Earthquake Alert (AEA) system during the April 23, 2025, Mw 6.2 Marmara Ereğlisi, Türkiye earthquake. Leveraging stationary smartphone accelerometers, AEA detected the offshore earthquake 5.31 seconds after origin—faster than traditional regional stations due to dense coastal phone concentrations—and issued alerts to over 16 million users. Using USGS ShakeMaps, Google Search felt surveys, and EMSC/DYFI reports as ground truth, the authors show that 'Be Aware' alerts (targeting MMI ≥ III) achieved a 90% true positive rate, 99% precision, and a median warning time of 56 seconds. However, magnitude saturation at Mw 6.04 caused a 99% false negative rate for high-tier 'Take Action' alerts (targeting MMI ≥ V). Analysis of 67,056 user feedback surveys reveals that 46.4% of recipients took active protective measures (e.g., Drop, Cover, Hold On or warning others), demonstrating that timely warnings significantly boost protective actions and future user trust.
本研究评估了谷歌安卓地震预警（AEA）系统在2025年土耳其马尔马拉6.2级地震中的表现与用户反馈。利用密集分布的智能手机加速度计，系统在震后5.31秒即完成检测（早于传统台网），并向超过1600万用户发送预警。结合震动图与震感调查评估显示，针对弱震（MMI≥III）的“注意”预警达到了90%的真阳……

t: Stationary charging Android smartphones detect P/S arrivals via accelerometers and stream data to servers to estimate source parameters. Performance is evaluated on 20-km population grids and via chi-square tests on 67,056 user surveys.
利用静止充电手机加速度计检测P/S波并由云端估算震源参数；通过20公里人口网格和6.7万份问卷卡方检验评估性能。

Data include waveforms from ~66,000 triggered Android phones, AFAD seismic stations, USGS/INGV ShakeMaps, 239,779 Google Search felt responses, 67,056 in-alert user surveys, and 55 USGS DYFI questionnaires.
包含约6.6万部触发手机与AFAD台网波形、震动图、24万份搜索震感回复、6.7万份用户调查及55份DYFI问卷。

AEA detected the quake in 5.31 s, alerting >16M users. 'Be Aware' alerts achieved 90% true positives, 99% precision, and 56 s median warning time. 46.4% of surveyed users took active protective responses, and 92% rated alerts useful.
震后5.31秒检出并预警超1600万人；弱震预警真阳性率90%、精度99%、中位提前56秒；46.4%用户积极避险。
Magnitude saturation at Mw 6.04 caused 99% false negatives for 'Take Action' (MMI V) alerts, and phone handling/coda waves caused missed alerts for immediate aftershocks.
震级饱和于6.04导致强震（MMI V）高级预警漏报率达99%，且尾波干扰与手机操作导致紧随的余震漏报。

Provides a large-scale real-world evaluation of smartphone EEW during an offshore event, demonstrating faster detection than coastal stations and statistically linking warning timeliness to high protective action and user trust.
首次针对近海强震开展大规模手机预警实测与行为统计，证实密集手机比沿海台站更快检出且及时预警显著提升避险率与信任。

kc: Demonstrated that dense coastal smartphone networks detected an offshore Mw 6.2 earthquake faster (5.31 s) than conventional regional seismic stations.
Quantified population-level alerting performance for weak shaking ('Be Aware', MMI ≥ III) at 90% true positive rate, 99% precision, and 56 s median lead time.
Identified a critical performance gap where magnitude underestimation (Mw 6.04 vs 6.2) caused 99% false negatives for inland 'Take Action' (MMI ≥ V) alerts.
Analyzed over 67,000 user surveys to show 46.4% active protective responses, linking pre-shaking alert timeliness directly to perceived utility and future trust.
证明了沿海密集分布的智能手机网络比传统区域地震台网更早（5.31秒）检测到近海6.2级地震。
量化了人群层面的弱震（“注意”级别，MMI ≥ III）预警表现：真阳性率达90%，精确度99%，中位预警时间56秒。
揭示了由于震级低估（估计为6.04级而非6.2级）导致内陆强震（“采取行动”级别，MMI ≥ V）预警出现99%漏报的关键缺陷。
分析了超过6.7万份用户调查，发现46.4%的用户采取了积极避险响应，证实震前预警的及时性直接决定了感知有用性和未来信任度。
me: On-device P/S-wave triggering using stationary three-axis smartphone accelerometers coupled with server-side spatio-temporal source parameter estimation.
Spatial grid-based (level 8 s2cells, ~20 km) population exposure evaluation comparing alert polygons against composite ground truth shaking (ShakeMaps, DYFI, EMSC, Google Search survey).
Nonparametric statistical analysis (Pearson chi-square tests and Cramer's V effect sizes) of voluntary in-alert user feedback and USGS DYFI questionnaires.
利用静止状态下的智能手机三轴加速度计进行端侧P/S波触发检测，并结合云端服务器进行时空震源参数估计。
基于空间网格（约20公里的s2cells）的人口暴露评估法，将预警多边形与综合真实震动分布（ShakeMaps、DYFI、EMSC及谷歌搜索调查）进行对比。
对自愿提交的预警内置用户反馈和USGS DYFI补充问卷进行非参数统计分析（皮尔逊卡方检验与Cramer's V效应量）。
de: Acceleration waveforms and trigger times from ~66,000 online Android phones and regional AFAD strong-motion/seismic stations.
Ground truth macroseismic intensity data from USGS and INGV ShakeMaps, USGS DYFI, EMSC felt reports, and 239,779 Google Search survey responses.
67,056 in-alert Android user feedback surveys and 55 supplemental USGS DYFI EEW questionnaires, plus global comparative AEA response datasets.
来自约6.6万部在线安卓手机和土耳其AFAD区域地震台网的加速度波形与触发时间数据。
来自USGS和INGV震动图、USGS DYFI、EMSC震感报告以及239,779份谷歌搜索调查回复的真实宏观地震烈度数据。
67,056份安卓预警内置用户反馈调查、55份USGS DYFI预警补充问卷，以及全球多国AEA用户响应对比数据集。
li: Magnitude saturation at Mw 6.04 underestimated the Mw 6.2 mainshock, causing 99% false negatives for the 'Take Action' (MMI V) alert tier.
The system underestimated and failed to issue alerts for immediate M4.5–M5.3 aftershocks due to coda wave contamination, overlapping 1-minute time windows, and user phone handling.
User feedback surveys rely on nonrandom, self-selected respondents, introducing potential selection and subjective perception biases.
震级估计在Mw 6.04发生饱和，低估了Mw 6.2主震，导致针对MMI V区域的“采取行动”高级别预警出现99%的漏报。
受尾波干扰、1分钟时间窗口重叠以及主震后用户拿起手机操作的影响，系统低估并漏报了随后的M4.5–M5.3级余震。
用户反馈调查依赖于非随机的自愿受访者，存在潜在的样本选择偏差和主观感知偏差。

tm.why: The paper evaluates an earthquake early warning system (AEA) designed to mitigate seismic hazard and notify users before strong ground shaking arrives.
It examines real-time P- and S-wave detection, hypocenter localization, and magnitude estimation using a crowd-sourced smartphone accelerometer network.
It utilizes a massive, distributed sensing network of low-cost three-axis smartphone accelerometers and compares them against traditional AFAD seismic stations.

ev.notes: Full 39-page PDF (including main text, Table 1, Figures 1–7, and Supplementary Materials Tables S1–S2 and Figures S1–S7) was read and used as primary evidence.

sum: This study presents a deep learning-based workflow for 3D seismic fault segmentation in complex pre-salt carbonate reservoirs, specifically applied to broadband ocean-bottom node (OBN) data from the Búzios Field, Brazil. To overcome training data limitations, the authors generate synthetic training datasets using point-spread function (PSF) convolution to mimic realistic seismic illumination and frequency characteristics. A 3D U-Net is trained for binary fault segmentation, and its predictions are further enhanced using an edge-preserving smoothing filter guided by the predicted fault probability volume. This workflow successfully identifies major and subtle fault trends, outperforming conventional coherence-based methods by reducing artifacts and improving discontinuity continuity.
本研究提出了一种针对复杂盐下碳酸盐岩储层（巴西Búzios油田宽频海床节点OBN数据）的三维地震断层分割深度学习工作流。为克服训练数据限制，研究采用点扩散函数（PSF）卷积生成合成训练集，以模拟真实的地震照明与频率特征。利用3D U-Net进行二分类断层分割，并结合断层概率体指导的边缘保持平滑滤波进……

t: A 3D U-Net architecture trained with balanced cross-entropy loss for binary fault segmentation, combined with a post-prediction edge-preserving smoothing filter guided by the fault probability volume.
采用平衡交叉熵损失训练的3D U-Net进行断层分割，并结合断层概率体指导的边缘保持平滑滤波进行后处理。
Synthetic training data generated via point-spread function (PSF) convolution, applied to real broadband ocean-bottom node (OBN) seismic data from the Búzios Field in the Brazilian pre-salt.
利用点扩散函数（PSF）卷积生成的合成训练数据，并应用于巴西盐下Búzios油田的真实宽频OBN地震数据。

The workflow successfully identified major and small-to-medium displacement faults, reducing artifacts and enhancing the continuity of subtle discontinuities compared to conventional coherence-based methods.
成功识别了主干及中小位移断层，相比传统相干方法显著减少了伪影并增强了微细不连续性的连续性。
The workflow's reliance on synthetic training data requires accurate PSF modeling to match the complex illumination and frequency characteristics of the target pre-salt reservoir.
该工作流依赖于合成训练数据，需要精确的PSF建模以匹配目标盐下储层复杂的照明与频率特征。

Combining PSF-convolved synthetic data generation with 3D U-Net segmentation and fault-guided edge-preserving smoothing to improve fault delineation in highly structured pre-salt carbonate reservoirs.
将PSF卷积合成数据生成、3D U-Net分割与断层引导的边缘保持平滑相结合，提升了复杂盐下储层的断层识别精度。

kc: Developed a 3D U-Net deep learning workflow tailored for fault segmentation in complex pre-salt carbonate reservoirs.
Introduced point-spread function (PSF) convolution to generate highly realistic synthetic training data that matches OBN seismic characteristics.
Implemented a post-prediction preconditioning workflow using fault-probability-guided edge-preserving smoothing to enhance continuity.
开发了针对复杂盐下碳酸盐岩储层断层分割的3D U-Net深度学习工作流。
引入点扩散函数（PSF）卷积生成高度逼真的合成训练数据，以匹配OBN地震特征。
实现了基于断层概率指导的边缘保持平滑后处理工作流，以增强断层连续性。
me: Synthetic training data generation using Point-Spread Function (PSF) convolution.
3D U-Net convolutional neural network architecture for binary fault segmentation.
Balanced cross-entropy loss function to address class imbalance between fault and non-fault pixels.
Edge-preserving smoothing filter guided by the predicted fault probability volume.
使用点扩散函数（PSF）卷积生成合成训练数据。
用于二分类断层分割的3D U-Net卷积神经网络架构。
采用平衡交叉熵损失函数解决断层与非断层像素之间的类别不平衡问题。
由预测的断层概率体指导的边缘保持平滑滤波器。
de: Synthetic seismic datasets generated via PSF convolution to simulate pre-salt imaging conditions.
Real 3D broadband ocean-bottom node (OBN) seismic data from the Búzios Field in the Brazilian pre-salt province.
通过PSF卷积生成的合成地震数据集，用以模拟盐下成像条件。
来自巴西盐下盆地Búzios油田的真实三维宽频海床节点（OBN）地震数据。

PSF卷积合成训练数据的性能取决于估计的点扩散函数和速度模型的准确性。

The application is specifically tailored to fault delineation in a highly structured pre-salt carbonate reservoir (Búzios Field).

sum: This study investigates dynamically triggered seismicity in Nevada from 2008 to 2023 using a newly compiled high-resolution local earthquake catalog (182,880 events with ML ≤ 5) and 247 global teleseismic events (Mw ≥ 7). By applying beta- and Z-statistics within 6-hour windows across 0.1°×0.1° spatial bins, the authors identify 94 triggered earthquakes across eight clusters in four distinct regions, triggered by nine teleseismic events. Among the triggered events, 75% (70) are delayed and 22% (21) are instantaneously triggered by Rayleigh waves, suggesting that subsurface pore-fluid interactions drive triggering susceptibility. The authors also introduce a normalized triggering variance (TV) metric and evaluate peak dynamic stress (PDS) from 179 broadband stations. Spatially, the triggered clusters exhibit a modest positive correlation with geothermal injection/production wells and oil/gas production wells, demonstrating that dynamic triggering analysis can help identify critically stressed faults near anthropogenic operations.
本研究利用内华达州2008至2023年的高分辨率地震目录（182,880个ML≤5事件）和247个全球远震事件（Mw≥7），结合179个宽频带台站波形计算的峰值动态应力，采用β和Z统计量及新提出的归一化触发方差（TV）评估了动态地震触发。研究在四个区域的8个簇中识别出由9个远震触发的94次地方震。其……

t: The study divides Nevada into 0.1°×0.1° geographic bins and computes beta- and Z-statistics using 6-hour windows before and after teleseismic S-wave arrivals to identify seismicity rate increases at the 99% confidence level.
将内华达划分为0.1°网格，计算远震S波到时前后6小时窗的β和Z统计量，以99%置信度识别触发。

Analyzes 182,880 local earthquakes (ML ≤ 5) from Trugman's (2024) relocated Nevada catalog alongside 247 global teleseisms (Mw ≥ 7, 2008–2023), broadband waveforms from 179 stations, and 753 geothermal and 743 oil/gas well records.
使用2008-2023年182,880个地方震、247个全球远震、179个台站波形及地热和油气井数据。

Nine teleseisms dynamically triggered 94 local earthquakes across eight clusters in four regions of Nevada. Of these, 70 (75%) were delayed and 21 (22%) were instantaneously triggered by Rayleigh waves, mildly correlating with well density.
9个远震在8个簇触发94次地震，75%为延迟触发，22%为瑞利波触发，与井密度弱相关。

Publicly accessible fluid injection records are sparse in Nevada, small triggering sample sizes (9 teleseisms) limit parametric trends, and statistical tests remain susceptible to false positives from coincidental background swarms.
缺乏公开注采体积记录，触发远震样本少（9个），且统计方法易受背景震群假阳性影响。

First comprehensive statewide assessment of dynamic earthquake triggering in Nevada using a newly compiled high-resolution relocated catalog (2008–2023), linking triggered clusters to geothermal and hydrocarbon well distributions and introducing normalized triggering variance.
首次利用高分辨率目录系统评估内华达全州动态触发，关联地热与油气井分布并提出归一化触发方差。

kc: Identified 94 dynamically triggered earthquakes across eight clusters in four distinct regions of Nevada from 2008 to 2023 using a high-resolution catalog.
Demonstrated that 75% of triggered events are delayed and 22% coincide with Rayleigh waves, pointing to fluid-driven triggering mechanisms.
Observed a qualitative modest positive spatial correlation between dynamically triggered clusters and geothermal and hydrocarbon well densities.
Introduced a normalized triggering variance (TV) metric to compare relative triggering susceptibility across teleseismic events.
利用高分辨率地震目录识别出2008至2023年间内华达州四个区域8个簇中的94次动态触发地震。
证明75%的触发事件为延迟触发，22%与瑞利波一致，表明流体驱动的触发机制占主导。
发现动态触发地震簇与地热及油气井密度之间存在定性的弱空间正相关。
引入了归一化触发方差（TV）指标，用于比较不同远震事件的相对触发敏感性。
me: Spatial binning of the local earthquake catalog into 2421 geographic bins of 0.1° × 0.1°.
Statistical rate-change detection using beta-statistic and Z-statistic with 6-hour pre- and post-S-wave arrival windows at a 99% confidence threshold (≥ 3.0).
Peak ground velocity (PGV) and peak dynamic stress (PDS) calculation from instrument-corrected waveforms across 179 broadband stations.
Phase arrival window classification into S, Love (4.5 km/s), Rayleigh (4.0 km/s), and post-coda delayed (< 1.2 km/s) triggering.
Normalized triggering variance (TV) calculation combining beta- and Z-statistics to evaluate mainshock triggering characteristics.
将地方地震目录按0.1°×0.1°划分为2421个地理网格。
使用S波到时前后6小时时间窗计算β和Z统计量，以99%置信度（≥3.0）检测地震活动率变化。
基于179个宽频带台站仪器响应校正后的波形计算峰值地面速度（PGV）和峰值动态应力（PDS）。
根据理论震相到时和群速度将触发事件分类为S波、勒夫波（4.5 km/s）、瑞利波（4.0 km/s）瞬时触发及尾波后延迟触发（<1.2 km/s）。
计算结合β和Z统计量的归一化触发方差（TV）以评估主震触发特征。
de: High-resolution relocated local earthquake catalog for Nevada (Trugman, 2024) containing 182,880 events (ML ≤ 5) from 2008 to 2023.
USGS ANSS Comprehensive Catalog of 247 global teleseismic events (Mw ≥ 7) from 2008 to 2023.
Three-component broadband seismic waveforms from 179 unique stations across 12 networks in Nevada.
Historical dataset of 753 geothermal wells and 743 oil and gas wells from the Nevada Division of Minerals Open Data Site.
2008至2023年内华达州高分辨率重定位地方地震目录（Trugman, 2024），包含182,880个ML≤5事件。
USGS ANSS综合目录中2008至2023年的247个全球远震事件（Mw≥7）。
内华达州12个台网共179个宽频带台站的三分量地震波形数据。
内华达州矿产局开放数据网站的753口历史地热井和743口油气井数据集。
li: Detailed fluid injection and production volume/pressure records in Nevada are sparsely available for public access, limiting quantitative correlation.
Surface-wave dispersion and overlapping arrival windows between Love and Rayleigh waves may introduce minor phase classification uncertainties.
Statistical rate-change methods (beta and Z) remain inherently susceptible to false-positive identifications from coincidental local swarm activity.
The small sample size of triggering teleseismic events (only 9) limits robust statistical characterization of the relationship between PDS and TV.
内华达州缺乏公开的详细流体注入和开采体积/压力记录，限制了定量相关性分析。
勒夫波与瑞利波的频散及到时窗重叠可能引入轻微的震相分类不确定性。
统计速率变化方法（β和Z）本质上仍易受巧合的地方震群活动引起的假阳性影响。
触发远震事件的样本量较小（仅9个），限制了对PDS与TV关系的稳健统计定性。

tm.why: The study investigates the spatial correlation between dynamically triggered seismicity and geothermal, oil, and gas injection/production wells in Nevada.
The paper analyzes dynamic triggering mechanisms caused by passing teleseismic waves, highlighting pore-fluid pressure fluctuations and fault stress states.
The analysis directly leverages a newly published, high-resolution relocated earthquake catalog for Nevada to detect seismicity rate changes.

ev.notes: Full 13-page BSSA accepted manuscript PDF (LA-UR-26-20286) was read and analyzed in full, including all 7 figures and Table 1.

sum: This paper presents a Bayesian-inspired workflow for prestack amplitude-variation-with-angle (AVA) elastic parameter inversion using a guided diffusion model. An unconditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) is pretrained on 5,000 synthetic and well-log-derived models to learn the non-Gaussian joint distribution of P-wave velocity, S-wave velocity, and density. At inference, Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) injects data-consistency gradients computed via a linearized Aki-Richards forward operator at each reverse diffusion step without retraining. Tested on the out-of-distribution 2D Otway synthetic benchmark and Poseidon field data from Australia, DPS achieves higher structural similarity (SSIM) and sharper lithological boundaries than LSQR and ADMM with total-variation regularization. Generating multiple posterior realizations enables spatially resolved 2D uncertainty quantification. However, benchmarking against the closed-form analytical Bayesian solution of Buland and Omre reveals that DPS uncertainty bands are systematically overconfident by one to two orders of magnitude due to likelihood-gradient collapse and prior concentration.
本文提出一种结合引导扩散模型的叠前地震角道集弹性参数反演方法。首先利用基准模型与测井合成数据无监督预训练去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），学习纵波速度、横波速度和密度的非高斯联合先验分布；随后在反向扩散过程中采用扩散后验采样（DPS），通过Aki-Richards线性正演算子注入数据一致性梯度，无需重新……

t: Pretrains an unconditional 2D U-Net DDPM on three-channel elastic models (Vp, Vs, density) and guides reverse diffusion via Diffusion Posterior Sampling using gradients of a linearized Aki-Richards AVA forward operator.
利用三通道弹性模型预训练2D U-Net扩散模型，并在反向采样中通过Aki-Richards正演算子梯度执行扩散后验采样…

Trained on 5,000 synthetic and well-log elastic models (SEAM Arid, Overthrust, Marmousi2) and evaluated on the 2D Otway synthetic model and Poseidon field angle-stack data from Browse Basin, Australia.
使用5000个合成与测井弹性模型训练，并在2D Otway合成数据和澳大利亚Poseidon实际角道集数据上进行测试验证…

On the Otway benchmark, DPS achieves the highest structural similarity across all three parameters (SSIM = 0.841 for Vp, 0.752 for Vs, 0.842 for density), outperforming LSQR and ADMM+TV in structural continuity.
在Otway测试中，DPS在三个参数上均取得最高结构相似性（SSIM分别为0.841、0.752、0.842），横向连续…

DPS posterior uncertainty bands are systematically overconfident (1–2 orders of magnitude smaller than the mean) compared to the exact analytical Bayesian posterior covariance, and the linearized Aki-Richards operator restricts wide-angle accuracy.
相比解析贝叶斯基准，DPS不确定性区间系统性偏窄（过度自信），且线性Aki-Richards算子限制了广角和强对比度精度…

Combines an unsupervised three-parameter elastic diffusion prior with Aki-Richards likelihood guidance via DPS and critically benchmarks the resulting 2D ensemble uncertainty against closed-form analytical Bayesian inversion.
将无监督多参数弹性扩散先验与Aki-Richards似然引导相结合，并首次与解析贝叶斯反演系统对比了不确定性校准度。

kc: Develops a diffusion-based framework for simultaneous AVA inversion of Vp, Vs, and density using Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS).
Integrates a linearized Aki-Richards forward operator as likelihood guidance during reverse diffusion without task-specific retraining.
Validates superior structural recovery (SSIM) over LSQR and ADMM+TV baselines on 2D Otway synthetic data and Poseidon field data.
Benchmarks DPS ensemble uncertainty against closed-form analytical Bayesian covariance, revealing systematic overconfidence in DPS uncertainty bands.
开发了基于扩散后验采样（DPS）的叠前角道集纵波速度、横波速度和密度同步反演框架。
将基于Aki-Richards近似的线性AVA正演算子作为似然引导项嵌入反向扩散过程，无需针对特定任务重新训练先验模型。
在2D Otway合成数据和Poseidon实际地震数据上验证了该方法比LSQR和ADMM+TV具有更优的结构恢复能力（SSIM更高）。
将DPS集合不确定性与解析贝叶斯后验协方差进行基准对比，揭示了DPS不确定性区间存在系统性过度自信的特征。
me: Unconditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) with a 2D U-Net backbone trained on normalized three-channel elastic models (Vp, Vs, density).
Linearized three-term Aki-Richards AVA forward operator with log-domain parameterization implemented matrix-free in PyLops.
Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) using Tweedie's denoised estimate and adjoint-state data-consistency gradient updates at each reverse step.
Plane-wave destruction (PWD) dip estimation and structurally preconditioned Tikhonov well-log extrapolation for field initial model building.
Ensemble uncertainty quantification across multiple stochastic DDPM trajectories benchmarked against trace-wise analytical Gaussian Bayesian inversion.
采用基于2D U-Net架构的无条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），在归一化的三通道弹性参数模型（Vp、Vs、密度）上训练先验分布。
采用对数域参数化的三项Aki-Richards线性AVA正演算子，基于PyLops实现无矩阵正演及伴随运算。
利用Tweedie去噪估计与伴随状态数据残差梯度，在每步反向扩散中执行扩散后验采样（DPS）引导更新。
利用平面波破坏（PWD）滤波器估计构造倾角，并通过构造预条件Tikhonov反演外推测井曲线以构建实际数据初始模型。
通过多次随机DDPM采样轨迹计算后验均值与标准差，并与逐道解析高斯贝叶斯反演结果进行不确定性基准对比。
de: Training dataset of 5,000 2D elastic models (size 128 x 256) from SEAM Arid, Overthrust, Marmousi2, and field well logs, augmented with elastic structural transformations.
Out-of-distribution 2D Otway synthetic benchmark using near (3–10°), mid (10–20°), and far (20–30°) angle stacks with a 150 Hz Ricker wavelet and 3% Gaussian noise.
Poseidon 2D field dataset from NW Shelf, Browse Basin, Australia, comprising near (6–18°), mid (18–30°), and far (30–42°) angle stacks and four validation wells.
Uncertainty quantification experiments using 100 posterior realizations for Otway synthetic data and 500 realizations for Poseidon field data.
包含5000个128×256高分辨率二维弹性模型的训练集，源自SEAM Arid、Overthrust、Marmousi2基准模型及测井合成模型，并经褶皱和断层弹性形变增强。
分布外2D Otway合成模型测试，合成近（3°–10°）、中（10°–20°）、远（20°–30°）三个角道集，使用150 Hz主频Ricker子波并添加3%高斯噪声。
澳大利亚Browse盆地Poseidon工区实际数据测试，包含近（6°–18°）、中（18°–30°）、远（30°–42°）角道集及4口验证井。
针对Otway合成数据生成100个后验实现、针对Poseidon实际数据生成500个后验实现的不确定性量化对比实验。
li: DPS uncertainty bands are systematically overconfident (1–2 orders of magnitude smaller than the mean) due to likelihood gradient collapse and concentrated learned priors.
Reconstruction quality and uncertainty behavior are strongly sensitive to the training dataset distribution, risking bias if target geology is unrepresented.
Relies on the linearized Aki-Richards approximation, limiting accuracy at strong-contrast interfaces and wide incidence angles.
Diffusion prior can occasionally over-regularize fine-scale amplitude variations, resulting in slightly lower peak SNR than LSQR or ADMM+TV in some intervals.
受似然梯度坍缩和先验分布集中的影响，DPS得出的不确定性包络系统性偏窄（比均值小1至2个数量级，表现过度自信）。
重建质量与不确定性估计高度依赖训练数据分布，若目标工区地质特征未被训练集覆盖则可能引入偏差。
正演算子依赖线性化的Aki-Richards近似，限制了其在强阻抗对比界面和大入射角条件下的适用性。
扩散先验有时会过度平滑细尺度的振幅变化，导致局部区段的峰值信噪比（SNR）略低于LSQR或ADMM+TV。

tm.why: The paper trains an unsupervised denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) with a 2D U-Net backbone to learn a generative prior over subsurface elastic parameters.
The work formulates prestack AVA inversion within a Bayesian framework using Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) and benchmarks ensemble uncertainty estimates against an analytical Bayesian solution.
The study solves the ill-posed prestack seismic amplitude-variation-with-angle (AVA) inverse problem for P-wave velocity, S-wave velocity, and density.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF read and analyzed, including equations, quantitative SNR/SSIM metrics, and all 16 figures across synthetic Otway and Poseidon field datasets.

sum: This study investigates seismic and tsunami traveling ionospheric disturbances (STIDs and TTIDs) triggered by the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake using total electron content (TEC) from 1,417 GNSS stations in Japan and Taiwan and six DART buoys. Applying a 20-min high-pass filter, z-score normalization, and distance-dependent scaling enhances weak far-field signals (>2,000 km) under low signal-to-noise conditions. An STID (3.6 km/s) and two TTIDs (273.2 m/s and 215.4 m/s) are identified, corresponding to the primary tsunami and a likely coastline-reflected wave (with possible Mw 6.9 aftershock contribution). By extracting over 1,500 coherent wavefront points as 'space buoys' and applying ray tracing and beamforming, the authors resolve the TTID1 source within ~90 km of the maximum-slip subfault inferred from deep-ocean tsunami waveform inversion. The novelty lies in achieving robust far-field, single-azimuth ionospheric tsunami source localization despite low signal amplitudes.
本研究利用日本和台湾1,417个GNSS测站的总电子含量（TEC）及6个DART浮标数据，分析了2025年7月29日堪察加Mw 8.8地震引发的地震和海啸行进电离层扰动（STID和TTID）。通过高通滤波、z-score标准化和距离衰减补偿，成功增强了2000公里外的微弱远场信号，识别出速度为3.6……

t: Applies 20-min high-pass filtering, z-score normalization, and distance scaling to GNSS TEC to extract coherent wavefronts in distance-time domain, followed by ray tracing and beamforming to locate TTID sources.
对GNSS TEC进行高通滤波、z-score标准化和距离缩放以提取相干波前，结合射线追踪和波束形成定位海啸源。
Uses 30-s GNSS TEC observations from 1,417 stations in Japan and Taiwan, tsunami records from six DART buoys, and ETOPO bathymetry data for the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake.
采用日本和台湾1,417个测站的30秒GNSS TEC数据、6个DART浮标记录及ETOPO地形数据。
Identifies STID (3.6 km/s), TTID1 (273.2 m/s), and TTID2 (215.4 m/s). Beamforming locates the TTID1 source within ~90 km of the main slip area inferred from tsunami waveform inversion.
识别出3.6 km/s的STID及273.2、215.4 m/s的两个TTID，波束形成定位的主海啸源距主滑移区仅约90…
Far-field (>2,000 km), single-azimuth receiver geometry produces elongated source uncertainty in ray tracing, while ~80% of space buoys exhibit SNR below 2.
远场单方位角观测导致射线追踪沿传播方向不确定性拉长，且约80%空间浮标信噪比低于2。

Demonstrates robust ionospheric tsunami source localization over 2,000 km away with single-region azimuthal coverage and low SNR by integrating z-score normalization and coherent wavefront extraction.
结合标准化与相干波前提取，在2000公里外单方位角低信噪比条件下实现了高精度电离层海啸源定位。

kc: Applied z-score normalization and geometric scaling to GNSS TEC distance-time plots, revealing one STID (3.6 km/s) and two TTIDs (273.2 m/s and 215.4 m/s) from the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake at distances >2,000 km.
Located the primary TTID source within ~90 km of the main seafloor slip area inferred from tsunami waveform inversion using coherent wavefront extraction, ray tracing, and beamforming.

Identified a prominent secondary tsunami ionospheric disturbance (TTID2) occurring ~45 minutes after TTID1, attributing it to coastline reflection off Paramushir with possible contribution from an Mw 6.9 aftershock.
对GNSS TEC距离-时间图应用z-score标准化和几何衰减缩放，在2000公里外成功识别出2025年堪察加Mw 8.8地震引发的1个STID（3.6 km/s）和2个TTID（273.2 m/s和215.4 m/s）。
利用相干波前提取、射线追踪和波束形成技术，将主TTID源定位在海啸波形反演所得主滑移区约90公里范围内。
识别出主波后约45分钟出现的显著次级海啸电离层扰动（TTID2），证实其主要源于Paramushir海岸反射，并可能包含Mw 6.9余震的贡献。
me: 20-minute high-pass filtering of 30-s GNSS TEC time series assuming an Ionospheric Piercing Point altitude of 325 km.
Z-score normalization at each epicentral distance combined with square-root distance scaling to compensate for geometric attenuation and enhance weak far-field wavefronts.
Coherent wavefront extraction in the distance-time domain to establish >1,500 effective 'space buoy' observation points despite SNR < 2.
Complementary ray tracing (minimizing onset time standard deviation) and beamforming (minimizing propagation speed standard deviation) to constrain source location, onset time, and velocity.
假定电离层穿刺点高度为325公里，对30秒采样的GNSS TEC时间序列进行20分钟高通滤波。
在每个震中距上进行z-score标准化，并结合距离平方根缩放以补偿几何衰减，增强微弱的远场波前信号。
在距离-时间域提取相干波前，在信噪比低于2的条件下构建超过1,500个有效“空间浮标”观测点。
结合互补的射线追踪（最小化发震时刻标准差）和波束形成（最小化传播速度标准差）方法，联合约束海啸源位置、起始时间和传播速度。
de: 30-s GNSS TEC data from 1,417 ground-based stations in Japan (GSI) and Taiwan (CWA) during 29–30 July 2025.
Deep-ocean tsunami waveform and residual tide records from six NOAA DART stations (21414, 21416, 21418, 21420, 52402, 52405).
ETOPO 2022 global bathymetry data resampled from 15 to 120 arc-seconds.
2025年7月29日至30日期间日本（GSI）和台湾（CWA）共1,417个地面接收站的30秒采样GNSS TEC数据。
沿传播路径上6个NOAA DART深海海啸浮标（21414、21416、21418、21420、52402、52405）的潮位残差记录。
由15角秒重采样至120角秒的ETOPO 2022全球海底地形数据。
li: Far-field observations (>2,000 km) restricted to a single southwestward azimuthal sector produce elongated source-location uncertainty along the propagation direction in ray tracing.
Roughly 80% of identified space buoys have signal-to-noise ratios below 2 due to geometric attenuation and daytime background ionospheric variability.
The exact relative contributions of coastline reflection versus the Mw 6.9 aftershock to the secondary disturbance (TTID2) cannot be fully separated.
远场观测（>2,000公里）仅限于单一的西南方位角扇区，导致射线追踪在传播方向上产生拉长的源位置不确定性。
受几何衰减和日间背景电离层变化影响，约80%的空间浮标信噪比低于2。
无法完全区分海岸反射与Mw 6.9余震对次级扰动（TTID2）的具体相对贡献。

tm.why: Investigates lithosphere-atmosphere-ionosphere coupling and tsunami-induced traveling ionospheric disturbances using GNSS total electron content.
Estimates the tsunami source location of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake and compares it with the main slip area inferred from tsunami waveform inversion.
Demonstrates far-field tsunami source localization using ionospheric 'space buoys', contributing to tsunami early warning capabilities.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all equations, 5 figures, and references.

sum: Studying sediment-dominated mid-ocean ridges is challenging because thick sediments mask basement structures controlling magmatic and hydrothermal processes. This study investigates the Escanaba Trough (southern Gorda Ridge) by combining a new 1:100,000 scale lithostratigraphic map with 3D magnetic susceptibility inversions of high-resolution near-seafloor magnetic data collected by AUV Sentry in 2022. The authors mapped 252 laccoliths/sills totaling ~6.66 km³ across segmented spreading axes that rotate counterclockwise by 19.2° from north to south, causing diminished volcanism in the central transition zone (MESCA). Constrained 3D minimum-structure inversions across six survey areas distinguish sediment from basaltic basement and reveal ring-like magnetic anomalies around uplifted sediment mounds, particularly in northern Escanaba (NESCA). These anomalies indicate that sub-sediment intrusions often form saucer-shaped sills with upturned dyke margins and/or host high-temperature hydrothermal pyrrhotite mineralization, while basement susceptibility decreases southward due to thicker insulating sediment cover.
本研究结合新建的1:100,000比例尺海底岩相地层图与2022年AUV Sentry采集的高分辨率近海底磁数据的三维磁化率约束反演，研究了被厚层沉积物覆盖的戈达洋脊南段埃斯卡纳巴海槽。研究共圈定了252个岩盖/岩床（总体积约6.66 km³），发现扩张轴由北向南逆时针旋转19.2°，导致中部过渡带……

t: The authors apply 3D minimum-structure magnetic susceptibility inversion using a total variation smoothness norm on unstructured tetrahedral meshes, constrained by a two-layer sediment-basement reference model, alongside 1:100,000 lithostratigraphic mapping and normalized volcanic volume analysis.
基于非结构化四面体网格、双层参考模型和全变分范数进行三维磁化率约束反演，结合1:100,000岩相地层填图与体积计算。

Data come from the 2022 TN403 expedition aboard R/V Thomas G. Thompson using AUV Sentry at ~60 m altitude (150 m line spacing, 6 Hz fluxgate magnetometer, 1 m multibeam, backscatter, MAPR sensors), plus ship multibeam and legacy seismic/isopach datasets.
2022年TN403航次AUV Sentry近海底三分量磁测、1米多波束、背散射、热液羽流数据及历史地震剖面。

Mapped 252 laccoliths/sills covering 206 km² (2.92 km³ in NESCA, 0.54 km³ in MESCA, 2.97 km³ in SESCA) across seven S3 segments rotating 19.2° counterclockwise; 3D inversions image saucer-shaped sills, thermally demagnetized intrusions, and southward-decreasing basement susceptibility.
圈定252个岩盖/岩床（面积206 km²），揭示7个扩张段发生19.2°旋转，三维反演识别出碟状岩床和向南递增的基底蚀…
The ~50 m model resolution cannot resolve meter-wide ring dykes, and magnetic anomalies cannot uniquely separate mafic dyke intrusions from hydrothermal pyrrhotite mineralization.
50米分辨率无法精细分辨米级岩脉，且磁异常无法唯一区分基性岩脉侵入与高温热液磁黄铁矿化。

First 1:100,000 lithostratigraphic bedrock map of Escanaba Trough combined with two-layer constrained 3D AUV magnetic inversions that distinguish intra-sediment saucer-shaped sills from basement alteration.
首幅埃斯卡纳巴海槽1:100,000岩相地层图，并首次利用双层约束三维AUV磁反演区分沉积层内碟状岩床与基底蚀变。

kc: Generated a new 1:100,000 scale lithostratigraphic map of the Escanaba Trough quantifying 252 sub-sediment laccoliths/sills and seven S3 spreading segments.
Demonstrated that a 19.2° counterclockwise rotation in spreading axis orientation controls volcanic center distribution and explains reduced magma volume in MESCA.
Produced six constrained 3D magnetic susceptibility models from AUV Sentry data that resolve saucer-shaped sills, ring dykes, and basement hydrothermal alteration.
编制了埃斯卡纳巴海槽1:100,000岩相地层图，量化了252个沉积物下岩盖/岩床及7个S3级扩张段。
证明扩张轴走向19.2°的逆时针旋转控制了火山中心的分布，并解释了中部MESCA岩浆体积减少的原因。
利用AUV近海底磁测数据建立了6个三维约束磁化率反演模型，精细刻画了碟状岩床、环状岩脉及基底热液蚀变。
me: Seafloor lithostratigraphic mapping integrating 1 m AUV and 50 m ship-based multibeam bathymetry, backscatter, SWOT gravity, EMAG2 magnetics, and legacy seismic profiles.
Volumetric quantification of sub-sediment volcanism by gridding uplifted mound polygons at 100 m spacing and computing normalized volumes along the spreading axis.
Constrained 3D minimum-structure magnetic susceptibility inversion on unstructured tetrahedral meshes using a total variation norm and a layered sediment-basement reference model.
综合1米AUV与50米船载多波束测深、背散射、SWOT卫星重力、EMAG2磁异常及历史地震剖面进行海底岩相地层填图。
以100米网格离散隆起沉积丘多边形并沿扩张轴计算归一化体积，定量评估沉积物下火山物质体积。
基于非结构化四面体网格，采用全变分范数和双层沉积-基底参考模型进行三维最小结构磁化率约束反演。
de: Near-bottom (~60 m altitude) 3-axis vector fluxgate magnetometer data, multibeam bathymetry/backscatter, and MAPR plume data (temperature, ORP) collected by AUV Sentry during 2022 cruise TN403.
ROV Jason video observations and rock/sediment samples from cruise TN403 for ground-truthing.
Legacy seismic reflection profiles, sediment isopach maps (Gardner et al., 1993), GMRT bathymetry, SWOT gravity, and EMAG2 magnetic grids.
2022年TN403航次由AUV Sentry在距海底约60米高度采集的三分量磁通门磁力仪数据、多波束测深/背散射及MAPR热液羽流（温度与氧化还原电位）数据。
TN403航次ROV Jason视频观测与海底岩石/沉积物采样数据用于地面实况校准。
历史地震反射剖面、沉积物等厚图、GMRT地形汇编、SWOT卫星重力及EMAG2磁异常网格数据。
li: AUV survey altitude (~60 m) and line spacing (100–150 m) limit 3D magnetic model resolution to ~50 m, smoothing out meter-scale ring dykes into surrounding sediment.

Magnetic susceptibility anomalies around mounds cannot uniquely distinguish between cooled mafic dyke intrusions and reheated ferrimagnetic hexagonal pyrrhotite from high-temperature hydrothermal alteration.
Approximating the sediment-basement interface with a 0.04 SI magnetic susceptibility isolayer fails where active intrusions heat rock above the ~580°C Curie temperature.
AUV航高（约60米）和测线间距（100–150米）使三维磁模型分辨率受限于50米左右，米级环状岩脉被平滑平均到周围沉积物中。
仅凭磁化率正异常无法唯一区分冷却的基性环状岩脉侵入与高温热液蚀变形成的亚铁磁性六方磁黄铁矿。
当存在温度高于居里点（~580°C）的热侵入体时，利用0.04 SI磁化率等值面近似沉积-基底界面的方法会失效。

tm.why: The paper investigates tectonic controls on volcanism, crustal spreading segment geometry, and sub-sediment magmatic intrusions at the Escanaba Trough mid-ocean ridge.
The study performs constrained 3D minimum-structure magnetic susceptibility inversion using unstructured tetrahedral meshes and a total variation smoothness norm.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF of Galley et al. (2026) in JGR: Solid Earth was analyzed, including all sections, equations, and Figures 1 to 10.

sum: This study reconstructs the spatiotemporal evolution of Cretaceous tectonic shortening in the Longmen Shan tectonic belt (LMSTB) from 128 to 64 Ma. By conducting systematic anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) measurements on a 724.1-m-thick stratigraphic section in the Western Sichuan Basin and integrating them with paleomagnetic rotation data, the authors restore the maximum horizontal shortening directions. The results reveal a persistent NW-SE-trending shortening direction at the million-year scale, with an oblique shortening shear component superimposed between 102 and 90 Ma. This high-resolution time series constrains how the eastern Tibetan Plateau margin responded to far-field tectonic forcing during the Cretaceous.
本研究重建了龙门山构造带128至64 Ma白垩纪构造缩短的时空演化。通过对四川盆地西部724.1米厚的连续地层剖面进行系统磁化率各向异性（AMS）测量，并结合古地磁旋转数据，恢复了最大水平缩短方向。结果表明，百万年尺度上龙门山构造带的缩短方向以持久的北西-南东向为主，但在102-90 Ma期间叠加了……

t: Systematic anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) measurements integrated with paleomagnetic crustal rotation data to reconstruct maximum horizontal shortening directions.
结合磁化率各向异性（AMS）测量与古地磁地壳旋转数据，重建最大水平缩短方向。
AMS measurements from a 724.1-m-thick continuous stratigraphic interval at the Jinmenguan section, constrained by a high-resolution magnetostratigraphic age model (128 to 64 Ma).
四川盆地西部剑门关剖面724.1米厚连续地层的AMS测量数据，受高分辨率磁性地层年代学约束。
The Cretaceous shortening direction was dominated by a persistent NW-SE trend, with an additional oblique shear component superimposed during 102-90 Ma.
白垩纪缩短方向以持久的北西-南东向为主，并在102-90 Ma期间叠加了斜向剪切分量。
The temporal resolution and spatial coverage are restricted to the Jinmenguan section and depend on the fidelity of the existing paleomagnetic rotation database.
重建精度和空间代表性受限于单一剖面及现有古地磁旋转数据的质量。
Provides the first high-resolution, time-resolved continuous record of Cretaceous shortening directions for the LMSTB in a consistent time-geometry reference frame.
首次在统一的时间-几何参考系中，提供了龙门山构造带白垩纪缩短方向的高分辨率连续记录。

kc: Established a high-resolution time series of Cretaceous tectonic shortening directions for the Longmen Shan tectonic belt from 128 to 64 Ma.
Integrated AMS fabric measurements with paleomagnetic crustal rotation data to restore shortening directions in a consistent time-geometry reference frame.
Identified a persistent NW-SE shortening direction and a superimposed oblique shear component during 102-90 Ma.
建立了龙门山构造带128至64 Ma白垩纪构造缩短方向的高分辨率时间序列。
将磁化率各向异性（AMS）磁组构测量与古地磁地壳旋转数据相结合，在统一的时空几何参考系中恢复了缩短方向。
识别出持久的北西-南东向缩短方向，以及在102-90 Ma期间叠加的斜向剪切分量。
me: Anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) measurements to determine layer-parallel shortening (LPS) fabrics.
Integration of paleomagnetic data to reconstruct time-dependent crustal rotations.
Restoration of maximum horizontal shortening directions using a time-geometry reference frame.
磁化率各向异性（AMS）测量，用于确定层行缩短（LPS）组构。
结合古地磁数据以重建随时间变化的地壳旋转。
利用时间-几何参考框架恢复最大水平缩短方向。
de: Systematic AMS measurements across a 724.1-m-thick continuous stratigraphic interval at the Jinmenguan section, Western Sichuan Basin.
Utilization of a previously published high-resolution magnetostratigraphic age model and existing paleomagnetic rotation data.
对四川盆地西部剑门关剖面724.1米厚的连续地层层位进行系统的AMS测量。
利用先前发表的高分辨率磁性地层年代模型及现有的古地磁旋转数据。
li: The reconstruction relies heavily on the accuracy and resolution of the pre-existing magnetostratigraphic age model and paleomagnetic rotation data.
重建结果在很大程度上依赖于预先存在的磁性地层年代模型和古地磁旋转数据的准确性与分辨率。

tm.why: The paper investigates Cretaceous crustal shortening, tectonic deformation, and geodynamics of the Longmen Shan tectonic belt using AMS fabrics and paleomagnetic rotations.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study reconstructs the Cretaceous to Oligocene tectono-sedimentary and thermal history of the French Upper Rhine Graben (URG) and its western margin (Vosges). Using basin analysis, low-temperature thermochronology, and source-to-sink mapping, the authors identify two main rifting phases: isolated sub-basins during the Lutetian-Bartonian, followed by rift widening into the Rupelian. The fault patterns indicate oblique rifting under a continuous stress regime. Thermochronology reveals a complex pre-rift cooling history and syn-rift shoulder uplift around 40 Ma. The authors attribute the pre-rift thermal state to a Late Cretaceous volcanic province or asthenospheric mantle flow, suggesting that rifting was initiated by far-field stresses acting on pre-existing lithospheric anomalies.
本研究重建了法国上莱茵地堑（URG）及其西缘（孚日山脉）白垩纪至渐新世的构造-沉积与热演化历史。通过盆地分析、低温热年代学及源-汇制图，研究指出裂谷经历了两个主要阶段：路特期-巴顿期的孤立沉降盆地，以及巴顿期-鲁培尔期的裂谷拓宽。断裂系统特征表明其在持续应力场下呈斜向裂谷发育。热年代学揭示了复杂的裂……

sum: This Zenodo repository provides a high-frequency seismic dataset and four self-contained Python scripts. The dataset covers 19 seismic stations recording wavefields from four major earthquakes: the 2023 Kahramanmaraş (Turkey), 2019 Ridgecrest, 2016 Kumamoto, and 2024 Hualien (Taiwan) mainshocks. The provided Python scripts allow users to read the per-station data and automatically regenerate corresponding figures, facilitating reproducibility and further analysis of high-frequency strong ground motion and near-source earthquake physics.

sum: This study investigates the dynamic triggering of seismicity in the Iranian plateau following the February 6, 2023, Turkey doublet earthquakes (Mw 7.8 and Mw 7.6). Using continuous waveform data from 99 seismic stations across Iran, the authors applied bandpass filtering, STA/LTA detection, beta-statistics, and the matched-filter technique to identify small triggered events. They observed triggered seismicity and tremors at 14 stations, primarily concentrated in the Persian Block and the Main Recent Fault zone. The triggered events occurred 20 to 200 km from the recording stations, often near hot springs, suggesting that subsurface fluids and pore-pressure changes facilitated delayed triggering. Interestingly, only the Mw 7.8 mainshock caused dynamic triggering, while the Mw 7.6 event did not. This highlights the role of transient dynamic stress transfer and crustal fluids in remote seismic activation.
本文研究了2023年土耳其双震对伊朗高原的动态触发效应。利用99个台站的连续波形数据，结合STA/LTA和模板匹配技术，在14个台站检测到触发地震。这些台站集中在温泉密集区，表明地下流体和孔隙压升高促进了延迟触发。研究发现仅Mw7.8主震引起了触发，揭示了动态应力传递与流体在远程触发中的关键作用。

t: Applied bandpass filtering, STA/LTA, beta-statistics, and matched-filter techniques to continuous waveform data from 99 seismic stations to detect small triggered seismic events.
利用带通滤波、STA/LTA、β统计和模板匹配技术处理99个台站的连续波形以检测微小触发地震。
Continuous seismic waveforms and catalog data from 99 stations across IIEES, IRSC, and AZAR networks in Iran surrounding the 2023 Turkey doublet.
2023年土耳其双震前后，来自伊朗IIEES、IRSC和AZAR网络的99个台站的连续波形和目录数据。

First comprehensive observational evidence of widespread dynamic triggering in NW Iran from the 2023 Turkey doublet, highlighting fluid-facilitated delayed triggering.
