sum: This study investigates anomalous medium-scale gravity gradient changes observed prior to the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku earthquake using 3D spectral-infinite-element simulations (SPECFEM-X). By modeling slab extension with ensembles of dislocations in a realistic 3D subduction-zone geometry, the authors assess the impact of lateral elastic structure, source depth, and spatial distribution on surface displacements and gravity signals. The results show that lateral elastic heterogeneities have a minimal impact (<3%) on surface observables. In contrast, the depth and spatial distribution of the deformation strongly control the signal amplitudes and smoothness. Broadly distributed deformation reduces vertical surface displacements by up to 40% while only slightly decreasing gravity gradient signals, providing a quantitative framework for interpreting GRACE pre-seismic anomalies.
本研究利用SPECFEM-X软件进行三维谱无限元模拟，探讨了2011年日本东北Mw 9.0地震前观测到的中尺度重力梯度异常。通过在真实三维俯冲带几何结构中用位错群模拟板块拉伸，评估了横向弹性结构、震源深度和空间分布对地表位移和重力信号的影响。结果表明，横向弹性非均匀性对地表观测值的影响极小（<3%）……

t: 3D spectral-infinite-element simulations using SPECFEM-X to model gravitational and surface displacement signals from slab deformation represented by dislocation ensembles.
使用SPECFEM-X进行三维谱无限元模拟，通过位错群表征板块变形并计算重力和地表位移信号。
Synthetic modeling based on the realistic 3D geometry and elastic structure of the Japan subduction zone prior to the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.
基于2011年东北地震前日本俯冲带真实三维几何与弹性结构的合成模拟数据。
Lateral elastic structure impacts signals by <3%, whereas distributed deformation reduces vertical displacement by up to 40% but gravity gradients by ≤20%.
横向弹性结构对信号影响小于3%，而分布式变形使垂直位移减少达40%，但重力梯度仅减少不超过20%。
Distributed slab deformations still fail to explain the sub-centimetric level of ground motions observed at the surface.

First fully 3D spectral-infinite-element modeling of pre-seismic gravity perturbations incorporating realistic subduction geometry and lateral elastic heterogeneities.

Representation of deep slab extension using ensembles of dislocations.
Incorporation of realistic 3D subduction-zone geometry and elastic structure.

sum: This study evaluates the ground-motion characteristics of idealized supershear earthquake ruptures using dynamic rupture simulations. By comparing supershear and subshear ruptures, the authors find that in the absence of seismic scattering, supershear ruptures consistently produce stronger ground-motion amplitudes across various metrics. Specifically, peak ground velocity remains elevated beyond 20 km from the fault due to mildly attenuating surface Mach waves. In the near-fault region (<7 km), supershear ruptures generate longer shaking durations and larger spectral accelerations, particularly in the high-frequency regime (2–3 Hz). These findings suggest that current building codes may underestimate the seismic hazard posed by near-field supershear ruptures, highlighting the need to incorporate these effects into engineering design and hazard assessments.
本研究利用动力学破裂模拟对比了超剪切与亚剪切地震破裂的地面运动特征。结果表明，在无散射情况下，超剪切破裂产生更强的地面运动振幅。由于马赫波的低衰减性，其峰值地面速度在20公里外仍保持高位；在近断层区（<7公里），其振动持续时间更长且高频谱加速度更大。这表明现行建筑规范可能低估了超剪切破裂的近场危害。

t: Dynamic rupture simulations comparing idealized supershear and subshear earthquake ruptures to analyze ground-motion intensity measures.

Synthetic ground-motion data generated from dynamic rupture simulations under idealized conditions without seismic scattering.

Analysis of ground-motion intensity measures including peak ground velocity, shaking duration, and spectral acceleration.

sum: Low-rise reinforced concrete (RC) frame structures face both earthquakes and strong winds, yet existing studies focus mainly on tall buildings or single hazards. This study evaluates a six-story RC frame under 100 randomly paired wind-seismic scenarios (10 natural strong-motion records from PEER × 10 simulated pulsating wind speeds from 12 to 30 m/s) using nonlinear time-history analysis in ABAQUS/Explicit. Comparing uncontrolled and staggered viscous-damper-retrofitted configurations, results show that concurrent wind and earthquake loads substantially amplify top-story displacement (by 9.82% over earthquake alone and 364.41% over wind alone at PGA=0.159g and 16 m/s wind). A binary log-linear regression demand model and multi-hazard fragility surfaces across four limit states demonstrate that viscous dampers reduce displacement by 9.45–26.88%, decrease structural sensitivity to PGA by 27.4%, and lower severe-damage exceedance probability by up to 42.39 percentage points, proving single-hazard checks underestimate risk.

Proposes a staggered viscous damper retrofit strategy that reduces displacement by 9.45–26.88% and lowers severe damage exceedance probability by up to 42.39 percentage points.
建立了多层RC框架在风震时序耦合作用下的多灾害易损性曲面评估框架。
通过100种风震组合工况量化了多灾害耦合对结构动力响应的放大效应。
提出了交错布置粘滞阻尼器的加固方案，将位移降低9.45%–26.88%，严重破坏超越概率最高降低42.39个百分点。
me: 3D nonlinear finite element modeling in ABAQUS/Explicit using Concrete Damage Plasticity (CDP) and embedded truss reinforcement.
Sequential multi-hazard loading protocol embedding earthquake acceleration records within 100 s pulsating wind histories generated via harmonic superposition.
Binary log-linear regression engineering demand modeling (relating MIDR to PGA and wind speed) and 2D fragility surface construction across four limit states.
基于ABAQUS/Explicit建立三维非线性有限元模型，采用混凝土损伤塑性（CDP）模型与嵌入式钢筋桁架单元。
采用时序加载策略，将地震动加速度时程嵌入谐波叠加法生成的100秒脉动风荷载时程中。
建立双变量对数线性回归工程需求模型（关联最大层间位移角MIDR与PGA、风速），并构建四个极限状态的二维易损性曲面。
de: 10 unscaled natural ground motion records (M 6.0–7.0, PGA 0.159g–0.753g) selected from the PEER strong-motion database and FEMA P695.
10 simulated pulsating wind speed levels (12 to 30 m/s in 2 m/s increments) representing 1-year to 50-year return periods.
100 nonlinear dynamic time-history simulations each for uncontrolled and viscous-damper-controlled six-story RC frame models.
从PEER强震数据库和FEMA P695中选取的10条未缩放天然地震动记录（震级6.0–7.0，PGA为0.159g–0.753g）。
模拟生成的10个脉动风速等级（12至30 m/s，步长2 m/s），涵盖1年至50年重现期。
针对无控和粘滞阻尼器受控六层RC框架模型分别开展的100组非线性动力时程仿真。
li: Relies solely on numerical finite element simulations without experimental or field validation.
Fragility analysis only considers a fixed coefficient of variation (0.3) for structural capacity, neglecting spatial material variability.
Conclusions are restricted to a single six-story RC frame geometry and a modest suite of 10 ground motion records.
完全依赖有限元数值模拟，缺乏物理实验或现场实测验证。
易损性分析仅考虑结构抗力的固定变异系数（0.3），忽略了材料属性的空间变异性。
结论局限于单一的六层RC框架构型及仅包含10条地震动记录的较小样本集。

tm.why: The paper conducts multi-hazard fragility and structural performance assessments of reinforced concrete frames subjected to strong ground motions and wind loads.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 48-page Accepted Manuscript PDF including all text, equations, 4 tables, and 11 figures.

sum: Subsurface crevasse damage controls glacier stability and ice loss, yet remains difficult to quantify. This study deploys a 1-km distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) cable and 29 seismic nodes in a 2D grid over an active crevasse field at Gornergletscher, Switzerland, detecting 1,355 icequakes over 7 days. Using Rayleigh-wave azimuthal anisotropy tomography (~20% anisotropy) combined with Voigt and Reuss effective medium models, the authors estimate upper-bound crevasse volume fractions up to 0.35–0.41. Additionally, Bayesian full-waveform moment tensor inversion (using Salvus spectral-element modeling) of 50 high-SNR icequakes reveals predominantly tensile crack opening (~70%) with minor shear components (~30%). Extrapolating the 5-day cumulative crack opening volume (~87 m³) over a 1-year residence time yields ~8.4% of total ice volume, agreeing with anisotropy bounds. This proves subsurface damage is driven primarily by fracturing rather than melt and establishes DAS as a scalable tool for cryosphere hazard monitoring.
冰川地下裂隙损伤控制着冰川稳定性，但难以量化。本研究在瑞士Gornergletscher冰川裂隙区布设了1公里分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆和29个地震节点，7天内检测到1355次冰震。通过瑞利波方位各向异性层析成像（约20%各向异性）结合等效介质理论，估算了裂隙体积分数上限。此外，利用Salvus谱……

t: Icequakes are detected via QuakeMigrate back-migration. Rayleigh-wave differential travel times invert for azimuthal velocity anisotropy mapped to fracture volume via Voigt/Reuss bounds. Bayesian full-waveform moment tensor inversion using Salvus spectral-element modeling estimates fracture mechanisms and opening volumes.
用QuakeMigrate检测冰震，瑞利波差分走时反演各向异性并结合Voigt/Reuss模型估算裂隙体积，用Salvu…
A 1-km DAS fiber-optic cable (1.6 m spacing, 6.4 m gauge length, 1000 Hz) and 29 vertical MEMS seismic nodes deployed in a 2D grid on Gornergletscher, Switzerland, from 17 to 23 October 2023.
2023年10月在瑞士Gornergletscher冰川裂隙区二维网格布设的1公里DAS光缆（1.6米道间距）和29个垂…

Detected 1,355 icequakes over 7 days and measured ~20% Rayleigh-wave velocity anisotropy. Full-waveform inversion of 50 icequakes shows dominant tensile opening (~87 m³ over 5 days), extrapolating to ~8.4% annual ice volume fraction.
7天检测到1355次冰震，观测到约20%面波速度各向异性；50次冰震反演显示张性开启主导，年化裂隙体积分数约8.4%。
Strong crevasse-scattered coda waves interfere with short-offset waveforms in source inversions, and effective medium models yield wide bounds without constraining fracture connectivity or geometry.
近距离处强散射尾波干扰波形拟合，且等效介质模型体积分数跨度大、无法约束裂隙连通性。

First 2D DAS array quantification of subsurface glacier fracture volume fractions combining surface-wave anisotropy and native-unit full-waveform icequake moment tensors, demonstrating fracture dominates over melt.
首次结合DAS面波各向异性与全波形冰震矩张量反演量化冰川地下裂隙损伤，证实破裂主导体积变化。

kc: Demonstrated 2D fiber-optic DAS grid deployment on an active alpine crevasse field to detect 1,355 icequakes over 7 days.
Quantified ~20% Rayleigh-wave velocity anisotropy and translated it into crevasse volume fraction bounds using Voigt and Reuss effective medium theory.
Performed automated Bayesian full-waveform moment tensor inversions in native strain/acceleration units for 50 icequakes, confirming dominant tensile opening mechanisms.
Showed consistency between icequake-derived cumulative opening volumes (~8.4% per year) and anisotropy-derived fracture volume fractions, proving fracture dominates over melt.
展示了在高山冰川活跃裂隙区布设二维DAS光缆网格，在7天内检测到1355次冰震。
量化了约20%的瑞利波速度各向异性，并利用Voigt和Reuss等效介质理论将其转化为裂隙体积分数上下限。
在原生应变和加速度单位下对50次冰震进行了自动化的贝叶斯全波形矩张量反演，证实了张性开启的主导机制。
证明了冰震累积张开体积（每年约8.4%）与各向异性推导的裂隙体积分数一致，表明破裂而非融化主导了地下损伤。
me: Back-migration icequake detection (QuakeMigrate adapted for DAS) using P- and surface-wave phases, followed by NonLinLoc relocation.
Iterative grid-search inversion of differential Rayleigh-wave arrival times for 1D azimuthal velocity anisotropy (fast/slow velocities and fast azimuth) and refined epicenters.
Voigt and Reuss effective medium theory parameterizations to map fast/slow velocities to air- or water-filled crevasse volume fractions.
Ambient-noise channel-by-channel coherency scalar product to calibrate DAS coupling and absolute strain amplitudes.
Bayesian probabilistic full-waveform moment tensor inversion using 3D spectral-element modeling (Salvus) and spectral ratios for source corner frequency and path attenuation.
结合P波和面波相位的逆时迁移冰震检测（适配DAS的QuakeMigrate）及NonLinLoc重定位。
利用瑞利波差分到时进行迭代网格搜索反演，获取方位速度各向异性（快慢波速及快波方向）并优化震中位置。
应用Voigt和Reuss等效介质理论模型，将快慢波速映射为充气或充水裂隙的体积分数。
利用背景噪声逐通道相干标量积校准DAS光缆耦合度及绝对应变振幅。
采用三维谱元法（Salvus）进行贝叶斯概率全波形矩张量反演，并利用谱比法估算震源拐角频率和路径衰减。
de: Field deployment at Gornergletscher, Switzerland, from 17 to 23 October 2023 over an active crevasse field.
1-km fiber-optic cable interrogated by a Sintela Onyx unit (1.6 m channel spacing, 6.4 m gauge length, 1000 Hz sampling rate, measuring strain).
29 co-located Sercel WiNG vertical-component MEMS accelerometer nodes sampled at 1000 Hz.
Catalog of 1,355 detected icequakes, with 14 high-SNR events used for anisotropy tomography and 50 events for full-waveform moment tensor inversion.
2023年10月17日至23日在瑞士Gornergletscher冰川活跃裂隙区开展的野外观测实验。
由Sintela Onyx解调仪连接的1公里光纤光缆（道间距1.6米，标距6.4米，采样率1000 Hz，测量应变）。
29个同址布设的Sercel WiNG垂直分量MEMS加速度计节点，采样率1000 Hz。
包含1355个检测到的冰震目录，其中14个高信噪比事件用于各向异性层析成像，50个事件用于全波形矩张量反演。
li: Strong coda waves from crevasse scattering overlap with direct arrivals at short source-receiver distances, causing high waveform misfits on some eastern channels.
Voigt and Reuss effective medium bounds span orders of magnitude (especially for air-filled cracks) and do not constrain fracture connectivity or geometry.
Apparent closing tensile crack solutions for a few events have high uncertainties because surface waves dominate the misfit over dilatational P-wave polarities.
Field deployments require a narrow seasonal window (snow-free for safety, overnight freezing for fiber-ice coupling).
近震源距处裂隙散射产生的强尾波与直达波重叠，导致东部部分通道波形拟合误差较大。
Voigt和Reuss等效介质理论上下限跨度达数个数量级（尤其是充气裂隙），且无法约束裂隙连通性和几何形态。
少数表现为闭合张性裂隙的事件不确定性较高，因为面波振幅主导了拟合误差而非膨胀P波初动极性。
野外布设受限于狭窄的季节窗口（出于安全需无雪覆盖，同时需夜间结冰以保证光纤与冰耦合）。

tm.why: The study deploys a 1-km DAS fiber-optic grid over an alpine glacier to detect icequakes, invert for moment tensors, and measure surface-wave anisotropy.
The primary focus is quantifying subsurface crevasse fracture damage and icequake failure mechanisms at Gornergletscher, an alpine glacier in Switzerland.
Rayleigh-wave azimuthal velocity anisotropy (~20%) is inverted and combined with effective medium theory to estimate crevasse volume fractions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page Science Advances PDF manuscript including all figures, tables, equations, and methods sections.

sum: This study presents a decadal (2015–2024) record of SO2 emission rates from a permanent UV Camera system on Mount Etna, combined with SEVIRI satellite-derived thermal fluxes and GNSS deformation data. Using a 0.3 GW volcanic radiative power threshold, the authors identify 18 major eruptive phases. Time-averaged SO2 fluxes systematically increase from ~1,957 t/d during inter-eruptive periods to ~2,302 t/d pre-eruption, peaking at ~3,828 t/d during eruptions. By converting SO2 fluxes into magma input rates via petrological sulfur mass balance and thermal fluxes into magma output rates, the study quantifies Etna's volumetric magma budget across individual activity styles. Results demonstrate that only ~28% of eruptible magma (above the 1.18 m3/s baseline recycling rate) is erupted, while ~72% (~120 Mm3 during 2016–2021) accumulates intrusively. Detrended excess magma volume correlates positively (R=0.69) with vertical GNSS ground displacement, demonstrating the value of coupled gas-thermal monitoring.
本研究结合埃特纳火山永久紫外相机（UV Camera）获取的十年（2015-2024年）SO2排放率、SEVIRI卫星热通量及GNSS形变数据，量化了火山喷发周期的岩浆收支平衡。利用0.3 GW辐射功率阈值划分出18个主要喷发阶段，发现SO2通量从喷发间歇期的约1,957 t/d升至喷发前的2,30……

t: Pairs of co-aligned UV Camera images are merged into absorbance images using the Beer-Lambert law, calibrated with gas cells, integrated across the plume, and multiplied by optical-flow plume speed to yield daily SO2 fluxes, alongside petrological and thermal flux conversions.
利用比尔-朗伯定律合成双紫外相机吸光度图像，结合气室标定与光流法测速计算SO2通量，并转化为岩浆输入输出率。

Nearly a decade (November 2015–December 2024) of daily SO2 fluxes from a permanent UV Camera on Mount Etna, combined with 5–15 min SEVIRI satellite thermal radiance data, INGV-OE eruption catalogs, and continuous GNSS vertical displacements.
埃特纳火山近十年（2015–2024）紫外相机日均SO2通量、SEVIRI卫星热辐射、喷发目录及连续GNSS垂直形变数据…

Mean SO2 fluxes rise from 1,957 t/d (inter-eruptive) to 2,302 t/d (pre-eruptive) and 3,828 t/d (syn-eruptive). Cumulative degassed (777 Mm3), eruptible (437 Mm3), and erupted (124 Mm3) volumes indicate only ~28% of eruptible magma erupts while ~72% remains stored.
SO2均值从间歇期1,957 t/d升至同喷发期3,828 t/d；仅约28%可喷发岩浆（124 Mm3）喷出，约72%…
Light dilution causes a 30%–40% SO2 underestimation, the camera field of view misses the North-East Crater, and high background emissions obscure small eruptions (<1 Mm3).
光稀释效应导致SO2低估30%–40%，相机视场存在盲区（漏测NEC），且高背景脱气掩盖了小规模喷发（<1 Mm3）。

Characterizes Etna's magma input/output volumetric imbalance across a full decade at the resolution of individual eruptive phases and activity styles, directly linking gas-thermal excess magma budgets to GNSS summit deformation.
在单个喷发阶段尺度上量化十年岩浆体积收支不平衡，并将气体-热过剩岩浆预算与GNSS山顶形变直接关联。

kc: Compiled and analyzed an exceptionally long (~10-year, 2015–2024) continuous record of SO2 fluxes from a permanent UV Camera at Mount Etna alongside SEVIRI thermal data.
Quantified SO2 degassing across 18 major eruptive phases, showing a systematic progression from inter-eruptive (~1,957 t/d) to pre-eruptive (~2,302 t/d) and syn-eruptive (~3,828 t/d) regimes.
Resolved the volumetric magma budget across inter-, pre-, syn-, and post-eruptive phases, finding that only ~28% of eruptible magma is discharged while ~72% is stored intrusively.
Demonstrated a positive correlation (R=0.69) between detrended excess magma volume and continuous vertical GNSS ground displacement at the volcano summit.
整合并分析了埃特纳火山永久紫外相机长达约十年（2015–2024年）的连续SO2通量记录及SEVIRI卫星热辐射数据。
量化了18个主要喷发阶段的SO2脱气过程，揭示了从间歇期（~1,957 t/d）到喷发前（~2,302 t/d）及同喷发期（~3,828 t/d）的系统性增长模式。
解析了间歇期、喷发前、同喷发及喷发后阶段的岩浆体积收支，发现仅约28%的可喷发岩浆喷出地表，其余约72%侵入储存。
证实了去趋势累积过剩岩浆体积与火山顶部连续GNSS垂直地表位移之间存在显著正相关（R=0.69）。
me: UV Camera dual-filter absorbance processing (300–320 nm and 320–340 nm) calibrated with SO2 gas cells and combined with Lucas-Kanade optical flow plume speed tracking.
Light dilution attenuation modeling using empirical atmospheric scattering coefficients and non-linear polynomial correction curves.
Automated hotspot detection and Volcanic Radiative Power (VRP) quantification from multispectral SEVIRI satellite imagery via the CL-HOTSAT system.
Petrological sulfur mass-balance modeling to convert SO2 fluxes into magma input rates (Qin) and thermal proxy conversions to estimate Time-Averaged Discharge Rates (TADR).
Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) statistical testing and segmented second-order polynomial detrending for comparison with GAMIT/GLOBK-processed GNSS vertical time series.
采用双滤光片（300–320 nm和320–340 nm）紫外相机吸光度处理，结合SO2气室标定与Lucas-Kanade光流法羽流速度追踪。
利用经验大气散射系数和非线性多项式校正曲线评估光稀释衰减效应。
通过CL-HOTSAT系统对多光谱SEVIRI卫星图像进行自动热点检测与火山辐射功率（VRP）量化。
利用岩石学硫质量平衡模型将SO2通量转化为岩浆输入率（Qin），并通过热辐射转换估算时间平均排放率（TADR）。
应用双样本Kolmogorov-Smirnov（K-S）统计检验及分段二阶多项式去趋势方法，与GAMIT/GLOBK处理的GNSS垂直位移时间序列进行对比。
de: Daily averaged SO2 flux time series from November 2015 to December 2024 acquired by the permanent UV3 camera system at La Montagnola ridge (2,600 m elevation) on Mount Etna.
Multispectral thermal infrared imagery (5–15 min resolution) from the SEVIRI sensor aboard the Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) satellite.
Volcanic activity catalog (75 paroxysmal lava fountains and 32 lava flows) extracted from INGV-OE weekly monitoring bulletins.
Continuous vertical ground displacement time series from the summit-proximal EPLU GNSS station.
2015年11月至2024年12月由安装在埃特纳火山La Montagnola山脊（海拔2,600米）的永久UV3相机系统获取的日均SO2通量时间序列。
搭载于第二代气象卫星（MSG）上的SEVIRI传感器获取的高时间分辨率（5–15分钟）多光谱热红外图像。
从INGV-OE每周监测公报中提取的火山活动目录（包含75次猛烈熔岩喷泉和32次熔岩流事件）。
来自靠近火山顶部的EPLU连续GNSS站点的垂直地表位移时间序列。
li: Light dilution and multiple scattering in the optically dense proximal plume cause an estimated 30%–40% underestimation of SO2 fluxes, which was not automatically corrected in the full dataset.
The UV Camera field of view only covers the southern crater terrace (SEC and southern VOR+BN), missing emissions from the North-East Crater (NEC).
High background passive degassing (~1,957 t/d) prevents the UV Camera record from reliably resolving smaller eruptive phases (<1 Mm3 erupted volume).
SEVIRI's 3-km spatial resolution can miss weak thermal anomalies, while intense lava fountaining can saturate the 3.9 um infrared channel or be obscured by ash clouds.
光学致密的近源羽流中的光稀释和多次散射导致SO2通量被低估约30%–40%，且全数据集中未对此进行自动校正。
紫外相机的视场仅覆盖火山口露台南部（SEC及VOR+BN南部），无法捕捉东北火山口（NEC）的气体排放。
高背景被动脱气（~1,957 t/d）使得紫外相机记录难以可靠地分辨较小规模的喷发阶段（喷出体积<1 Mm3）。
SEVIRI传感器3公里的空间分辨率可能遗漏微弱热异常，而强烈的熔岩喷泉则可能导致3.9微米红外通道饱和或被火山灰云遮挡。

tm.why: The paper investigates volcano dynamics, magma volumetric budgets, and GNSS-derived ground deformation at Mount Etna using a decade of UV Camera SO2 emissions and satellite thermal data.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), Table 1, and Figures 1–9.

sum: This paper presents a data-driven, seismic-only workflow for regional facies classification in heterogeneous carbonate formations. To overcome sparse well control and labor-intensive manual interpretation, the authors employ a two-stage shallow learning approach. First, a Genetic Algorithm (GA) automatically constructs laterally consistent seismic horizons. Second, Self-Organizing Maps (SOMs) cluster horizon-consistent seismic attributes (amplitude, waveform, and discontinuity) into facies-style classes. Applied to a large regional carbonate survey, the workflow completes in about two hours, significantly reducing interpretation time from weeks to hours. The SOM results successfully capture major depositional trends and resolve key features like the Out-Inter Shoal anomaly, matching conventional Gross Depositional Environment (GDE) maps. This workflow provides an efficient, reproducible, and interpreter-consistent tool for regional reservoir reconnaissance.
本文提出一种基于地震数据的区域碳酸盐岩相分类工作流。利用遗传算法自动构建地震层位，并采用自组织映射（SOM）对地震属性进行聚类以划分沉积相。在大型碳酸盐岩测区的应用表明，该方法在两小时内完成了传统需数周的人工解释，成功捕获了主要沉积趋势，与传统沉积环境图高度吻合，实现了高效、可重复的储层预测。

t: A two-stage workflow combining a Genetic Algorithm for automated horizon construction and Self-Organizing Maps for clustering multi-family seismic attributes into facies classes.
结合遗传算法自动构建层位与自组织映射（SOM）对多族地震属性进行聚类划分沉积相的双阶段工作流。
A large regional carbonate seismic survey spanning tens of thousands of square kilometers, benchmarked against a conventional Gross Depositional Environment map and sparse well data.
覆盖数万平方公里的区域碳酸盐岩地震测区数据，并以传统总沉积环境图和稀疏井数据作为基准。
The workflow completed in about two hours, successfully capturing major depositional trends and independently resolving the Out-Inter Shoal anomaly in agreement with well property contrasts.
工作流在约两小时内完成，成功捕获了主要沉积趋势，并独立识别出与井物性对比一致的“滩外-滩间”异常。
The seismic-only approach is subject to non-unique seismic responses in heterogeneous carbonates and depends on the choice of attribute families.
仅地震数据的方法在非均质碳酸盐岩中存在多解性，且依赖于属性族的选择。
Automating regional carbonate facies mapping by coupling genetic-algorithm-based horizon picking with multi-attribute self-organizing maps, reducing interpretation time from weeks to hours.
将基于遗传算法的层位拾取与多属性自组织映射相结合，实现区域碳酸盐岩相的自动制图，将解释时间缩短至数小时。

kc: Developed a two-stage, seismic-only workflow using shallow machine learning for rapid regional carbonate facies classification.
Demonstrated that Genetic Algorithms can automate laterally consistent horizon construction, reducing manual picking time from weeks to hours.
Validated SOM-based clustering against conventional Gross Depositional Environment (GDE) maps, successfully identifying key geological features like the Out-Inter Shoal anomaly.
开发了一种利用浅度机器学习进行快速区域碳酸盐岩相分类的双阶段、仅地震数据工作流。
证明了遗传算法可以自动构建横向一致的地震层位，将人工拾取时间从数周缩短至数小时。
通过与传统沉积环境（GDE）图对比验证了基于SOM的聚类，成功识别出“滩外-滩间”异常等关键地质特征。
me: Genetic Algorithm (GA) for target-oriented and reproducible construction of laterally consistent seismic horizons.
Self-Organizing Maps (SOMs) for clustering multi-attribute seismic data (amplitude, waveform-character, and lateral-discontinuity).

sum: Short-term geodetic and long-term geologic vertical deformation rates in active orogens often diverge due to elastic strain accumulation over the seismic cycle. This study reconciles decadal geodetic (GNSS and precise leveling) and millennial geologic uplift observations across Taiwan using a 3D elastic plate-based kinematic back-slip model subject to flexural isostasy. Employing Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) inversion, the authors jointly resolve slip rates and interseismic locking across upper-crustal faults, a basal detachment, and subduction interfaces. Results indicate that slip on a largely unlocked basal detachment drives orogen-wide uplift of up to 10–12 mm/yr in the Central Range, whereas interseismic locking concentrates on upper-crustal faults. Present-day subsidence in the Coastal Range is explained by locking on the Longitudinal Valley Fault. Furthermore, resolving strike-slip components substantially increases 100-year equivalent moment magnitudes on oblique faults, improving regional seismic hazard assessments.
本研究利用考虑挠曲均衡的三维弹性板运动学回滑模型，結合马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）反演，联合台湾2018-2020年GNSS与精密水准短周期大地测量数据及千年尺度地质隆升记录，反演了上地壳断层、基底滑脱层和俯冲界面的滑动速率与震间闭锁分布。结果表明，基本未闭锁的基底滑脱层滑动驱动了中央山脉高达10……

采用考虑挠曲均衡的三维弹性板回滑模型与MCMC算法，联合反演断层滑动速率与闭锁深度。

Integrates millennial-scale geologic uplift/subsidence rates with 2018–2020 geodetic velocities from 698 continuous and 773 campaign GNSS stations plus 42 precise leveling routes (~1 km spacing) across Taiwan.

Slip on an unlocked basal detachment drives up to 10–12 mm/yr uplift in the Central Range; locking concentrates on upper-crustal faults like the Longitudinal Valley Fault (19.67 mm/yr dip-slip, 16.32 mm/yr strike-slip).

Assumes steady-state geologic uplift and purely elastic interseismic deformation, imposing uniform slip along fault segments and omitting transient postseismic viscoelastic flow and sub-detachment faults.
假设纯弹性震间形变与断层均匀滑动，忽略了集集地震震后粘弹性松弛及滑脱层下伏发震构造。

首次在全台湾应用无刚性块体边界和无固定滑动角假设的三维弹性板模型，调和长短期垂直形变。

kc: Reconciled short-term geodetic (GNSS/leveling) and millennial geologic vertical deformation rates across Taiwan using a 3D deformable elastic plate-based back-slip model.
Demonstrated that an unlocked basal detachment drives orogen-wide uplift (10–12 mm/yr in the Central Range), while interseismic locking concentrates on upper-crustal faults.
Independently resolved strike-slip and dip-slip rates without fixed rake assumptions, showing that strike-slip motion significantly increases accumulated seismic moment on oblique structures.

me: 3D plate-based kinematic back-slip forward modeling using triangular dislocation elements embedded in a 30-km elastic plate overlying an inviscid substrate with flexural isostasy.
Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) inversion with Metropolis-Hastings sampling to jointly estimate linear fault slip rates and nonlinear upper/lower locking depth boundaries.
Empirical uncertainty scaling and weighting across disparate geodetic and geologic datasets to balance data influence and avoid fitting non-tectonic vertical signals.
基于三维弹性板运动学回滑正演模型，将三角形位错元嵌入覆于无粘性基底之上、厚30 km且受挠曲均衡约束的弹性板中。
采用Metropolis-Hastings采样的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）反演，联合估计线性断层滑动速率和非线性上下闭锁深度边界。
对不同类型的大地测量和地质数据进行经验不确定性缩放与加权，以平衡数据影响并避免拟合非构造垂直信号。

Short-term geodetic observations (2018–2020) from 698 continuous and 773 campaign GNSS stations, plus 42 precise leveling routes (~1 km benchmark spacing).
3D fault mesh geometry adapted from the Taiwan Earthquake Model (TEM), offshore seismic reflection profiles, and aftershock distributions.
千年尺度地质垂直速率汇编，包括海岸/河流阶地放射性测年、钻孔盆地沉降率、宇宙成因核素剥蚀率及碎屑锆石裂变径迹数据。
2018至2020年间的短周期大地测量数据，包含698个连续站、773个流动GNSS站以及42条精密水准路线（水准点平均间距约1 km）。
改编自台湾地震模型（TEM）、近海地震反射剖面及余震分布的三维断层网格几何模型。
li: Assumes a fully relaxed inviscid mantle over long timescales and purely elastic interseismic deformation, neglecting transient viscoelastic postseismic flow (e.g., from the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake).
Imposes spatially uniform long-term slip rates along individual upper-crustal fault segments and omits poorly constrained sub-detachment seismogenic structures.
Sparse geologic vertical constraints in northern Taiwan and offshore areas lead to high uncertainties and poorly resolved locking probabilities in those regions.
假设长周期下地幔完全松弛无粘性且震间形变为纯弹性，忽略了瞬态粘弹性震后流动（如1999年集集地震的震后效应）。
在单个上地壳断层段上施加空间均匀的长期滑动速率，且未显式包含几何约束较差的滑脱层下伏发震构造。

tm.why: The paper resolves interseismic fault locking, creeping sections, and long-term fault slip rates across upper-crustal faults and a basal detachment in Taiwan.
The study models 3D orogen-scale crustal deformation, mountain building, and flexural isostasy across the Taiwan convergent plate boundary.
The authors apply a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm with Metropolis-Hastings sampling to jointly estimate posterior distributions of fault slip rates and nonlinear locking depths.

sum: This document outlines a 'frozen analysis protocol' designed to prospectively or retrospectively test the hypothesis of hours-scale precursory slip prior to major earthquakes in Japan. Utilizing high-precision tiltmeter data from the National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED) Hi-net array, the protocol establishes strict, pre-defined criteria and statistical tests to avoid post-hoc bias (p-hacking) in searching for precursory deformation. This systematic approach is crucial for evaluating the predictability of earthquakes and the physical validity of proposed precursory slip models.
本文详细介绍了一项“冻结分析协议”，旨在利用日本防灾科学技术研究所（NIED）Hi-net微震台网的高精度倾斜仪数据，对日本地震前数小时尺度是否存在前兆滑动进行严格的假设检验。该协议通过预先设定明确的数据处理与统计检验标准，有效避免了事后选择性汇报（p-hacking）偏差。这种系统性方法对于客观评……

sum: This publication outlines a 'frozen analysis protocol' designed to test the hypothesis of hours-scale precursory slip prior to major earthquakes in Japan. Utilizing high-sensitivity tiltmeter data from the National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED) Hi-net array, the protocol establishes a pre-registered, unbiased statistical framework to evaluate whether detectable precursory deformation consistently occurs before seismic events. By freezing the analysis parameters before executing the test on the full dataset, the method aims to eliminate researcher degrees of freedom and avoid hindsight bias in earthquake precursor studies. This represents a rigorous methodological step toward evaluating the predictability of earthquake nucleation phases.
本文提出了一种“冻结分析协议”，用于测试日本大地震前数小时尺度前兆滑动的假设。该协议利用NIED Hi-net高灵敏度倾斜仪数据，构建了预注册的无偏统计框架。通过在测试前冻结分析参数，旨在消除研究人员的主观选择偏差，避免后见之明。这是严谨评估地震前兆可预测性的重要方法学尝试。

sum: This study investigates the melt-assisted destruction of thick continental lithosphere using petrographic and Sr-Nd-Pb isotopic analyses of Arabian xenoliths. The authors identify three distinct metasomatic events (silicate, hydrous fluid, and carbonate) occurring between 400 and 1000 Ma. These events modified the lithosphere, making it anomalously dense and fusible. Despite these modifications, the lithosphere remained stable ("frozen") until Miocene fracturing perturbed the system, initiating lithospheric foundering and recycling. This mechanism explains continental volcanism and lithospheric foundering in the absence of active subduction, offering insights into lithospheric differentiation on early Earth and other planetary bodies.
本研究通过对阿拉伯地幔包体进行岩相学和Sr-Nd-Pb同位素分析，探讨了熔体辅助下大陆岩石圈的破坏机制。研究发现，在400-1000 Ma期间发生了三次截然不同的交代事件（硅酸盐、富水流体和碳酸盐），导致岩石圈异常致密且易熔。该改性岩石圈保持稳定直至中新世，此时断裂发育扰动了岩石圈并引发了沉降与循环……

t: Petrographic and Sr-Nd-Pb isotopic characterization of mantle xenoliths to identify distinct metasomatic events.
通过地幔包体的岩相学和Sr-Nd-Pb同位素表征来识别不同的交代事件。
Geochemical and isotopic measurements of Arabian mantle xenoliths representing ancient metasomatism.
代表古老交代作用的阿拉伯地幔包体的地球化学和同位素测量数据。
Identification of three metasomatic events (400-1000 Ma) that preconditioned the lithosphere for Miocene foundering.
识别出三次交代事件（400-1000 Ma），这些事件为中新世岩石圈沉降提供了先决条件。
Spatial limitation of xenolith samples and reliance on indirect timing of physical triggers like fracturing.
包体样品的空间局限性，以及对断裂等物理触发机制间接定时的依赖。
Linking ancient metasomatic preconditioning to delayed, fracture-triggered lithospheric foundering in the absence of active subduction.
在无主动俯冲的情况下，将古老的交代预处理与延迟的、断裂触发的岩石圈沉降联系起来。

kc: Characterized three distinct metasomatic events (silicate, hydrous fluid, carbonate) in Arabian xenoliths using Sr-Nd-Pb isotopes.
Demonstrated how ancient metasomatism (400-1000 Ma) preconditioned the lithosphere for modern instability and foundering.
Proposed a model where Miocene fracturing triggered the recycling of a previously stable, metasomatized lithosphere.
利用Sr-Nd-Pb同位素特征化了阿拉伯地幔包体中的三种不同交代事件（硅酸盐、富水流体和碳酸盐）。
证明了古老的交代作用（400-1000 Ma）如何使岩石圈预先具备了现代不稳定性和沉降的条件。
提出了一个模型，即中新世的断裂作用触发了先前稳定的交代岩石圈的循环消亡。

sum: Submarine landslides on gentle continental slopes (<2°) require weak layers to initiate failure, yet the role of oceanographic internal waves (IWs) in generating these layers remains poorly understood. Using high-resolution 3D seismic reflection data and acoustic impedance inversion from the northern South China Sea, this study images previously unrecognized submarine landslides landward of the giant Baiyun Slide Complex. The newly mapped Northern and Southern Slide Complexes expand the unstable slope area by ~700 km² (~20 km³ volume) and show recurrent failures at ~0.54 Ma and ~0.2 Ma. Crucially, all failures share a basal glide plane directly atop a stratigraphic interval of buried sediment waves (wavelengths 140–230 m, heights 3–8 m). High acoustic impedance and palaeo-seafloor criticality calculations (~1.6 Ma) indicate these waves consist of coarse-grained sediments deposited by dissipating diurnal IWs, which later liquefied under seismic shaking or overpressure to trigger repeated slope collapse.
平缓大陆坡上的海底滑坡受控于软弱层，但海洋内波对软弱层形成的作用尚不明确。本研究利用南海北部高分辨率三维地震反射数据、方差属性与波阻抗反演，在白云滑坡群陆侧识别出新的北部和南部滑坡复合体，将不稳定斜坡面积扩大了约700平方公里（体积约20立方公里），并揭示了~0.54 Ma和~0.2 Ma的多次滑坡……

t: The authors combine 3D seismic attribute analysis (variance, RMS amplitude, acoustic impedance inversion) with oceanographic internal-wave criticality modeling (comparing seafloor slope angle to internal-wave characteristic slope via CTD buoyancy frequency) to link buried sediment waves to slope failure.
结合三维地震属性（方差、RMS振幅、波阻抗反演）与海洋内波临界性水动力计算分析斜坡失稳。

High-resolution 3D seismic reflection data covering 700 km² on the northern South China Sea continental slope (water depths 750–1250 m), tied to regional 2D seismic lines, ODP/IODP boreholes, and WOD18 hydrographic CTD casts.
南海北部陆坡700平方公里高分辨率三维地震数据，结合二维地震剖面、大洋钻探井及CTD水文数据。

Newly discovered submarine landslides expand the Baiyun Slide Complex by ~700 km² (~20 km³ volume), failing repeatedly (~0.54 Ma and ~0.2 Ma) along a basal weak layer composed of diurnal internal-wave-induced coarse-grained sediment waves formed around ~1.6 Ma.
新发现滑坡将白云滑坡群扩大约700平方公里（体积20立方公里），沿~1.6 Ma形成的内波沉积物波多次滑脱。

Near-bed current velocities, grain-size contrasts, and sediment-transport thresholds cannot be directly constrained due to the absence of sediment core samples and in-situ bottom current measurements.
缺乏沉积物钻孔岩芯与原位近底海流测量，无法直接约束粒径对比和泥沙起动流速阈值。

First 3D seismic demonstration that coarse-grained sediment waves deposited by deep-water internal waves can form persistent weak layers that precondition recurrent submarine landslides on gentle continental slopes.
首次利用三维地震证实深水内波沉积的粗粒沉积物波可作为持久软弱层控制平缓陆坡反复滑坡。

kc: Maps previously unrecognized submarine landslides landward of the Baiyun Slide Complex using 3D seismic data, expanding its known unstable area by ~700 km² (~6%) and volume by ~20 km³.
Identifies a buried interval of sediment waves (wavelengths 140–230 m, heights 3–8 m) with high acoustic impedance directly beneath the basal glide plane of recurrent slope failures.

Demonstrates through oceanographic criticality modeling and seismic stratigraphy that dissipating diurnal internal waves at ~1.6 Ma deposited coarse-grained sediment waves that act as liquefaction-prone weak layers.
利用三维地震数据在白云滑坡群陆侧识别出未知的海底滑坡，将其已知不稳定面积扩大约700平方公里（约6%），体积增加约20立方公里。
在多次滑坡的底界滑脱面正下方识别出一套具有高波阻抗特征的埋藏沉积物波（波长140–230米，波高3–8米）。
结合海洋内波临界性模拟与地震地层学，证实~1.6 Ma全日潮内波耗散沉积的粗粒沉积物波构成了易液化的软弱层。
me: 3D seismic reflection interpretation and horizon mapping of mass-transport deposits (MTDs) and basal glide planes.
Seismic attribute extraction including variance, root-mean-square (RMS) amplitude, and acoustic impedance inversion.
Oceanographic internal wave criticality analysis comparing seafloor slope gradients to theoretical internal wave characteristic rays using CTD water-column stratification profiles.
三维地震反射解释及块体搬运沉积（MTDs）与底界滑脱面的层位追踪。
地震属性提取，包括方差属性、均方根（RMS）振幅及波阻抗反演。
海洋内波临界性分析，利用CTD水体层化剖面对比海床坡度与理论内波特征射线斜率。
