Regional 2D seismic profiles tied to ODP Site 1148 and IODP Site U1501 for Plio-Quaternary age constraints.
World Ocean Database 2018 (WOD18) CTD temperature-salinity-pressure casts (1970–2017) for calculating buoyancy frequency and internal wave criticality.
南海北部700平方公里高分辨率三维地震反射数据集（水深750–1250米，面元12.5米×12.5米，主频约40 Hz）。
连接ODP 1148站位和IODP U1501站位的区域二维地震剖面，用于上新世-第四纪地层年代约束。
世界海洋数据库2018（WOD18）CTD温盐压剖面数据（1970–2017年），用于计算浮力频率和内波临界角。
li: Lack of direct geological sediment cores or in-situ geotechnical measurements penetrating the buried sediment wave interval to directly confirm grain size and liquefaction properties.
Near-bed palaeo-current velocities and exact sediment-transport thresholds at ~1.6 Ma cannot be directly constrained without physical samples.
缺乏穿透埋藏沉积物波层位的直接地质岩芯或原位岩土工程测量数据，无法直接证实其粒径和液化特性。
在没有实物样品的情况下，无法直接约束~1.6 Ma时期的近底古流速和确切的泥沙起动阈值。

tm.why: Uses 3D marine seismic reflection imaging and acoustic attributes to investigate submarine landslide mechanics and internal-wave-induced weak layers on continental slopes.
Evaluates recurrent submarine slope instability, earthquake-triggered liquefaction of coarse-grained weak layers, and associated tsunami geohazard potential in the South China Sea.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the provided PDF text (pages 1 and 11–15) and complete metadata/abstract.

sum: Western Canada's Canadian Cordillera exhibits clear inland deformation, yet most crustal faults lack definitive Quaternary characterization and are omitted as explicit fault sources in Canada's 6th Generation Seismic Hazard Model (CanSHM6). This study maps potentially active faults across western Canada and constructs a 379-block, 923-fault tectonic model using the Oiler code. Inverting 6,911 GNSS velocities and 427 geologic slip rates yields low-to-moderate slip rates (<2 mm/yr) on most inland faults, such as 1.5–1.6 mm/yr along the Rocky Mountain thrust front and 2.0–2.7 mm/yr on Vancouver Island faults. Using the Fermi toolkit, 154 regional faults are converted into multifault rupture networks and merged into CanSHM6 and Canada's National Seismic Risk Model. While absolute hazard changes are modest near Cascadia, relative hazard and financial risk increase by 1.5 to 20 times in interior communities like Cranbrook, Lillooet, and Calgary, highlighting an urgent need for denser geodetic and paleoseismic data.
本研究利用大地测量与地质块体模型评估了加拿大西部潜在活动断层对地震危险性和风险的影响。作者基于地形数据绘制潜在活动断层，构建包含379个块体和923条断层的构造模型，联合反演6911个GNSS速度数据和427个第四纪地质滑动速率。反演表明大多数内陆断层滑动速率较低（<2 mm/yr），如落基山逆冲前……

t: The authors map potentially active faults to construct a rigid-block and triangular subduction-mesh kinematic model (Oiler), invert GNSS and geologic rates via weighted least-squares, and build multifault PSHA sources (Fermi) merged into CanSHM6.
绘制潜在活动断层构建块体与俯冲网格模型（Oiler），最小二乘反演滑动速率，并用Fermi构建多断层破裂源融入CanSH…

The kinematic block inversion uses 6,911 GNSS velocities and 427 Quaternary geologic and spreading slip rates across 379 blocks and 923 faults, alongside 30 m SRTM, ArcticDEM, and GMRT bathymetry for fault mapping.
利用379个块体和923条断层上的6911个GNSS速度和427个地质滑动速率，结合SRTM和ArcticDEM地形。

Inland Canadian faults show slip rates <2 mm/yr (e.g., 1.5–1.6 mm/yr on the Rocky Mountain thrust front). Including these faults changes coastal hazard little, but increases expected financial losses 1.3x in Calgary and 20x in Cranbrook.
内陆断层滑动率多<2 mm/yr；纳入断层后沿海危险性变化小，但卡尔加里和Cranbrook预期损失增至1.3倍和20倍…

Extreme sparsity of geodetic stations and verified Holocene geologic slip rates outside the Cascadia region introduces large epistemic uncertainties, making the hazard and risk estimates illustrative rather than prescriptive.
卡斯卡迪亚以外地区GNSS站点和全新世地质数据极度稀疏，认知不确定性大，结果仅具示意性。

First regional integration of a geodetic-geologic tectonic block model and multifault rupture networks for uncharacterized interior Cordilleran faults directly into Canada's national seismic hazard and financial risk models.
首次将科迪勒拉内陆潜在断层的大地测量块体模型与多断层破裂网络直接整合进加拿大国家地震危险性与风险模型。

kc: Mapped active and potentially active crustal faults across the Canadian Cordillera and built a 379-block, 923-fault kinematic block model.
Jointly inverted 6,911 GNSS velocities and 427 geologic slip rates to estimate fault slip rates and subduction coupling, finding <2 mm/yr slip on most mainland Canadian faults.
Converted 154 crustal faults into a 38,785-rupture multifault PSHA source model using Fermi and integrated it into CanSHM6 and Canada's National Seismic Risk Model.
Demonstrated that while coastal cities dominated by Cascadia see minimal hazard change, interior communities near newly modeled faults face 1.5 to 20 times higher financial risk.
绘制了加拿大科迪勒拉山系的活动及潜在活动地壳断层，构建了包含379个块体和923条断层的运动学块体模型。
联合反演6911个GNSS速度和427个地质滑动速率以估算断层滑动速率与俯冲带耦合，发现加拿大内陆多数断层滑动速率低于2 mm/yr。
利用Fermi工具将154条地壳断层转化为包含38,785个破裂的多断层地震危险性震源模型，并整合至CanSHM6和国家地震风险模型中。
证明受卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带主导的沿海城市危险性变化不大，但靠近新建模断层的内陆社区面临1.5至20倍的预期经济损失增长。
me: Tectonic geomorphology fault mapping using 30 m SRTM, ArcticDEM, and GMRT bathymetry.
Elastic-block kinematic modeling (Oiler code) via weighted linear least-squares inversion of block motions and triangular-mesh subduction locking with Monte Carlo uncertainty estimation.
Multifault rupture network generation (Fermi toolkit) using ~10x10 km subfaults, 10 km jump distance, and 0.7 seismic slip fraction.
Probabilistic seismic hazard and stochastic financial risk calculations using the OpenQuake Engine merged with CanSHM6 and NBCC2020 exposure/vulnerability models.
基于30米SRTM、ArcticDEM及GMRT水深数据的构造地貌断层填图。
利用Oiler代码进行弹性块体运动学建模，通过加权线性最小二乘反演同时估算块体运动与三角网格俯冲带闭锁，并采用蒙特卡洛模拟评估不确定性。
利用Fermi工具包生成多断层破裂网络（约10x10 km子断层、10 km跳跃距离阈值及0.7地震滑动比例）。
将新断层震源与CanSHM6及NBCC2020暴露度/脆弱性模型融合，使用OpenQuake引擎计算概率地震危险性与随机财务风险。
de: 6,911 GNSS horizontal velocity vectors compiled from Elliott & Freymueller (2020), Global Strain Rate Model (Kreemer et al., 2014), and UNR MIDAS (Blewitt et al., 2018).
427 Quaternary geologic fault slip rates and mid-ocean ridge spreading rates across North America and the Pacific.
Digital elevation and bathymetry datasets: 30 m SRTM (south of 60°N), ArcticDEM (north of 60°N), and GMRT offshore synthesis.
CanSHM6 seismic source logic tree, ground motion models, and Canada's 1st Generation Seismic Risk Model exposure dataset for 9 western Canadian municipalities.
汇编自Elliott & Freymueller (2020)、全球应变率模型和UNR MIDAS的6,911个GNSS速度矢量。
北美和太平洋地区的427个第四纪地质断层滑动速率及洋中脊扩张速率数据。
数字高程与水深数据集：60°N以南30米SRTM、60°N以北ArcticDEM以及近海GMRT综合水深数据。
CanSHM6震源逻辑树、地面运动模型以及加拿大第一代国家地震风险模型中西部9个市镇的暴露度数据集。
li: Extreme sparsity of GNSS stations and peer-reviewed Quaternary geologic slip rates across interior British Columbia, Alberta, and Yukon heavily limits confidence in inferred fault slip rates.
Mapped faults are treated as 'potentially active' without requiring documented Holocene rupture, and diffuse multi-stranded fault zones are simplified into single continuous block-bounding traces.
Merging block-model faults into CanSHM6 required ad-hoc 80% reductions in Mw > 6.0 area-source rates without formal model-wide seismic moment balancing or epistemic logic-tree exploration.
不列颠哥伦比亚省内陆、阿尔伯塔省和育空地区的GNSS站点及经同行评审的第四纪地质滑动速率极其稀疏，严重限制了推断滑动速率的可信度。
所绘断层仅作为“潜在活动断层”处理，未严格要求全新世破裂证据，且将弥散的多分支断层带简化为单一连续的块体边界。
将块体模型断层并入CanSHM6时，对含断层面源中Mw>6.0的地震发生率进行了80%的经验性折减，未进行全模型地震矩平衡或认知不确定性逻辑树探索。

tm.why: The core objective of the paper is to evaluate changes in probabilistic seismic hazard and financial risk across western Canada by incorporating potentially active crustal faults into Canada's 6th Generation Seismic Hazard Model.

The study constructs a tectonic microplate block model spanning North America and the Pacific to invert GNSS velocities and Quaternary geologic slip rates for regional crustal deformation and fault kinematics.
A weighted linear least-squares inversion with equality constraints and spatial regularization is formulated to simultaneously estimate block motions and subduction zone locking deficits.

ev.notes: Full 32-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF (formatted for Seismica) including all 12 figures and 2 tables was analyzed directly.

sum: This paper presents a novel numerical approach combining the fast sweeping method (FSM) with the discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method on triangular meshes to solve the eikonal equation. This combination achieves second-order accuracy and high efficiency for computing first-arrival traveltimes in models with rugged topography and complex subsurface interfaces. Furthermore, the method is extended to compute reflected PP and PS wave traveltimes in elastic media by using the computed traveltimes at reflection interfaces as initial conditions. Numerical simulations demonstrate the method's high accuracy and capability in handling complex geometries, making it highly suitable for seismic tomography and imaging applications.
本文提出了一种结合快速扫频法（FSM）与间断伽辽金（DG）方法的数值算法，在三角形网格上求解程函方程。该方法实现了二阶精度，能高效计算具有起伏地表和复杂地下界面模型的初至波走时。此外，该方法通过将反射界面处的走时作为初始条件，进一步实现了弹性介质中反射PP和PS波走时的计算。数值模拟证实了该方法在处……

t: A fast sweeping method combined with the discontinuous Galerkin method on triangular meshes to solve the eikonal equation with second-order accuracy.
结合快速扫频法与间断伽辽金法，在三角形网格上二阶精度求解程函方程。
Synthetic velocity models with complex geometries, rugged topography, and irregular subsurface interfaces.
具有复杂几何形状、起伏地形和不规则地下界面的合成速度模型。
Accurate and efficient computation of first-arrival traveltimes and reflected PP/PS wave traveltimes in complex elastic media.
在复杂弹性介质中实现了初至波和反射PP/PS波走时的高精度、高效计算。
The method's performance and implementation complexity in 3D tetrahedral meshes are not fully explored in this work.
该方法在三维四面体网格中的性能和实现复杂度在本文中未作深入探讨。
Combining DG and FSM on triangular meshes to handle complex topography and extending it to reflected PP/PS waves.
在三角形网格上结合DG与FSM以应对复杂地形，并将其扩展至反射PP/PS波。

kc: Developed a second-order discontinuous Galerkin fast sweeping method on triangular meshes for eikonal equations.
Extended the traveltime calculation to reflected PP and PS waves in elastic media.
Enabled accurate traveltime modeling in the presence of rugged topography and complex subsurface interfaces.
研发了三角形网格上求解程函方程的二阶间断伽辽金快速扫频法。
将走时计算扩展至弹性介质中的反射PP和PS波。
实现了在起伏地形和复杂地下界面存在时的精确走时建模。
me: Discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method for solving the eikonal equation.
Fast Sweeping Method (FSM) for efficient Gauss-Seidel iterations.
Triangular meshing to conform to complex geometries.
用于求解程函方程的间断伽辽金（DG）方法。
用于高效高斯-赛德尔迭代的快速扫频法（FSM）。
适应复杂几何形状的三角形网格剖分。
de: Numerical simulations on synthetic velocity models with complex geometries and rugged topography.
在具有复杂几何形状和起伏地形的合成速度模型上进行数值模拟。
li: The computational cost and implementation complexity in 3D tetrahedral meshes are not fully addressed.
该方法在三维四面体网格中的计算成本和实现复杂度尚未得到完全解决。

tm.why: The paper develops a discontinuous Galerkin method combined with a fast sweeping method to solve the eikonal equation for traveltimes.
Accurate traveltime computation is a core component of traveltime tomography and seismic imaging.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Initializing fault stress states is a major challenge in dynamic rupture simulations. Traditional methods rely either on regional stress field projections or on geodetic interseismic locking models, leading to inconsistencies between geometric barriers and strain accumulation. This study proposes a spatiotemporal co-constraint framework that integrates interseismic slip-deficit models with regional tectonic stress projections, capping background shear stress at the dynamic frictional strength via a calibrated reference point. Validated on the 2022 Mw 6.6 Luding earthquake using a two-stage GPU-accelerated curvilinear grid finite-difference method (CGFDM), the simulation reproduces the observed Mw 6.6 magnitude, 26.0 km surface rupture length, rupture arrest at a 32-degree fault bend, seismic intensity distribution, and strong-motion waveforms. Comparative analyses against stress-field-only (Mw 7.0) and slip-deficit-only (Mw 6.7) models confirm that joint constraints better capture complex rupture termination and energy release, offering a robust physics-based approach for seismic hazard assessment.
断层初始应力设定是动力破裂模拟的核心难题。传统方法单独依赖区域应力场投影或大地测量震间闭锁模型，难以兼顾断层几何屏障与应变积累的时空演化。本文提出一种时空联合约束框架，通过参考点标定与动态摩擦强度截断，将GPS/InSAR反演的震间滑动亏损与区域构造应力场相结合。基于GPU加速的曲线网格有限差分法（……

t: A spatiotemporal co-constrained stress initialization framework combines regional stress projections (background shear stress capped at dynamic frictional strength) with cumulative interseismic shear stress from geodetic locking, simulated via a two-stage GPU-accelerated 3D curvilinear grid finite-difference method (CGFDM).
结合动态摩擦截断的区域应力场投影与震间闭锁累积剪应力，利用GPU加速CGFDM进行两阶段破裂与强震模拟。

The model uses GPS/InSAR interseismic slip-deficit rates on the Xianshuihe Fault scaled since 1327, a 3D regional stress model, CSRM-1.0 3D velocity structure, SRTM 90m topography, and strong-motion waveforms and intensities from the 2022 Luding earthquake.
采用鲜水河断裂GPS/InSAR震间闭锁模型、3D区域应力与速度模型（CSRM-1.0）、SRTM地形及强震记录。

The co-constrained model reproduces an Mw 6.6 rupture arresting at the southern 32-degree fault bend, with 1.35 m peak slip, 0.47 m peak surface offset over 26.0 km, 1.26 MPa average stress drop, and intensity IX matching observed waveforms.
复现Mw 6.6震级、1.35 m最大滑动、26 km地表破裂、1.26 MPa平均应力降、32°弯曲处终止及IX度烈度…
Forward rupture simulations remain highly sensitive to the unknown hypocenter location, are limited by geodetic locking model resolution, and omit viscoelastic relaxation and off-fault plasticity.
正向预测对震源位置高度敏感，受限于大地测量分辨率，且未包含粘弹性松弛和断层外塑性。
It resolves the inconsistency between geodetic strain accumulation and geometric stress modulation by combining regional stress projections with stress capping and interseismic slip deficits.
通过参考点标定与背景应力截断将区域应力投影与震间滑动亏损结合，解决了断层弯曲处应力集中与阻挡的矛盾。

kc: Proposed a spatiotemporal co-constrained stress initialization framework integrating geodetic interseismic locking models with regional stress projections.
Introduced a stress-capping mechanism at dynamic frictional strength to resolve the paradox of rapid strain accumulation vs. rupture arrest at fault bends.
Demonstrated that stress accumulation for the 2022 Mw 6.6 Luding earthquake originated after the 1327 M7.5 event rather than the 1786 M7.75 event.
Reproduced the rupture process, surface offset, seismic intensity, and 3-component waveforms of the 2022 Luding earthquake, outperforming single-constraint schemes.
提出了融合大地测量震间闭锁模型与区域应力场投影的时空联合约束初始应力构建框架。
引入动态摩擦强度应力截断机制，解决了断层弯曲处快速应力积累与破裂阻挡之间的物理矛盾。
证实2022年泸定Mw 6.6地震的应力积累始于1327年M7.5地震而非1786年M7.75地震。
成功复现了泸定地震的破裂过程、地表位移、地震烈度及三分量强震波形，表现显著优于单一约束方法。
me: Spatiotemporal co-constrained stress initialization with reference-point pore pressure calibration (lambda = 0.7081) and dynamic friction shear stress truncation.
Linear slip-weakening friction law with depth-dependent slip-weakening distance and fault cohesion.
Two-stage numerical modeling using GPU-accelerated 3D curvilinear grid finite-difference method (CGFDM at 50 m grid for dynamic rupture; CGFDM3D-EQR at 200 m grid for strong ground motion).
Coulomb failure stress change (Delta CFS) modeling to evaluate post-mainshock stress transfer and aftershock distribution.
基于参考点孔隙水压力标定（λ = 0.7081）和动态摩擦剪应力截断的时空联合约束初始应力初始化方法。
采用随深度变化的特征滑动距离和断层粘聚力的线性滑动弱化摩擦准则。
利用GPU加速的三维曲线网格有限差分法进行两阶段模拟（50米网格CGFDM模拟动力破裂，200米网格CGFDM3D-EQR模拟强地面运动）。
计算库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）以评估主震后的应力转移及余震分布特征。
de: GPS and InSAR-derived interseismic locking and shear stress accumulation rate model of the Xianshuihe Fault from Li et al. (2022d).
3D geomechanical regional stress field model at 5 km depth (Li et al., 2022b) and 3D China Seismological Reference Model (CSRM-1.0) with SRTM 90m topography.
Strong-motion waveform records (0.02-0.2 Hz) at 7 near-field stations and instrumental seismic intensity data (Zhou et al., 2023).

Comparative numerical experiments testing co-constrained, slip-deficit-only, and stress-projection-only models, plus sensitivity tests on loading history (1327 vs 1786), dip angle, friction, and reference point.
基于GPS和InSAR反演的鲜水河断裂震间闭锁及剪应力积累速率模型（Li et al., 2022d）。
5 km深度三维地质力学区域应力场模型（Li et al., 2022b）、中国地震参考模型（CSRM-1.0）及SRTM 90米地形数据。
7个近场强震台站的三分量波形记录（0.02–0.2 Hz）及仪器地震烈度数据（Zhou et al., 2023）。
对比联合约束、仅滑动亏损、仅应力投影三种模型的数值实验，以及加载历史（1327年对比1786年）、倾角、摩擦系数和参考点位置的敏感性测试。
li: Strong sensitivity of forward rupture simulations to the assumed hypocenter nucleation location remains unresolved.
Spatial resolution is bounded by the GNSS station density and InSAR resolution of the input interseismic locking model.
Off-fault plasticity, thermal pressurization, and viscoelastic relaxation over multiple earthquake cycles are not explicitly modeled.
正向破裂模拟结果对预设震源成核位置的高度敏感性问题仍未解决。
模型的空间分辨率受限于输入震间闭锁模型的GNSS台站密度和InSAR分辨率。
未显式包含断层外塑性变形、热增压效应以及多地震周期的粘弹性松弛过程。

tm.why: The paper develops a spatiotemporal co-constrained stress initialization framework for 3D dynamic rupture simulations of the 2022 Mw 6.6 Luding earthquake.
The study couples dynamic rupture models with 3D strong ground motion simulations to predict seismic intensity (PGV) and compare synthetic waveforms against strong-motion stations.
The simulations rely on a GPU-accelerated 3D curvilinear grid finite-difference method (CGFDM) and the CGFDM3D-EQR platform incorporating complex 3D media and surface topography.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 15-page article PDF including abstract, methodology equations, 3D dynamic rupture and strong-motion simulation results, and all 10 figures.

sum: This study evaluates the advantages of using coda wave interferometry (CWI) with the Accurately Controlled Routinely Operated Signal System (ACROSS) active seismic source for high-resolution temporal monitoring of subsurface velocity changes (dv/v). Using a 10-month dataset from a 14-seismometer array in Morimachi, Japan, the authors deconvolved the recorded signals with the source function to obtain transfer functions. Applying CWI to these transfer functions successfully resolved both seasonal long-term and rapid, rainfall-induced short-term dv/v variations. Comparisons with direct P/S-wave travel times and ambient-noise interferometry demonstrated that ACROSS-CWI provides superior sensitivity to transient environmental changes. The mechanisms were validated using a poroelastic model incorporating precipitation, thermoelastic, and groundwater effects.
本研究评估了利用精确控制常规信号系统（ACROSS）主动地震源进行尾波干涉测量（CWI）在地下速度变化（dv/v）高分辨率监测中的优势。利用日本森町14个地震仪台阵的10个月观测数据，通过反褶积获取传输函数，并对尾波部分进行干涉分析。结果成功检测到季节性长期和降雨引起的短期快速dv/v变化。与传统的……

t: Coda wave interferometry applied to transfer functions obtained by deconvolving ACROSS active-source signals with the known source function.
将尾波干涉测量应用于通过反褶积ACROSS主动源信号与已知源函数获得的传输函数中。
A 10-month dataset of active-source ACROSS signals recorded by a 14-seismometer array deployed 3 km from the source in Morimachi, Japan.
日本森町距离ACROSS源约3公里处部署的14个地震仪台阵记录的10个月主动源数据集。
Successful detection of both seasonal long-term and rapid, rainfall-induced short-term dv/v variations, outperforming conventional direct-wave and ambient-noise methods.
成功检测到季节性长期和降雨引起的短期快速dv/v变化，性能优于传统的直达波和背景噪声方法。
Requires an expensive, specialized active seismic source (ACROSS) and localized receiver array, limiting widespread applicability.
需要昂贵且专业的有源地震发射装置（ACROSS）及局域接收台阵，限制了其广泛应用。
First comprehensive demonstration of combining ACROSS active sources with coda wave interferometry to resolve dual-timescale environmental velocity variations.
首次全面展示了将ACROSS主动源与尾波干涉相结合，以解析双时间尺度环境速度变化。

kc: Demonstrated the high sensitivity of active-source coda wave interferometry (ACROSS-CWI) for monitoring dual-timescale subsurface velocity changes.
Proved that ACROSS-CWI outperforms conventional direct-wave travel-time and ambient-noise interferometry methods in resolving rapid, transient variations.
Modeled the observed velocity variations using a poroelastic framework incorporating precipitation, thermoelastic, and groundwater effects.
展示了主动源尾波干涉测量（ACROSS-CWI）在监测双时间尺度地下速度变化方面的高灵敏度。
证明了在解析快速瞬态变化方面，ACROSS-CWI优于传统的直达波走时和背景噪声干涉方法。
利用结合降雨、热弹性及地下水效应的多孔弹性框架对观测到的速度变化进行了建模。
me: Deconvolution of recorded ACROSS active-source signals with the known source function to obtain transfer functions.
Application of coda wave interferometry (CWI) to the late-arriving scattered wave portions of the transfer functions.
Poroelastic modeling incorporating precipitation, thermoelastic effects, and groundwater level variations.
将记录的ACROSS主动源信号与已知源函数进行反褶积以获取传输函数。
对传输函数的晚期散射波（尾波）部分应用尾波干涉测量（CWI）。
结合降雨、热弹性效应和地下水位变化的多孔弹性建模。
de: A 10-month continuous seismic dataset recorded by a 14-seismometer array deployed 3 km away from the ACROSS source in Morimachi, central Japan.
由部署在日本中部森町、距离ACROSS源约3公里的14台地震仪台阵记录的为期10个月的连续地震数据集。
li: The method relies on a highly specialized, active seismic source (ACROSS), which limits its applicability to areas equipped with such infrastructure.
该方法依赖于高度专业的主动地震源（ACROSS），这限制了其在未配备此类基础设施的区域的应用。

tm.why: The paper focuses on applying coda wave interferometry to monitor temporal seismic velocity changes.
The study compares the active-source coda wave interferometry results with conventional ambient-noise interferometry.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study analyzes CCTV video recordings capturing co-seismic surface deformation during the 2018 Hualien (Mw 6.4), 2025 Mandalay (Mw 7.7), and 2026 Kumamoto (Mw 6.8) earthquakes using a unified image-tracking methodology. To eliminate camera shaking from strong ground motion and handheld secondary recording, video frames are aligned by translating, scaling, and rotating reference pixel windows on the near side of the fault. Subpixel cross-correlation tracking of far-side targets, followed by correlation-weighted Savitzky–Golay polynomial differentiation, yields displacement and velocity time histories calibrated against field surveys. Despite whole-fault rupture durations spanning 8 to 85 s, local surface displacement lasted ~2 s across all three events, with peak velocities of at least 0.84, 2.1, and 1.3 m/s, respectively. Notably, the oblique-slip 2026 Kumamoto rupture exhibited a multi-peaked velocity history, suggesting fault geometry and near-surface compliance strongly influence surface slip complexity.
本研究采用统一的图像追踪方法，分析了2018年花莲（Mw 6.4）、2025年曼德勒（Mw 7.7）和2026年熊本（Mw 6.8）三次地震的监控视频，提取同震地表变形过程。通过固定断层近侧参考窗口并对齐图像帧，消除了强地面运动和二次翻拍抖动的影响；进而利用亚像素互相关追踪远侧目标，结合相关系数加权……

t: Frames are aligned by fixing near-fault reference windows via translation, scaling, and rotation, followed by subpixel cross-correlation tracking of far-side windows and correlation-weighted Savitzky–Golay polynomial differentiation.
通过固定近断层参考窗口对齐图像帧，亚像素互相关追踪远侧目标，并用加权Savitzky–Golay滤波求导计算速度。

Publicly available CCTV videos recording co-seismic surface displacement during the 2018 Hualien (Mw 6.4), 2025 Mandalay (Mw 7.7), and 2026 Kumamoto (Mw 6.8) earthquakes, calibrated with post-earthquake field survey measurements.
2018年花莲、2025年曼德勒和2026年熊本地震的同震地表变形监控视频，以及震后野外测量位错数据。

Surface motion lasted ~2 s in all three events despite magnitude differences, with estimated peak velocities of ≥0.84 m/s (Hualien), ≥2.1 m/s (Mandalay), and ≥1.3 m/s (Kumamoto, showing three velocity peaks).
三次事件地表错动均持续约2秒，峰值速度分别为≥0.84、≥2.1和≥1.3 m/s，其中熊本地震速度呈三峰复杂形态。

Video analysis only resolves 2D image-plane components rather than unique fault-parallel and vertical components, and the Hualien video captures complicated surface compression rather than pure fault slip.
仅能测量二维图像平面位移，无法唯一分解断层平行与垂直分量；花莲视频包含非纯断层滑动的地表压缩。

First unified comparative analysis of co-seismic surface fault motion across three earthquakes from CCTV footage, resolving the 2026 Kumamoto surface slip at tenfold higher temporal resolution than preliminary reports.
首次用统一方法对比三次地震同震地表错动视频，并以高一个量级的时间分辨率解析了2026年熊本地表破裂过程。

kc: Applies a unified image-alignment and subpixel correlation tracking method to CCTV videos of three earthquakes (2018 Hualien, 2025 Mandalay, 2026 Kumamoto).
Demonstrates that local co-seismic surface displacement duration is ~2 s across all three cases, independent of earthquake magnitude (Mw 6.4 to 7.7).
Estimates peak surface fault velocities of ~0.84–2.1 m/s by calibrating pixel tracking with post-earthquake field displacement measurements.
Reveals a complex, multi-peaked slip-velocity history for the 2026 Kumamoto oblique rupture compared to simpler unimodal histories in the other two events.
将统一的图像对齐与亚像素互相关追踪方法应用于2018年花莲、2025年曼德勒和2026年熊本三次地震的监控视频。
证实三次地震的局部同震地表位移持续时间均约为2秒，与地震矩震级（Mw 6.4至7.7）无明显直接比例关系。
结合震后野外地表位错测量标定像素追踪结果，估算得到约0.84–2.1 m/s的峰值地表断层滑动速度。
揭示了2026年熊本斜滑破裂具有复杂的多峰滑动速度时程，而其余两次事件则表现为相对简单的单峰特征。
me: Frame alignment via translation, scaling, and rotation keeping one or two reference pixel windows on the near side of the fault stationary.
Subpixel cross-correlation template tracking of a 50x50 pixel target window on the far side of the fault.
Velocity estimation by differentiating a second-order Savitzky–Golay polynomial locally fitted with fourth-power correlation coefficient weights.
Conversion from pixels and pixels/s to meters and m/s using post-earthquake field survey displacement measurements.
通过平移、缩放和旋转对齐图像帧，使断层近侧的一个或两个参考像素窗口保持固定，以消除相机抖动。
利用亚像素互相关模板匹配追踪断层远侧50×50像素目标窗口的相对运动。
以相关系数的四次方为权重进行局部二阶Savitzky–Golay多项式拟合，并通过求导计算滑动速度。
结合震后野外考察测量的地表最终位错量，将像素位移和像素速度转换为米和米每秒。
de: CCTV video footage of the February 2018 Mw 6.4 Hualien earthquake (11 fps effective frame rate) and field deformation measurements from Huang et al. (2019).
CCTV video footage of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake in Myanmar (30 fps) and field strike-slip offset measurements from Gao et al. (2025).
CCTV video footage of the July 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto earthquake along the southern Hinagu Fault (30 fps) and field survey offsets from Toda et al. (2026).
2018年2月Mw 6.4花莲地震的监控视频（有效帧率11 fps）及Huang等（2019）的野外观测变形数据。
2025年缅甸Mw 7.7曼德勒地震的监控视频（30 fps）及Gao等（2025）的野外走滑位错测量数据。
2026年7月沿日奈久断层南段发生的Mw 6.8熊本地震监控视频（30 fps）及Toda等（2026）的野外测量位错数据。
li: Video tracking measures only 2D image-plane (x, y) displacements, which cannot be uniquely mapped onto 3D fault-parallel, fault-normal, and vertical components.
The 2018 Hualien video has a low effective frame rate (~11 fps) and captures broader ground compression across a horsetail splay rather than pure fault slip.
Secondary handheld recordings of playback screens introduce additional camera motion and motion blur during strong shaking.
视频追踪仅能测量二维图像平面（x, y）位移，无法唯一映射为三维断层平行、断层法向和垂直分量。
2018年花莲地震视频有效帧率较低（约11 fps），且记录到的是断层马尾状分叉区的地表压缩而非纯断层滑动。
对回放屏幕的手持二次翻拍以及强地面运动会导致额外的画面抖动和运动模糊。

tm.why: The paper directly extracts and compares temporal slip histories, local slip durations, and peak slip velocities of co-seismic surface fault ruptures across three earthquakes.
It discusses fault-zone slip partitioning, compliant near-surface deformation, and compares video-derived surface slip velocities with laboratory rock-friction estimates.
The method removes strong ground motion shaking from CCTV footage to isolate co-seismic surface fault displacement discontinuities.

ev.notes: All 11 pages of the PDF including text, Table 1, and Figures 1–4 were read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates how faulting style affects the complete directional characteristics of horizontal earthquake ground motions. Using 3,862 records (Mw ≥ 5) from the NGA-West2 database across 58 oscillator periods (0.01 to 10 s), the authors examine two directionality parameters: pseudo-acceleration response spectral ordinates at all non-redundant orientations normalized by either RotD100 (η) or RotD50 (ν). Using nonlinear regression and maximum likelihood estimation, they develop strike-slip and reverse-slip specific models for geometric means, logarithmic standard deviations, and four-parameter Beta probability distributions. Results reveal minimal differences below 1 s, but at periods above 0.5 s, strike-slip events are 1% to 44% more polarized than reverse-slip events and exhibit 1% to 3.7% larger RotD100/RotD50 ratios. This provides the first comprehensive numerical quantification and statistical parameterization of faulting-style effects on full ground-motion directionality for orientation-specific seismic hazard and risk analyses.
本研究探讨了断层错动类型对水平地震动完整方向性特征的影响。基于NGA-West2数据库中3862条记录（Mw≥5），作者在0.01至10秒的58个周期上分析了经RotD100（η）或RotD50（ν）归一化的全方向伪加速度反应谱纵坐标。通过非线性回归和最大似然估计，构建了走滑和逆冲地震专属的几何均值……

t: Normalized spectral ordinates (η and ν) are computed across [-90°, 90°] from the RotD100 axis across 58 periods. Nonlinear regression and maximum likelihood estimation fit mechanism-specific trigonometric moment models and four-parameter Beta distributions.
在58个周期及[-90°,90°]旋转角计算归一化谱值η和ν，用非线性回归和最大似然估计拟合机制专属统计模型与Beta分…
3,862 free-field ground motion records (2,220 reverse-slip, 1,642 strike-slip) from the NGA-West2 database with Mw ≥ 5, NEHRP site classes B, C, or D, and PGV > 0.1 cm/s.
NGA-West2数据库中3862条自由场记录（2220条逆冲，1642条走滑），满足Mw≥5、B/C/D类场地及PGV…

Strike-slip earthquakes are 1% to 44% more polarized than reverse-slip earthquakes at periods above 0.5 s, have 1% to 3.7% larger RotD100/RotD50 ratios, and up to 34%–41% higher logarithmic standard deviations orthogonal to RotD100.
在>0.5s周期，走滑比逆冲地震极化度高1%–44%，RotD100/RotD50比值大1%–3.7%，正交方向对数标准…
Normal-slip earthquakes were excluded due to the limited number of available records in the crustal ground motion dataset, preventing statistically significant results.
由于地壳地震动数据集中正断层记录数量有限，无法获得统计显著结果，故未包含正断层地震。

First numerical quantification and probabilistic parameterization of complete horizontal response spectral directionality separated by faulting mechanism (strike-slip vs. reverse-slip), overcoming aggregation bias in prior models.
首次按走滑与逆冲机制分别量化并概率参数化水平反应谱完整方向性，消除了以往混合建模的平均偏差。

kc: Quantified differences in ground motion directionality between strike-slip and reverse-slip earthquakes across 58 periods (0.01–10 s) using 3,862 NGA-West2 records.
Demonstrated that strike-slip ground motions are 1% to 44% more polarized than reverse-slip motions at periods > 0.5 s and have 1% to 3.7% higher RotD100/RotD50 ratios at long periods.
Developed mechanism-specific nonlinear regression models for geometric means, logarithmic standard deviations, and four-parameter Beta distributions of normalized spectral ordinates (η and ν).
利用3862条NGA-West2记录，量化了0.01至10秒内58个周期上走滑与逆冲地震在地震动方向性上的差异。
证明在大于0.5秒周期上走滑地震比逆冲地震极化程度高1%至44%，且长周期RotD100/RotD50比值高1%至3.7%。
建立了走滑和逆冲机制专属的归一化反应谱参数（η和ν）的几何均值、对数标准差及四参数Beta分布模型。
me: Computation of 5%-damped pseudo-acceleration response spectral ordinates rotated across [-90°, 90°] in 1° increments relative to the RotD100 major response axis.
Normalization of directional spectral ordinates by RotD100 (η) and RotD50 (ν) intensities.
Nonlinear regression to parameterize geometric means and logarithmic standard deviations as trigonometric functions of rotation angle.
Maximum likelihood estimation to fit four-parameter Beta distributions with period-independent theoretical bounds.
相对于RotD100主响应轴，以1°步长在[-90°, 90°]内旋转计算5%阻尼伪加速度反应谱纵坐标。
使用RotD100（η）和RotD50（ν）强度对不同方向的反应谱纵坐标进行归一化。
应用非线性回归将几何均值和对数标准差参数化为旋转角的三角函数。
使用最大似然估计拟合具有独立于周期的理论边界的四参数Beta分布。
de: Subset of 3,862 free-field horizontal ground motion records from the PEER NGA-West2 database (1,642 strike-slip and 2,220 reverse-slip).
Filtered for events with Mw ≥ 5, NEHRP site classes B, C, or D, and maximum PGV > 0.1 cm/s.
来自PEER NGA-West2数据库的3862条自由场水平地震动记录子集（1642条走滑，2220条逆冲）。
筛选条件为矩震级Mw ≥ 5、NEHRP场地类别B、C或D，以及最大峰值地面速度PGV > 0.1 cm/s。
li: Normal-slip earthquakes were excluded due to insufficient records in the database to achieve statistically significant results.
Strong site effects (e.g., soft soils outside NEHRP B, C, D) were filtered out and not evaluated.
由于数据库中记录数量不足以获得统计显著结果，未包含正断层地震。
滤除了强场地效应（如NEHRP B、C、D类以外的软土场地），未对其进行评估。

tm.why: The paper develops mechanism-specific probabilistic models for the directionality of horizontal pseudo-acceleration response spectral ordinates to improve ground motion models and seismic hazard analysis.

ev.notes: Full 37-page manuscript PDF (including all text, equations, references, figure captions, and 14 figures) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study correlates kinematic plate tectonic reconstructions in a minimum-continent-motion mantle reference frame with global seismic tomography models (primarily UU-P07, alongside GAP_P4 and S40RTS) to identify Paleo- and Neotethyan slab remnants beneath the Eastern Mediterranean and Middle East. Focusing on the complex Anatolian segment, the authors provide the first comprehensive lower-mantle slab interpretation for this region. They identify three major Neotethyan slabs: the Pontides (600–2200 km depth) and Egypt (900–1300 km) slabs, which detached in the Late Cretaceous, and the overturned Cyprus slab extending to ~1000 km. A deep sub-horizontal anomaly between 1500 and 2200 km (the Herodotus anomaly) is newly interpreted as Paleotethyan lithosphere subducted between ~240 and 180 Ma. The findings demonstrate that slab positions reflect past detachment locations and geometries record paleo-trench motions, implying near-vertical slab sinking (~1.0–1.5 cm/yr) and minimal lateral mantle convective flow since the Early Mesozoic.
本研究将最小大陆运动地幔参考系下的板块构造运动学重建与全球地震层析成像模型（主要为UU-P07，辅以GAP_P4和S40RTS）相结合，识别了东地中海和中东下方的古、新特提斯俯冲板片残余。针对复杂的安纳托利亚段，首次给出了全面的下地幔板片解释：识别出三个主要新特提斯板片（晚白垩世断离的Pontide……

t: The authors place a detailed plate tectonic reconstruction into a minimum-continent-motion mantle reference frame and compare predicted subduction locations, timing, and lithospheric volumes against N-S and horizontal cross-sections of global seismic tomography.
将板块构造重建置于最小大陆运动地幔参考系中，并与全球地震层析成像剖面进行空间与尺度对比。

The analysis uses the global P-wave tomography model UU-P07 as the primary dataset, supplemented by GAP_P4 and S40RTS cross-sections, alongside Triassic-to-present plate kinematic reconstructions of the Tethyan realm.
主要使用全球P波层析成像模型UU-P07（辅以GAP_P4和S40RTS）及三叠纪以来的板块重建数据。

Neotethys closure formed the Pontides (600–2200 km), Egypt (900–1300 km), and overturned Cyprus (to ~1000 km) slabs, while the Herodotus anomaly (1500–2200 km) represents Paleotethyan lithosphere (~240–180 Ma), yielding average lower-mantle sinking rates of ~1.0–1.5 cm/yr.
识别出新特提斯Pontides、Egypt和Cyprus板片及古特提斯Herodotus板片，下地幔下沉速率为1.0–1…

The Triassic (220 Ma) reference frame prediction is offset eastwards by ~10° relative to deepest-mantle anomalies, and tomographic slab interpretations lack rigorous quantitative definitions of slab boundaries and uncertainties.
三叠纪深部预测存在约10°向东偏差，且缺乏板片边界和形状不确定性的定量化定义。

Provides the first comprehensive lower-mantle interpretation beneath the Anatolian segment, identifying the Pontides and Herodotus slabs and proving that contrasting trench motions caused differently aged slabs to reach comparable depths.
首次全面解释安纳托利亚下地幔结构，新识别出Pontides和Herodotus板片并阐明海沟运动对下沉深度的影响。

kc: Provides the first comprehensive geological interpretation of lower mantle tomographic anomalies beneath the Anatolian segment of the Alpine-Himalayan belt.
Identifies two major lower-mantle anomalies in the Anatolian segment: the vertical Pontides slab (Neotethys) and the sub-horizontal Herodotus slab (Paleotethys, 1500–2200 km depth).
Demonstrates that slab geometries reflect paleo-trench absolute motions (stationary, retreating, or advancing, including a Late Cretaceous double same-dip subduction system).
Shows that transform-bounded Tethyan mantle provinces remained longitudinally stable since the Triassic, indicating near-vertical slab sinking without significant lateral mantle wind deflection.
首次对阿尔卑斯-喜马拉雅造山带安纳托利亚段下方的下地幔层析成像异常进行了全面的地质解释。
在安纳托利亚段识别出两个主要的下地幔板片异常：近垂直的Pontides板片（新特提斯）和近水平的Herodotus板片（古特提斯，1500–2200 km深）。
证实了板片几何形态反映了古海沟的绝对运动状态（静止、后撤或前进，包括晚白垩世同倾向双俯冲系统）。
表明受转换断层限制的特提斯地幔省自三叠纪以来在经向上保持稳定，指示板片近垂直下沉且未受明显横向地幔流偏转。
me: Kinematic plate tectonic reconstruction placed in a minimum-continent-motion mantle reference frame.
Semiquantitative dimensional and spatial correlation of predicted subducted lithosphere with global P- and S-wave seismic tomography cross-sections.
Slab sinking rate and thickening factor analysis accounting for trench mobility (stationary vs. rollback vs. advance).
基于最小大陆运动地幔参考系的运动学板块构造重建。
将预测的俯冲岩石圈体量及位置与全球P波和S波地震层析成像剖面进行半定量尺度和空间对比。
考虑海沟移动性（静止、后撤或前进）的板片下沉速率与增厚系数分析。
de: Global P-wave travel-time tomography model UU-P07 (primary basis for interpretation) and GAP_P4, plus lower-mantle S-wave model S40RTS.
Utrecht Paleogeographic Model and regional plate tectonic reconstructions of the Eastern Mediterranean and Middle East from 240 Ma to present.
全球P波走时层析成像模型UU-P07（主要解释依据）与GAP_P4，以及下地幔S波模型S40RTS。
乌得勒支古地理模型以及240 Ma至今的东地中海和中东区域板块构造重建数据。
li: The minimum-continent-motion reference frame shows an ~10° eastward offset relative to deepest-mantle Triassic (220 Ma) slab structures, possibly due to Pangea frame oversimplification.
The comparison is semiquantitative; advancing kinematic mantle reconstructions requires quantitative definitions of slab vs. ambient mantle and uncertainty quantification of slab edges and shapes.
最小大陆运动参考系对三叠纪（220 Ma）最深部地幔板片的预测存在约10°的向东偏差，可能源于盘古大陆参考系的过度简化。
对比分析属于半定量性质；推进地幔运动学重建需要严格定义板片与背景地幔的界限，并量化板片位置、边缘和形状的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper links plate tectonic reconstructions of the Tethyan oceans with upper and lower mantle slab remnants to constrain subduction history and mantle flow dynamics.
The authors analyze global P-wave and S-wave tomographic models (UU-P07, GAP_P4, S40RTS) to identify and measure subducted slab geometries beneath the Eastern Mediterranean.

ev.notes: Full 38-page manuscript PDF (submitted to Geophysical Journal International) including abstract, main text, 7 figures, and references was analyzed.

sum: This study investigates the deep crustal structure of the Zhongnan Fault and Ridge Zone, a key tectonic boundary between the Northwest and Southwest sub-basins of the South China Sea. Using active-source wide-angle seismic data recorded by Ocean Bottom Seismometers (OBS), the authors perform travel-time tomography to reconstruct a detailed 2D P-wave velocity model. The resulting velocity structure reveals variations in sediment thickness, crustal thickness, and Moho depth across the fault zone. These findings provide crucial constraints on the tectonic evolution, crustal nature, and geodynamics of the South China Sea sub-basins.
本研究利用海底地震仪（OBS）记录的主动源广角地震数据，对南海西北次海盆与西南次海盆之间的重要构造边界——中南断裂与脊状带进行了深部地壳结构研究。通过走时断层成像方法，重建了跨越该断裂带的详细二维P波速度结构。结果揭示了沉积层厚度、地壳厚度及Moho面深度的空间变化特征，为理解南海次海盆的构造演化、……

t: Active-source wide-angle seismic travel-time tomography using ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data to resolve 2D P-wave velocity structure.
利用海底地震仪（OBS）主动源广角地震走时断层成像方法重建二维P波速度结构。
Wide-angle seismic refraction/reflection data recorded by ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) along a profile crossing the Zhongnan Fault and Ridge Zone.
跨越中南断裂与脊状带的剖面上由海底地震仪（OBS）记录的广角地震折射/反射数据。
Detailed 2D P-wave velocity model revealing crustal thinning, sediment distribution, and the deep structure of the Zhongnan Fault and Ridge Zone.
获得了详细的二维P波速度模型，揭示了地壳减薄、沉积物分布以及中南断裂带的深部结构特征。
Resolution is limited by OBS spacing and the 2D assumption of the profile, which may not capture 3D structural variations.
受限于OBS测点间距和二维剖面假设，可能无法完全捕获三维结构变化。
Provides the first or a highly-resolved deep crustal P-wave velocity structure across the Zhongnan Fault and Ridge Zone, clarifying its tectonic nature.
提供了中南断裂与脊状带高分辨率的深部地壳P波速度结构，阐明了其构造属性。

kc: Obtained a high-resolution 2D P-wave velocity structure across the Zhongnan Fault and Ridge Zone.
Constrained the crustal thickness, sediment distribution, and Moho depth variations across the sub-basin boundary.
Provided geophysical evidence to understand the tectonic evolution and crustal nature of the South China Sea.
获得了跨越中南断裂与脊状带的高分辨率二维P波速度结构。
约束了次海盆边界处的地壳厚度、沉积物分布及Moho面深度变化。
为理解南海构造演化和地壳属性提供了关键的地球物理证据。
me: Active-source wide-angle seismic reflection and refraction profiling.
Ocean Bottom Seismometer (OBS) data acquisition.
2D travel-time seismic tomography / forward modeling.
主动源广角地震反射和折射剖面探测。
海底地震仪（OBS）数据采集。
二维走时地震断层成像/前向建模。
de: Wide-angle seismic data recorded by OBS stations along a profile crossing the Zhongnan Fault Zone in the South China Sea.
南海跨越中南断裂带剖面上OBS台站记录的广角地震数据。
li: The 2D profile assumption may simplify complex 3D tectonic features.
Resolution is constrained by the spacing of OBS instruments and airgun shot density.
二维剖面假设可能会简化复杂的三维构造特征。
分辨率受限于OBS仪器间距和气枪激发密度。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the P-wave velocity structure, which typically involves seismic travel-time tomography.
The study investigates the deep crustal structure of the Zhongnan Fault and Ridge Zone to understand South China Sea tectonics.
Marine seismic profiles in the South China Sea sub-basins typically rely on Ocean Bottom Seismometer (OBS) arrays.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the paper title, authors, venue, and established geophysical knowledge of the Zhongnan Fault Zone in the South China Sea.

sum: At slow-spreading mid-ocean ridges, lithospheric unbending across axial valley flanks reverses up to 50% of extensional fault offsets via reverse faulting. Standard models assuming uniform hydrostatic pore pressures underpredict the depth extent and surface strain of this compression by a factor of two. Combining analytical thin-plate flexure theory and 2D elasto-viscoplastic numerical simulations (GeoFLAC), the authors incorporate stress-state and plastic-strain-dependent pore-fluid pressures. They demonstrate that as inherited abyssal-hill normal faults migrate into off-axis compressional zones, fluid trapping and overpressurization approaching lithostatic levels (λC = 0.99) deepen the bending neutral surface from ~2 km to ~4 km and double the reverse-faulting strain (~0.073), matching seafloor bathymetric strain and earthquake hypocenter depths (2.7–4.2 km) at the 54°N Mid-Atlantic Ridge. This highlights pore-pressure modulation on inherited faults as a key control on flexural seismicity, including continental forebulge earthquakes like the 2001 Mw 7.6 Bhuj event.
在慢速扩张洋中脊，轴部裂谷两翼的岩石圈反向弯曲通过逆断层滑动可抵消高达50%的伸展断层位移，但传统恒定静水孔隙压力模型严重低估了压缩深度和地表应变。本研究结合薄板挠曲解析理论与二维弹粘塑性数值模拟（GeoFLAC），引入了随应力状态和累积塑性应变演化的孔隙流体压力。结果表明，当先存深海丘陵正断层进入……

t: 2D elasto-viscoplastic numerical modeling (GeoFLAC) of a slow-spreading ridge combining axial magmatic diking with a Mohr-Coulomb yield criterion where pore-fluid pressure depends on accumulated plastic strain and horizontal deviatoric stress.
采用GeoFLAC进行慢速扩张洋中脊二维弹粘塑性模拟，使孔隙流体压力随塑性应变和偏应力动态演化。

Global compilation of across-axis seafloor bathymetric fault-throw profiles and apparent tectonic strains at symmetric slow-spreading mid-ocean ridges, alongside seismic constraints from the 2022 54°N Mid-Atlantic Ridge earthquake sequence.
全球对称慢速扩张洋中脊跨轴地形断层落差与应变数据集，以及2022年大西洋中脊54°N地震序列约束。

Near-lithostatic compressional pore pressure (λC = 0.99) deepens the neutral surface from ~2 km to ~4 km and doubles reverse-faulting strain from 0.036 to 0.073, matching observed bathymetric strains and earthquake depths (2.7–4.2 km).
近静岩挤压孔隙压力（λC=0.99）使中性面从2 km加深至4 km，逆断层应变翻倍至0.073，与观测吻合。
Simulated rifts are wider than observed, and models assume steady slow strain rates (<10^-13 s^-1) with a fixed thermal structure, underestimating transient high-rate flexural strains.
模拟裂谷偏宽，且假设固定热结构和稳态低应变率变形，忽略了岩脉侵入引起的瞬态高应变率效应。

First quantitative demonstration that differential, near-lithostatic pore-fluid pressures in compressional zones are required to explain deep flexural reverse faulting and abyssal hill unfaulting at mid-ocean ridges.
首次定量证明挤压区近静岩孔隙流体超压是驱动洋中脊深部挠曲逆断层活动和断层反向滑动的关键机制。

kc: Developed an analytical thin-plate flexure model and 2D elasto-viscoplastic numerical models incorporating differential pore-fluid pressures between extensional and compressional domains.

Demonstrated that near-lithostatic pore pressures (λC = 0.99) in compressional zones deepen the bending neutral surface from ~2 km to ~4 km and localize shortening into discrete reverse-fault shear bands.

Reconciled numerical model predictions with global mid-ocean ridge bathymetric strain datasets and hypocenter depths (2.7–4.2 km) of the 2022 54°N Mid-Atlantic Ridge reverse-faulting earthquake swarm.
建立了结合伸展区和挤压区差异孔隙流体压力的薄板挠曲解析模型和二维弹粘塑性数值模型。
证明挤压区近静岩孔隙流体压力（λC = 0.99）可将弯曲中性面从约2 km加深至4 km，并将缩短应变集中到离散的逆断层剪切带中。
将模拟预测的反向弯曲应变与全球洋中脊地形应变数据集以及2022年大西洋中脊54°N逆断层地震群的震源深度（2.7–4.2 km）实现了定量吻合。
me: Analytical thin-plate flexure modeling solving for the neutral surface depth (Zn) and surface bending strain under Andersonian brittle yield envelopes with distinct extensional (λE) and compressional (λC) pore-pressure ratios.

2D elasto-viscoplastic numerical modeling using GeoFLAC (combining finite-element and finite-difference methods) with Mohr-Coulomb plasticity, cohesion strain-weakening, diabase viscous flow law, continuous axial diking (M = 0.85), and dynamic pore pressure dependent on horizontal deviatoric stress and plastic strain.
基于薄板挠曲解析模型，在具有不同伸展（λE）和挤压（λC）孔隙压力比的Anderson脆性屈服包络线下求解中性面深度（Zn）和地表弯曲应变。
利用GeoFLAC（结合有限元与有限差分法）进行二维弹粘塑性数值模拟，包含Mohr-Coulomb塑性准则、内聚力应变弱化、辉绿岩粘性流变律、轴部岩脉侵入（M = 0.85）以及受水平偏应力和塑性应变动态控制的孔隙流体压力。
de: Bathymetric fault throw and apparent tectonic strain data across the 54°N segment of the Northern Mid-Atlantic Ridge and a global compilation of symmetric slow-spreading ridge segments from Olive et al. (2024).
Seismicity relocation catalog and hypocenter depth constraints (2.7–4.2 km) from the 2022–2023 reverse-faulting earthquake sequence at 54°N on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
Parametric numerical sensitivity experiments varying compressional pore-fluid pressure ratio (λC from 0.33 to 0.99), off-axis brittle lithospheric thickness (H0), and Young's modulus.
北大西洋中脊54°N段及全球对称慢速扩张洋中脊段的跨轴海底地形断层落差与视构造应变数据集（源自Olive et al., 2024）。
2022–2023年大西洋中脊54°N逆断层地震序列的精定位目录与震源深度约束（2.7–4.2 km）。
改变挤压区孔隙流体压力比（λC从0.33至0.99）、离轴脆性岩石圈厚度（H0）和杨氏模量的参数敏感性数值实验。
li: The numerical models assume a fixed, simplified thermal structure without explicitly modeling hydrothermal circulation and its coupling to lithospheric deformation.
Simulated rifts are wider than observed natural rifts, causing modeled flexural strains to sit at the lower edge of the global observational range.
The simulations assume steady deformation at slow strain rates (<10^-13 s^-1), neglecting transient high strain-rate loading from rapid axial dike intrusions.
数值模型假设了固定且简化的热结构，未显式模拟热液循环及其与岩石圈变形的耦合。
模拟生成的裂谷宽度大于实际观测值，导致模拟的挠曲应变处于全球观测范围的下限。
模拟假设了低应变率（<10^-13 s^-1）下的稳态变形，忽略了轴部岩脉快速侵入引起的瞬态高应变率加载效应。

tm.why: The paper models lithospheric flexure, unbending, and tectonic deformation at slow-spreading mid-ocean ridges using elasto-viscoplastic geodynamic models.
The central mechanism investigated is how elevated pore-fluid pressures in compressional domains weaken inherited faults and enable deep-seated reverse fault slip.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 8-page PDF manuscript including all figures, equations, and methods sections.

sum: Dehydration melting occurs above the 410-km discontinuity as water-rich mantle transition zone (MTZ) materials upwell into the low-water-storage-capacity upper mantle, yet the resulting melt fraction has remained poorly constrained. Here, the authors performed high-pressure phase equilibrium experiments at 13 GPa and 1,800–2,100 K on a peridotite + 1 wt.% H2O system using a Kawai-type multi-anvil apparatus, combined with five-component mass balance calculations. They found that melt fraction increases systematically from ~10.1 vol.% (12.8 wt.%) at 1,800 K to 42.6 wt.% at 2,100 K. Because 10.1 vol.% vastly exceeds the ~0.7 vol.% required to explain observed seismic shear-wave velocity reductions above the 410-km discontinuity, the authors propose that most buoyant, low-viscosity hydrous melts rapidly migrate upward. Over 23–320 Myr, these ascending melts can accumulate below the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary, contributing to rheological weakening of the asthenosphere and facilitating plate tectonics.
富含水的地幔转换带物质上涌至上地幔底部410公里间断面附近时会发生脱水熔融，但其熔体分数尚不明确。本研究利用多面砧压机在13 GPa和1800–2100 K条件下对橄榄岩+1 wt.% H2O体系进行了高温高压相平衡实验，并结合五组分质量平衡计算精确测定了熔体比例。结果表明，熔体分数随温度升高从18……

t: High-pressure phase equilibrium experiments at 13 GPa and 1,800–2,100 K in a Kawai-type multi-anvil apparatus, followed by EPMA chemical analysis and five-component (MgO, SiO2, FeO, Al2O3, CaO) mass balance calculations.
利用多面砧压机在13 GPa和1800–2100 K下开展相平衡实验，结合EPMA分析与五组分质量平衡计算。
Four high-pressure experimental runs (PG0010, PG0016, PG0026, PG0029) on KLB-1 peridotite + 1 wt.% H2O at 13 GPa and 1,800, 1,900, 2,000, and 2,100 K for 10–360 minutes.
KLB-1橄榄岩+1 wt.% H2O在13 GPa及四个温度点（1800–2100 K）下的四组高压实验产物。
Melt fraction increases with temperature from ~12.8 wt.% (~10.1 vol.%) at 1,800 K to 42.6 wt.% at 2,100 K, producing an ascending melt flux of 2.6×10^11 to 7×10^11 kg/y.
熔体分数从1800 K时的约10.1 vol.%升至2100 K时的42.6 wt.%，产生每年2.6×10^11至7×…
H2O was excluded from mass balance because silicate melts crystallize during quenching, and the 2,100 K run shows an abnormally high olivine fraction (~57 wt.%) due to compositional uncertainty.
淬火结晶导致无法直接测水，且2100 K时橄榄石比例因成分相近存在计算异常。

First precise five-component mass-balance determination of dehydration melt fraction for a water-rich MTZ composition (peridotite + 1 wt.% H2O) at 410-km discontinuity conditions, linking deep melting to asthenospheric weakening.
首次通过五组分质量平衡精确测定410公里间断面富水地幔脱水熔融比例，揭示其对软流圈弱化的贡献。

kc: Quantified the melt fraction of peridotite + 1 wt.% H2O at 13 GPa and 1,800–2,100 K using five-component mass balance calculations.
Demonstrated that dehydration melting under 410-km discontinuity conditions (13 GPa, 1,800 K) produces ~10.1 vol.% hydrous melt.
Reconciled high experimental melt production with seismic observations (~0.7 vol.% retained melt) via rapid buoyant upward migration of interconnected melts to the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary.
利用五组分质量平衡计算量化了13 GPa和1800–2100 K下橄榄岩+1 wt.% H2O体系的熔体分数。
证明了410公里间断面温压条件下（13 GPa，1800 K）脱水熔融可产生高达约10.1 vol.%的含水熔体。
提出连通的浮力熔体快速上涌至岩石圈-软流圈边界，调和了高实验熔体产率与地震观测残留熔体量（~0.7 vol.%）之间的差异。
me: High-pressure, high-temperature phase equilibrium experiments at 13 GPa and 1,800–2,100 K using a 1000-ton Kawai-type multi-anvil apparatus.
Microstructural and compositional characterization via Field Emission SEM, microfocus XRD, and Electron Probe Microanalyzer (EPMA).
Five-component (MgO-SiO2-FeO-CaO-Al2O3) mass balance calculations, evaluated both with and without FeO to rule out capsule iron loss bias.
利用1000吨Kawai型多面砧压机在13 GPa和1800–2100 K下开展高温高压相平衡实验。
通过场发射扫描电镜（SEM）、微区X射线衍射（XRD）和电子探针（EPMA）进行显微结构与成分表征。
采用五组分（MgO-SiO2-FeO-CaO-Al2O3）质量平衡计算，并对比包含与排除FeO的结果以消除样品舱吸铁误差。
de: Four multi-anvil experimental runs (PG0010, PG0029, PG0016, PG0026) at 13 GPa and 1,800, 1,900, 2,000, and 2,100 K using KLB-1 peridotite + 1 wt.% H2O starting powder in Pt or Pt-Rh capsules.
EPMA major oxide compositional datasets and XRD phase spectra of quenched melts and coexisting olivine, clinopyroxene, and garnet.
在13 GPa及1800、1900、2000和2100 K下使用装有KLB-1橄榄岩+1 wt.% H2O初始粉末的Pt或Pt-Rh样品舱开展的四组多面砧实验。
淬火熔体及共存橄榄石、单斜辉石和石榴石的EPMA主量氧化物成分数据集与XRD物相谱图。
li: Silicate melts crystallize during quenching, preventing direct EPMA measurement of H2O in melts and excluding H2O from mass balance equations.
Abnormal olivine fraction (~57 wt.%) at 2,100 K likely caused by similar (Mg+Fe)/Si ratios between the melt and starting material.
Temperature inhomogeneity across the capsule (~60 K in numerical models for MgO capsules, though smaller in metal capsules) was not directly measured.
硅酸盐熔体在淬火过程中发生结晶，无法直接测定熔体含水量，因此质量平衡计算排除了水组分。
2100 K下橄榄石比例异常偏高（~57 wt.%），可能源于熔体与初始物料相近的(Mg+Fe)/Si比值带来的计算不确定性。
未直接测量样品舱内的温度不均匀性。

tm.why: The paper investigates dehydration melting of upwelling mantle transition zone material at the 410-km discontinuity and its role in upper mantle dynamics and asthenosphere weakening.
The experimental results directly interpret the seismic low-velocity layer observed above the 410-km mantle discontinuity.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article used, including all sections, Table 1, and Figures 1-4.

sum: This study presents a three-dimensional S-wave velocity model of the crust across the Sumatran forearc–back-arc system in Indonesia using ambient noise tomography. By cross-correlating continuous ambient seismic noise, the authors extract empirical Green's functions (primarily Rayleigh waves) to map shear-wave velocity variations. The resulting model reveals prominent crustal heterogeneities, highlighting low-velocity zones associated with the Sumatran Fault Zone, active volcanic arcs, and sedimentary basins, alongside high-velocity anomalies in the forearc and stable blocks. These findings provide crucial insights into the subduction dynamics, magma plumbing systems, and crustal deformation of the active Sumatran convergent margin.
本研究利用背景噪声断层成像技术，构建了印度尼西亚苏门答腊弧前-弧后系统的高分辨率三维地壳S波速度模型。通过对连续背景噪声数据进行互相关处理，提取了经验格林函数（主要是瑞雷面波），并反演获得了剪切波速度结构。结果揭示了显著的地壳非均匀性，包括与苏门答腊断裂带、活动火山弧及沉积盆地相关的低速异常，以及弧……

t: Ambient noise tomography using cross-correlation of continuous seismic data to extract Rayleigh wave dispersion curves and invert for 3D S-wave velocity.
利用连续地震数据的互相关提取瑞雷波频散曲线，并反演三维S波速度的背景噪声成像方法。
Continuous seismic waveform data recorded by regional seismic stations across Sumatra, Indonesia.
由印度尼西亚苏门答腊地区区域地震台站记录的连续地震波形数据。
A detailed 3D S-wave velocity model revealing crustal heterogeneities, including low-velocity zones beneath the volcanic arc and Sumatran Fault Zone.
精细的三维S波速度模型，揭示了地壳非均匀性，包括火山弧和苏门答腊断裂带下方的低速带。
Resolution is constrained by station coverage, especially in the offshore forearc region.
分辨率受台站覆盖范围限制，特别是在离岸弧前区域。
Provides a comprehensive 3D crustal shear-wave velocity model spanning the entire Sumatran forearc-to-back-arc transition.
提供了跨越整个苏门答腊弧前到弧后过渡带的完整三维地壳剪切波速度模型。

kc: Constructs a new high-resolution 3D S-wave velocity model of the Sumatran forearc-back-arc system.
Delineates crustal heterogeneities, mapping low-velocity zones beneath the volcanic arc and fault zones.
Improves the understanding of tectonic boundaries and magma pathways in the Sumatran subduction zone.
构建了苏门答腊弧前-弧后系统的高分辨率三维S波速度模型。
描绘了地壳非均匀性，标定了火山弧和断裂带下方的低速异常区。
深化了对苏门答腊俯冲带构造边界和岩浆通道系统的认识。
me: Ambient noise cross-correlation of continuous seismic data to retrieve empirical Green's functions.
Measurement of surface-wave (Rayleigh wave) dispersion curves.
Inversion of dispersion data for 3D shear-wave velocity (Vs) structure.
对连续地震数据进行背景噪声互相关以提取经验格林函数。
测量面波（瑞雷波）频散曲线。
利用频散数据反演三维剪切波速度（Vs）结构。
de: Continuous seismic waveform data from regional networks in Sumatra, Indonesia.
来自印度尼西亚苏门答腊地区区域地震台网的连续地震波形数据。
li: Resolution is limited by the spatial distribution and density of the seismic stations, particularly in offshore forearc areas.
成像分辨率受限于地震台站的空间分布和密度，特别是在离岸弧前区域。

tm.why: The paper uses ambient noise tomography to image the 3D S-wave velocity structure.
The study constructs a three-dimensional S-wave velocity model using surface-wave dispersion from ambient noise.
The target of the imaging is the crustal heterogeneity and structure across the Sumatran forearc-back-arc system.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the paper's title, authors, and metadata, which clearly indicate a 3D ambient noise tomography study of the Sumatran crust.

sum: The ultraslow Mohns and Knipovich mid-ocean ridges in the Arctic Ocean display pronounced across-axis bathymetric and thermal asymmetries alongside basalts with strongly radiogenic Hf isotopes. Using 3D visco-plastic thermo-mechanical simulations in ASPECT, this study investigates the combined impact of curved ridge geometry, oblique asymmetric spreading rates, ridge migration, and pre-existing mantle heterogeneity derived from the NAT2021 shear-wave velocity tomography model. By imposing a two-order-of-magnitude viscosity reduction on the western (North American) side corresponding to low dVs anomalies and ancient melt-depleted mantle domains, the models successfully reproduce the asymmetric 1200°C isotherm (40–50 km depth on the west vs. 100–115 km on the east) and westward-offset melting zones observed in electromagnetic imaging. This work demonstrates that inherited compositional and rheological mantle heterogeneity, rather than ridge migration or ridge jumps alone, is the primary driver of spreading center asymmetry and plate boundary reorganization.
北极超慢速Mohns和Knipovich洋中脊表现出显著的跨轴地形和热结构不对称性，且玄武岩具有高放射成因Hf同位素特征。本研究利用ASPECT软件开展三维粘塑性热-力学数值模拟，综合考虑弯曲洋脊几何形态、斜向非对称扩张速率、洋脊迁移以及基于NAT2021剪切波层析成像的先存地幔不均一性。通过在北美……

t: 3D finite-element visco-plastic thermo-mechanical simulations in ASPECT v2.5.0, combining kinematic plate spreading and ridge migration boundary conditions with tomography-derived mantle viscosity contrasts.
利用ASPECT v2.5.0进行三维有限元粘塑性热-力学模拟，结合运动学边界条件与层析成像约束的粘度对比。
A 1000×600×150 km 3D domain constrained by plate kinematics, NAT2021 shear-wave tomography anomalies, GEBCO bathymetry, MORB Nd-Hf isotopes, and electromagnetic isotherm profiles.
受板块运动学、NAT2021层析成像、GEBCO水深、MORB同位素及电磁等温线约束的1000×600×150 km三维…

Models produce a pronounced asymmetric thermal structure and melting zone, with the 1200°C isotherm at ~40-50 km depth on the western flank versus ~100-115 km on the eastern flank, and average melting decreasing southward from 8.4% to 5.6%.
模拟出显著非对称热结构，西翼1200°C等温线深约40-50 km而东翼深约100-115 km，平均熔融度由北向南从8…

Viscosity heterogeneity is simplified and imposed only on the western flank, leading to a ~50 km depth discrepancy in the 1200°C isotherm on the homogeneous eastern flank compared to electromagnetic observations.
仅在西翼施加粘度不均一性而将东翼视为均一，导致东翼1200°C等温线深度偏离观测达50 km。

Demonstrates through 3D multiphysics modeling that pre-existing depleted mantle heterogeneity and curved ridge kinematics naturally generate Mohns-Knipovich thermal and melt asymmetries without requiring ridge jumps as the primary initiator.
首次通过三维多物理场模拟证明先存亏损地幔与弯曲洋脊运动学即可自然产生热与熔融非对称性，无需以洋脊跳跃为主导。

kc: Integrates curved ridge geometry, oblique asymmetric spreading, ridge migration, and tomography-derived mantle viscosity contrasts into 3D thermo-mechanical models of the Mohns-Knipovich intersection.
Demonstrates that a two-order-of-magnitude viscosity reduction beneath the western flank is the primary driver of the asymmetric 1200°C isotherm (~40-50 km west vs. ~100-115 km east).
Links regional negative shear-wave velocity (dVs) anomalies to ancient, buoyant, melt-depleted mantle domains with high radiogenic Hf isotopic ratios.
Shows that pre-existing mantle heterogeneity naturally generates observed thermal and melt asymmetries, with ridge jumps acting to reinforce rather than initiate the feedback.
将弯曲洋脊几何、斜向非对称扩张、洋脊迁移及层析成像约束的地幔粘度对比整合进Mohns-Knipovich交汇区的三维热-力学模型。
证明洋脊西翼下方两个数量级的粘度降低是导致1200°C等温线非对称（西侧约40-50 km，东侧约100-115 km）的主要驱动力。
将区域负剪切波速（dVs）异常与具有高放射成因Hf同位素比值的古老、亏损且具浮力的地幔域联系起来。
表明先存地幔不均一性自然产生了观测到的热和熔融非对称性，而洋脊跳跃起到强化而非触发该反馈的作用。
me: 3D finite-element thermo-mechanical convection modeling using ASPECT v2.5.0 solving conservation of mass, momentum, and energy.
Visco-plastic rheology combining Drucker-Prager brittle yielding and dry olivine dislocation creep (Arrhenius law).
Sensitivity analysis converting shear-wave velocity (NAT2021 model) to temperature and viscosity using constant empirical dVs/dT scaling and Gibbs free-energy minimization (V2RhoT_Gibbs).
利用ASPECT v2.5.0进行三维有限元热-力学对流模拟，求解质量、动量和能量守恒方程。
采用结合Drucker-Prager脆性屈服准则与干橄榄石位错蠕变（Arrhenius定律）的粘塑性流变学模型。
利用经验常数dVs/dT缩放及吉布斯自由能最小化方法（V2RhoT_Gibbs），将剪切波速度（NAT2021模型）转换为温度和粘度进行敏感性分析。
de: 3D numerical domain (1000 km × 600 km × 150 km) with kinematic top boundary conditions from plate motion models (Müller et al., 2008; DeMets et al., 2010) and bottom ridge migration (Gripp and Gordon, 2002).
Upper mantle shear-wave velocity anomalies (dVs) from the NAT2021 waveform tomography model (Celli et al., 2021).
Geochemical dataset of Nd-Hf isotopes in Arctic MORBs and bathymetric grids from GEBCO 2024, validated against magnetotelluric/CSEM isotherm profiles (Johansen et al., 2019).
1000 km × 600 km × 150 km的三维数值模型域，顶部施加板块运动学边界条件（Müller et al., 2008; DeMets et al., 2010），底部施加洋脊迁移速度（Gripp and Gordon, 2002）。

Compositional heterogeneity does not directly enter the viscosity formulation and two-phase melt/volatile-dependent rheologies or grain-size feedbacks are not explicitly coupled.
地幔粘度不均一性被简化为仅施加在西侧（北美板块），导致东翼1200°C等温线深度与观测存在高达约50 km的偏差。
成分不均一性未直接计入粘度公式，且未显式耦合两相熔体/挥发分依赖流变学及晶粒尺寸演化反馈。

sum: The authors present a micro-continuum computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model to simulate cohesive sediment gravity flows (SGFs) across mudslide, mudflow, and turbidity current regimes. By incorporating independent measurements of sediment solid fraction and rheological yield stress, the model successfully captures the complex viscoplastic behavior of clay-rich matrices (e.g., smectite and kaolinite). It reproduces four distinct flow regimes observed in lock-exchange experiments: low-density turbidity currents, high-density turbidity currents, mudflows, and mudslides. Validated against experimental data on flow morphology, speed, and runout distance, this model provides a predictive framework for understanding how intrinsic properties (particle size, density, rheology) and extrinsic factors (topography, solid fraction) control self-sustaining cohesive SGFs.
本文开发了一种基于微观连续介质的计算流体力学（CFD）模型，用于模拟跨越滑泥、泥流和浊流机制的粘性沉积物重力流。该模型基于沉积物固体体积分数与流变屈服应力之间的独立测量关系，成功捕捉了富含粘土（蒙脱石和高岭石）介质的复杂粘弹性行为。模型重现了锁启实验中观察到的四种主要流态（低密度和高密度浊流、泥流、……

t: A micro-continuum computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model incorporating sediment solid fraction and rheological yield stress relations to simulate cohesive sediment gravity flows.
结合固体体积分数与流变屈服应力关系的微观连续介质计算流体力学模型。
Independent rheological measurements and previous lock-exchange experimental observations of smectite and kaolinite clay slurries.
蒙脱石和高岭石粘土浆体的独立流变测量数据及先前的锁启实验观测数据。
The model successfully predicts and captures four primary flow regimes (low/high density turbidity currents, mudflows, mudslides) and matches experimental flow morphology, speed, and runout.

First micro-continuum CFD model capable of unifying and predicting all four cohesive sediment gravity flow regimes based on independent rheological properties.
首次提出能基于独立流变性质统一预测四种粘性沉积物重力流态的CFD模型。

sum: This study presents the design, implementation, and initial performance of the first regional-scale Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) seismic monitoring network in northeastern Italy, integrated into the operational framework of the Seismological Research Center of OGS. Utilizing dark fiber segments of a public telecommunication network and multiple DAS units, the system spans several hundred kilometers, generating tens of thousands of virtual channels. The authors establish an end-to-end workflow for continuous acquisition, data format conversion, metadata handling, and real-time streaming via SeedLink. Case studies demonstrate the network's capability to record local and teleseismic earthquakes, characterize spatial ambient noise, and improve earthquake location when integrated with conventional seismic stations. This work demonstrates the feasibility of large-scale operational DAS for regional seismic monitoring, while highlighting ongoing challenges in data volume, directional sensitivity, and channel localization.
本文介绍意大利东北部首个区域级DAS地震监测网络的设计与运行。系统利用数百公里公共暗光纤产生数万虚拟通道，构建了数据转换与SeedLink实时传输工作流。该网络可记录本地及远震、表征环境噪声，并与传统台网联合辅助地震定位。研究展示了业务化DAS在区域监测中的可行性，并探讨了数据量和方向敏感性等局限。

将多台DAS解调仪与公共电信网络的暗光纤结合，将私有格式数据转换为标准地震学格式并通过SeedLink进行实时传输。

Successful real-time streaming of DAS data, recording of local and teleseismic earthquakes, characterization of spatial noise, and contribution to earthquake location when combined with conventional networks.

Challenges include high data volume, real-time latency, channel localization accuracy, directional sensitivity of the fiber, and effective sensing range limits.

sum: This study investigates the complexity of earthquake cycles using 3D rate-and-state friction simulations on a single dipping fault. The authors systematically analyze how physical parameters—such as the ratio of seismogenic width to nucleation length ($W'$), fault dip, and down-dip/lateral frictional transitions—and numerical factors like meshing choices control the transition from periodic to irregular stick-slip behavior. They find that while increasing $W'$ promotes irregular cycles, fault dip and frictional heterogeneities can independently induce similar transitions and compete with $W'$. Crucially, the study demonstrates that subtle meshing choices can artificially force periodic solutions, highlighting the high sensitivity of physics-based earthquake simulations to both physical and numerical assumptions.
本研究利用单倾斜断层上的三维速率-状态摩擦模拟，探讨了地震周期的复杂性。作者系统分析了物理参数（如震源区宽度与成核长度之比 $W'$、断层倾角、沿倾向和走向的摩擦过渡带）以及数值因素（如网格划分）对周期性向非周期性/无序地震周期过渡的控制作用。结果表明，增加 $W'$ 会促进无序周期，而断层倾角和摩……

t: 3-D earthquake-cycle simulations governed by rate-and-state friction on a single dipping fault embedded in an elastic half-space.
在弹性半空间中的单倾斜断层上，进行受速率-状态摩擦控制的三维地震周期模拟。
Synthetic numerical experiments systematically varying fault dip, frictional transitions, and grid meshing parameters.
系统改变断层倾角、摩擦过渡和网格划分参数的合成数值实验。

Increasing W' promotes irregular cycles, but fault dip and frictional heterogeneities can independently induce similar transitions and compete with W'. Subtle meshing choices can lead to spuriously periodic solutions.
增加 W' 会促进无序周期，但断层倾角和摩擦非均匀性可独立诱导类似过渡，且网格选择可能导致虚假周期解。
The study is limited to a single fault in an elastic half-space, omitting complex fault networks and inelastic rheology.
研究局限于弹性半空间中的单断层，忽略了复杂的断层网络和非弹性流变学。
Identifies that subtle numerical meshing choices can cause spurious periodicity, and shows that fault dip and frictional heterogeneities compete with W' in controlling cycle complexity.
发现细微的数值网格选择会导致虚假的周期性，并指出断层倾角和摩擦非均匀性与 W' 共同竞争控制周期复杂性。

kc: Demonstrated that fault dip and frictional heterogeneities can independently control and compete with the seismogenic-to-nucleation width ratio in driving transitions to irregular earthquake cycles.
Revealed that subtle numerical meshing choices beyond spatial resolution can artificially force periodic earthquake cycle solutions.
Provided a systematic framework to isolate the roles of frictional dynamics, fault geometry, and free-surface effects in 3D simulations.
证明了断层倾角和摩擦非均匀性可以独立控制并与震源区/成核宽度比竞争，从而驱动向无序地震周期的过渡。
揭示了除空间分辨率外，细微的数值网格选择也可能人为地导致虚假的周期性地震周期解。
提供了一个系统性的框架，用以在三维模拟中隔离摩擦动力学、断层几何形状和自由表面效应的作用。

sum: This software and data repository accompanies the study 'Seismic Evidence for Increasing Unfrozen Pore Water Heterogeneity from Roadside to Coastal Arctic Tundra.' It provides processed data products and Jupyter notebooks to reproduce MASW (Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves) shear-wave velocity (Vs) profiles, temperature- and laboratory-informed reference constraints, joint porosity inversion outputs, and final water saturation (Sw) profiles. By comparing Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and conventional geophone arrays, the underlying research characterizes the spatial heterogeneity of unfrozen pore water in Arctic tundra permafrost. The repository serves as an open-science tool for reproducible environmental seismology and cryosphere characterization.
该开源软件与数据仓库对应于“从路边到海岸北极苔原未冻孔隙水非均匀性增加的地震学证据”一文。它提供了处理后的数据产品和Jupyter Notebook，用于重现多道表面波分析（MASW）剪切波速度剖面、温度和实验室约束、联合孔隙度反演输出以及最终的水饱和度剖面。通过对比分布式声学传感（DAS）与传统检……

t: Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) combined with temperature- and laboratory-informed joint porosity inversion to estimate shear-wave velocity and unfrozen water saturation profiles.
结合多道表面波分析（MASW）与基于温度和实验室约束的联合孔隙度反演，估算剪切波速度和未冻水饱和度剖面。
Processed seismic data products from DAS and geophone arrays deployed across Arctic tundra (roadside to coastal), alongside temperature and laboratory reference constraints.
部署在北极苔原（路边至海岸）的DAS和检波器阵列的处理后地震数据，以及温度和实验室参考约束。
Reconstructed shear-wave velocity and water saturation profiles demonstrating increasing unfrozen pore water heterogeneity from roadside to coastal Arctic tundra.
重建的剪切波速度和水饱和度剖面表明，从路边到海岸的北极苔原未冻孔隙水非均匀性逐渐增加。
Relies on pre-processed data products rather than raw waveforms, and requires site-specific laboratory and temperature constraints for joint inversion.
依赖于预处理的数据产品而非原始波形，且联合反演需要特定场地的实验室和温度约束。
First open-source data and code release for comparing DAS and geophone MASW performance in characterizing unfrozen pore water heterogeneity in Arctic permafrost.

sum: This study deploys a dense array of 309 short-period nodal seismometers across the middle segment of the Longriba fault zone (LRBFZ) in the eastern Tibetan Plateau. Using ambient noise tomography, the authors construct a high-resolution 3D isotropic shear-wave velocity (VS) and azimuthal anisotropy model of the shallow crust (0–12 km). The isotropic model reveals a prominent velocity contrast across the fault and a localized low-velocity anomaly at the intersection of the LRBFZ and the Aba South fault, indicating intense fracturing and fluid enrichment. Azimuthal anisotropy shows NWW-SEE fast directions aligned with regional extrusion-driven stress, with local rotations near the fault linkage zone. This provides key constraints on fault zone heterogeneity and deformation.
本研究在青藏高原东缘龙日坝断裂带中段部署了309台短周期节点地震仪。利用背景噪声断层成像方法，构建了浅地壳（0-12 km）高分辨率三维各向同性剪切波速度（VS）和方位各向异性模型。结果显示，断裂带两侧存在显著的速度对比，且在龙日坝断裂与阿坝南断裂交汇处存在显著的低速异常，指示了强烈的岩石破裂和流体……

利用密集节点台阵的连续波形进行背景噪声成像，重建三维各向同性VS和方位各向异性。

sum: This study evaluates the potential of the IceCube Upgrade, a densely instrumented extension at the South Pole, to probe Earth's deep interior using multi-GeV atmospheric neutrino oscillations. Relying on matter-induced modifications to neutrino oscillation probabilities (MSW and parametric resonances), the authors analyze simulated Monte Carlo datasets combining 12 years of IceCube DeepCore (IC86) and 3 years of IceCube Upgrade (IC93), processed via DynEdge graph neural networks. Using a 12-layered and 5-layered Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM), they perform chi-squared template fits across energy, zenith angle, and particle identification bins. The combined setup can reject vacuum oscillations at up to 7.1σ, reject a uniform Earth density profile at 2.4σ, and measure Earth's total mass to ~10% precision. Incorporating mass and moment of inertia constraints, it constrains correlated layer densities to ~7% (core), ~10% (inner mantle), and ~23% (middle mantle), offering an independent weak-interaction complement to seismic tomography.
本研究评估了南极IceCube升级版利用GeV级大气中微子振荡探测地球深部结构的潜力。基于地球物质效应（MSW及参量共振），作者利用DynEdge图神经网络重建模拟数据，联合分析了12年DeepCore（IC86）与3年升级版（IC93）的Asimov数据集。基于12层和5层PREM密度模型，研究发……

t: Events are reconstructed and classified using DynEdge graph neural networks, binned in energy, zenith angle, and PID, and fitted via a modified chi-squared statistic on Asimov Monte Carlo templates.
利用DynEdge图神经网络重建并分类事件，按能量、天顶角和PID分箱，对Asimov模板进行修正卡方拟合。
Simulated atmospheric neutrino oscillation datasets combining 12 years of IceCube DeepCore (IC86) and 3 years of IceCube Upgrade (IC93) evaluated against 12-layered and 5-layered PREM density models.
结合12年DeepCore（IC86）和3年IceCube升级版（IC93）的模拟大气中微子数据及12层和5层PREM模…
The joint IC86+IC93 fit rejects vacuum oscillations at 5.5σ (7.1σ with prior), rejects uniform density at 2.4σ, measures Earth's mass to ~10%, and constrains core density to ~7%.
联合拟合以7.1σ确立物质效应、2.4σ拒绝均匀模型，测得地球总质量精度约10%、地核密度精度约7%。
Simulations assume the planned 7-string IC93 layout rather than the 5-string operational IC91 geometry, and fix Earth's chemical composition (Ye) and radial resolution to 5 layers.
模拟基于原计划7串IC93而非实际运行的5串IC91配置，且固定了化学成分并仅划分5层。
First comprehensive sensitivity projection of the newly deployed IceCube Upgrade for multi-GeV neutrino oscillation tomography of Earth's mass, stratification, and correlated layer densities.
首次全面评估新部署的IceCube升级版利用GeV中微子振荡层析成像约束地球质量与分层密度的灵敏度。

Demonstrates the capability to distinguish a 12-layered PREM density structure from a homogeneous uniform Earth profile at 2.4σ significance.
Projects a ~10% (1σ) precision for an independent neutrino-based measurement of the total mass of the Earth.
Constrains correlated radial densities of a 5-layered PREM model to ~7% for the core, ~10% for the inner mantle, and ~23% for the middle mantle using gravitational constraints.

证明了该探测器能以2.4σ的显著性区分12层PREM密度结构与均匀地球密度模型。

Event reconstruction and particle identification (cascade, mixed, track) using four separately trained DynEdge graph neural network models.
Asimov dataset template fitting using a modified chi-squared test statistic with pull penalties for detector, flux, cross-section, and oscillation nuisance parameters.
Non-nested binary hypothesis testing (PREM vs. vacuum/uniform) and nested Wilks' theorem parameter scanning for mass and correlated layer density scaling factors.
在12层和5层PREM球壳模型中计算包含MSW共振和振荡长度/参量共振的三味大气中微子振荡概率。
使用四个独立训练的DynEdge图神经网络模型进行中微子能量、天顶角重建及粒子鉴别（级联、混合、径迹）。
采用包含探测器、通量、截面和振荡系统误差惩罚项的修正卡方统计量对Asimov模拟数据集进行模板拟合。

IceCube升级版（IC93配置，3年曝光量）的蒙特卡洛Asimov模拟数据集，重建能量范围3–300 GeV，天顶角余弦-1至0。
IceCube DeepCore（IC86配置，12年与15年曝光量）模拟数据集，重建能量范围5–100 GeV，用于基线对比与联合拟合。

li: Assumes the chemical composition (electron-to-nucleon ratio Y_e) of the core and mantle is perfectly known and fixed.

sum: Seismic hazard assessment along the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) is hindered by a short historical record and complex fault behavior. This study generates a 10,000-year synthetic earthquake catalog for the MHT using the physics-based Rate-and-State Earthquake Simulator (RSQSim), constrained by geodetically inferred coupling and slip-rate models. The synthetic catalog successfully reproduces observed magnitude-frequency distributions, bimodal seismicity patterns, and historical rupture extents. Notably, along-strike low-coupling zones consistently act as rupture barriers, limiting the maximum simulated magnitude to Mw 8.9. Implementing this catalog into a stochastic probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) for Nepal using subduction ground-motion models reveals generally lower Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) estimates compared to classical PSHA, with differences ranging from +20% to -70% at 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years. This work demonstrates that physics-based simulations effectively incorporate spatial coupling variations to complement conventional seismic hazard models.
喜马拉雅主逆冲断层（MHT）的地震危险性评估受限于较短的历史记录。本研究将大地测量反演的断层几何、滑移率与耦合模型输入基于物理的速率-状态地震模拟器（RSQSim），生成了10,000年的合成地震目录。该目录重现了观测到的震级-频度分布、双峰地震活动模式及历史破裂范围。关键发现是沿走向的低耦合区充当……

将MHT大地测量几何、滑移率及耦合摩擦属性输入RSQSim模拟万年地震目录，并结合俯冲带地面运动模型进行随机PSHA。
The MHT model uses a planar fault geometry, coupling factor, and slip rates (13–30 mm/yr) from Dal Zilio et al. (2020), validated against the ISC-GEM catalog and historical earthquakes since 1500 CE.
采用Dal Zilio等(2020)的平面断层几何、耦合因子与滑移率(13–30 mm/yr)，并用ISC目录及1500…
Low-coupling zones act as rupture barriers limiting maximum magnitude to Mw 8.9. RSQSim-derived PGA in Nepal differs from classical PSHA by +0.1g (+20%) to -0.6g (-70%) at 10% PoE in 50 years.

来自Dal Zilio等（2020）的MHT平面断层几何模型（沿走向2000公里，倾角10°）及震间耦合/滑移率模型。

尼泊尔0.1° x 0.1°网格上的USGS全球Vs30数据及俯冲带地面运动模型（Parker et al., 2020; Abrahamson and Gulerce, 2022）。
li: Adopted a simplified planar MHT geometry rather than a ramp-flat-ramp geometry, because non-planar geometry in RSQSim produced excessive small-to-moderate events terminating at ramp intersections.
Assumed a stationary spatial coupling pattern over the 15,000-year simulation rather than time-dependent evolving coupling.
Overestimated the frequency of Mw 5–6 earthquakes compared to the ISC instrumental catalog, likely due to single- or two-patch high stress-drop artifacts.

sum: This study investigates deep slab deformation and rupture mechanisms in the Tonga subduction zone using relative earthquake relocation and focal mechanism clustering. Utilizing regional arrival times from land and ocean-bottom seismometers alongside teleseismic phases, the authors relocate earthquakes via hypocentroidal decomposition and perform K-means clustering on GCMT solutions. The results reveal that deep earthquakes align along a dense, narrow (<3 km) seismic plane coplanar with steeply dipping nodal planes at the upper boundary of the slab. This seismicity is interpreted as active fault zones accommodating the downward motion of the Tonga slab relative to stagnant material to the west. The findings suggest these fault zones represent planes of recurrent thermal shear runaway within the subducted oceanic crust, providing key insights into deep earthquake physical mechanisms.
本研究利用相对地震重定位和震源机制解聚类分析，探讨了汤加俯冲带深部板块变形与破裂机制。研究整合了陆地与海底地震仪的区域走时及体波数据，采用震中分解法进行重定位，并对GCMT解进行K-means聚类。结果表明，深部地震沿一条宽度小于3公里的极窄地震面分布，与震源机制的陡倾节面共面，且位于板块上边界。该……
