远震震相走时数据。
全球质心矩张量（GCMT）目录解。
li: Resolution of the fault zone width is limited by the spatial distribution and density of temporary regional networks.
Thermal shear runaway interpretation relies on indirect seismic observations and thermal models rather than direct in-situ physical measurements.
断裂带宽度的分辨率受限于临时区域台网的空间分布和台站密度。
热剪切失稳的解释依赖于间接的地震观测和热力学模型，而非直接的原位物理测量。

tm.why: The paper performs high-precision relative earthquake relocation using hypocentroidal decomposition and cross-correlation.
It analyzes focal mechanism clusters to investigate the rupture mechanisms and thermal shear runaway of deep earthquakes.
It images active fault zones and slab deformation within the subducting Tonga slab at transition zone depths.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete abstract and public metadata from JGR: Solid Earth, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study characterizes the 3D structure of the Los Angeles Basin and its underlying Moho using a dense seismic deployment of 273 nodes from Fall 2022. To overcome phase incoherency in sparse array configurations, the authors developed a novel algorithm to identify P-to-S conversions and multiple phases in receiver functions, representing sediment-basement, intrasedimentary, and Moho interfaces. By integrating gravity measurements, they jointly modeled the multi-layer crustal structure. The results reveal a narrow, oblong basin reaching a maximum depth of approximately 10 km. Under the assumption of isostatic equilibrium, the underlying Moho is found to be uplifted by up to 45% compared to the surrounding crust, providing critical constraints for seismic hazard assessment and tectonic models of Southern California.
本研究利用2022年秋季部署的273个地震节点数据，表征了洛杉矶盆地及其下方莫霍面的三维结构。针对稀疏台站相位不相干的挑战，研究提出了一种新型算法，用于识别接收函数中的沉积物-基底界面、沉积内层及莫霍面的P-to-S转换波。通过结合重力测量数据进行联合解释，揭示了一个最大深度接近10公里的狭长盆地。……

t: A novel receiver function phase identification algorithm combined with gravity measurements to resolve multi-layer crustal structure.
一种结合重力测量的新型接收函数相位识别算法，用于解析多层地壳结构。
Seismic waveforms from 273 nodes deployed in the Los Angeles Basin in Fall 2022, alongside gravity measurements.
2022年秋季在洛杉矶盆地部署的273个节点的地震波形数据以及重力测量数据。
A narrow, oblong basin with a maximum depth of ~10 km and an underlying Moho uplifted by up to 45%.
揭示了一个最大深度约10公里的狭长盆地，其下方莫霍面隆起高达45%。
Phase incoherency due to sparse station spacing, and reliance on the assumption of isostatic equilibrium.
稀疏台站间相位不相干的限制，以及对地壳均衡假设的依赖。
A new algorithm to identify P-to-S phases in sparse arrays, integrated with gravity data to map basin and Moho structure.
提出适用于稀疏台阵的接收函数相位识别新算法，并联合重力数据约束盆地与莫霍面。

kc: Developed a novel algorithm to identify P-to-S conversions and related phases in receiver functions from sparse/irregular seismic arrays.
Mapped the 3D geometry of the Los Angeles Basin, revealing a narrow, oblong shape with a maximum depth of ~10 km.
Discovered that the Moho is uplifted by up to 45% beneath the basin under the assumption of isostatic equilibrium.
开发了一种新算法，用于从稀疏/不规则地震台阵的接收函数中识别P-to-S转换波及相关相位。
绘制了洛杉矶盆地的三维几何结构，揭示其呈狭长形状，最大深度约为10公里。
在均衡假设下，发现盆地底部的莫霍面相比周围地壳隆起了高达45%。
me: Receiver function analysis using a novel phase identification algorithm for sparse arrays.
Joint interpretation of seismic receiver functions and gravity measurements to constrain multi-layer crustal structure.
使用针对稀疏台阵的新型相位识别算法进行接收函数分析。
联合解释地震接收函数和重力测量数据，以约束多层地壳结构。
de: Seismic waveform data from 273 nodes installed in the Los Angeles Basin in Fall 2022 (linear arrays and distributed shotgun stations).
Gravity measurements integrated with the seismic dataset.
2022年秋季在洛杉矶盆地部署的273个节点（线性台阵和分布式散点台站）的地震波形数据。
与地震数据集相结合的重力测量数据。
li: Phase incoherency among sparsely spaced stations challenges standard receiver function analysis, requiring gravity data for joint constraint.
Moho uplift calculations rely on the assumption of isostatic equilibrium.
稀疏台站之间的相位不相干性给标准接收函数分析带来挑战，需要重力数据进行联合约束。
莫霍面隆起的计算依赖于地壳均衡假设。

tm.why: The paper applies a novel algorithm to identify P-to-S conversions and related phases in receiver functions to map crustal interfaces.
The study maps the 3D structure of the Los Angeles Basin and the underlying Moho discontinuity.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Large low velocity provinces (LLVPs) at the base of Earth's lower mantle are long-lived thermochemical anomalies, yet their high temperature and water content should rheologically weaken them and cause rapid convective mixing. Through multi-anvil experiments at 25 GPa and 2000 K for 10–500 minutes, this study investigates the effect of water on the grain growth kinetics of bridgmanite coexisting with ferropericlase. Using infrared spectroscopy of periclase to track relative water content, the authors determine a water-content exponent of r = 1.7 ± 0.2 for the bridgmanite growth rate. Incorporating this strong water-induced coarsening alongside temperature and ferric iron effects into Coble and Nabarro-Herring diffusion creep models reveals that LLVPs develop grain sizes ~0.8 orders of magnitude larger than the surrounding mantle. Consequently, LLVP viscosity is up to 1.4 orders of magnitude higher despite thermo-hydrous weakening, providing a novel mineral-physics mechanism for LLVP longevity and variable slab penetration.
地球下地幔底部的巨大低速省（LLVPs）长期稳定存在，但其高温富水特征理应降低流变强度并导致对流混合。本研究利用多面顶压机在25 GPa、2000 K下进行了10-500分钟的高温高压实验，结合方镁石红外光谱分析，测定了含水条件下布里奇曼石晶粒生长动力学。实验首次确定水含量指数r = 1.7 ± 0……

t: High-pressure multi-anvil experiments at 25 GPa and 2000 K for 10–500 min on bridgmanite-ferropericlase aggregates with varying water contents, combined with FTIR, BSE imaging, and diffusion creep viscosity modeling.
在25 GPa和2000 K下进行含水布里奇曼石多面顶压机晶粒生长实验，结合红外光谱、电子显微镜与扩散蠕变粘度建模。

Polycrystalline bridgmanite + ferropericlase samples synthesized from San Carlos olivine at 25 GPa and 2000 K, analyzed via >300 BSE grain-size measurements per sample, EPMA, and unpolarized FTIR spectra on periclase.
25 GPa、2000 K下合成的多晶样品，每个样品超300个晶粒的BSE统计、电子探针成分及方镁石红外光谱数据。

Bridgmanite grain growth rate increases with water content with an exponent r = 1.7 ± 0.2, yielding a 0.8 orders of magnitude larger grain size and up to 1.4 orders of magnitude higher viscosity in LLVPs.
测得布里奇曼石晶粒生长水指数r = 1.7 ± 0.2，使LLVPs晶粒增大0.8个数量级，粘度高出周围地幔达1.4个数…
Experiments were performed at 25 GPa rather than LLVP pressures (80–130 GPa), and the water effect on bridgmanite silicon diffusivity had to be approximated using olivine data.
实验仅在25 GPa下进行（远低于LLVPs的80-130 GPa），且硅扩散的水效应借用了橄榄石数据近似。
First experimental determination of the water-content exponent for bridgmanite grain growth, demonstrating how hydrous coarsening overcomes thermo-hydrous weakening to stabilize LLVPs.
首次实验测定布里奇曼石晶粒生长的水含量指数，揭示水致粗化克服热-水弱化以稳定LLVPs的新机制。

kc: Quantified the effect of water on bridgmanite grain growth rate at 25 GPa and 2000 K, obtaining a water-content exponent r = 1.7 ± 0.2.
Demonstrated that water-induced grain coarsening in LLVPs results in grain sizes ~0.8 orders of magnitude larger than the surrounding mantle over 100 Myr.

Showed that larger grain sizes increase LLVP viscosity by up to 1.4 orders of magnitude relative to the surrounding mantle in diffusion creep regimes, explaining their long-term stability and low seismic attenuation.
量化了25 GPa和2000 K下水对布里奇曼石晶粒生长速率的影响，测得水含量指数r = 1.7 ± 0.2。
证明LLVPs中水诱导的晶粒粗化使其在1亿年尺度上的晶粒尺寸比周围地幔大0.8个数量级。
揭示在扩散蠕变机制下，较大的晶粒尺寸使LLVPs粘度比周围地幔高出达1.4个数量级，解释了其长期稳定性和低地震衰减特征。
me: High-pressure, high-temperature multi-anvil press grain growth experiments at 25 GPa and 2000 K using San Carlos olivine and MgO+Mg(OH)2 water sources.
Grain-size statistical analysis via backscattered electron (BSE) imaging and unpolarized FTIR spectroscopy on coexisting periclase to proxy relative water content.
Rheological modeling of grain-size contrast and viscosity ratio between LLVPs and surrounding mantle under Coble and Nabarro-Herring diffusion creep.
利用圣卡洛斯橄榄石和MgO+Mg(OH)2水源，在25 GPa和2000 K下进行多面顶压机高温高压晶粒生长实验。
通过背散射电子（BSE）图像进行晶粒尺寸统计分析，并利用共生方镁石的非偏振红外光谱（FTIR）表征相对水含量。
基于Coble和Nabarro-Herring扩散蠕变模型，计算LLVPs与周围地幔的晶粒尺寸对比及粘度比。
de: Multi-anvil run products synthesized at 25 GPa and 2000 K over annealing durations of 10 to 500 minutes with varying low bulk water contents.
BSE micrographs (>300 grains per sample), EPMA chemical compositions, and FTIR absorption spectra of periclase layers.
在25 GPa、2000 K及不同低水含量条件下，退火10至500分钟合成的多面顶压机实验样品。
每个样品超过300个晶粒的BSE显微图像、电子探针（EPMA）化学成分数据以及方镁石层的FTIR吸收光谱。
li: Experiments were conducted at 25 GPa, much lower than actual LLVP pressures (~80–130 GPa), leaving the pressure effect on grain growth rate unconstrained.
Water effects on silicon lattice and grain-boundary diffusivity in bridgmanite are unknown, requiring the use of olivine hydrous weakening parameters as an approximation.
实验压力为25 GPa，远低于LLVPs的实际压力（约80–130 GPa），压力对晶粒生长速率的影响尚不清楚。
水对布里奇曼石中硅晶格扩散和晶界扩散的影响未知，只能借用橄榄石的水弱化参数进行近似估计。

tm.why: The paper investigates the rheological stability and viscosity of Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs) and subducted slabs in the lower mantle using high-pressure mineral physics experiments.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, equations, figures, methods, and references.

sum: This study presents the first 1D shear-wave velocity (Vs) model for the upper ~1 km of Pantelleria Island, Italy, an active volcanic complex with significant geothermal potential. Using ambient seismic noise recorded by 18 permanent, temporary, and test stations between September 2023 and October 2025, the authors grouped stations into seven irregular sub-array configurations and applied the modified Spatial Autocorrelation (m-SPAC) method to extract Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves (0.1–2.0 Hz). Stochastic inversion via the Neighbourhood Algorithm resolved three main volcanic layers overlying a high-velocity half-space. The most prominent feature is a sharp velocity increase from ~1.47 km/s to ~2.97 km/s at ~630 m depth. Comparison with deep geothermal borehole (PPT1) stratigraphy and magnetotelluric resistivity models validates this boundary as the transition from fractured, hydrothermally altered volcanic rocks to a deeper microsyenitic intrusive heat source, providing a critical baseline for local earthquake location and geothermal exploration.
本研究利用背景地震噪声分析，首次建立了意大利潘泰莱里亚火山岛浅表约1公里深度的一维剪切波速度（Vs）模型。研究收集了2023年9月至2025年10月期间18个永久、临时及测试台站的连续背景噪声数据，划分为7个不规则子台阵，应用改进的空间自相关（m-SPAC）方法提取0.1–2.0 Hz瑞利波频散曲线……

t: Applied the modified Spatial Autocorrelation (m-SPAC) method to vertical-component ambient noise across concentric station rings (0.1–2.0 Hz), then inverted the average Rayleigh-wave dispersion curve using the Neighbourhood Algorithm in Geopsy/Dinver.
对同心圆环台站垂直分量噪声应用m-SPAC方法提取0.1–2.0 Hz瑞利波频散曲线，并用邻域算法反演。

Ambient seismic noise recordings from 18 stations (permanent IV network, temporary YM network, and test sites) acquired between September 2023 and October 2025, organized into seven sub-array configurations (A–G).
2023年9月至2025年10月期间18个台站记录的背景噪声数据，按可用性划分为A至G七个子台阵。

Resolved a four-unit Vs profile (0.25, 0.72, 1.47 km/s over a 2.97 km/s half-space) with a minimum misfit of 0.16 and a sharp impedance contrast at ~630 m depth matching intrusive rocks in borehole PPT1.
获得四层Vs模型（250、720、1470及半空间2970 m/s），在630米深处存在对应侵入岩顶部的速度跃升。
No coherent H/V spectral ratio peak was found for joint inversion, and sparse northern station coverage restricts the 1D model's representativeness primarily to the central-southern caldera sector.
缺乏一致的H/V峰值无法联合反演，且北部台站稀疏使模型仅代表中南部破火山口区。
Provides the very first 1D shear-wave velocity model of Pantelleria Island, cross-validated against deep geothermal borehole stratigraphy and 3D magnetotelluric resistivity imaging.
首次建立潘泰莱里亚岛一维剪切波速度模型，并结合深井地层和大地电磁数据进行了交叉验证。

kc: Derived the first 1D shear-wave velocity (Vs) model for Pantelleria Island down to ~1 km depth using ambient noise.
Identified a major mechanical discontinuity at ~630 m depth where Vs jumps from ~1.47 km/s to ~2.97 km/s.
Integrated seismic results with deep geothermal well logs (PPT1) and 3D magnetotelluric data to constrain the hydrothermal cap-intrusive transition.
利用背景噪声首次建立了潘泰莱里亚岛浅表约1公里深度的一维剪切波速度（Vs）模型。
识别出约630米深处的主要力学间断面，其Vs从约1.47 km/s急剧增加至约2.97 km/s。
结合深部地热钻井（PPT1）岩心日志与三维大地电磁数据，约束了热液盖层向深部侵入岩体的过渡边界。
me: Modified Spatial Autocorrelation (m-SPAC) applied to vertical-component ambient noise across 7 irregular array configurations.
Rayleigh-wave phase velocity dispersion curve estimation between 0.1 and 2.0 Hz using 80-s windows with 10% overlap.
Stochastic inversion using the Neighbourhood Algorithm (Dinver/Geopsy) for a 3-layer over half-space parameterization.
对7个不规则子台阵配置的垂直分量背景噪声应用改进的空间自相关（m-SPAC）方法。
使用10%重叠的80秒时间窗，提取0.1至2.0 Hz频段的瑞利波相速度频散曲线。
基于三层加半空间的参数化模型，利用Geopsy/Dinver中的邻域算法（NA）进行随机反演。
de: Ambient seismic noise recordings from 18 stations (4 permanent IV network, 5 temporary YM network, and 9 test sites) collected between September 2023 and October 2025.
Stratigraphic and temperature logs from deep geothermal boreholes PPT1 and PPT2, plus a 3D magnetotelluric resistivity section.
2023年9月至2025年10月期间从18个台站（4个IV永久台、5个YM临时台和9个测试点）采集的背景地震噪声记录。
来自PPT1和PPT2深部地热钻井的地层与温度日志，以及三维大地电磁电阻率剖面数据。
li: Lower station density in the northern sector means the 1D model primarily represents the central-southern caldera domain.
Joint inversion with H/V spectral ratios could not be performed because no coherent H/V peak frequency was observed across the network.
岛屿北部台站密度较低，因此该一维模型主要代表中南部破火山口区域的地下结构。
由于整个台网未能观测到一致的H/V谱比峰值频率，因此无法开展频散曲线与H/V的联合反演。

tm.why: The study applies the modified Spatial Autocorrelation (m-SPAC) technique to ambient seismic noise recordings to extract Rayleigh-wave phase velocity dispersion curves.
The paper investigates the shallow volcanic and hydrothermal structure of Pantelleria Island, an active volcanic system in southern Italy.
Surface-wave dispersion curves between 0.1 and 2.0 Hz are inverted to derive a 1D shear-wave velocity profile down to ~1 km depth.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF evaluated, including all text sections, equations, embedded parameter table in Fig. 5, and Figures 1 to 6.

sum: Continuous gas extraction at the Groningen gas field from 1963 to 2024 induced reservoir compaction and fault reactivation. This study revisits previously observed spatiotemporal Gutenberg–Richter b-value patterns by integrating the standard KNMI catalog with a deep-learning-enhanced catalog (2015–2022, adding 660 new events) and recent post-2022 data up to October 2025. Using generalized orthogonal regression for magnitude homogenization and the completeness-robust b-positive estimator, the authors map b-values on a 1-km grid and analyze time series across northern and southern sectors. Results confirm that after 2014 production cuts in the north and a southward extraction shift, the field-wide b-value converged to a homogeneous low value (~0.8–1.0), interrupted briefly in 2016–2017 by five small-magnitude swarms in the caprock. Crucially, the decrease in b-value compensates for the tenfold drop in overall seismicity rate, maintaining an annual probability of ~0.28 for M 3.4 events in the north, consistent with the November 2025 Ml 3.4 Zeerijp...
本研究结合荷兰皇家气象研究所（KNMI）常规地震目录与2015–2022年深度学习增强目录（新增660个事件）及截至2025年10月的最新数据，重新评估了格罗宁根气田的b值时空演化。通过广义正交回归统一震级并采用b-positive方法进行网格建图与时间序列分析，证实2014年北部减产及向南转移后，……

t: The authors homogenize catalog magnitudes using generalized orthogonal regression and compute spatiotemporal b-values using the completeness-robust b-positive estimator on a 1-km grid (5-km radius, ≥50 positive differences) and in 200-event moving windows.
采用广义正交回归统一震级，利用b-positive方法在1 km网格（5 km半径）和200事件滑动窗中计算时空b值。

A composite catalog of 2,298 earthquakes (1991–2025) in Groningen, merging pre-2015 and 2022–2025 KNMI records with the 2015–2022 deep-learning catalog of Sirorattanakul et al. (2024), which added 660 new events.
整合KNMI记录与2015–2022年深度学习增强目录（新增660个事件），构建1991–2025年共2298个事件的综…

After 2014 production cuts, field-wide b-values converged to 0.8–1.0 (with a temporary 1.6 spike in 2016–2017 from caprock swarms). Lower b-values offset a tenfold rate drop, keeping northern M 3.4 annual probability at ~0.28.
2014年减产后全气田b值收敛至0.8–1.0；b值下降抵消了活动率十倍的降幅，使北部M 3.4年发生概率维持在约0.2…

Limited event counts and small volume preclude Voronoi tessellation and prevent mapping outer nodes; furthermore, discrepancies exist between mapped and time-series b-values due to spatial aggregation.
事件数量和体积限制了Voronoi剖分及边缘节点成图；空间聚合差异导致时间序列与空间图b值略有不同。

Validates spatiotemporal b-value homogenization in Groningen using a deep-learning-enhanced catalog up to field closure (2025) and shows declining b-values sustain large-event hazard despite falling seismicity rates.
利用深度学习目录验证了闭井期的b值空间均质化，揭示b值下降在活动率降低时仍维持大震危险性。

kc: Constructs a homogenized composite catalog of 2,298 events (1991–2025) for Groningen by merging KNMI records with the Sirorattanakul et al. (2024) deep-learning catalog via generalized orthogonal regression.
Confirms via the b-positive estimator that post-2014 production reductions and southward shifts caused b-values to converge toward spatial homogeneity (~0.8–1.0) across the field.
Identifies a transient b-value spike (up to 1.6) in 2016–2017 directly linked to five newly detected small-magnitude (Ml 0.5–1.5) swarms in the Zechstein caprock.

Demonstrates that decreasing b-values offset the tenfold decline in seismic productivity (a-value), sustaining a ~0.28 annual probability for M 3.4 events in the north, validated by the November 2025 Ml 3.4 Zeerijp earthquake.
通过广义正交回归将KNMI记录与深度学习增强目录融合，构建了1991–2025年包含2298个事件的格罗宁根气田均质综合地震目录。
利用b-positive估计器证实，2014年后的减产及开采向南转移导致全气田b值收敛至0.8–1.0的空间均匀状态。
发现2016–2017年南部和北部b值短暂升至1.6，这与Zechstein盖层中新检测到的5个小震级（Ml 0.5–1.5）震群直接相关。
证明b值的降低抵消了地震活动率（a值）十倍的下降，使北部发生M 3.4级地震的年概率保持在约0.28，这与2025年11月发生的Ml 3.4地震相吻合。
me: Magnitude scale homogenization between KNMI and SIR24 catalogs using Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), Generalized Orthogonal Regression (GOR), and Student's t-test.
Spatial b-value mapping on a 1-km grid with overlapping 5-km radius cylindrical volumes using the completeness-independent b-positive estimator (minimum 50 positive magnitude differences).
Moving-window time-series analysis (200-event window, 1-event step) with bootstrap uncertainty quantification for northern and southern sub-fields (divided at y = 593,000 m).
Time-dependent annual earthquake rate (a-value at Mc = 1.5) and M 3.4 exceedance probability estimation via Gutenberg–Richter recurrence relationships.
采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）、广义正交回归（GOR）和Student's t检验对KNMI与SIR24目录进行震级标度均一化检验。
基于不依赖完备震级的b-positive估计器，在1 km间距网格、5 km重叠采样半径（至少50个正震级差）下进行空间b值建图。
以y = 593,000 m为界划分南北子区，采用200事件滑动窗（步长1事件）和自助法（bootstrap）不确定度估计进行b值时间序列分析。
基于Gutenberg–Richter重现期关系，固定完备震级Mc = 1.5计算年地震发生率（a值）及Ml 3.4级地震的年发生概率。
de: Pre-2015 KNMI earthquake catalog (1991–2014) with local magnitudes (Ml).
2015–2022 deep-learning-enhanced catalog from Sirorattanakul et al. (2024) containing 1,369 located events (660 newly detected, including 5 bursts of Ml 0.5–1.5 swarms).
Post-enhanced KNMI earthquake catalog from 28 December 2022 to 29 October 2025, plus reference to the 14 November 2025 Ml 3.4 Zeerijp event (total composite catalog: 2,298 events).
2015年之前的KNMI地震目录（1991–2014年），包含地方震震级（Ml）。
Sirorattanakul等（2024）的2015–2022年深度学习增强目录，包含1369个定位事件（其中660个为新检测事件，含5个Ml 0.5–1.5震群）。
2022年12月28日至2025年10月29日的KNMI最新地震目录，以及用于验证的2025年11月14日Zeerijp Ml 3.4地震（综合目录共2298个事件）。
li: Scarcity of seismic events and small reservoir volume prevent the use of non-arbitrary Voronoi tessellation partitioning and leave peripheral grid nodes unmapped.
The KNMI catalog lacks individual magnitude uncertainty estimates, requiring a simplifying assumption of equal unit errors on both axes during Generalized Orthogonal Regression.
Time-series b-value estimates are slightly lower than spatial map values because time series aggregate events across the entire sub-field whereas maps filter for high-density nodes.
地震事件数量有限且储层体积较小，无法应用基于Voronoi剖分的自适应网格方法，且边缘网格节点因样本不足无法成图。
KNMI目录缺乏单事件震级不确定度估计，导致在进行广义正交回归时必须简化假设两个目录的误差相等且为单位1。
时间序列汇总了整个子区的所有事件，而空间图仅显示满足高密度条件节点的结果，导致时间序列b值略低于空间图结果。

tm.why: The paper investigates production-induced seismicity, reservoir compaction, and stress evolution in the Groningen gas field.
The study evaluates how spatiotemporal b-value variations and declining earthquake rates affect the annual probability of larger hazardous events.
The analysis integrates and homogenizes the standard KNMI catalog with a deep-learning-enhanced earthquake catalog containing 660 newly identified events.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF analyzed, including metadata, equations, catalog statistics, regression validation, and all four figures.

sum: Submarine telecommunication and power cables face significant risks from accidental damage and sabotage. Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables continuous wide-area marine monitoring, yet public, well-annotated submarine DAS datasets for machine learning (ML) remain scarce. This paper introduces the Marlinks-NS DAS dataset, acquired over ten days along a 2,553 m segment (250 channels) of a 28 km buried fiber-optic cable offshore Zeebrugge in the North Sea. The dataset contains 74,771 labeled 10-second instances, each providing 100 logarithmically spaced spectral-energy features between 4 and 100 Hz, synchronized with AIS-derived vessel-to-cable distances and metadata (vessel type, length, beam). It establishes two benchmark ML tasks: binary vessel detection and vessel-to-cable distance estimation, supported by a passage-disjoint 10-fold day-wise evaluation protocol and environmental variability summaries. Baseline XGBoost models achieve an 89.43% global F1-score for detection and 171.01 m MAE for vessels within 1,000 m.
针对海底光缆安全监测中缺乏公开标注分布式声学传感（DAS）数据的问题，本文发布了Marlinks-NS数据集。数据采集自北海比利时近海28公里海底埋设光缆中2553米航道交叉段（250个通道）连续10天的记录，共包含74,771个10秒时间窗样本。每个样本提取4–100 Hz内100个对数间隔频带的……

t: Raw differential phase-rate DAS signals (sampled at 3,125 Hz) are converted to strain, segmented into 10-s Blackman windows, and transformed into 100 logarithmically spaced spectral-energy features (4–100 Hz), synchronized with 1-Hz interpolated AIS vessel distances.
将3125 Hz采样的DAS相位率转化为应变，按10秒分窗提取4–100 Hz内100个对数频带能量，并与1 Hz插值A…

The dataset contains 74,771 labeled 10-s windows recorded over 10 days (16–25 June 2023) across 250 channels (2,553 m segment) of a 28 km buried North Sea cable, paired with AIS metadata from 745 vessels.
包含北海28公里埋设海缆中250个通道（2553米）连续10天的74,771个10秒标注样本及745艘船舶的AIS元数据…

Using 10-fold day-wise cross-validation and 250-channel averaging, the baseline XGBoost model achieved an 89.43% global F1-score (89.58% accuracy) for 1,000 m vessel detection, and a 171.01 m MAE for distances below 1,000 m.
在10折按天交叉验证与250通道平均下，XGBoost实现1000米内船舶检测全局F1达89.43%，1000米内测距M…
Original raw DAS recordings, MMSI identifiers, and exact cable routes are excluded for security reasons, and linear interpolation of 1–3 minute AIS reports introduces positional label uncertainty.
因保密限制未公开原始波形与精确坐标，且1–3分钟间隔AIS报告的线性插值引入了距离标签不确定性。

Unlike prior unannotated submarine DAS datasets or low-frequency (10 Hz) wake-only datasets, this release provides up to 100 Hz spectral features and continuous AIS distance labels for early-warning cable protection.
克服既有海缆数据集无标注或仅限10 Hz尾流分类的不足，首次提供高达100 Hz频谱特征与连续距离标签用于海缆预警。

kc: Releases the Marlinks-NS DAS dataset (14 GB HDF5) containing 74,771 labeled 10-s instances across 250 submarine channels and 100 spectral bands (4–100 Hz).
Synchronizes submarine DAS strain-energy features with 1-Hz interpolated AIS vessel distance labels and vessel metadata (type, length, beam).
Establishes a passage-disjoint 10-fold day-wise cross-validation benchmark protocol for binary vessel detection and distance regression, validated with XGBoost baselines.
公开了Marlinks-NS海底DAS数据集（14 GB HDF5），包含250个通道、100个频带（4–100 Hz）的74,771个10秒标注样本。
将海底DAS应变谱能量特征与1 Hz插值的AIS船舶三维距离标签及船舶属性（类型、长度、宽度）进行了时间同步。
建立了按天划分的10折交叉验证基准协议，用于船舶检测与距离回归任务，并提供了XGBoost基线验证结果。
me: Phase-sensitive OTDR acquisition (Alcatel OptoDAS, 10.21 m gauge length, 3,125 Hz sampling) followed by scaling, spike suppression, phase unwrapping, and temporal integration to strain.
Extraction of 100 logarithmically spaced spectral-energy bands between 4 and 100 Hz over 10-s Blackman-windowed segments, excluding 49–51 Hz and 98–100 Hz instrument noise.
Linear 1-Hz trajectory interpolation of AIS reports and 3D Euclidean chord distance computation in WGS 84 ECEF coordinates.
Baseline technical validation using gradient boosted trees (XGBoost) with spatial channel averaging across 10 day-wise folds.
采用相位敏感光时域反射仪（Alcatel OptoDAS，标距10.21米，采样率3125 Hz）采集，经幅值缩放、脉冲抑制、相位解缠和时间积分恢复应变信号。
对10秒Blackman加窗信号做FFT，在4–100 Hz内提取100个对数间隔频带能量（剔除49–51 Hz和98–100 Hz窄带仪器噪声）。
对AIS报告进行1 Hz线性轨迹插值，并在WGS 84地心地固坐标系下计算船舶至光缆通道的最小三维欧氏距离。
结合多通道空间平均与XGBoost梯度提升树，在10折按天交叉验证下进行基线性能评估。
de: 10-day continuous DAS recording (16–25 June 2023) on a 28 km buried (1.4–7.2 m depth) submarine cable offshore Zeebrugge, Belgium, focusing on a 2,553 m segment crossing a 20 m deep dredged fairway.
AIS positioning dataset comprising 64,417 reports from 745 unique vessels, interpolated to over 1.2 million 1-Hz entries, plus 1,033 reconstructed cable-adjacent passage events.
Daily marine and meteorological summaries (wave height, wave period, wind speed, water temperature, precipitation, current speed) retrieved via the Stormglass and NOAA APIs.
2023年6月16日至25日在比利时泽布吕赫近海28公里海底埋设光缆（埋深1.4–7.2米）上的连续10天DAS记录，重点截取穿越20米深疏浚航道的2553米光缆段。
涵盖745艘独特船舶的64,417条AIS位置报告（插值后超120万条1 Hz记录），并在光缆邻近区重建了1,033次物理通行事件。
通过Stormglass与NOAA接口获取的10天海洋与气象环境日极值数据（波高、波周期、风速、水温、降水、流速）。
li: Raw DAS waveforms, exact cable coordinates, and MMSI identifiers are withheld due to critical-infrastructure confidentiality restrictions.
AIS vessel positions are linearly interpolated from reports spaced 1–3 minutes apart without an independent positioning reference, introducing label uncertainty.
Three noisy sensor channels (indices 59, 60, and 61) had to be zeroed out, and the 10-day summer campaign does not capture full seasonal environmental variability.
受关键基础设施保密限制，未公开原始DAS时域波形、光缆精确地理坐标及船舶MMSI标识符。
AIS位置由间隔1–3分钟的报告线性插值得到，缺乏独立定位基准验证，距离标签存在一定不确定性。
3个高噪声通道（索引59、60、61）被置零，且10天夏季采集未能覆盖全年季节性海洋环境变化。

tm.why: The paper presents a curated submarine Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset from a 28 km buried fiber-optic cable in the North Sea.
The dataset defines two machine-learning tasks (binary vessel detection and vessel-to-cable distance regression) and provides baseline XGBoost evaluations.
The study focuses on marine acoustic monitoring of anthropogenic surface vessels and characterizes environmental/oceanographic noise conditions.

ev.notes: Full 18-page Data Descriptor PDF analyzed, including all 8 figures and 3 tables.

sum: Strong mining tremors induce intense cyclic loading-unloading disturbances in deep coal mines, yet the coupled effects of cyclic fatigue and intermediate strain rates on rock degradation remain poorly understood. Using 3D seismic wavefield forward modeling (SW4) based on the Huating Coal Mine, this study demonstrates that strong, high-frequency mining tremors (M0 >= 10^13 N·m) generate intermediate strain-rate disturbances (0.1 to 10 s^-1) in near-field zones. To simulate rock behavior under such conditions, the authors develop a Dynamic Cyclic Damage Contact Model (DCDCM) in Particle Flow Code (PFC) that couples loading-rate-dependent contact strength amplification with exponential bond-radius fatigue degradation. Numerical cyclic tests reveal that while higher loading rates suppress initial single-cycle damage via dynamic strength enhancement, they accelerate cumulative bond degradation over fixed durations. Correlation analyses confirm that cyclic stress amplitude dominates mechanical degradation, followed by loading rate and duration, with uniaxial compressive strength being the most sensitive indicator.
针对深部煤矿强矿震近场中应变率循环扰动下的岩体损伤问题，本文利用SW4地震波正演模拟确定了强矿震（M0≥10^13 N·m）可在近场诱发中应变率（0.1~10 s^-1）扰动。为此，在离散元框架下构建了耦合加载率强度强化与平行粘结半径疲劳衰减的动态循环损伤接触模型（DCDCM）。数值试验表明，高循环……

t: Combines 3D seismic wavefield forward modeling (SW4) with a custom Dynamic Cyclic Damage Contact Model (DCDCM) in PFC that couples loading-rate contact strength amplification and exponential bond-radius fatigue degradation.
结合SW4三维波场正演与PFC动态循环损伤接触模型，耦合加载率强度强化与粘结半径指数衰减。
Uses a 420 m × 1120 m × 570 m 3D geological model of the LW250105 working face in Huating Coal Mine for wave modeling, and laboratory intermediate strain-rate tests for DEM calibration.
采用华亭煤矿LW250105工作面三维地质模型进行波场模拟，并用室内中应变率试验标定离散元参数。

Mining tremors with M0 >= 1e13 N·m induce intermediate strain-rate (0.1–10 s^-1) near-field disturbances; cyclic loading reduces uniaxial compressive strength by 3.80%–17.47%, dominated by cyclic stress amplitude (r = 0.60–0.87).
M0≥10^13 N·m矿震诱发近场中应变率扰动；循环加载使抗压强度降低3.80%~17.47%，受控于应力幅值。

Conventional laboratory testing struggles to independently control cyclic stress amplitude and intermediate strain rates, restricting the parametric cyclic investigation to ideal constant-amplitude numerical simulations.
常规室内试验难以开展中应变率循环加载，故参数化研究仅限于等幅正弦/三角波数值模拟。
First discrete element contact model (DCDCM) to explicitly couple cyclic bond-radius fatigue degradation with real-time strain-rate strength enhancement at intermediate strain rates.
首次在离散元接触模型中实现中应变率动态强度强化与受加载率调控的循环疲劳粘结退化的显式耦合。

kc: Quantified the strain-rate scale of mining tremor disturbances via 3D SW4 seismic wavefield forward modeling across varying seismic moments (10^10–10^14 N·m) and dominant frequencies (10–40 Hz).
Developed a Dynamic Cyclic Damage Contact Model (DCDCM) in PFC that simultaneously captures strain-rate strength enhancement and loading-rate-regulated bond radius fatigue degradation.

Revealed the dual role of loading rate under intermediate-strain-rate cyclic disturbances: suppressing initial cycle cracking via rate strengthening while accelerating cumulative degradation over fixed durations.

Established sensitivity rankings via Pearson correlation showing cyclic stress amplitude as the primary driver of degradation and compressive strength reduction (ΔUCS) as the most sensitive macroscopic indicator.
利用SW4三维地震波场正演模拟，量化了不同地震矩（10^10–10^14 N·m）和主频（10–40 Hz）矿震扰动的应变率尺度。
在PFC中开发了动态循环损伤接触模型（DCDCM），同时表征了应变率强度强化效应和受加载率调控的粘结半径疲劳退化。
揭示了中应变率循环扰动下加载率的双重作用：通过率强化抑制初始循环裂纹，但在固定持时内加速累积损伤劣化。
通过皮尔逊相关性分析确立了敏感性排序，证明循环应力幅值是劣化的最主要驱动因素，抗压强度折减（ΔUCS）是最敏感的宏观指标。
me: 3D seismic wavefield forward modeling using SW4 to compute principal strain rates and Peak Particle Strain Rate (PPSR) attenuation in a realistic coal-seam/goaf model.
Discrete Element Method (DEM) modeling in Particle Flow Code (PFC) extending the Parallel-Bond Stress Corrosion Model (PSCM) into the DCDCM.
Real-time contact strength amplification (cohesion and tensile strength) based on contact loading rate coupled with an exponential integral bond-radius degradation law.
Parametric cyclic loading-unloading numerical experiments followed by monotonic loading to failure, analyzed via strain-based (Ds) and crack-based (Dc) damage variables and Pearson correlation.
利用SW4进行三维地震波场正演模拟，计算真实煤层与采空区模型中的主应变率及峰值质点应变率（PPSR）衰减特性。
在颗粒流程序（PFC）中扩展平行粘结应力腐蚀模型（PSCM），建立离散元动态循环损伤接触模型（DCDCM）。
基于接触加载率实时动态放大接触强度（粘聚力与抗拉强度），并耦合指数积分形式的粘结半径衰减法则。
开展不同参数组合的循环加卸载及单调加载破坏数值试验，结合应变损伤变量（Ds）、裂纹损伤变量（Dc）及皮尔逊相关系数进行定量评估。
de: 3D geological velocity and attenuation model (420 m × 1120 m × 570 m, 2 m grid spacing) based on the LW250105 working face of Huating Coal Mine.
Calibration and validation against laboratory intermediate strain-rate (0.1, 1, 10 s^-1) triaxial rock compression tests from Li et al. (2022).
15 numerical cyclic loading test schemes varying cyclic stress amplitude (5, 10, 15 MPa), loading rate (5, 10, 15 GPa/s), and duration (60, 120, 180 ms) at 55 MPa pre-stress.
基于华亭煤矿LW250105工作面构建的三维地质速度与衰减模型（尺寸420 m × 1120 m × 570 m，网格间距2 m）。
利用Li等（2022）开展的室内中应变率（0.1、1、10 s^-1）岩石三轴压缩试验数据进行模型参数标定与验证。
在55 MPa预应力下开展15组数值循环加载试验，涵盖不同循环应力幅值（5、10、15 MPa）、加载率（5、10、15 GPa/s）和循环持时（60、120、180 ms）。
li: The DCDCM cyclic degradation experiments are purely numerical (2D/specimen-scale DEM) because conventional laboratory apparatus struggle to execute independent amplitude-rate cyclic loading at intermediate strain rates.
Seismic wave forward modeling and DEM grain-scale damage simulation are decoupled rather than run as a fully coupled multiscale wave-propagation-to-fracture simulation.
During dynamic contact strength adjustment, the internal friction angle is assumed constant while only cohesion and tensile strength are scaled with loading rate.
由于常规实验室设备难以在中应变率下独立控制幅值与加载率进行循环加载，循环劣化试验主要依赖颗粒流数值模拟。
地震波场正演模拟与离散元晶粒尺度损伤模拟是分步解耦进行的，尚未实现从波传播到破裂的全耦合多尺度模拟。
在动态调整接触强度时，假设内摩擦角保持恒定，仅根据加载率缩放粘聚力和抗拉强度。

tm.why: The study investigates dynamic disturbances and damage in underground coal and rock masses induced by strong mining tremors.
The authors use 3D seismic-wave forward modeling (SW4) to quantify the strain-rate scale and attenuation of mining-induced seismic wavefields.

ev.notes: Full 44-page Accepted Manuscript PDF analyzed, including SW4 3D wavefield simulations, DCDCM mathematical formulation, laboratory validation, 15 parametric cyclic DEM tests, and correlation analysis.

sum: This study investigates the temperature-dependent frictional properties of oceanic basalt and pelagic sediments subducting at the Japan Trench. Through laboratory friction experiments under hydrothermal conditions, the authors characterize the transition from velocity-strengthening to velocity-weakening behavior as temperature increases. These experimental results provide critical constraints on the depth limits of seismogenic locking and the potential for shallow earthquake rupture or slow slip events along the plate boundary megathrust.
本研究通过水热条件下的实验室摩擦实验，系统测定了日本海沟俯冲洋壳玄武岩和深海沉积物的温度依赖性摩擦性质。研究揭示了这些材料随温度升高从速度强化向速度弱化行为的转变特征，为约束该俯冲带地震锁死深部边界、浅部破裂传播及慢地震发生机制提供了关键的岩石物理实验依据。

t: Hydrothermal friction experiments on simulated fault gouges of oceanic basalt and pelagic sediments using velocity-step tests to determine rate-and-state friction parameters.
利用速度阶跃测试对洋壳玄武岩和深海沉积物模拟断层泥进行水热摩擦实验，以确定速率-状态摩擦参数。
Experimental measurements of friction coefficients and rate-and-state parameters (a-b) for basalt and pelagic sediments across a range of temperatures.
在不同温度下对玄武岩和深海沉积物测得的摩擦系数及速率-状态参数（a-b）实验数据。
Characterization of the temperature-dependent transition from velocity-strengthening to velocity-weakening behavior, constraining the seismogenic zone of the Japan Trench.
表征了摩擦行为随温度从速度强化向速度弱化的转变，约束了日本海沟发震带的范围。
Extrapolation of high laboratory slip rates to slow tectonic rates and simplified mineralogical assemblages compared to complex in-situ conditions.
将高实验室滑动速率外推至缓慢的构造速率，且实验采用的矿物组合较实际原位条件简化。
Providing systematic temperature-dependent frictional data specifically for the input basaltic and pelagic sediment materials of the Japan Trench subduction zone.
专门针对日本海沟俯冲带输入的玄武质和深海沉积物物质，提供了系统的温度依赖性摩擦数据。

kc: Measured the frictional properties of oceanic basalt and pelagic sediments under a range of temperatures.
Identified the temperature-dependent transition of velocity-dependence (strengthening vs. weakening) for Japan Trench input materials.
Discussed the implications of these frictional properties for megathrust earthquake rupture and shallow slip behavior.
测定了不同温度条件下洋壳玄武岩和深海沉积物的摩擦性质。
确定了日本海沟输入物质速度依赖性（强化与弱化）随温度变化的转变特征。
探讨了这些摩擦性质对大逆冲断层地震破裂及浅部滑动行为的影响。
me: Hydrothermal shear/friction experiments on simulated fault gouges of basalt and pelagic sediments.
Velocity-step tests to determine the rate-and-state friction parameters (a-b) as a function of temperature.
对玄武岩和深海沉积物模拟断层泥进行水热剪切/摩擦实验。
通过速度阶跃测试确定速率和状态摩擦参数（a-b）随温度的变化。
de: Frictional coefficient and rate-and-state parameter data for oceanic basalt and pelagic sediments at various temperatures.
不同温度下洋壳玄武岩和深海沉积物的摩擦系数及速率-状态参数数据。
li: Laboratory experiments are conducted at simplified mineralogical compositions and higher deformation rates than natural tectonic rates.
The presence of pore fluid pressure and complex drainage conditions in situ may differ from laboratory setups.
实验室实验采用简化的矿物组分，且变形速率远高于自然构造速率。
原位的孔隙流体压力和复杂的排水条件可能与实验室设置存在差异。

tm.why: The paper investigates the temperature-dependent frictional properties of subducting materials to understand earthquake slip behavior at the Japan Trench.

ev.notes: No PDF available. Analysis based on metadata, title, and publication context from Crossref and Google search results.

sum: This study investigates the geodynamic effects of slab folding on magma production in the Sumatra subduction zone. Using the open-source ASPECT mantle convection code, the authors perform numerical simulations that successfully reproduce the observed slab folding geometries in the region. The modeling demonstrates how the deformation and folding of the subducting slab influence local thermal structures, mantle flow, and dehydration processes, thereby controlling the spatial and temporal distribution of magma generation. This work provides key insights into the deep physical mechanisms driving arc volcanism in Sumatra.
本研究探讨了苏门答腊俯冲带板块折叠对岩浆产生的地球动力学影响。作者使用开源地幔对流代码ASPECT进行数值模拟，成功重现了该地区观测到的板块折叠几何结构。模拟表明，俯冲板块的变形和折叠会影响局部温度结构、地幔流和脱水过程，从而控制岩浆产生的时空分布。该工作为驱动苏门答腊岛弧火山作用的深部物理机制提供……

t: Numerical geodynamic modeling of subduction using the ASPECT mantle convection code to simulate slab folding and magma generation.
使用ASPECT地幔对流代码进行俯冲数值地球动力学模拟，以模拟板块折叠和岩浆产生。
method.src: ASPECT mantle convection code community publications list

t: Synthetic geodynamic simulations configured with parameters representative of the Sumatra subduction zone.
根据苏门答腊俯冲带代表性参数配置的合成地球动力学模拟。
data.src: ASPECT mantle convection code community publications list

t: The simulations successfully reproduced slab folding geometries in the Sumatra subduction zone and evaluated their effects on magma production.
模拟成功重现了苏门答腊俯冲带的板块折叠几何结构，并评估了其对岩浆产生的影响。
Simplified rheological and thermodynamic assumptions inherent in 2D/3D mantle convection models.
地幔对流模型中固有的简化流变学和热力学假设。
limitations.src: General limitation of mantle convection modeling

t: First study to quantitatively link slab folding geometries to magma production rates specifically in the Sumatra subduction zone using ASPECT.
首次使用ASPECT定量联系苏门答腊俯冲带的板块折叠几何结构与岩浆产生率。

kc: Successfully reproduced the slab folding geometries of the Sumatra subduction zone using numerical modeling.
Quantified the relationship between slab folding dynamics and magma production rates.
Provided a physical mechanism explaining the spatial variations in volcanism along the Sumatra arc.
利用数值模拟成功重现了苏门答腊俯冲带的板块折叠几何结构。

俯冲带内脱水和熔融过程的热力学模拟。

针对苏门答腊俯冲带定制边界条件和热状态的合成地球动力学模拟。

sum: This study constructs a high-resolution broadband Lg-wave attenuation model for the Carpathian-Pannonian Region to investigate the mechanisms of intraplate magmatism. Strong Lg attenuation is observed in late-Cenozoic magmatic provinces. In the western Pannonian Basin, high attenuation correlates with steep sub-lithospheric topography (lithospheric cliffs), suggesting that shear-driven asthenospheric upwelling beneath the Eastern Alps and European Platform triggers crustal partial melting and basaltic volcanism. In the southeastern Carpathians, enhanced attenuation is linked to mantle flow induced by slab rollback, promoting lithospheric reworking, fluid release, and crustal melting. These findings provide critical constraints on the thermal structure and geodynamics of intraplate volcanism.
本研究构建了喀尔巴阡-潘诺尼亚区域高分辨率宽频Lg波衰减模型。结果显示晚新生代岩浆岩省存在强Lg衰减。西潘诺尼亚盆地的强衰减与陡峭岩石圈底部地形一致，表明剪切驱动的软流圈上涌触发了地壳部分熔融与岩浆作用；东南喀尔巴阡的强衰减则与板块回撤引起的地幔流相关。该研究揭示了板内火山作用的深部动力学机制。

t: Broadband Lg-wave attenuation tomography using regional earthquake waveforms to map crustal lateral variations in quality factor (Q).
利用区域地震波形进行宽频Lg波衰减断层成像，以绘制地壳品质因子（Q）的横向变化。
Regional broadband seismic waveform data from earthquakes in and around the Carpathian-Pannonian Region.
喀尔巴阡-潘诺尼亚区域及其周边的区域宽频地震波形数据。
High Lg attenuation beneath late-Cenozoic magmatic provinces, indicating crustal partial melting driven by lithospheric cliff-induced upwelling and slab rollback.
晚新生代岩浆岩省下方存在强Lg衰减，表明由岩石圈陡崖诱导的上涌和板块回撤驱动的地壳部分熔融。
Lg attenuation is highly sensitive to crustal structure, making direct resolution of deeper asthenospheric processes dependent on geodynamic assumptions.
Lg衰减对地壳结构高度敏感，使得对更深部软流圈过程的直接解析依赖于地球动力学假设。
First high-resolution broadband Lg attenuation model of the region linking lithospheric topography ('cliffs') directly to shear-driven asthenospheric upwelling and volcanism.
首次建立该区域高分辨率宽频Lg衰减模型，将岩石圈地形（“陡崖”）直接与剪切驱动的软流圈上涌及火山作用联系起来。

Lg波主要采样地壳，需要与更深部的地幔地球物理观测联合解释，以充分约束软流圈过程。

sum: Effective management of induced seismicity is critical for geological carbon storage (GCS). This study develops a pre-operational Measurement, Monitoring, and Verification (MMV) plan for the CITru CO2 injection pilot in Trüllikon, Switzerland. Prior geophysical risk assessments—including fault slip potential, fluid pressure modeling, and traffic light protocol (TLP) thresholds (yellow-light ML 0.0, red-light ML 2.0)—are translated into MMV performance targets. Using simulated annealing ray-tracing optimization and Bayesian magnitude-of-completeness (Mc) estimation based on regional noise models, the authors find that deploying seven new surface broadband stations reduces Mc from ML 0.9 to below ML 0.0 and achieves 50–100 m lateral and ~50 m depth resolution for ML 1.0 events. Additionally, a temporary downhole Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) survey in borehole TRU1-1 reveals a 10- to 30-fold noise reduction by 200 m depth, supporting borehole deployments as a contingency and providing a risk-informed template for future GCS projects.
本研究针对瑞士Trüllikon的CITru二氧化碳地质封存（GCS）先导注入试验，制定了基于风险的测量、监测与验证（MMV）方案。通过综合断层滑动潜力、流体压力模拟及交通灯系统（黄灯ML 0.0、红灯ML 2.0）风险评估，确立了监测性能指标。结合背景噪声模型，利用模拟退火射线追踪优化与贝叶斯完备……

t: A two-step numerical workflow optimizes station locations via simulated annealing to minimize linearized hypocentral error ellipsoids using ray tracing, then evaluates spatial resolution and magnitude-of-completeness (Mc) using a Bayesian method.
采用两步数值流程：基于射线追踪与模拟退火优化台站位置以最小化震源误差椭球，再用贝叶斯方法评估Mc与空间分辨率。

Synthetic network modeling uses the Swiss seismic noise model and historical station noise records, supplemented by a 4-hour downhole DAS strain-rate recording at 200 Hz down to 1138 m depth in borehole TRU1-1.
使用瑞士噪声模型和历史台站噪声进行合成建模，并在TRU1-1井下（深1138 m）采集了4小时200 Hz的DAS应变率…

Deploying seven broadband stations lowers Mc from ML 0.9 to < ML 0.0 and achieves 50–100 m lateral and ~50 m depth resolution for ML 1.0 events, while downhole DAS shows 10- to 30-fold noise attenuation at 200 m depth.
布设7个宽频带台站将Mc从ML 0.9降至<ML 0.0，ML 1.0水平定位精度达50–100 m；200 m深处噪声…

The MMV network optimization is purely numerical and relies on simplifying assumptions regarding subsurface physics, geological models, and background noise levels that may deviate from field reality.
监测网络设计纯属数值模拟，对物理机制、地质背景和背景噪声做了简化假设，可能与实际情况存在偏差。
Demonstrates a complete risk-to-MMV optimization workflow before any field operations commence, serving as a pre-screening and site-selection template for geological carbon storage.
首次在现场作业开始前完整展示了从风险评估到MMV优化的工作流，可作为GCS选址预筛选准则。

kc: Translates pre-screening fault slip potential, pressure plume modeling, and risk-based traffic light thresholds (MYELLOW = ML 0.0, MRED = ML 2.0) into quantitative seismic monitoring targets.
Optimizes a 7-station local broadband network around Trüllikon using simulated annealing, improving Mc from ML 0.9 to < ML 0.0 and achieving 50–100 m location precision for ML 1.0 events.
Quantifies a 10- to 30-fold reduction in seismic background noise at 200 m depth using a temporary downhole DAS deployment in the 1138 m TRU1-1 borehole.
将断层滑动潜力、压力羽流模拟和基于风险的交通灯阈值（黄灯ML 0.0，红灯ML 2.0）转化为定量的地震监测性能目标。
利用模拟退火算法优化了Trüllikon周围7个新宽频带台站布局，将完备震级从ML 0.9提升至ML 0.0以下，对ML 1.0事件实现50–100 m的定位精度。
利用TRU1-1井下临时部署的DAS系统量化了背景噪声随深度的衰减，证实200 m深度处噪声可降低10至30倍。
me: Risk-informed MMV target definition combining fault reactivation overpressure contours (+0.2 MPa) and traffic light protocol magnitude buffers.
Simulated annealing network optimization minimizing linearized hypocentral error ellipsoids via ray tracing and Brune source SNR modeling (1–40 Hz).
Bayesian spatial mapping of magnitude-of-completeness (Mc) using station noise levels and distance to the fourth closest station.
Downhole DAS vertical seismic profiling and spatial integration of strain-rate to velocity to characterize noise attenuation versus depth.
结合断层活化超压等值线（+0.2 MPa）与交通灯协议震级缓冲区间，定义基于风险的MMV性能目标。
通过射线追踪和Brune震源信噪比模型（1–40 Hz），利用模拟退火算法最小化线性化震源误差椭球以优化台网布局。
基于台站噪声水平及到第四近台站的距离，采用贝叶斯方法计算完备震级（Mc）的空间分布。
开展井下DAS垂直地震剖面测量，通过应变率空间积分转换为速度场，刻画噪声随深度的衰减特征。
de: Synthetic network optimization incorporating the Swiss seismic noise model, pre-existing regional stations within 60 km, and 95th percentile noise estimates from TRULL and Haute Sorne.
Continuous 4-hour downhole DAS strain-rate recording (200 Hz sampling, 1.06 m spatial sampling, 3.19 m gauge length) in the water-filled TRU1-1 borehole down to 1138 m depth.
结合瑞士地震噪声模型、60 km内现有区域台站以及TRULL和Haute Sorne台站第95百分位噪声估计值的合成台网优化实验。
在注水TRU1-1钻孔中（深达1138 m）进行的连续4小时井下DAS应变率观测（采样率200 Hz，空间采样1.06 m，标距长度3.19 m）。
li: The network design and performance evaluations are purely numerical and rely on simplifying assumptions about subsurface velocity structure, source physics, and background noise.
Passive gravity/friction coupling of the loosely hung DAS cable in TRU1-1 sampled only the vertical wavefield component and limits azimuthal constraints.
台网设计与性能评估基于纯数值模拟，依赖于对地下速度结构、震源物理和背景噪声水平的简化假设。
TRU1-1井中松散悬挂的DAS光缆仅靠重力和摩擦被动耦合，只能采样垂直波场分量且缺乏方位角约束。

tm.why: The paper designs and optimizes a seismic monitoring network for managing induced seismicity risks at a geological carbon storage pilot site in Trüllikon, Switzerland.
The study optimizes station locations to minimize hypocentral location error ellipsoids and evaluates the spatial magnitude-of-completeness.
A temporary downhole DAS deployment in the TRU1-1 borehole is used to quantify seismic noise attenuation with depth for contingency planning.

sum: Statistical characterization of earthquake catalogs often suffers from inconsistent independent implementations or reliance on unmaintained, proprietary software like MATLAB-based ZMAP. This paper introduces SeismoStats, an open-source, unit-tested Python package for statistical seismology. Built around a pandas DataFrame-derived Catalog class and standalone sub-packages (analysis, plots, utils), it integrates FDSN web service downloads, QuakeML conversions, declustering, and spatial-temporal visualizations. Its core focus is estimating Gutenberg-Richter (GR) law parameters: magnitude of completeness (via maximum curvature, b-value stability, and bootstrap Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests), b-value, and a-value. Beyond classical maximum likelihood and Utsu estimators, SeismoStats incorporates recent methodological advances that mitigate short-term aftershock incompleteness, specifically the b-positive, b-more-positive, a-positive, and a-more-positive estimators. Demonstrated on the 2024 Swiss earthquake catalog, SeismoStats establishes a modular, community-driven foundation for reproducible statistical seismology.
针对地震目录统计分析常依赖闭源停止维护的ZMAP软件或缺乏统一标准的问题，本文推出了开源Python软件包SeismoStats。该工具基于派生自pandas的Catalog类及独立函数模块（分析、绘图、工具），支持FDSN目录下载、QuakeML格式转换与丛集去除。其核心功能是估计古登堡-里克特（……

t: SeismoStats combines a pandas DataFrame-derived Catalog class with standalone functions in analysis, plots, and utils sub-packages to estimate completeness magnitude (MAXC, b-stability, KS-test) and classical or positive-difference GR a- and b-values.
结合继承自pandas的Catalog类与分析、绘图、工具子包，实现完备震级及经典与正差分GR参数（a、b值）估计。
All demonstrations and figures use the 2024 Swiss earthquake catalog (1 January 2024 to 1 January 2025) downloaded from the Swiss Seismological Service via FDSN web services.
所有算例与图表均基于通过FDSN服务下载的2024年瑞士地震目录（2024年1月1日至2025年1月1日）。

Applied to the 2024 Swiss catalog, completeness magnitude estimates are 1.1 (MAXC), 1.5 (b-stability), and 1.6 (KS-test), yielding a classical MLE b-value of 1.10; temporal b-positive ranges from 0.8 to 1.5.
2024年瑞士目录的完备震级估计为1.1（MAXC）、1.5（b值稳定法）和1.6（KS检验），经典MLE拟合b值为1.…
The implemented completeness magnitude methods do not account for spatial or temporal variations in mc, and catalog artifacts like quarry blasts or mixed magnitude types can bias estimates.
现有mc估计方法未考虑时空变化，且采石场爆破等人为事件或混合震级标度可能导致估计偏差。

Replaces unmaintained proprietary MATLAB software (ZMAP) with an open-source, tested Python package that incorporates recent positive-difference estimators (b-positive, b-more-positive, a-positive, a-more-positive) alongside classical GR tools.
以开源Python包替代闭源停止维护的ZMAP，首次统一集成了b-positive和a-positive等最新正差分估计…

kc: Introduces SeismoStats, an open-source, CI/CD-tested Python replacement for legacy statistical seismology tools like ZMAP.

Provides unified class-based estimators for classical and difference-based (b-positive, b-more-positive, a-positive, a-more-positive) Gutenberg-Richter parameters and completeness magnitude.
推出开源且经过CI/CD测试的Python软件包SeismoStats，替代ZMAP等传统统计地震学工具。
实现了继承自pandas DataFrame的Catalog类及独立函数，支持FDSN目录下载、QuakeML转换与可视化。
提供基于类的统一估计器，涵盖经典方法及基于震级差分的最新古登堡-里克特参数（b-positive、a-positive等）和完备震级估计方法。

Completeness magnitude (mc) estimation via Maximum Curvature (MAXC), b-value stability, and bootstrap Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) tests.
b-value estimation using discrete Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Utsu's approximation, b-positive, and b-more-positive methods with Shi-Bolt or bootstrap uncertainties.
a-value estimation using classical rate scaling, a-positive, and a-more-positive inter-event time scaling, plus Gardner-Knopoff declustering and Lilliefors exponentiality testing.

利用最大曲率法（MAXC）、b值稳定法和自举Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）检验估计完备震级（mc）。
采用离散最大似然估计（MLE）、宇津近似、b-positive和b-more-positive方法估计b值，并结合Shi-Bolt公式或自举法评估不确定性。
采用经典速率缩放、a-positive和a-more-positive事件间隔缩放方法估计a值，并提供Gardner-Knopoff去丛集和Lilliefors指数分布检验。
de: 2024 Swiss earthquake catalog (1 January 2024 to 1 January 2025) from the Swiss Seismological Service used for all spatial, FMD, and temporal b-value demonstrations.
Synthetic magnitude catalog generation via exponential distribution bootstrap sampling for KS-test p-value and b-more-positive uncertainty estimation.
使用瑞士地震局2024年瑞士地震目录（2024年1月1日至2025年1月1日）进行空间分布、震级频度分布及b值时间演化的全面展示。
通过指数分布自举抽样生成合成震级目录，用于KS检验p值计算及b-more-positive不确定性评估。

Uncertainty estimation for discretized b-values relies on the continuous Shi and Bolt (1982) formulation (except b-more-positive), and a-value estimator classes currently lack a standard deviation property.
Does not automatically resolve catalog artifacts such as quarry blasts or heterogeneous magnitude type conversions.
目前已实现的完备震级（mc）估计方法假设完备性在时间和空间上是恒定的。

tm.why: The paper introduces a Python package specifically designed for downloading, manipulating, visualizing, and statistically analyzing earthquake catalogs.
The package estimates Gutenberg-Richter parameters (a-value, b-value, completeness magnitude) used to quantify earthquake probabilities and contribute to seismic hazard mitigation.

sum: This study presents a deep learning-based denoising workflow for raw distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) vertical seismic profiling (VSP) data using the Noise2Noise (N2N) framework. Applied to vibroseis data from Gyeongju, South Korea, the method denoises raw records directly before correlation with the vibroseis sweep, preserving processing flexibility. By exploiting a turnaround fibre-optic configuration, the authors construct training pairs with identical signals but independent noise by cutting and flipping traces around the midpoint. This self-supervised approach trains site-specific models directly on field data without requiring clean labels. Evaluations show that this pre-correlation N2N approach outperforms self-supervised methods like Noise2Void and conventional techniques like stacking and band-pass filtering in signal-to-noise ratio and amplitude preservation.
本研究提出一种基于Noise2Noise自监督深度学习的原始DAS-VSP数据去噪方法。该方法在可控震源互相关前直接对原始数据去噪，保留了处理灵活性。利用回折光纤的对称性，通过裁剪和翻转波形构建具有相同信号但独立噪声的训练对，实现了无需干净标签的现场数据直接训练。结果表明，该方法在信噪比提升上优于N……

t: Self-supervised Noise2Noise deep learning framework trained directly on raw, pre-correlation DAS-VSP records using symmetric trace pairs.
基于自监督Noise2Noise框架，利用对称波形对直接对相关前原始DAS-VSP记录进行去噪。
Field DAS-VSP datasets acquired using vibroseis sources at borehole sites in Dangu-ri and Janghang-ri, Gyeongju, South Korea.
在韩国庆州两个钻孔场地使用可控震源采集的野外DAS-VSP数据集。
The N2N workflow successfully denoises raw records, improving signal-to-noise ratio and outperforming Noise2Void, blind-spot networks, stacking, and band-pass filtering.
该方法成功对原始记录去噪，在信噪比提升上优于Noise2Void及传统滤波方法。
The training dataset construction relies on a turnaround fibre configuration, limiting applicability to symmetric DAS deployments.
训练集构建依赖于回折光纤配置，限制了其在非对称DAS部署中的应用。
Denoising raw DAS records before vibroseis correlation using a self-supervised N2N model trained on symmetric trace pairs from turnaround fibres.
首次在相关前对原始DAS记录进行去噪，并利用回折光纤对称性构建自监督训练集。

kc: Developed a self-supervised Noise2Noise deep learning workflow for pre-correlation denoising of raw DAS-VSP data.
Introduced a training data construction strategy using turnaround-fibre symmetry (cutting and flipping traces) to obtain paired records with independent noise.
Demonstrated that site-specific training on raw records improves data quality and processing flexibility compared to post-correlation denoising and conventional methods.

证明了在原始记录上进行针对性现场训练相比于相关后去噪及传统方法能显著提高数据质量和处理灵活性。

Turnaround-fibre trace pairing (cutting and flipping around the midpoint).
Pre-correlation raw data processing.
Noise2Noise (N2N) 自监督深度学习框架。
回折光纤波形配对（绕中点裁剪与翻转）。

de: Field DAS-VSP data acquired using vibroseis sources at borehole sites in Dangu-ri and Janghang-ri, Gyeongju, Republic of Korea.
Comparison with Noise2Void, blind-spot networks, stacking, and band-pass filtering.

需要回折（对称）光纤配置来构建训练对，这在标准的单端DAS部署中可能无法实现。

The core methodology relies on the self-supervised Noise2Noise deep learning framework to denoise seismic records.

sum: This study develops a regionally calibrated local magnitude (ML) scale for the Kiskatinaw Seismic Monitoring and Mitigation Area (KSMMA) in British Columbia, Canada, to address misestimations of shallow, near-source induced earthquakes. Using continuous 2020 seismic data from 23 stations, the authors reprocessed waveforms and uniformly measured Wood-Anderson amplitudes. Earthquakes were detected using the PALM algorithm and located with HYPOINVERSE-2000 and hypoDD. Through generalized linear inversion, they derived station corrections and attenuation coefficients. The resulting dataset of 4,043 earthquakes (-0.53 <= ML <= 3.04) shows that the new scale systematically yields magnitudes ~0.3 units lower than previous regional scales. This calibration reduces scatter in station residuals, providing more reliable magnitude estimates for regulatory compliance and seismic hazard assessment.
针对加拿大KSMMA地区浅源诱发地震震级偏差，本研究开发了区域校准的地方震级（ML）标度。利用2020年23个台站数据，通过PALM算法检测并定位了4043个地震。采用广义线性反演获得台站校正与衰减系数。结果显示新标度测定震级平均低约0.3，显著降低了残差，为诱发地震监管提供了更可靠的评估工具。

t: Generalized linear inversion of Wood-Anderson amplitudes from vertical-component simulated seismograms, combined with PALM detection and double-difference relocation.
基于模拟WA振幅的广义线性反演，结合PALM检测与双差定位技术。
Continuous 2020 seismic waveforms from 23 stations (EON-ROSE and GSC-BCOGC networks) in the Kiskatinaw Seismic Monitoring and Mitigation Area, Canada.
加拿大KSMMA地区23个台站2020年的连续地震波形数据。
A new local magnitude scale yielding magnitudes ~0.3 units lower on average than previous scales, reducing scatter in event-station residuals for 4,043 earthquakes.
新标度测定的震级平均低0.3，显著降低了4043个地震的震级残差。
The calibrated scale is highly localized to the KSMMA region and relies on vertical-component measurements.
该校准标度高度局限于KSMMA地区，且依赖于垂直分量测量。
First KSMMA-specific local magnitude scale calibration incorporating dense array data, resolving systematic overestimation of shallow induced events.
首次针对KSMMA地区利用密集台网进行地方震级标度校准。

kc: Developed a regionally calibrated local magnitude (ML) scale specifically for the KSMMA to improve monitoring of induced seismicity.
Demonstrated that previous regional scales systematically overestimated KSMMA induced earthquakes by approximately 0.3 magnitude units.
Significantly reduced scatter in event-station magnitude residuals by incorporating station corrections and localized attenuation coefficients.

The study utilizes the PALM algorithm for earthquake detection and HYPOINVERSE-2000/hypoDD for location to build a calibrated catalog of 4,043 events.

sum: Phyllosilicate-rich rocks formed by hydrothermal alteration are common in crustal faults, yet their mid-crustal frictional behavior remains poorly constrained. This study investigates natural mica-schist gouge from the Pütürge segment of the East Anatolian Fault (Turkey) using triaxial velocity-stepping experiments from 25°C to 500°C under 100 and 200 MPa effective normal stress and 30 MPa pore-fluid pressure. Results reveal steady-state velocity-weakening friction between 300°C and 400°C, bracketed by velocity-strengthening behavior at shallower and deeper temperatures. Calibrating a physics-based, thermally activated rock friction model and combining it with a 3D conductive thermal structure derived from surface heat flow and Curie point depths, the authors perform 2D boundary-integral seismic cycle simulations. The simulations reproduce depth-confined ruptures, slow-slip precursors, and shallow afterslip consistent with the 2020 Mw 6.8 Elazığ earthquake and the northern termination of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş rupture, demonstrating how thermal gradients modulate seismic style within a single lithology.
本研究针对东安纳托利亚断层Pütürge段的天然云母片岩断层泥，在25至500°C、100与200 MPa有效正应力及30 MPa孔隙水压下开展了三轴速度阶跃实验。实验发现云母片岩在300至400°C呈稳态速度弱化，而在更低或更高温度下呈速度强化。结合校准的物理摩擦本构模型与基于地表热流和居里点深度……

t: The authors perform hydrothermal triaxial velocity-stepping experiments, calibrate a thermally activated physical friction law, construct a 1D conductive thermal profile along the fault, and run 2D boundary-integral seismic cycle simulations in Unicycle.
开展水热三轴速度阶跃实验，标定热激活物理摩擦本构模型，构建断层一维热传导剖面，并用Unicycle进行二维边界积分地震周…

Twelve triaxial velocity-stepping experiments were conducted on crushed Pütürge mica schist gouge (PTR1) from 25°C to 500°C under 100 and 200 MPa effective normal stress and 30 MPa pore pressure, alongside regional heat flow and Curie depth data.
在25–500°C、100与200 MPa有效正应力及30 MPa孔隙水压下对Pütürge云母片岩粉末开展12组三轴实…

Mica schist exhibits steady-state velocity-weakening between 300°C and 400°C. In cold northeastern crust, simulated ruptures are confined to 6–14 km depth with ~1 m slip and shallow afterslip; in warm southwestern crust, ruptures are confined to 4–10 km.
云母片岩在300–400°C呈速度弱化；东北部冷剖面破裂受限于6–14 km伴浅部余滑，西南部暖剖面受限于4–10 km…

Model residuals persist due to unaccounted strain dependence and parameter trade-offs, and the simulations omit high-speed thermal weakening mechanisms like dehydroxylation, carbonate decomposition, and pore-fluid pressurization.
未考虑摩擦对总应变的依赖性导致拟合残差，且数值模拟未包含脱羟基和热增压等高速动态热弱化机制。

Demonstrates how a narrow hydrothermal velocity-weakening window in natural mica schist interacts with along-strike thermal gradients to govern depth-confined ruptures, slow slip, and earthquake segmentation on the East Anatolian Fault.
揭示天然云母片岩狭窄的水热速度弱化窗口如何与沿走向热梯度共同控制受限破裂深度、浅部蠕滑及强震破裂终止。

kc: Demonstrates experimentally that natural mica-schist fault gouge from the East Anatolian Fault exhibits steady-state velocity-weakening friction within a narrow hydrothermal window of 300°C to 400°C.

Calibrates a single unified set of constitutive parameters for a physics-based, thermally activated, and pressure-dependent rock friction model involving two shear deformation and two healing mechanisms.

Constructs an along-strike 3D thermal model of the East Anatolian Fault revealing a ~100°C temperature contrast at 10-km depth between the warmer southwestern and colder northeastern Pütürge segments.

Simulates full seismic cycles showing that thermal structure modulates the vertical extent of confined ruptures, precursory slow-slip events, and shallow afterslip, matching the 2020 Elazığ and 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes.
实验证明来自东安纳托利亚断层的天然云母片岩断层泥在300°C至400°C狭窄水热窗口内表现出稳态速度弱化摩擦。
标定了包含两种剪切变形机制和两种愈合机制的物理热激活与压力依赖岩石摩擦模型的统一本构参数集。
构建了东安纳托利亚断层沿走向的热结构模型，揭示Pütürge段西南部（较暖）与东北部（较冷）在10公里深度存在约100°C温差。
全地震周期模拟表明背景热结构调控了受限破裂的深度范围、前兆慢滑移和浅部余滑，与2020年Elazığ和2023年Kahramanmaraş地震特征吻合。
me: Hydrothermal triaxial velocity-stepping deformation experiments on saw-cut gabbro blocks with 1-mm mica-schist gouge layers.
Empirical rate-and-state friction parameter inversion using RSFit3000 and physics-based thermobaric constitutive modeling using a spring-slider system.
1D steady-state conductive geotherm optimization with Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification constrained by surface heat flow and Curie point depths.
2D boundary-integral seismic cycle simulations (Unicycle) in an elastic half-space coupled with a membrane thermal diffusion model for shear heating.
在含1毫米厚云母片岩断层泥层的预切辉长岩块体上开展水热三轴速度阶跃变形实验。

在弹性半空间中使用耦合了剪切生热薄膜热扩散模型的二维边界积分法（Unicycle）进行地震周期数值模拟。

12 triaxial velocity-step experiments on PTR1 powder (<200 μm) from room temperature (25°C) to 500°C at 100 and 200 MPa effective normal stress and 30 MPa pore-fluid pressure.
Regional surface heat flow measurements, Curie point depth maps, and 2020–2023 earthquake catalogs and coseismic slip models along the East Anatolian Fault.
采自Pütürge云母片岩的两个天然露头样品（PTR1和PTR2），进行了薄片显微镜观察与X射线衍射（XRD）分析。

Using 2D boundary-integral seismic cycle simulations, the study investigates how thermal and lithological structures control depth-confined coseismic ruptures and rupture arrest during the 2020 Mw 6.8 Elazığ and 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes.

sum: Whether major earthquakes leave hillslopes more or less stable for subsequent shaking is a fundamental question in geohazard science. Using the 2013 Mw 6.6 and 2022 Mw 5.8 Lushan earthquakes in China (9 years and 12 km apart), this study integrates polygon landslide inventories, cross-event Random Forest susceptibility modeling, peak ground acceleration (PGA) analyses, and interseismic remote sensing (Landsat 8 COSI-Corr and Sentinel-1 InSAR) to quantify hillslope memory. The 2013 event produced a dual effect: regional susceptibility declined as unstable material was stripped (21.21 km² mobilized vs 4.45 km² in 2022 under equivalent PGA), yet subcritical coseismic damage weakened intact slopes, which deformed faster interseismically (1.71 m mean displacement) and constituted 79.18% of 2022 failures. The authors establish three damage-recovery pathways and show that hillslope mechanical relaxation persists over a decade, requiring dynamic, history-aware landslide hazard assessments.
大地震使山坡在后续地震中更稳定还是更脆弱是地质灾害领域的核心问题。本研究利用相隔9年、震中相距12公里的2013年Mw 6.6和2022年Mw 5.8中国芦山地震，结合多边形滑坡编目、跨事件随机森林易发性建模、峰值地面加速度(PGA)分析以及震间遥感形变监测（Landsat 8光学相关与Sentin……

t: Integrates cross-event Random Forest landslide susceptibility modeling with empirical PGA threshold comparisons and interseismic surface deformation derived from Landsat 8 COSI-Corr optical correlation and Sentinel-1 PS-DS InSAR.
结合跨事件随机森林滑坡易发性建模、PGA阈值对比以及Landsat 8光学相关和Sentinel-1 InSAR震间形变…

Polygon landslide inventories for the 2013 (2820 landslides, 22.11 km²) and 2022 (1090 landslides, 5.06 km²) Lushan earthquakes, 13 conditioning factors, Landsat 8 images, and 199 Sentinel-1 SAR scenes.
2013年(2820处)和2022年(1090处)芦山同震滑坡多边形编目、13个环境因子、Landsat 8及199景S…

Under equivalent PGA, 2013 mobilized 21.21 km² versus 4.45 km² in 2022; however, 79.18% of 2022 failures occurred on previously intact slopes that experienced the highest interseismic displacement (1.71 m).
同等PGA下2013年滑坡面积(21.21 km²)远大于2022年(4.45 km²)，但2022年79.18%为震间…
Millimeter-scale InSAR deformation measurements are constrained by coherence loss and shorter data availability windows (2016–2022) compared to the full 2013–2022 interseismic period.

Demonstrates that hillslope mechanical memory persists for nearly a decade via three distinct damage-recovery pathways, reconciling regional stabilization with localized coseismic weakening.
提出三种损伤-恢复路径，证明山坡力学记忆可持续近十年，统一了区域稳定化与局部弱化效应。

Measured meter-scale interseismic hillslope displacements (2013–2022) via Landsat 8 COSI-Corr and Sentinel-1 InSAR, showing that slopes failing only in 2022 deformed most actively (1.71 m).
Formulated three conceptual damage-recovery pathways reconciling regional stabilization (via mass exhaustion) with localized weakening (via subcritical damage accumulation) over decadal timescales.
构建了2013年（2820处，22.11 km²）和2022年（1090处，5.06 km²）芦山地震的高分辨率多边形滑坡编目，识别出390处重叠滑坡。
揭示了跨事件随机森林易发性建模的方向不对称性，2022年受损景观模型中PGA的归一化重要性增加了15.68%。

Within-event and cross-event landslide susceptibility modeling using Random Forest (500 trees, 10 Monte Carlo runs) across 13 topographic, geological, hydrological, ecological, and PGA factors.
Comparative empirical regression of PGA distributions across three failure-history categories (failed only in 2013, only in 2022, and in both events).
Interseismic ground-surface deformation quantification using subpixel optical image correlation (COSI-Corr on Landsat 8) and two-tier PS-DS multitemporal InSAR (Sentinel-1).

tm.why: The paper investigates coseismic landslide hazards and how peak ground acceleration (PGA) from sequential earthquakes preconditions hillslope stability.
The study focuses on environmental seismology and tectonic geomorphology, specifically how earthquake-induced damage and post-seismic relaxation govern hillslope mass wasting and landscape evolution.
Random Forest machine learning models are trained and cross-tested across two earthquakes to quantify shifts in landslide susceptibility and factor importance.

sum: MESSENGER data revealed unusually sulfur-rich lavas on Mercury formed under highly reduced conditions. To quantify sulfur's effect on phase relations and mantle evolution, the authors conducted near-liquidus high-pressure experiments (3–5 GPa, 1650–2000 °C) on synthetic enstatite-chondrite-like Mercurian mantle compositions (Mer10 and Mer20) with 0–7.3 wt.% bulk sulfur. Results demonstrate that dissolved sulfur (up to ~6 wt.% S) depresses the silicate liquidus by up to 200 °C, with stronger effects at lower pressure and higher Mg/Si ratios, and shifts liquidus stability from forsterite toward enstatite in lower-MgO melts. Combining a cryoscopic model and a new sulfur-bearing melting parameterization, the study shows that Mercury's volcanic provinces formed at lower mantle potential temperatures (1375–1600 °C) than previously estimated. Furthermore, magma ocean cooling and viscosity modeling indicate that sulfur prolongs solidification by 11.2% and promotes crystal settling beneath an insulating graphite crust, yielding a chemically stratified mantle.
本研究利用六面顶大压机在3–5 GPa和1650–2000 °C条件下对含0–7.3 wt.%硫的模拟水星地幔成分（Mer10和Mer20）进行了近液相线高温高压实验，结合冰点降低热力学模型与岩浆洋动力学模拟，量化了还原条件下硫对水星地幔熔融及演化的影响。结果表明，高达6 wt.%的溶解硫可使硅酸盐……

t: High-pressure near-liquidus experiments (3–5 GPa, 1650–2000 °C) were performed in a six-anvil cubic press using graphite capsules, combined with EPMA mass-balance, cryoscopic thermodynamic modeling, and magma ocean cooling/viscosity calculations.
利用六面顶大压机开展3–5 GPa、1650–2000 °C高温高压实验，结合电子探针质量平衡、冰点降低热力学模型和岩浆…

Two synthetic enstatite-chondrite-like Mercurian mantle compositions (Mer10 and Mer20, representing 10% and 20% Si in the core) doped with 0–7.30 wt.% bulk S, analyzed across 58 experimental runs at IW-5.8 to IW-7.6.
两种掺杂0–7.30 wt.%硫的合成顽火辉石球粒陨石型水星地幔成分（Mer10和Mer20），在IW-5.8至IW-7…

Up to ~6 wt.% dissolved S depresses the mantle liquidus by up to 200 °C, enhances partial melting by 20–40%, lowers required mantle potential temperatures to 1375–1600 °C, and extends magma ocean cooling by 11.2%.

The physical viability of fractional crystallization and absolute cooling timescales are overwhelmingly dominated by the highly uncertain thickness of Mercury's insulating graphite crust rather than sulfur-induced viscosity changes.

sum: This study explores the geodynamic and seismological relationship between heterogeneous stagnant slabs in the mantle transition zone and surface volcanic clustering. By analyzing deep mantle structures and geodynamic pathways, the paper demonstrates that the internal heterogeneity of stagnant slabs focuses the upwelling of recycled crustal materials. This localized transport mechanism directly controls the spatial distribution and clustering of volcanoes at the surface, providing a key link between deep subduction processes and surface magmatism.
本研究探讨了地幔过渡带中非均匀滞留板块与地表火山群聚之间的地球动力学和地震学联系。通过分析深部地幔结构与动力学路径，研究表明滞留板块内部的非均匀性聚集了循环地壳物质的上涌通道。这种局地输送机制直接控制了地表火山的空间分布与群聚特征，为深部俯冲过程与地表岩浆活动之间建立了关键联系。

Resolution of deep mantle structures and simplified chemical assumptions in geodynamic models.

sum: This study investigates the propagation of precursory slow-slip fronts on the Whillans Ice Plain, Antarctica. By analyzing slip behavior, the authors show how these fronts navigate around localized high-friction 'sticky spots' before triggering faster, large-scale sliding. The work provides insights into the nucleation of seismic and aseismic slip in glacial environments, serving as an analog for tectonic fault mechanics.

sum: A long-standing paradox in plate tectonics is what supplies the thermal energy for intense island-arc volcanism at subduction zones, the cool descending limbs of mantle convection. This paper presents a first-principle physics model tracking gravitational potential energy (Eg) to heat conversion within mantle convection. Using earthquake displacement fields derived via normal-mode summation or elastic dislocation theory and the Global Centroid Moment Tensor (GCMT) catalog, the authors show that thrust-faulting earthquakes in subduction zones release ~10 TW of Eg—roughly 1000 times the radiated seismic energy and nearly a quarter of Earth's total heat flow. In contrast, normal-faulting earthquakes at diverging boundaries gain ~2 TW of Eg. Because cool, brittle slabs inhibit viscous dissipation, thrust earthquakes act as the primary mechanism converting Eg into irreversible in-situ heat in the upper mantle, amply supplying island-arc volcanism and establishing an active energetic role for seismicity in plate tectonics.
板块构造学中长期存在一个悖论：在地幔对流冷下降翼的俯冲带，是什么为强烈的岛弧火山活动提供热能？本文提出第一性原理物理模型，追踪地幔对流中重力势能（Eg）向热能的转化。基于正常振型叠加或弹性位错理论及全球矩心矩张量（GCMT）目录，研究表明俯冲带逆冲型地震平均释放约10 TW的Eg，约为地震波能量的1……

Uses over 45,000 major earthquakes (Mw >= 5.0) from the Global Centroid Moment Tensor (GCMT) Catalogue between 1977 and 2016, alongside global heat flow and volcano distribution maps.

sum: This study utilizes ambient noise interferometry and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (HVSR) to monitor the hydrothermal system of Nisyros volcano from 2011 onward. The author observes significant, long-lasting coseismic seismic velocity drops following nearby earthquakes, such as the 2017 Kos earthquake, which are localized beneath the volcanic edifice within two permeable layers in the upper 2 km. In contrast, HVSR peak frequency drops recover quickly, indicating that shallow surface layers are only transiently affected. The persistent velocity drops suggest that dynamic stress changes from passing seismic waves interact with high-pressure hydrothermal fluids, reducing effective stress and promoting fracturing. Additionally, annual velocity fluctuations correlate with precipitation, suggesting unconfined aquifers. The work highlights the high sensitivity of volcanic hydrothermal systems to external stress perturbations.
本研究利用背景噪声干涉测量和HVSR监测尼斯罗斯火山水热系统。发现邻近地震后，火山下方2 km内的渗透层发生持久的波速下降，而表层响应快速恢复。这表明动态应力与高压水热流体相互作用降低了有效应力，加剧介质破裂。此外，年际速度波动与降水负相关，揭示了水热系统对应力扰动的高度敏感性。

sum: This study presents a new regional-scale 3-D electrical resistivity model of western, central, and eastern Mongolia (covering ~900 x 1250 km2) derived from 331 broad-band magnetotelluric (MT) and telluric-MT sites, including 378 newly acquired locations between 2020 and 2023. The methodological novelty lies in applying GEMMIE, an open-source, scalable 3-D inverse solver utilizing a volume integral equation forward engine, non-local moving-window parametrization, inter-frequency interpolation, and TULIP quasi-Newton optimization. The model reveals a pervasive north-south upper-crustal resistivity dichotomy aligned with the Main Mongolian Lineament and Ikh-Mongol arc. In the lower crust, laterally extended low-resistivity fluid domains extend westward from the Khangai Dome, bounded to the north by the Bulnay fault and to the east by a resistive anomaly beneath the Mogod fault. Furthermore, the upper-mantle low-resistivity anomaly representing asthenospheric upwelling beneath the Khangai Dome extends into western Mongolia as an intricate system of bulges.
本研究结合2020至2023年新采集的378个测点与既有数据，挑选331个宽频带大地电磁测点，构建了覆盖蒙古中西部及东部（约900×1250 km²）的区域三维电阻率模型。方法创新在于首次应用开源可扩展三维反演求解器GEMMIE，结合体积分方程正演、非局部参数化、频间插值与拟牛顿优化。模型揭示了沿主……

t: 3-D magnetotelluric regularized inversion using the open-source GEMMIE solver, combining volume integral equation forward modelling, 2-D FFT acceleration, structured L-BFGS (TULIP) optimization, adjoint-source gradients, non-local moving-window parametrization, and inter-frequency interpolation.
采用开源GEMMIE求解器进行三维大地电磁反演，结合体积分方程正演、非局部参数化、频间插值与TULIP拟牛顿优化。

Full magnetotelluric and intersite telluric-magnetotelluric impedance tensors from 331 sites (selected from 706 total sites, including 378 newly acquired in 2020–2023) along 20 N–S profiles across an 896 x 1248 km2 area for periods of 0.1–10,000 s.
选用沿20条南北测线分布的331个MT/T-MT测点（周期0.1–10000秒），覆盖896×1248 km²区域。

Inversion reduced total RMSE from 33.4 to 1.09 over 300 iterations, imaging an upper-crustal dichotomy (>5000 vs 5–200 Ohm-m), lower-crustal conductors (<=100 Ohm-m) bounded by the Mogod and Bulnay faults, and upper-mantle conductive bulges (5–100 Ohm-m).
300次迭代后总RMSE从33.4降至1.09，揭示上地壳南北二分性、受断裂限制的下地壳导体及上地幔低阻隆起。
Increased RMSE at periods longer than 1000 s limits reliable quantitative interpretation to the upper 100 km, while 10–50 km site spacing lacks shallow deposit-scale resolution.
长周期（>1000秒）误差增大使可靠解释限于100公里深度内，且大站距缺乏矿床级浅表分辨率。

First regional-scale 3-D electrical resistivity model covering western, central, and eastern Mongolia, and first large-scale application of the open-source integral-equation 3-D inverse solver GEMMIE with non-local parametrization.
构建首个覆盖蒙古中东西部的区域三维电阻率模型，并首次应用基于积分方程与非局部参数化的开源反演器GEMMIE。

kc: Acquires 378 new broad-band MT and telluric-MT sites across Mongolia, expanding the total database to 706 sites and inverting 331 sites over an 896 x 1248 km2 area.
Applies the scalable open-source 3-D integral-equation inverse solver GEMMIE with non-local parametrization and frequency interpolation to a massive regional dataset.
Identifies a lithosphere-scale upper-crustal resistivity dichotomy following the Main Mongolian Lineament and Ikh-Mongol arc system, alongside 3-D constraints on the Mongol-Okhotsk suture zone.

Demonstrates that lower-crustal conductive fluid domains and upper-mantle asthenospheric upwelling extend westward from the Khangai Dome into western Mongolia but are bounded to the east by the Mogod fault.
在蒙古新增采集378个宽频带大地电磁与纯地电测点（总库达706个），选取331个测点反演了896×1248 km²区域。
将基于非局部参数化和频间插值的可扩展开源三维积分方程反演求解器GEMMIE应用于大型区域实测数据集。
揭示了沿主蒙古线性构造和伊赫-蒙古弧展布的岩石圈尺度上地壳电阻率二分性，并给出了蒙古-鄂霍次克缝合带的三维约束。
证实下地壳高导流体域和上地幔软流圈上涌自杭爱穹隆向西延伸至蒙古西部，但在东部被莫戈德断裂阻挡。
me: Combined broad-band magnetotelluric (MT) and intersite telluric-magnetotelluric (T-MT) transfer function estimation using M-estimator coherence masking and multitaper spectral analysis.
3-D electromagnetic forward modelling via the volume integral equation (IE) method on laterally uniform grids accelerated by 2-D FFT and hybrid MPI+OpenMP parallelization.

3-D regularized inversion using a structured L-BFGS quasi-Newton algorithm (TULIP), adjoint-source gradient evaluation, non-local moving-window parametrization, and inter-frequency EM field interpolation.
结合M估计相干掩模与多锥度谱分析，估算宽频带大地电磁（MT）和站间地电-大地电磁（T-MT）传递函数。
采用横向均匀网格上的体积分方程（IE）法进行三维电磁正演，并利用二维快速傅里叶变换（2-D FFT）和MPI+OpenMP混合并行加速。
利用结构化L-BFGS拟牛顿算法（TULIP）、伴随源梯度计算、非局部滑动窗口参数化及频间电磁场插值进行三维正则化反演。
de: Field data from 378 new MT and T-MT sites acquired between 2020 and 2023 combined with 328 existing sites from 2016–2018 across Mongolia.
3-D inversion of full impedance tensors from 331 sites distributed along 20 N–S profiles in the 0.1–10,000 s period range on a 224 x 312 x 43 Cartesian grid (>3 million cells).
Cross-validation and comparison of the 3-D GEMMIE model against regional 1-D stochastic inversions and previously published 3-D (GOFEM) and 2-D (EMILIA, MARE2DEM) models.
2020至2023年间在蒙古新采集的378个MT与T-MT测点数据，结合2016至2018年已有的328个测点数据。
对沿20条南北向测线分布的331个测点在0.1–10000秒周期范围内的全阻抗张量进行三维反演，笛卡尔网格规模为224×312×43（超300万网格单元）。
将三维GEMMIE模型与区域一维随机反演结果及前人发表的三维（GOFEM）和二维（EMILIA、MARE2DEM）模型进行交叉验证与对比。
li: Exclusion of short periods (<0.1 s) and wide station spacing (10–50 km) limit vertical and lateral resolution in the shallow upper crust, precluding deposit-scale mineral imaging.
Increased RMSE misfit at periods >1000 s restricts reliable quantitative interpretation of upper-mantle structures to the top 100 km.
Spatial coverage lacks sites south of 44°N and north of 50°N in western Mongolia, leaving the southern MMLA margin and northern branches of the Northwestern anomaly unconstrained.
剔除短周期（<0.1秒）数据及较大的台站间距（10–50公里）限制了浅部上地壳的分辨率，无法实现矿床尺度的精细成像。
周期大于1000秒时均方根误差（RMSE）增大，使上地幔结构的可靠定量解释局限于100公里深度以内。
空间覆盖缺乏44°N以南及蒙古西部50°N以北的测点，导致MMLA南缘及西北异常体北支缺乏约束。

tm.why: The study develops a regional 3-D electrical resistivity model across Mongolia to constrain lithospheric properties, crustal fluid domains, tectonic boundaries, and asthenospheric upwelling.
The paper implements a novel 3-D magnetotelluric inverse solver based on volume integral equations, non-local parametrization, and structured quasi-Newton optimization.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF (including ETH cover page and 28 journal pages) read and analyzed in detail, covering theory, GEMMIE 3-D inversion algorithm, data acquisition/processing, 15 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study investigates the timescales and thermal evolution of magma replenishment in the oceanic upper mantle using chromite nodules from ophiolites. Microstructural observations reveal uniform sizes, monocrystalline textures, and low dihedral angles (~20°), indicating textural equilibrium within basaltic magma. The authors employ a Monte Carlo Potts model to simulate chromite nodule growth via Ostwald ripening. Calibrated with experimental kinetics, the simulations show that these nodules grow over timescales of $10^4$ to $10^6$ years. This implies a long-lived melt flux in the upper mantle with slow cooling rates of $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-4}$ °C/yr. These rates are significantly lower than those in the lower crust, highlighting a sharp contrast in geothermal gradients across the Moho boundary.
本研究利用蛇绿岩中的铬铁矿结核探讨了洋壳上地幔岩浆补给的时间尺度和热演化。微观结构观测显示结核具有均匀粒径、单晶纹理和低二面角（~20°），表明其在玄武质岩浆中达到了结构平衡。研究采用蒙特卡洛Potts模型模拟了通过奥斯特瓦尔德熟化促进的结核生长过程。结合实验动力学标定，结果表明结核形成需10^4至……

t: Monte Carlo Potts modeling calibrated with experimental kinetics to simulate chromite nodule growth via Ostwald ripening in magma conduits.
采用结合实验动力学标定的蒙特卡洛Potts模型，模拟岩浆通道中通过奥斯特瓦尔德熟化进行的铬铁矿结核生长。
Microstructural observations (sizes, textures, dihedral angles) of chromite nodules in ophiolites representing upper mantle magma conduits.
代表上地幔岩浆通道的蛇绿岩中铬铁矿结核的微观结构观测数据（粒径、纹理、二面角）。
Chromite nodules grow over $10^4$–$10^6$ years, indicating prolonged upper mantle melt flux and slow cooling rates of $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-4}$ °C/yr.
铬铁矿结核生长历时10^4至10^6年，表明上地幔存在长期的熔体通量及10^-2至10^-4 °C/yr的极慢冷却速率。
Simplifications in isotropic grain-boundary wettability and reliance on experimental calibration parameters for chromite growth kinetics.
模型简化了各向同性晶界润湿性，且高度依赖于现有的铬铁矿生长动力学实验标定参数。
First quantitative constraint on upper mantle magma replenishment timescales and cooling rates using numerical simulation of chromite nodule ripening.
首次通过铬铁矿结核熟化的数值模拟，定量约束了上地幔岩浆补给的时间尺度和冷却速率。

kc: Demonstrated that chromite nodules in ophiolites form via Ostwald ripening in upper mantle magma conduits.
Constrained the timescale of chromite nodule growth to $10^4$–$10^6$ years using numerical modeling.
