Revealed slow cooling rates ($10^{-2}$ to $10^{-4}$ °C/yr) in the oceanic upper mantle, indicating a strong geothermal gradient contrast across the Moho.
证明了蛇绿岩中的铬铁矿结核是通过上地幔岩浆通道中的奥斯特瓦尔德熟化作用形成的。
利用数值模拟将铬铁矿结核的生长寿命约束在10^4至10^6年之间。
揭示了洋壳上地幔中极慢的冷却速率（10^-2至10^-4 °C/yr），表明跨莫霍面存在强烈的地温梯度对比。
me: Microstructural analysis of chromite nodules (size, texture, dihedral angles).
Monte Carlo Potts modeling to simulate grain growth and Ostwald ripening.
Kinetic calibration using experimental data.
铬铁矿结核的微观结构分析（粒径、纹理、二面角）。
利用蒙特卡洛Potts模型模拟晶粒生长和奥斯特瓦尔德熟化过程。
利用实验数据进行动力学标定。
de: Petrological and microstructural observations of chromite nodules from ophiolites.
Numerical simulations of Ostwald ripening using Monte Carlo Potts model.
蛇绿岩中铬铁矿结核的岩石学和微观结构观测。
基于蒙特卡洛Potts模型的奥斯特瓦尔德熟化数值模拟。
li: The model relies on simplified basaltic magma properties and isotropic grain-boundary wettability.
Kinetic calibration depends on the accuracy of existing experimental growth rates of chromite.
模型依赖于简化的玄武质岩浆性质和各向同性的晶界润湿性。
动力学标定取决于现有铬铁矿生长速率实验数据的准确性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the thermal evolution, magma replenishment, and geothermal gradients of the oceanic upper mantle across the Moho boundary.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: Lightguide is a Python-based software package designed for processing and modeling seismic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. It provides essential routines for data handling, including restitution to apparent velocity or integration to linear strain, alongside frequency and frequency-wavenumber (f-k) filtering. For forward modeling, Lightguide integrates with Pyrocko's Green's function framework, enabling full-waveform modeling of dislocation sources to simulate DAS strain-rate or velocity observations in homogeneous and layered half-spaces. This tool bridges the gap between raw DAS measurements and physical source modeling.
Lightguide是用于分布式声学传感（DAS）数据处理与建模的软件工具包。它提供了数据转换（视速度或线性应变）、频率及f-k滤波等常规算法。在正演方面，该工具包基于Pyrocko格林函数框架，实现了均匀和分层半空间中位错源到DAS观测（应变率/速度）的全波形模拟。该工具为DAS数据处理与震源建模……

t: Processing routines including f-k filtering, strain integration, and Pyrocko-based forward modeling of dislocation sources.
包含f-k滤波、应变积分以及基于Pyrocko的位错源正演模拟的处理常规算法。
Synthetic DAS observations (strain-rate and velocity) generated in homogeneous and layered half-spaces.
在均匀和分层半空间中生成的合成DAS观测数据（应变率和速度）。
An open-source Python tool capable of processing raw DAS data and performing full-waveform modeling.
提供了一个能够处理原始DAS数据并进行全波形正演模拟的开源Python工具。
The forward modeling is restricted to homogeneous and layered half-space models.
正演模拟目前仅限于均匀和分层半空间模型。
Integration of DAS-specific data processing (restitution, f-k filtering) with Pyrocko-based full-waveform dislocation source modeling.
将DAS特有的数据处理（恢复、f-k滤波）与基于Pyrocko的全波形位错源模拟相结合。

kc: Developed Lightguide, an open-source software package for DAS data processing and forward modeling.
Implemented routines for converting DAS data to apparent velocity or integrating to linear strain.
Enabled full-waveform modeling of dislocation sources for DAS observations in layered media using Pyrocko GFs.
开发了用于DAS数据处理和正演模拟的开源软件工具包Lightguide。
实现了将DAS数据转换为视速度或积分至线性应变的处理常规算法。
基于Pyrocko格林函数，实现了分层介质中位错源到DAS观测的全波形正演模拟。
me: Frequency and frequency-wavenumber (f-k) filtering for DAS noise reduction.
Data restitution and integration techniques (apparent velocity, linear strain).
Forward modeling of dislocation sources using Pyrocko Green's functions.
用于DAS降噪的频率和频率-波数（f-k）滤波方法。
数据恢复与积分技术（视速度、线性应变）。
基于Pyrocko格林函数的位错源正演模拟方法。
de: Synthetic DAS strain-rate and velocity waveforms simulated in homogeneous and layered half-spaces.
在均匀和分层半空间中模拟的合成DAS应变率和速度波形。
li: Forward modeling is currently limited to homogeneous and layered half-space geometries.
正演模拟目前仅限于均匀和分层半空间几何结构。

tm.why: The paper presents Lightguide, a software package specifically designed for processing, filtering, and forward modeling seismic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the metadata and abstract provided by OpenAlex, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study identifies a new class of monochromatic seismic tremors with a 43 s period in the northern Canadian Arctic using continuous broadband seismic records. Cross-spectral analysis of station pairs reveals that these tremors persist for hours and propagate globally as surface waves. The events occur predominantly during winter, coinciding with 1–4 m thick sea-ice cover. By integrating satellite-derived sea-ice thickness, tremor force spectra, and the dominant period, the authors propose ocean–ice–solid-Earth coupling as the excitation mechanism. This discovery highlights the potential of broadband seismic networks to monitor cryosphere–ocean processes remotely.
本研究利用连续宽频带地震记录，在加拿大北极发现了一种新型43秒周期单频微震。台站对交叉谱分析表明，该微震可持续数小时并作为面波全球传播。微震主要发生在冬季，此时源区覆盖1-4米厚海冰。结合卫星海冰厚度、微震力谱和主周期，研究提出洋-冰-固态地球耦合是其激发机制，展示了地震学监测冰冻圈-海洋过程的潜力……

t: Cross-spectral analysis of continuous broadband seismic station pairs to detect and characterize long-duration monochromatic tremors.
对连续宽频带地震台站对进行交叉谱分析，以检测和表征长持续时间单频微震。
Long-term continuous broadband seismic waveform records from the Canadian Arctic, combined with satellite-derived sea-ice thickness data.
加拿大北极长期连续宽频带地震波形记录，结合卫星反演的海冰厚度数据。
Discovery of a new class of 43 s period monochromatic tremors that propagate globally as surface waves, occurring mainly in winter.
发现新型43秒周期单频微震，主要在冬季发生，并作为面波在全球传播。
The precise localized source location and detailed physical mechanism of the ocean-ice-solid-Earth coupling are not fully resolved.
洋-冰-固态地球耦合的精确局部震源位置和详细物理机制尚未完全解析。
Identification of a previously unrecognized 43 s monochromatic tremor class and linking it to Arctic ocean-ice-solid-Earth coupling.
首次发现43秒单频微震，并将其与北极洋-冰-固态地球耦合机制联系。

kc: Discovered a previously unrecognized class of 43 s period monochromatic tremors in the northern Canadian Arctic.
Demonstrated that these tremors persist for hours and propagate globally as surface waves.
Proposed ocean-ice-solid-Earth coupling as the excitation mechanism, supported by satellite sea-ice thickness and force spectrum analysis.
在加拿大北极北部发现了一种此前未被认识的43秒周期单频微震。
证明了这些微震可持续数小时，并作为面波在全球范围内传播。
结合卫星海冰厚度和力谱分析，提出了洋-冰-固态地球耦合的激发机制。
me: Cross-spectral analysis of continuous broadband seismic station pairs.
Force spectrum analysis of the tremor signals.
Correlation of seismic observations with satellite-derived sea-ice thickness data.
对连续宽频带地震台站对进行交叉谱分析。
对微震信号进行力谱分析。
将地震观测与卫星反演的海冰厚度数据进行相关性分析。
de: Continuous long-term broadband seismic waveform records from the northern Canadian Arctic.
Satellite-derived sea-ice thickness data (1–4 m thickness) around the source area.
来自加拿大北极北部的长期连续宽频带地震波形记录。
源区周围的卫星反演海冰厚度数据（厚度为1-4米）。
li: The precise localized source location and detailed physical mechanism of the ocean-ice-solid-Earth coupling are not fully resolved.
洋-冰-固态地球耦合的精确局部震源位置和详细物理机制尚未完全解析。

tm.why: The paper identifies and characterizes monochromatic tremors in the ice-covered Canadian Arctic, linking them to cryosphere-ocean processes.
The study utilizes continuous seismic waveform records and cross-spectral analysis across station pairs to detect persistent tremors.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from OpenAlex, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study reconstructs the Eocene-to-Pliocene paleo-fluid history of five lithospheric-scale fault zones in the Internal Betics (SE Spain) across major tectonic switches between crustal thickening and extension. The authors combine calcite U/Pb geochronology, C-O-Sr stable and clumped isotopes, fluid inclusion microthermometry, and noble gas (He-Ne-Ar) isotopes in syn-kinematic quartz and calcite. Conventional tracers indicate a shift from warm, deep/brine-derived fluids (~80–140°C in calcite, ~300°C in quartz) during Miocene extension to cool, meteoric-dominated circulation (~20–40°C) during Eocene and Pliocene compression. However, noble gas signatures persistently record minor mantle-sourced helium contributions (3–10%) across both compressional and extensional regimes (~38 Ma, ~6 Ma, and ~2 Ma) along Moho-connected faults, whereas faults disconnected from the Moho show >99% crustal helium. This demonstrates that deep lithospheric fault connectivity can persist regardless of tectonic regime even when conventional geochemical proxies suggest purely shallow circulation.
本研究结合方解石U/Pb定年、碳氧锶同位素、团簇同位素、流体包裹体显微测温及石英和方解石稀有气体（He-Ne-Ar）同位素分析，重建了西班牙东南部内贝蒂克地区五条岩石圈尺度断层从始新世至上新世构造转换期间的古流体演化。常规同位素和温度显示流体从渐新-中新世伸展期的深源高温热液（方解石80–140°C……

t: Combines femtosecond laser-ablation U/Pb calcite dating, C-O-Sr stable and clumped isotope thermometry (Δ47), fluid inclusion microthermometry, and in vacuo crushing noble gas (He-Ne-Ar) mass spectrometry on syn-kinematic fault quartz and calcite.
结合飞秒激光U/Pb方解石定年、C-O-Sr与团簇同位素测温、流体包裹体显微测温及真空压碎稀有气体质谱分析。
31 syn-kinematic fault samples (8 quartz, 23 calcite) and 15 host rocks collected from striated fault planes, veins, and core-zone breccias across five fault systems in the Internal Betics, SE Spain.
采自西班牙东南部内贝蒂克五条主要断层系统的31个同构造石英和方解石样品及15个围岩样品。

Stable isotopes and thermometry show warm deep fluids (~80–140°C in calcite, ~300°C in quartz) during Miocene extension and cool meteoric fluids (~20–40°C) during compression, while noble gases show persistent 3–10% mantle He along Moho-reaching faults.
伸展期为80–300°C深部流体，挤压期为20–40°C大气降水，但连通莫霍面的断层始终保持3–10%地幔氦贡献。

Single-step in vacuo crushing averages all fluid inclusion generations, atmospheric contamination affected most quartz samples (4He/20Ne < 1), and crustal radiogenic 4He addition may partially mask mantle 3He/4He ratios.
单步压碎无法区分包裹体期次，部分石英受大气混染，且地壳放射成因4He可能掩盖原始地幔氦比值。

First multi-proxy reconstruction pairing calcite U/Pb dating and clumped isotopes with noble gases in fault veins across tectonic switches, proving deep mantle connectivity persists even during meteoric-dominated compressional phases.
首次将U/Pb定年、团簇同位素与稀有气体结合，证明挤压期浅表流体主导下深部地幔断层连通性依然存在。

kc: Reconstructed Eocene to Pliocene paleo-fluid history across five major strike-slip fault systems in the Internal Betics using coupled U/Pb dating, clumped/stable isotopes, microthermometry, and He-Ne-Ar noble gases.

Demonstrated that conventional tracers (C-O-Sr isotopes, temperatures) reflect tectonic regime shifts (warm/deep during extension vs. cool/meteoric during compression) but fail to detect persistent deep mantle connectivity.
Revealed persistent minor mantle helium contributions (3–10% SCLM) at ~38 Ma, ~6 Ma, and ~2 Ma in Moho-connected faults (CF, CAFS, AMF) versus >99% radiogenic crustal He in shallower faults (AFZ).
结合U/Pb定年、团簇与稳定同位素、显微测温和He-Ne-Ar稀有气体分析，重建了内贝蒂克五条主要走滑断层始新世至上新世的古流体历史。
证明常规指标（C-O-Sr同位素、温度）虽能反映构造体制转换（伸展期高温深源与挤压期低温大气降水），但无法识别持续存在的深部地幔连通性。
揭示连通莫霍面的断层（CF、CAFS、AMF）在~38 Ma、~6 Ma和~2 Ma均保持3–10%的地幔氦贡献，而未达莫霍面的断层（AFZ）则以地壳放射成因氦（>99%）为主。
me: LA-SF-ICP-MS U/Pb geochronology and 87Sr/86Sr stratigraphy on syn-kinematic fault calcite.
Carbonate δ13C, δ18O, and CO2 clumped isotope thermometry (Δ47) combined with fluid inclusion microthermometry in quartz and calcite.
In vacuo single-step crushing extraction and mass spectrometry of He, Ne, and Ar isotopes from fluid inclusions.
同构造断层方解石的激光剥蚀高分辨电感耦合等离子体质谱（LA-SF-ICP-MS）U/Pb定年与87Sr/86Sr同位素地层学分析。
碳酸盐δ13C、δ18O及CO2团簇同位素测温（Δ47），结合石英和方解石流体包裹体显微测温。
流体包裹体真空单步压碎提取与He、Ne、Ar稀有气体同位素质谱分析。
de: 31 fault-zone mineral samples (8 quartz, 23 calcite) plus 15 host-rock samples from five fault systems in the Internal Betics (CF, PF, AMF, CAFS, AFZ).
Calcite U/Pb ages from 5 samples, clumped isotopes (Δ47) from 9 calcites, microthermometry from 8 quartz and 2 calcites, and noble gas (He-Ne-Ar) data from 6 quartz and 6 calcite samples.
采自内贝蒂克五条断层系统（CF、PF、AMF、CAFS、AFZ）的31个断层带矿物样品（8个石英，23个方解石）及15个围岩样品。
5个样品的方解石U/Pb年龄、9个方解石团簇同位素（Δ47）、8个石英和2个方解石显微测温数据，以及6个石英和6个方解石的He-Ne-Ar稀有气体数据。
li: Single-step in vacuo crushing cannot distinguish between multiple fluid inclusion generations, yielding an average noble gas signal.
Significant atmospheric contamination and potential post-entrapment helium leakage affected 5 of 12 crushed samples (mostly quartz with 4He/20Ne < 1).
Radiogenic 4He addition from crustal U/Th decay or host-mineral diffusion may dilute mantle 3He, making measured R/Ra values minimum estimates.
单步真空压碎法无法区分不同期次的流体包裹体，所得稀有气体组成为平均信号。
12个压碎样品中有5个（主要是4He/20Ne < 1的石英）受到显著大气混染及捕获后氦泄漏的影响。
地壳U/Th衰变或寄主矿物扩散加入的放射成因4He可能稀释地幔3He信号，使实测R/Ra成为最低估计值。

tm.why: The paper investigates lithospheric-scale fault connectivity to the Moho and mantle fluid degassing across major geodynamic switches (shortening to slab-retreat extension to inversion) in the Internal Betics.
It examines fault zone permeability, fluid circulation pathways, and syn-kinematic vein precipitation across five major active strike-slip fault systems in SE Spain.

ev.notes: Full 36-page preprint PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), and all 10 figures.

sum: Deep learning models in seismic processing are highly sensitive to out-of-distribution (OOD) field noise. This study evaluates how input noise type, scale, and complexity impact the performance and robustness of three architectures (U-Net, Swin-Unet, and Restormer) on two geophysical tasks: first-break picking and denoising. Using synthetic seismic-while-drilling (SWD) data and a stochastic noise generator, the authors construct robustness matrices across seen and unseen single and compound noise scenarios. Results show that noise scale shifts learning trajectories and boosts generalization up to intermediate levels, while noise type controls convergence steepness. Random and colored noises yield the most transferable features, whereas structured noises fail to generalize well. Crucially, the authors introduce a compound noise training strategy that combines multiple additive noises and data manipulations, acting as an implicit regularizer that reduces test performance variance by 72.8% and boosts mean OOD performance by 21% over single-noise baselines.
地震处理中的深度学习模型对分布外（OOD）噪声高度敏感。本研究利用合成随钻地震（SWD）数据和随机噪声生成器，评估了噪声类型、尺度和复杂度对U-Net、Swin-Unet和Restormer在初至拾取和去噪任务中泛化与鲁棒性的影响。研究表明，中等噪声尺度能提升泛化能力，随机和有色噪声产生的特征最具可……

t: Three encoder-decoder networks (U-Net, Swin-U, Restormer) are trained on synthetic seismic data augmented by a stochastic generator producing single and compound noises at fixed scales, then evaluated across seen and unseen noise profiles.
使用随机噪声生成器生成固定尺度的单一和复合噪声，训练U-Net、Swin-U和Restormer并评估其跨噪声泛化性能。
2,121 synthetic 2D walkaway Seismic-While-Drilling shot gathers simulated using finite-difference acoustic wave modeling with 160 surface receivers (25–2,000 m offset) and a 35 Hz Ricker wavelet.
采用声波有限差分模拟生成的2,121个2D随钻地震（SWD）合成道集（160道，35Hz雷克子波）。

Intermediate noise scale (beta=0.25) improves OOD performance by 25% over clean/low-noise baselines, while compound noise training reduces test variance by 72.8% and boosts mean OOD performance by 21% over single-noise baselines.
复合噪声训练使跨测试条件的性能方差平均降低72.8%，平均OOD性能比单一噪声基线提高21%。

Poorly composed or unbalanced noise mixtures deviate from linear ID-OOD trends, and further theoretical work is required to explain the mechanisms driving the observed compound-noise robustness gains.
不平衡的噪声混合会偏离线性趋势，且仍需进一步理论工作来解释复合噪声提升鲁棒性的内在机制。

Isolates input-source noise parameters (type, scale, complexity) in segmentation and denoising tasks, introducing a compound noise training strategy that mitigates architecture-noise mismatches and improves OOD robustness.
在分割和去噪任务中独立分析了输入噪声参数，提出了缓解架构与噪声失配的复合噪声训练策略。

kc: Developed a stochastic noise generator capable of producing controllable single and compound noise mixtures (random, spectral, spatially structured, and trace/frequency manipulations) for synthetic seismic data.
Systematically quantified in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness across U-Net, Swin-U, and Restormer for first-break picking and denoising.
Demonstrated that compound noise training acts as an implicit ensemble/regularizer, increasing mean OOD performance by 21% and reducing variance across test conditions by 72.8%.
开发了随机噪声生成器，能够为合成地震数据生成可控的单一和复合噪声混合（随机、频谱、空间结构化噪声以及道/频率操作）。
系统量化了U-Net、Swin-U和Restormer在初至拾取和去噪任务中的分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）鲁棒性。
证明了复合噪声训练可作为隐式集成/正则化器，使平均OOD性能提高21%，测试条件下的性能方差降低72.8%。
me: Stochastic noise generation combining data manipulation models (high/low-pass filters, trace masking) and additive noise models (Gaussian, f-k Gaussian, colored, bandpassed, linear, hyperbolic) scaled by parameter beta.
Supervised evaluation of three encoder-decoder architectures (U-Net, Swin-Unet, Restormer) standardized to ~7M parameters.
Robustness matrix evaluation mapping model performance across seen (ID) and unseen (OOD) noise types, complexities, and amplitude scales.
结合数据操作模型（高/低通滤波、道掩码）与加性噪声模型（高斯、f-k高斯、有色、带通、线性、双曲）的随机噪声生成，并由参数β控制尺度。
对参数量标准化为约700万的三种编码器-解码器架构（U-Net、Swin-Unet、Restormer）进行监督学习评估。
构建鲁棒性矩阵，评估模型在已知（ID）和未知（OOD）噪声类型、复杂度和振幅尺度下的泛化表现。
de: 2,121 synthetic 2D walkaway Seismic-While-Drilling (SWD) shot gathers simulated via acoustic finite-difference modeling (35 Hz Ricker wavelet, 160 receivers, offsets 25–2,000 m).
First-break picking framed as binary segmentation (BCE loss, mIoU metric) and denoising framed as regression (MSE loss, RMSE metric) across 80/10/10% train/val/test splits.
通过声波有限差分模拟生成的2,121个合成2D随钻地震（SWD）道集（35 Hz雷克子波，160个接收器，偏移距25–2,000米）。
按80/10/10%划分训练/验证/测试集，将初至拾取作为二元分割任务（BCE损失，mIoU指标），去噪作为回归任务（MSE损失，RMSE指标）进行实验。
li: Experiments are conducted entirely on synthetic 2D acoustic SWD data rather than real field recordings.
High-amplitude noise training can degrade clean-data fidelity and trigger architecture-specific failure modes.
Further theoretical work is needed to rigorously explain the underlying mathematical mechanisms driving the observed compound-noise robustness gains.
实验完全基于合成的2D声波SWD数据，而非真实野外记录。
高振幅噪声训练可能会降低干净数据的保真度，并触发特定于架构的失效模式。
仍需进一步的理论工作来严格解释驱动复合噪声鲁棒性提升的潜在数学机制。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates how input noise parameters affect the training, generalization, and out-of-distribution robustness of deep learning architectures (U-Net, Swin-Unet, Restormer) for seismic denoising and first-break picking.
One of the two primary tasks evaluated in the paper is automated P-wave arrival (first-break) picking on seismic gathers.

ev.notes: Full 31-page PDF from JGR: Machine Learning and Computation was analyzed, including all methodology equations, architectural configurations, robustness matrices, and quantitative conclusions.

sum: This study characterizes a previously unreported axial oscillation mode between Earth's mantle, fluid core, and solid inner core: the core-mantle gravitational (CMG) mode. When the core's internal magnetic field is strong enough that Alfvén wave propagation is faster than the oscillation period, the fluid outside the tangent cylinder (TC) rotates quasi-rigidly. Angular momentum exchanges between the outer fluid core and mantle via a three-step process: magnetic torque across the TC, electromagnetic coupling at the inner core boundary, and gravitational torque between the inner core and mantle. Using analytical derivations and a 1D numerical eigenvalue model of magnetically coupled cylinders, the author evaluates the CMG mode period and quality factor Q. For Earth, the period is 40–100 years, but realistic mantle conductance and inner core viscous relaxation (tau_i < 10 years) reduce Q to near or below 1, permitting only modest resonant amplification of multi-decadal length-of-day variations.
本研究揭示了一种此前未报道的地球地幔、外核和内核之间的轴向振荡模式——核幔引力（CMG）模式。当核内磁场足够强使阿尔芬波传播快于振荡周期时，切圆柱体（TC）外的流体准刚性旋转，并通过TC磁力矩、内核边界电磁耦合及内核-地幔引力矩三步过程与地幔交换角动量。作者结合理论推导与一维磁耦合圆柱数值本征值模型……

t: The author formulates a 1D coupled angular momentum and induction system for the mantle, inner core, and cylindrical fluid shells, solving for complex free-mode frequencies as an eigenvalue problem alongside analytical asymptotic approximations.
建立地幔、内核和流体圆柱壳的一维耦合角动量与感应方程，通过本征值问题与解析近似求解复频率。

The study uses synthetic numerical calculations parameterized with Earth-like physical constants (Table 1), varying gravitational coupling strength, inner core viscous relaxation time, mantle conductance, and ICB dipole field strength.
采用类地物理参数进行数值计算，改变引力耦合强度、内核粘性弛豫时间、地幔电导和内核边界偶极场。

For Earth-like magnetic field (~3 mT) and gravitational torque ([0.3-2] x 10^20 N m), the CMG mode period is 40-100 years, while CMB electromagnetic damping and inner core viscosity reduce Q to near or below 1.
在地球约3 mT磁场和估计引力矩下，CMG模式周期为40-100年，电磁阻尼和内核粘性使Q接近或低于1。
The model assumes axially invariant fluid core flows and omits Magnetic-Coriolis (MC) modes and core-top stratification (MAC modes) that may alter multidecadal oscillation dynamics.
假设流体核流动轴向不变，忽略了可能改变数十年振荡动力学的磁-科里奥利模式和核顶分层效应。

First identification and characterization of the global core-mantle gravitational (CMG) oscillation mode in a strong core magnetic field regime involving quasi-rigid oscillation of the entire fluid core.
首次发现并表征了强磁场下涉及整个流体核准刚性振荡的全球核幔引力（CMG）振荡模式。

kc: Identifies and characterizes the core-mantle gravitational (CMG) axial oscillation mode involving the whole core in a strong magnetic field regime.
Derives analytical expressions for the mode frequency, decay rate, and quality factor Q in two end-member limits: the rigid core regime and the locked inner core regime.
Quantifies the period (40–100 years) and strong attenuation (Q near or below 1) for realistic Earth parameters, assessing its role in multi-decadal length-of-day fluctuations.
识别并表征了强磁场机制下涉及整个地核的核幔引力（CMG）轴向振荡模式。
推导了刚性核和锁定内核两种端元机制下模式频率、衰减率和品质因子Q的解析表达式。
量化了真实地球参数下该模式的周期（40–100年）与强衰减特性（Q接近或小于1），评估了其在数十年日长变化中的作用。
me: Analytical derivation of coupled angular momentum equations for the mantle, inner core, and fluid core regions inside and outside the tangent cylinder.
Numerical eigenvalue computation of normal modes using a reduced 1D model of magnetically coupled coaxial cylinders with iterative magnetic skin-depth updates.
建立并解析推导地幔、内核以及切圆柱体内外流体核区域的耦合角动量方程。
利用磁耦合共轴圆柱简化一维模型和磁趋肤深度迭代更新方法，数值求解简正模本征值问题。
de: Numerical normal-mode experiments across varying gravitational coupling strengths (10^18 to 10^23 N m), inner core viscous relaxation times (10 to 1000 yr), and mantle conductances.
Benchmark comparisons of 1D torsional oscillation (TO) modes against published 2D full-sphere and spherical-shell magnetohydrodynamic models.
在不同引力耦合强度（10^18至10^23 N m）、内核粘性弛豫时间（10至1000年）和地幔电导下开展数值简正模实验。
将一维扭转振荡（TO）模式计算结果与已发表的二维全利用球体和球壳磁流体动力学模型进行基准对比。
li: Assumes axially invariant geostrophic cylinder flow in the fluid core, neglecting potential modifications from axisymmetric Magnetic-Coriolis (MC) modes.
Does not include core top stratification and potential interactions with Magnetic-Archimedean-Coriolis (MAC) modes at multi-decadal periods.
The reduced 1D model underestimates magnetic diffusion near the core-mantle boundary compared to 2D models.
假设流体核中为轴向不变的地转圆柱流，忽略了轴对称磁-科里奥利（MC）模式的潜在影响。
未考虑外核顶部分层结构及其在数十年周期上与磁-阿基米德-科里奥利（MAC）模式的潜在相互作用。
与二维模型相比，简化的一维模型低估了核幔边界附近的磁扩散效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates a coupled axial gravitational and electromagnetic rotational oscillation mode between the Earth's mantle, fluid core, and inner core, relevant to deep Earth geodynamics and length-of-day variations.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF including equations, 5 main figures, 1 main table, and Appendix A (1 table, 1 figure) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw 5.4 Xinlong earthquake in the eastern Tibetan Plateau using Sentinel-1 C-band and HT-2 X-band InSAR, Gaofen-2/7 optical imagery, UAV photogrammetry, field mapping, and teleseismic waveform/depth-phase analyses. InSAR reveals up to ~7 cm of line-of-sight coseismic deformation and ~3–4 cm step-like displacement discontinuities coinciding with a 4–5 km linear coherence-loss zone. Finite-fault geodetic inversion indicates predominantly normal faulting on a ~45° north-dipping structure, with slip concentrated at 1.4–5.7 km depth (peak slip 0.33 m at 3.4 km), consistent with teleseismic centroid depths of ~5–7 km. This is the first earthquake application of commercial HT-2 X-band SAR data and demonstrates that moderate normal-faulting earthquakes can generate measurable near-surface deformation, highlighting active localized extension accommodated by unmapped secondary normal faults within the predominantly strike-slip Sichuan–Yunnan block.
本研究综合利用Sentinel-1与HT-2雷达干涉测量（InSAR）、高分二号/七号光学影像、无人机摄影测量、野外调查及远震波形反演，研究了2025年藏东新龙Mw 5.4地震。InSAR观测到最大约7 cm的同震视线向形变及3–4 cm的局部地表位移间断。大地测量有限断层反演表明，破裂以正断层滑动……

t: The authors combine D-InSAR, pixel offset tracking, coherence analysis, optical image fusion, UAV photogrammetry, bounded least-squares finite-fault slip inversion on triangular elements, and teleseismic waveform and array depth-phase modeling.
结合D-InSAR、像素偏移追踪、相干性分析、光学融合、无人机航测、三角网格有限断层反演及远震波形与深度震相建模。

Data include Sentinel-1 C-band (T033D, T099A) and HT-2 X-band (T009D) SAR, Gaofen-2/7 optical imagery, 10-cm UAV photogrammetry over 0.35 km², field mapping, and teleseismic waveforms and small-aperture array recordings.
采用Sentinel-1和HT-2 SAR、高分二/七号光学影像、0.35 km²无人机10 cm航测、野外调查及远震台…
InSAR reveals up to ~7 cm LOS displacement and ~3–4 cm surface offsets across a 4–5 km zone. Geodetic inversion shows 45° dipping normal slip at 1.4–5.7 km depth (peak 0.33 m at 3.4 km).
InSAR揭示最大7 cm视线向位移及3–4 cm断层阶跃；反演显示45°倾角正断层滑动集中于1.4–5.7 km（峰值…
Regularized elastic slip modeling smooths localized near-surface deformation and fails to resolve surface-reaching slip, while freeze–thaw and snowfall rapidly degrade subtle field features.
正则化弹性模型平滑了近地表形变，且高寒冻融与降雪迅速掩盖了微弱地表破裂特征。

First earthquake application of HT-2 X-band SAR imagery, documenting rare near-surface rupture deformation from a moderate (Mw 5.4) normal-faulting event on a previously unmapped fault in eastern Tibet.
首次将HT-2 X波段SAR应用于地震，揭示藏东未测绘次级正断层上Mw 5.4地震的浅表破裂。

kc: Documented up to ~7 cm coseismic LOS deformation and ~3–4 cm localized surface displacement discontinuities for the 2025 Mw 5.4 Xinlong earthquake.
Conducted the first earthquake application of high-resolution commercial HT-2 X-band stripmap SAR imagery alongside Sentinel-1 C-band data.
Constrained coseismic slip to shallow depths of 1.4–5.7 km (peak slip 0.33 m at 3.4 km) via geodetic inversion, supported by teleseismic depth-phase and waveform modeling (~5–7 km).
Identified a previously unmapped ENE–WSW-trending secondary normal fault accommodating localized extension within the strike-slip dominated Sichuan–Yunnan block.
记录了2025年新龙Mw 5.4地震高达约7 cm的同震视线向形变及约3–4 cm的局部地表位移不连续。
首次将高分辨率商业HT-2 X波段条带模式SAR影像与Sentinel-1 C波段数据联合应用于地震研究。
通过大地测量反演将同震滑动约束在1.4–5.7 km浅部（3.4 km深处峰值滑动0.33 m），并得到远震深度震相和波形模拟（约5–7 km）的证实。
识别出一条此前未测绘的ENE–WSW向次级正断层，揭示了以走滑为主的川滇块体内部的局部伸展变形。
me: Differential InSAR, pixel offset tracking (POT), normalized phase gradient, and interferometric coherence analysis using GAMMA and GACOS atmospheric corrections.
Gram–Schmidt pan-sharpening of pre-event Gaofen-2 and post-event Gaofen-7 optical satellite imagery, coupled with DJI Mavic 3 Pro UAV photogrammetry and field mapping.
Bounded least-squares finite-fault slip inversion on a two-segment triangular mesh using the Earthquake Cycle Analyses Toolkits (ECAT).
Joint teleseismic moment-tensor and location inversion alongside high-frequency small-aperture seismic array beamforming for depth phases (pP, sP).
利用GAMMA软件和GACOS大气校正进行差分InSAR、像素偏移量追踪（POT）、归一化相位梯度及干涉相干性分析。
对震前高分二号和震后高分七号光学卫星影像进行Gram–Schmidt全色锐化融合，并结合大疆Mavic 3 Pro无人机摄影测量与野外地质调查。
使用地震周期分析工具包（ECAT）在双段三角形网格上进行有界最小二乘有限断层滑动反演。
联合远震矩张量与位置反演，并利用高频小孔径地震台阵波束形成技术识别深度震相（pP、sP）。
de: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR (tracks T033D, T099A) and commercial HT-2 X-band stripmap SAR (track T009D, 2 m resolution).
Pre-earthquake Gaofen-2 (0.8 m panchromatic) and post-earthquake Gaofen-7 (0.6 m panchromatic) optical satellite imagery.
UAV photogrammetry (~10 cm resolution over ~0.35 km² along a ~1.3 km fault trace) and November 2025 field investigation records.
Teleseismic broadband waveforms and high-frequency recordings from four small-aperture seismic arrays (Warramunga, Yellowknife, Alice Springs, Beaver Creek).
Sentinel-1 C波段SAR数据（T033D和T099A轨道）与商业HT-2 X波段条带模式SAR数据（T009D轨道，2米分辨率）。
震前高分二号（0.8米全色）与震后高分七号（0.6米全色）高分辨率光学卫星影像。
沿约1.3 km断层迹线覆盖约0.35 km²的无人机摄影测量数据（约10 cm分辨率）及2025年11月野外考察记录。
远震宽频带波形以及四个小孔径地震台阵（Warramunga、Yellowknife、Alice Springs、Beaver Creek）的高频记录。
li: The regularized elastic finite-fault slip model smooths highly localized near-surface deformation and does not resolve significant slip directly reaching the ground surface.
High elevation, seasonal snowfall, freeze–thaw cycles, and hydrological processes rapidly degrade centimeter-scale surface features prior to field surveys conducted weeks later.
Range-offset tracking on HT-2 imagery has an uncertainty of ~3 cm, limiting its ability to resolve small-amplitude localized features.
正则化弹性有限断层滑动模型平滑了高度局部的近地表形变，未能解析出直接到达地表的显著滑动。
高海拔、季节性降雪、冻融循环及水文过程在震后数周开展野外调查前迅速改造或掩盖了厘米级地表形变特征。
HT-2影像的距离向偏移量追踪具有约3 cm的不确定性，限制了其解析小振幅局部特征的能力。

tm.why: The paper characterizes the coseismic slip distribution, centroid depth, and near-surface rupture expressions of the 2025 Mw 5.4 Xinlong earthquake.
The findings reveal localized extensional deformation accommodated by a previously unmapped secondary normal fault within the strike-slip dominated Sichuan–Yunnan block.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete accepted manuscript PDF (pages 1–33) and attached Supplementary Material (pages 34–49).

sum: The processes controlling the explosive sequence of the 2022 Hunga submarine volcano eruption remain poorly understood. Here, the authors perform a continuous frequency-domain composite source inversion (six moment-tensor and three single-force components) of teleseismic P waves (10–70 s) from 23 global stations over the first 300 s, validated by group-sparse post-processing and near-field tsunami modeling. They resolve four implosion–explosion episodes (peak Mw ~6.5, upward force Fr ~10^14 N) separated by a 160-s pause. During the pause, volumetric and vertical-force radiation decayed while ring-fault shear deformation (deviatoric energy fraction ~0.7) persisted. This reveals an explosive engine driven by a hydraulically sealed, conduit-scale volume (10^7–10^8 m^3, orders of magnitude smaller than the 27 km^3 reservoir) that re-pressurized to an ~8 MPa failure threshold via seawater-driven phreatomagmatic inflow, establishing a quantitative benchmark linking eruption recurrence timescales to driving system volume.
针对2022年汤加洪阿海底火山喷发序列的控制机制，本文利用全球23个台站的远震P波数据（10–70 s），开展了包含6个矩张量分量和3个单力分量的连续频域复合震源反演，并结合群稀疏后处理与近场海啸模拟进行验证。研究在前300秒内解析出4个内爆-爆炸周期（峰值Mw ~6.5，向上垂直单力~10^14……

t: Continuous frequency-domain composite source inversion simultaneously solving for six moment-tensor and three single-force time histories from teleseismic P waves (10–70 s), validated via group-sparse lasso post-processing and resolution analysis.
利用远震P波开展连续频域复合震源反演，同时求解6个矩张量和3个单力分量，结合群稀疏与分辨率分析。

Teleseismic broadband P-wave velocity records (10–70 s passband, 450 s duration, 50°–90° epicentral distance) from 23 globally distributed channels, supplemented by Nuku'alofa tide-gauge tsunami observations.
全球23个台站通道（震中距50°–90°）10–70秒频段远震宽频带P波记录及近场验潮仪海啸数据。

Resolved four implosion–explosion episodes (peak Mw ~6.5, upward force Fr ~10^14 N) separated by a 160-s shear-dominated recharge interval (f_dev ~0.7), constraining failure overpressure to ~8 MPa and sealed conduit volume to 10^7–10^8 m^3.
解析出4个内爆-爆炸周期（Mw~6.5，Fr~10^14 N）及160秒剪切主导间歇期，约束破裂超压~8 MPa、密封体…
Teleseismic data have limited depth resolution, cannot distinguish single versus multiple closely spaced conduits, and cannot discriminate between tensile roof failure and frictional plug slip.
远震数据深度分辨率有限，无法区分单/多紧密通道，也无法区分张性破裂与塞体摩擦滑动。

First continuous, unconstrained composite source reconstruction of the Hunga eruption cycle, demonstrating that a sealed conduit-scale volume re-pressurized by phreatomagmatic inflow controls rapid explosive recurrence.
首次无约束连续重建洪阿喷发复合震源演化，证实水汽流入驱动的通道尺度密封体控制了快速爆炸循环。

kc: Reconstructed the continuous 9-component composite source history (moment tensor + single force) of the first 300 s of the 2022 Hunga eruption without sign or impulse constraints.
Resolved four discrete implosion-explosion cycles separated by a 160-s recharge interval where volumetric and vertical forces decayed but shear deformation persisted.

Demonstrated via mechanical scaling that the rapid 160-s cycle is governed by a sealed conduit-scale volume (10^7–10^8 m^3) re-pressurized to ~8 MPa by phreatomagmatic inflow, distinct from reservoir-scale dynamics like Kilauea.
在无符号或脉冲先验约束下，重建了2022年洪阿火山喷发前300秒的连续9分量复合震源时间函数（矩张量+单力）。
解析出4个离散的内爆-爆炸循环及中间160秒的充能间歇期，发现间歇期内体积与垂直力分量衰减但剪切变形持续。
通过力学标度律证明160秒快速循环受控于密封通道尺度体积（10^7–10^8 m^3）在岩浆水汽流入下再增压至~8 MPa的过程，完全不同于基拉韦厄等岩浆房尺度动力学。
me: Unconstrained frequency-domain least-squares composite source inversion solving simultaneously for 6 moment-tensor and 3 single-force time histories in the 10–70 s band using Instaseis (PREM) Green's functions.
Group-sparse post-processing (group lasso via FISTA with Tikhonov refitting and leave-one-out tests) and resolution matrix cross-talk analysis to verify active episodes and MT-SF separability.
Hilbert-envelope BIC model selection for quiet-period decay, plug frictional force-balance scaling, and nonlinear Boussinesq tsunami modeling (JAGURS).
基于Instaseis（PREM模型）格林函数，在10–70秒频段内开展无约束频域最小二乘复合震源反演，同时求解6个矩张量和3个单力时间函数。
采用群稀疏后处理（基于FISTA的Group Lasso、Tikhonov重拟合与留一法检验）及分辨率矩阵串扰分析，验证活跃时段及矩张量与单力的可分离性。
结合希尔伯特包络BIC模型选择开展平静期衰减分析、通道塞摩擦力学平衡标度分析，以及非线性Boussinesq海啸数值模拟（JAGURS）。
de: Teleseismic broadband P-wave velocity records (10–70 s period, 450 s window, epicentral distance 50°–90°, SNR >= 10) across 23 globally distributed FDSN channels (22 vertical, 1 north-south).
Near-field tide-gauge record at Queen Salote Wharf, Nuku'alofa, Tonga, and high-resolution merged topo-bathymetric grids (Tongatapu, Hunga DEM, GEBCO_2026).
Three synthetic recovery tests with realistic pre-event noise, bootstrap resampling (1000 realizations), and 20 trial source depths (0.5–10 km).
全球分布的23个FDSN台站通道（22个垂直分量，1个南北分量）的远震宽频带P波速度记录（10–70秒周期，450秒时窗，震中距50°–90°，信噪比>=10）。
汤加努库阿洛法Queen Salote码头近场验潮仪记录及高分辨率融合地形-水深网格数据（Tongatapu、Hunga DEM、GEBCO_2026）。
包含真实震前噪声水平的3组合成恢复测试、1000次自助法（Bootstrap）重采样测试以及0.5–10 km共20个测试震源深度的敏感性实验。
li: Teleseismic P-wave data in the 10–70 s passband have limited depth resolution and cannot distinguish between a single volcanic conduit and several closely spaced ones.

Seismic observations alone cannot distinguish between tensile rock failure of the caldera roof and frictional slip of a conduit-scale plug, nor separate horizontal seawater reaction forces from internal horizontal forces.
10–70秒频段的远震P波数据深度分辨率有限，且无法区分单一火山通道与多个紧密相邻的通道。
仅凭地震学观测无法区分破火山口顶板张性破裂与通道塞摩擦滑动，也无法将海水水平反作用力与内部水平力分量分离。

tm.why: The paper resolves the internal explosive mechanics, conduit sealing, and caldera collapse cycles of the 2022 Hunga submarine volcanic eruption using teleseismic waveforms.
The authors perform continuous frequency-domain composite source inversions for both six-component moment tensors and three-component single forces to track volumetric and shear deformation.
The study introduces group-sparse post-processing (FISTA), Tikhonov refitting, and model resolution cross-talk analysis to prove the separability of moment tensor and single-force components.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 39-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF (main text p. 1–18 and supplementary materials p. 19–39, including Figures 1–4, Figures S1–S9, and Table S1).

sum: This study evaluates on-fault seismicity and probabilistic seismic hazard in New Zealand by comparing a synthetic catalog from the physics-based Rate and State Earthquake Simulator (RSQSim) with the inversion fault model (IFM) from the 2022 New Zealand National Seismic Hazard Model (NZ NSHM 2022). Both models utilize the New Zealand Community Fault Model. The results show that while the IFM simulates larger magnitude ruptures, the RSQSim magnitude-frequency distribution remains within the IFM's uncertainty bounds. Peak ground acceleration discrepancies are generally under 20% in high-seismicity areas but exceed 250% near low-slip-rate faults and the Hikurangi-Kermadec subduction zone. Integrating a distributed seismicity model reduces discrepancies in low-seismicity regions, highlighting the challenges of incorporating physics-based simulators into hazard forecasting.
本研究对比了物理地震模拟器RSQSim与2022年新西兰国家地震危险性模型（NZ NSHM 2022）的反演断层模型。结果表明，尽管反演模型预测的破裂震级更大，但RSQSim的震级-频度分布仍在其不确定性范围内。多数高活动区峰值地面加速度差异小于20%，但在低滑移率断层及希库朗伊俯冲带附近差异超25……

t: Comparison of probabilistic seismic hazard and magnitude-frequency distributions generated by the physics-based RSQSim simulator and the inversion fault model (IFM) from NZ NSHM 2022.
对比基于物理的RSQSim模拟器与NZ NSHM 2022反演断层模型产生的概率地震危险性及震级-频度分布。
Synthetic earthquake catalog from RSQSim and the inversion fault model (IFM) from the 2022 New Zealand National Seismic Hazard Model, both implementing the New Zealand Community Fault Model.
来自RSQSim的合成地震目录和2022年新西兰国家地震危险性模型的反演断层模型，两者均采用新西兰社区断层模型。
PGA discrepancies are <20% in high-seismicity regions but >250% near low-slip-rate faults and the Hikurangi subduction zone; RSQSim's MFD is within the 5th-95th percentile of the IFM.
高活动区PGA差异小于20%，但低滑移率断层和希库朗伊俯冲带附近差异超250%；RSQSim的震级-频度分布在IFM的5…
Both models are incomplete representations of seismicity, and incorporating uncertainty into simulators remains challenging in regions with short historical catalogs.
两种模型对地震活动的表征均不完整，且在历史目录较短的地区，将不确定性引入模拟器仍具挑战。
First comprehensive comparison of physics-based RSQSim hazard estimates with the official national inversion-based hazard model for New Zealand.
首次将基于物理的RSQSim危险性估算与新西兰官方基于反演的国家地震危险性模型进行全面对比。

kc: First comprehensive comparison of physics-based RSQSim hazard estimates with the official national inversion-based hazard model for New Zealand.
Quantified the spatial discrepancies in peak ground acceleration (PGA) between physics-based and inversion-based seismic hazard models.
Demonstrated that incorporating distributed seismicity models (DSM) significantly reduces hazard discrepancies in low-seismicity regions.
首次将基于物理的RSQSim危险性估算与新西兰官方基于反演的国家地震危险性模型进行全面对比。
量化了基于物理和基于反演的地震危险性模型之间峰值地面加速度（PGA）的空间差异。
表明引入分布式地震活动性模型（DSM）可显著降低低地震活动区域的危险性估算差异。
me: Physics-based earthquake simulation using the Rate and State Earthquake Simulator (RSQSim) to generate synthetic catalogs.
Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Analysis (PSHA) comparing the RSQSim catalog against the NZ NSHM 2022 Inversion Fault Model (IFM).
Integration of the Distributed Seismicity Model (DSM) to evaluate the completeness of hazard estimates.
使用速率-状态地震模拟器（RSQSim）进行基于物理的地震模拟以生成合成目录。
进行概率地震危险性分析（PSHA），对比RSQSim目录与NZ NSHM 2022反演断层模型（IFM）。
整合分布式地震活动性模型（DSM）以评估危险性估算的完整性。
de: Utilized the New Zealand Community Fault Model (NZ CFM) as the structural framework for both simulation approaches.
Compared magnitude-frequency distributions (MFDs) and peak ground acceleration (PGA) at a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years.
利用新西兰社区断层模型（NZ CFM）作为两种模拟方法的结构框架。
对比了50年内超越概率为10%条件下的震级-频度分布（MFD）和峰值地面加速度（PGA）。
li: Both models represent incomplete characterizations of real-world seismicity and hazard.
Developing and testing physics-based simulators is highly challenging in regions like New Zealand that have short historical earthquake catalogs.
两种模型对真实世界地震活动和危险性的表征均不完整。
在新西兰等历史地震目录较短的地区，开发和测试基于物理的模拟器极具挑战性。

tm.why: The paper compares probabilistic seismic hazard estimates (PGA, exceedance probabilities) between different modeling approaches in New Zealand.
It evaluates on-fault seismicity and magnitude-frequency distributions using the physics-based Rate and State Earthquake Simulator (RSQSim).

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract and public metadata since the full PDF was not available.

sum: This study presents a deep learning workflow to estimate focal mechanisms for microseismic events. A combined CNN-Transformer model is trained on Southern California waveforms to predict P-wave polarities and adapted to estimate SH-wave polarities on rotated transverse components. Applied to the Utah FORGE stage 3 stimulation, the model achieves high accuracy (98.0% for P, 96.2% for SH). These polarities, combined with amplitude ratios, are inverted using a double-couple-constrained Bayesian approach, yielding 717 high-quality focal mechanisms that reveal complex strike-slip and normal faulting within the reservoir.
本研究提出一种微震震源机制估计的深度学习工作流。结合CNN与Transformer模型预测P波极性，并推广至旋转切向分量估算SH波极性。在犹他FORGE压裂数据中，P和SH波极性预测准确率达98.0%和96.2%。结合振幅比进行贝叶斯反演，获得717个高质量震源机制解，揭示了储层内复杂的断层作用。

t: A combined CNN-Transformer model trained on Southern California waveforms to predict P and SH polarities, followed by double-couple-constrained Bayesian inversion.
结合CNN-Transformer预测P和SH波极性，并利用双力偶约束贝叶斯反演确定震源机制。
290,730 Southern California waveforms for training; microseismic waveforms from the Utah FORGE stage 3 stimulation (April 2022) for application.
采用南加州波形进行训练，并应用至犹他FORGE第三阶段压裂微震波形数据。
Achieved 98.0% P-wave and 96.2% SH-wave polarity accuracy on Utah FORGE, yielding 717 high-quality focal mechanisms showing strike-slip and normal faulting.
FORGE数据上P和SH波极性准确率达98.0%和96.2%，获得717个高质量震源机制解。
SH-wave polarity estimation is site-specific and relies on accurate sensor rotation and high-quality downhole array data.
SH波极性估计具有场地特定性，依赖于准确的传感器旋转和高质量台阵。
Extending deep-learning polarity prediction to SH waves on rotated transverse components to constrain Bayesian focal mechanism inversions.
将深度学习极性预测推广至SH波，以约束贝叶斯震源机制反演。

kc: Developed a combined CNN-Transformer model for high-accuracy P and SH wave polarity measurements.
Extended deep learning polarity identification to rotated transverse components for SH-wave constraints.
Obtained 717 high-quality focal mechanisms for the Utah FORGE stage 3 stimulation, revealing complex faulting behavior.
开发了结合CNN与Transformer的模型，用于高精度的P波和SH波极性测量。
将深度学习极性识别推广至旋转切向分量，以获取SH波约束。
获得了犹他FORGE第三阶段压裂的717个高质量震源机制解，揭示了复杂的断层活动特征。
me: CNN-Transformer hybrid neural network for polarity classification.
Noise augmentation and random arrival-time perturbation during training.
Double-couple-constrained Bayesian inversion combining polarities and amplitude ratios.
用于极性分类的CNN-Transformer混合神经网络。
训练过程中的噪声增强和随机到时扰动。
结合极性与振幅比的双力偶约束贝叶斯反演。
de: Training dataset of 290,730 Southern California waveforms.
Testing and application on Utah FORGE stage 3 stimulation downhole array data (April 2022).
Manual verification using 166 P-wave and 158 SH-wave high-quality picks.
包含290,730条南加州波形的训练数据集。
在犹他FORGE第三阶段压裂井下台阵数据（2022年4月）上的测试与应用。
利用166个P波和158个SH波高质量人工拾取进行验证。
li: Performance depends on the quality of rotated transverse components for SH polarity.
Requires site-specific calibration or high-quality downhole array geometry.
性能依赖于用于SH极性的旋转切向分量的质量。
需要特定场地的校准或高质量的井下台阵几何结构。

tm.why: The paper develops and applies a combined CNN-Transformer model to predict P and SH wave polarities.
The predicted polarities are used in a Bayesian inversion to estimate focal mechanisms of microseismic events.
The workflow is applied to the Utah FORGE geothermal stimulation dataset to characterize fracture activation.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: Current wavefield-based numerical ground motion prediction methods for earthquake early warning (EEW) rely on data assimilation, which ignores rupture directivity and produces unphysical circular diffusion patterns. This study introduces a real-time framework coupling source rupture directivity with wavefield evolution. Observed station accelerations are site-corrected, converted to JMA seismic intensity, and interpolated via Simple Kriging. A 2D Radiative Transfer Theory (RTT) model solved via Monte Carlo particle simulation forecasts the baseline wavefield. By fitting residuals between observed and predicted fields to a bilateral line-source directivity model using Levenberg-Marquardt optimization, the algorithm dynamically estimates rupture direction, Mach number, and rupture proportion to correct future intensity predictions. Validated on K-NET and KiK-net strong-motion records from the 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto earthquake, the method accurately identifies the northeastward rupture propagation within 28 s and reduces peak intensity Mean Absolute Errors by 16.1%, 5.4%, and 19.6% for 5, 10, and 20 s lead times compared...
现有基于数据同化的地震预警数值地面运动预测方法忽略了破裂方向性效应。本研究提出一种耦合震源与波场的实时预测新方法：利用简单克里金插值构建实测烈度场，通过二维辐射传输理论（RTT）与蒙特卡洛方法模拟波传播；实时对比观测与预测残差，利用双侧线源模型反演破裂方向、马赫数等参数并修正预测波场。基于2016年……

t: Constructs real-time JMA intensity fields via Simple Kriging, simulates wave propagation using 2D Radiative Transfer Theory and Monte Carlo methods, and inverts wavefield residuals with a bilateral line-source model to correct directivity effects.
通过简单克里金构建实时烈度场，利用RTT和蒙特卡洛模拟波传播，并用双侧线源模型拟合残差以修正破裂方向性。
Validated on strong-motion records from K-NET and KiK-net stations for the April 16, 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto, Japan earthquake, corrected to reference bedrock conditions.
使用2016年日本熊本Mw 7.0地震的K-NET和KiK-net强震记录，并校正至参考基岩场地。

Identifies predominant northeastward unilateral rupture within 22-24 s and bilateral rupture within 26-28 s; reduces JMA intensity MAE by 16.1%, 5.4%, and 19.6% for 5 s, 10 s, and 20 s advance predictions compared to data assimilation.
28秒内识别出北东向破裂特征；相比数据同化法，提前5、10、20秒预测的MAE分别降低16.1%、5.4%和19.6%。
Less robust in regions with sparse station coverage, complex subsurface structures, or strong 3D heterogeneity due to the uniform 2D RTT assumption.
基于均匀二维RTT假设，在台站稀疏、复杂地下结构或强三维非均匀性区域鲁棒性受限。
Couples source rupture directivity with RTT wavefield simulation in real time by extracting line-source directivity parameters from observed-minus-predicted wavefield residuals.
通过实时对比观测与预测波场残差提取线源方向性参数，首次实现震源破裂方向性与RTT波场演化的实时耦合。

kc: Proposes a coupled source-wavefield numerical ground motion prediction framework for EEW that incorporates real-time rupture directivity corrections.
Extracts rupture directivity parameters (azimuth, Mach number, unilateral/bilateral ratio) dynamically from wavefield residuals using a bilateral line-source model.
Eliminates station-centered circular artifacts typical of data assimilation by combining Simple Kriging interpolation with 2D Radiative Transfer Theory (RTT) Monte Carlo simulations.
Reduces JMA intensity prediction Mean Absolute Error (MAE) by 16.1%, 5.4%, and 19.6% at 5 s, 10 s, and 20 s lead times for the 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto earthquake.
提出了一种耦合震源与波场的地震预警数值地面运动预测框架，实现了破裂方向性效应的实时修正。
利用双侧线源模型从实时波场残差中动态提取破裂方向性参数（破裂方位角、马赫数及单双侧破裂比例）。
结合简单克里金插值与二维辐射传输理论（RTT）蒙特卡洛模拟，消除了传统数据同化方法中以台站为中心的环状伪影。
在2016年熊本Mw 7.0地震测试中，提前5秒、10秒和20秒的JMA烈度预测平均绝对误差分别降低了16.1%、5.4%和19.6%。
me: Site amplification correction to reference bedrock (Vs30 = 760 m/s) followed by real-time JMA seismic intensity calculation.
Spatial interpolation of observed JMA intensity fields using Simple Kriging with a squared exponential variogram optimized via cross-validation.
2D Radiative Transfer Theory (RTT) wave propagation modeling solved via Monte Carlo simulation of energy-carrying particles with isotropic scattering and absorption.
Non-linear least-squares inversion (Levenberg-Marquardt) of wavefield residuals using a bilateral line-source directivity coefficient model.
将台站记录校正至参考基岩场地（Vs30 = 760 m/s），并实时计算日本气象厅（JMA）地震烈度。
采用带平方指数变异函数的简单克里金法对观测烈度场进行空间插值，并通过交叉验证优化尺度参数。
基于二维辐射传输理论（RTT）与考虑各向同性散射和吸收的蒙特卡洛粒子模拟方法预测波场能量传播。
采用Levenberg-Marquardt非线性最小二乘算法，利用双侧线源方向性系数模型拟合波场残差并反演破裂参数。
de: Strong-motion acceleration waveforms from K-NET and KiK-net dense seismic networks for the April 16, 2016 Mw 7.0 Kumamoto, Japan mainshock.
Borehole soil condition and geophysical data at KiK-net stations for site amplification corrections.
Comparative evaluation of 5 s, 10 s, and 20 s advance ground motion intensity predictions against traditional data assimilation (DA) methods at stations >25 km from the epicenter.
2016年4月16日日本熊本Mw 7.0主震的K-NET和KiK-net密集台网强震动加速度波形记录。
用于场地放大效应校正的KiK-net台站钻孔土层条件与地球物理数据。
在震中距大于25公里的台站上，对比评估了本文方法与传统数据同化（DA）方法提前5秒、10秒和20秒的烈度预测性能。
li: Assumes a 2D homogeneous scattering/absorption medium in the RTT model, leading to arrival time delays caused by 3D velocity heterogeneities, basins, and topography.
Relies on dense station coverage for accurate Kriging interpolation and residual extraction, making it less robust in regions with sparse seismic networks.
Requires an external real-time epicenter location from the EEW system and excludes a 10 km near-source zone during directivity inversion due to RTT underestimation.
RTT模型假设二维均匀散射和吸收介质，忽略了三维速度非均匀性、盆地和地形效应引起的走时延迟。
依赖密集的台网覆盖以保证克里金插值和残差提取精度，在台站稀疏地区鲁棒性受限。
需要外部地震预警系统提供实时震中位置，且因RTT在极近场存在系统性低估而需在反演时剔除震中10公里以内的区域。

tm.why: The paper proposes a numerical ground motion prediction method for earthquake early warning (EEW) to rapidly forecast seismic intensity fields.
The core contribution is real-time inversion of bilateral line-source rupture directivity parameters to modulate and correct simulated ground motion fields.
Wave propagation is simulated using 2D Radiative Transfer Theory (RTT) and Monte Carlo particle methods that explicitly model scattering and absorption.

ev.notes: Full 26-page unedited manuscript PDF used, including main text, 9 figures, pseudocode algorithm, and 2 tables in the Appendix.

sum: Machine-learning phase pickers generate earthquake catalogues five to fifty times larger than routine analyst-reviewed ones, leaving most detections unexamined. This study measures how much of an automated catalogue human experts can verify by collecting 4,800 blind waveform verdicts from four seismologists across 1,200 stratified detections from six earthquake sequences (Ridgecrest, Iquique, Amatrice, NE Japan, ToC2ME, Kīlauea). Among decided events, experts confirmed 60.1% to 97.6% depending on the catalogue, with three pipelines on the same Ridgecrest sequence differing by 21.6 percentage points on machine-only additions. The authors develop a "confirmability" score fitted to seven standard association/location features (or waveform SNR features) that reproduces panel judgements (AUC 0.946 at Ridgecrest) and transfers rankings across regions. Geometrically, high-scored events sharply resolve conjugate strike-slip faults and NE Japan's double seismic zone, whereas low-scored events form diffuse off-fault clouds, motivating tiered catalogue releases anchored by small blind audits.
机器学习震相拾取生成的地震目录比常规人工审核目录大5至50倍，但多数检测未经检验。本研究由四位地震学家对6个地震序列的1200个分层抽样事件进行4800次盲审，在可判定事件中确认了60.1%至97.6%，且同一Ridgecrest序列的三个目录差异达21.6个百分点。作者利用7个常规关联与定位特征构……

t: Four seismologists performed blind waveform adjudications on stratified 200-event samples per catalogue; verdicts were modeled via latent event quality and reviewer leniency, then predicted using ridge and L2-logistic regression on seven catalogue or waveform features.
四位地震学家对分层抽样的200个事件进行盲审，用潜在质量模型拟合并基于7个特征训练岭回归与逻辑回归评分。

Eight automated catalogues across six tectonic, subduction, volcanic, and induced sequences (Ridgecrest, Iquique, Amatrice, NE Japan forearc, ToC2ME, Kīlauea), totaling 4,800 blind verdicts across 1,200 stratified events.
涵盖构造、俯冲、火山和诱发地震的6个序列共8个自动目录，对1200个事件完成4800次盲审裁决。

Confirmed fractions among decided detections range from 60.1% (ToC2ME) to 97.6% (Kīlauea). The confirmability score achieves 0.946 AUC at Ridgecrest, and low-scored detections show a 9% off-fault tail (>8 km) and blur NE Japan's double seismic zone.
可判定事件的确认率介于60.1%至97.6%；Ridgecrest评分AUC达0.946，低分事件偏离断层且模糊双地震带…

Reviewers are the paper's authors rather than independent analysts, 200-event panels cannot resolve small verdict-linked geometric differences, and the three-catalogue comparison rests on one sequence.
审稿人为论文作者而非独立团队，200个样本检验力有限，且三目录对比仅基于单一序列。

First systematic, fully crossed blind human waveform audit across multiple machine-learning earthquake catalogues, paired with a calibrated confirmability score that quantifies and filters false detections.
首次对多源机器学习地震目录开展全交叉专家盲审，并提出校准的可确认性评分以量化和过滤虚假检测。

kc: Conducted a fully crossed blind audit of 4,800 expert verdicts on 1,200 stratified detections across eight automated earthquake catalogues of six diverse sequences.
Demonstrated that expert confirmation rates span 60.1% to 97.6% across catalogues and vary by 21.6 points across different pipelines on the same Ridgecrest waveforms.
Developed a transferable 'confirmability' score from seven routine catalogue statistics that achieves 0.946 AUC against human consensus and outperforms hard quality-control cuts.
Showed via fault-distance tails, correlation dimension (D2), and the NE Japan double seismic zone that low-scored machine detections contain false triggers that blur tectonic structures.
对6个不同地震序列的8个自动地震目录进行了1200个分层抽样事件的4800次全交叉专家盲审。
证明不同目录的专家确认率介于60.1%至97.6%之间，且同一Ridgecrest波形的三个不同处理流程目录差异达21.6个百分点。
基于7个常规目录统计量开发了可迁移的“可确认性”评分，在Ridgecrest达到0.946的AUC，优于传统的硬性质量控制截断。
通过断层距离长尾、关联维数（D2）和日本东北双地震带证明，低分机器检测包含模糊构造结构的虚假触发。
me: Disproportionate stratified sampling (200 events per catalogue) with inverse sampling-fraction design weights and 10,000-resample stratified bootstrap.
Blinded waveform record-section adjudication across five nearest stations by four seismologists, combined via plurality rule and a logistic latent-quality/reviewer-leniency model.
L2-regularized logistic regression (for calibrated probability) and ridge regression (for latent quality ranking) using seven association-stage or waveform SNR features.
Geometric validation using E2F 3-D Hough-transform fault-segment fitting, Grassberger-Procaccia correlation dimension (D2), and two-component Gaussian mixture modeling of double seismic zones.
采用非成比例分层抽样（每个目录200个事件），结合逆抽样比设计权重与10,000次分层自举法计算置信区间。
由四位地震学家对最近5个台站的盲化波形剖面进行裁决，通过多数决规则及逻辑斯蒂潜在质量-审稿人宽容度模型合成标签。
利用7个关联阶段特征或波形信噪比特征，进行L2正则化逻辑回归（校准概率）和岭回归（潜在质量排序）。
采用E2F三维霍夫变换断层拟合、Grassberger-Procaccia关联维数（D2）以及双地震带双分量高斯混合模型进行几何验证。
de: Two custom deep-learning catalogues (2019 Ridgecrest M7.1 and 2014 Iquique M8.1) built from continuous waveforms using PhaseNet, PyOcto, and ADLoc.

Six published high-resolution catalogues audited as distributed: Amatrice CAT5 (Tan et al.), NE Japan forearc (Suzuki et al.), ToC2ME hydraulic fracturing beamforming (Igonin et al.), Kīlauea template matching (Shelly & Thelen), plus Shelly (2020) and Ross et al. (2019) QTM catalogues for Ridgecrest.
Continuous seismic waveforms from SCEDC, GFZ Potsdam, EIDA/INGV, EarthScope, NIED (Hi-net and S-net), and USGS.
使用PhaseNet、PyOcto和ADLoc从连续波形自建的两个深度学习目录（2019年Ridgecrest M7.1和2014年Iquique M8.1）。
直接审计六个已公开发布的高分辨率目录：Amatrice CAT5、日本东北弧前、ToC2ME水力压裂波束形成、Kīlauea模板匹配，以及Ridgecrest的Shelly (2020)和QTM (2019)目录。
来自SCEDC、GFZ Potsdam、EIDA/INGV、EarthScope、NIED（Hi-net和S-net）及USGS的连续地震波形数据。
li: The four waveform reviewers are the paper's authors rather than an independent analyst panel, relying on strict blinding to prevent bias.
Panels of 200 events per catalogue lack statistical power to resolve small direct verdict-linked differences in fault distance.
The three-catalogue Ridgecrest comparison uses one sequence, a single reviewer for the two published arms, and a magnitude trim that removes 35% of the authors' arm.
Three published catalogues omit association-stage records, limiting direct unchanged transfer testing of the Ridgecrest association model to NE Japan and Iquique.
四位波形审稿人均为论文作者而非独立分析员团队，依赖严格的盲化界面来防止偏见。
每个目录200个事件的样本量统计检验力有限，无法直接分辨裁决结果与断层距离之间的微小差异。
Ridgecrest三目录对比仅基于单一序列，两个公开目录仅由一位审稿人裁决，且震级截断移除了自建目录组35%的样本。
三个公开目录未发布关联阶段记录，使得Ridgecrest关联模型的直接跨区域迁移测试仅限于日本东北和Iquique。

tm.why: The paper systematically audits eight automated and machine-learning earthquake catalogues across six sequences using blind human waveform verification.
It evaluates deep-learning phase-picker catalogues (e.g., PhaseNet) and introduces a statistical confirmability score to predict human verification of machine detections.

ev.notes: Full 43-page preprint PDF (including main text, Methods, Figures 1-4, Tables S1-S11, Notes S1-S11, and Supplementary Figures S1-S8) was analyzed.

sum: This study presents a refined kinematic model of the Lau Back-Arc Basin's opening from 10 Ma to the present, embedded in a global plate model. The model incorporates three previously unrecognized paleoplates, five microplates, and ten active spreading centers. It highlights how the collision of the Ontong Java Plateau with the Vitiaz arc blocked Pacific Plate subduction, forming a Subduction-Transform Edge Propagator (STEP) fault. Fragmentation and rotation of the Vitiaz arc, along with the reactivation of the Peggy Ridge as a strike-slip fault between 7 and 5 Ma, facilitated back-arc rifting. The findings demonstrate that Lau Basin evolution was highly asymmetric and non-linear, driven not only by slab rollback but also by upper plate processes, including block rotation and fault propagation.
本研究提出了劳后弧盆地自10 Ma至今的改进运动学开裂模型。模型包含3个新古板块、5个微板块和10个活动扩张中心。研究表明，温通爪哇高原碰撞导致俯冲受阻并形成STEP断层；维蒂亚兹弧碎裂旋转及佩吉脊重活化促进了后弧裂谷启动。结果证实劳盆地演化呈高度非线性与不对称性，受板片回撤和上覆板块过程共同驱动。

t: Kinematic plate reconstruction and boundary refinement embedded within a global plate motion model to track microplate and paleoplate evolution.
嵌入全球板块运动模型中的运动学板块重建与边界细化方法。
Tectonic and kinematic data of the Lau Basin from 10 Ma to present, including 3 paleoplates, 5 microplates, and 10 active spreading centers.
劳盆地10 Ma至今的构造运动学数据，包含3个古板块、5个微板块和10个活动扩张中心。
The model shows highly asymmetric, non-linear basin opening driven by slab rollback, STEP faulting, and reactivation of the Peggy Ridge as a strike-slip fault.
模型显示盆地呈高度非对称和非线性扩张，受板片回撤、STEP断层及佩吉脊重活化驱动。
Kinematic reconstructions are inherently limited by the preservation and resolution of marine magnetic anomalies and paleomagnetic data in complex back-arc regions.
运动学重建受限于复杂后弧区域内海洋磁异常和古地磁数据的保存与分辨率。
Identification of three previously unrecognized paleoplates and demonstrating the critical role of upper plate processes and transform reactivation over simple slab rollback.
识别出3个新古板块，并证实了上覆板块过程和转换断层重活化在后弧启动中的关键作用。

kc: Developed a refined kinematic model of the Lau Basin from 10 Ma to present embedded in a global plate model.
Identified three previously unrecognized paleoplates, five microplates, and ten active spreading centers in the region.
Demonstrated that upper plate processes, such as STEP faulting and transform reactivation (e.g., Peggy Ridge), are critical drivers of back-arc basin initiation.
建立了自10 Ma至今嵌入全球板块模型中的劳盆地改进运动学模型。
在该区域识别出3个先前未被发现的古板块、5个微板块和10个活动扩张中心。
证实了上覆板块过程（如STEP断层作用和佩吉脊等转换断层重活化）是后弧盆地启动的关键驱动因素。
me: Kinematic plate reconstruction and boundary refinement embedded within a global plate motion model.
嵌入在全球板块运动模型中的运动学板块重建与边界细化方法。
de: Tectonic and kinematic data spanning 10 Ma to present, incorporating paleoplates, microplates, and active spreading centers in the Lau Basin.
跨越10 Ma至今的构造与运动学数据，结合了劳盆地内的古板块、微板块和活动扩张中心。
li: The model relies on the resolution and accuracy of historical plate boundary indicators and magnetic anomalies in a highly complex back-arc setting.
该模型依赖于高度复杂的后弧背景下历史板块边界指示物和磁异常的分辨率与准确性。

tm.why: The paper presents a refined kinematic plate reconstruction model of the Lau Back-Arc Basin to understand crustal growth and tectonic evolution.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from JGR Solid Earth and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: The formation mechanisms of sharply curved orogenic syntaxes at collisional plate corners, such as the Eastern Himalayan syntaxis (EHS), remain debated. Using coupled 3D thermomechanical and surface process numerical experiments (I3VIS-FDSPM), this study investigates the links between deep slab dynamics and crustal deformation during the Indo-Eurasian collision. The results show that a pre-existing rheologically weak proto-plateau in the Eurasian plate is essential for initiating a northward-migrating syntaxis. Between 15 and 30 Myr, flattening of the subducting Indian slab and differential plate advance dismember the collisional corner via crustal-scale strike-slip fault zones. A ~160 MPa dynamic pressure gradient drives transient, localized mid-to-lower crustal flow (up to 7.5 cm/yr) within a narrow 30–35 km wide channel curving around the syntaxis. Unlike previous 2D or thin-sheet models, this work self-consistently reproduces spontaneous 3D syntaxis evolution, reconciling deep slab flattening with transient, fault-bounded crustal channel flow.
本研究利用耦合表面过程的三维热-力学数值模拟程序（I3VIS-FDSPM），探讨了印度-欧亚大陆碰撞中东喜马拉雅构造结（EHS）的形成机制。模型采用501×501×101欧拉网格并设置2亿个标志点。结果表明，欧亚板块先存的流变学软弱原高原对向北迁移的构造结初始形成至关重要。在碰撞15至30百万年间，……

t: 3D coupled thermomechanical and mass-conservative surface process numerical modelling using the I3VIS-FDSPM finite-difference marker-in-cell code with non-Newtonian visco-plastic rheologies.
采用I3VIS-FDSPM有限差分网格标志点代码，结合非牛顿粘塑性流变学与质量守恒表面过程进行三维热力学模拟。
A 1000 × 1000 × 200 km3 domain discretized into 501 × 501 × 101 Eulerian nodes (2-km step) and 200 million markers, simulating Indian indenter collision at 5 cm/yr over 30 Myr.
1000×1000×200 km3模型域，含501×501×101欧拉节点与2亿标志点，以5 cm/yr模拟30 Myr…

The proto-syntaxis translates ~250 km northward between 15 and 21 Myr; a ~160 MPa dynamic pressure gradient drives ductile mid-lower crustal flow up to 7.5 cm/yr in a 30–35 km wide channel over ~800 km.
原构造结向北迁移约250 km；约160 MPa压差驱动中下地壳在30-35 km宽通道内以最高7.5 cm/yr流动。

The surface process model assumes constant diffusivity and omits fluvial stream-power erosion; models also do not reproduce northward lower-crustal counter-flow due to lacking pre-existing weak zones.
表面模型采用恒定扩散率而忽略水力侵蚀；因缺乏先存软弱带未重现下地壳向北逆流。
First 3D thermomechanical model to simulate spontaneous, self-consistent syntaxis formation linking Indian slab flattening with transient, fault-bounded mid-lower crustal channel flow.
首次在三维热力学模型中实现构造结自发形成，揭示平板俯冲与瞬态地壳通道流的耦合。

kc: Demonstrates spontaneous, self-consistent 3D formation and northward migration of an orogenic syntaxis driven by Indian slab flattening and differential plate advance.
Establishes that a pre-existing rheologically weak proto-plateau in the overriding plate is required to decouple the crust and initiate syntaxis indentation.
Reconciles debates on Tibetan crustal flow by showing that mid-to-lower crustal flow is transient (~10 Myr) and localized within a narrow (30–35 km wide) shear-bounded channel around the syntaxis.
展示了在印度板片平板化和差异性板块推进驱动下，造山带构造结在三维空间中的自发、自洽形成与向北迁移。
证实了上覆板块中先存的流变学软弱原高原对于实现地壳解耦和启动构造结楔入是必不可少的。
调和了关于青藏高原地壳流的争论，证明中下地壳流是瞬态的（持续约10 Myr），且局限在绕构造结展布的狭窄（宽30-35公里）剪切边界通道内。
me: Coupled 3D thermomechanical and surface process numerical modelling using the finite-difference marker-in-cell code I3VIS-FDSPM.
Non-Newtonian visco-plastic rheologies incorporating diffusion creep, dislocation creep, Peierls/brittle strain weakening, and mantle grain size evolution.
Mass-conservative finite-difference surface process model accounting for hillslope diffusion, erosion, sedimentation, and advective topographic transport.
使用有限差分网格内标志点（marker-in-cell）代码I3VIS-FDSPM进行耦合三维热-力学与表面过程的数值模拟。
采用非牛顿粘塑性流变学，结合扩散蠕变、位错蠕变、脆性应变弱化以及地幔粒度演化机制。
使用质量守恒的有限差分表面过程模型，计算山坡扩散、侵蚀、沉积以及地形平流输运。
de: 3D numerical domain of 1000 × 1000 × 200 km resolved on a 501 × 501 × 101 Eulerian grid (2-km resolution) with 200 million Lagrangian markers.
Reference four-plate continental corner collision setup (Indian indenter, Eurasian plate with proto-plateau, and Tarim/Sichuan strong cratonic zones) driven at 5 cm/yr for 30 Myr.
Sensitivity analysis varying initial proto-plateau presence, Moho temperature/rheological contrasts (60 °C, 100 °C, 200 °C), and erosion intensities.
构建1000 × 1000 × 200公里的三维数值模型域，采用501 × 501 × 101欧拉网格（2公里分辨率）和2亿个拉格朗日标志点。
基准实验包含四个大陆块体（印度楔入体、含原高原的欧亚板块及代表塔里木和四川盆地的强刚性带），以5厘米/年的汇聚速率模拟30 Myr。
开展敏感性实验，测试初始原高原的存在与否、莫霍面温差/流变学对比度（60 °C、100 °C、200 °C）以及不同侵蚀强度的影响。
li: The surface process model uses a constant diffusivity and does not account for fluvial processes (stream power law) or major river incision.
The simulation does not reproduce the proposed northward counter-flow of lower crust in southeastern Tibet, likely due to omitting pre-existing crustal weak zones or partial melting.
表面过程模型采用恒定扩散系数，未考虑河流过程（河流水力侵蚀定律）或大型河流的下切作用。
模拟未能重现前人提出的藏东南下地壳向北逆向流动，这可能归因于模型未包含先存地壳软弱带或部分熔融。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D thermomechanical numerical simulations to study continental collision, slab flattening, crustal flow, and the geodynamic evolution of the Eastern Himalayan syntaxis.

ev.notes: Full 20-page Nature Geoscience PDF including main text, Methods, References, Extended Data Table 1, and Extended Data Figs. 1–8 was read and analyzed.

sum: Traditional seismic velocity model building (VMB) requires high-quality starting models and high computational cost, while existing generative diffusion models synthesize models in one shot without respecting the top-to-bottom progression of surface-recorded seismic information. This paper introduces a depth-progressive generative diffusion framework that constructs velocity models incrementally from shallow to deep. The model trains on paired shallow-deep velocity patches with randomized depth overlap, explicit depth positional encodings, sparse well-log profiles, and idealized vertical reflectivity structural constraints. During inference, overlapping depth slices are synthesized iteratively using a DDIM sampler and merged via Gaussian-weighted accumulation to eliminate boundary artifacts. Tested on 15,742 patches from ten industrial benchmark models (including in-distribution SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE, Overthrust, and out-of-distribution Marmousi), the method achieves high accuracy when combining well and structural constraints, while ensemble sampling provides uncertainty maps that strongly correlate with actual velocity errors.
传统地震速度建模计算量大且依赖初始模型，现有扩散模型则忽略了地表地震信息由浅入深的传播规律。本文提出一种深度渐进式生成扩散框架，利用具有随机重叠的浅-深速度块对及显式深度编码进行训练，并融合测井曲线和理想垂向反射率构造约束。推理阶段采用高斯加权融合拼接重叠深度切片以消除边界伪影。在SEAM Arid……

t: A conditional U-Net diffusion model trains on overlapping shallow-deep velocity patch pairs with explicit depth encodings, well logs, and reflectivity, synthesizing full models top-to-bottom using Gaussian-weighted patch blending.
训练融合显式深度编码、测井和反射率的条件U-Net扩散模型，利用高斯加权拼接由浅入深合成完整速度模型。

The model is trained on 15,742 2D velocity patches (256x256) extracted from ten 2D/3D industrial benchmark models, using paired 32x256 shallow-deep patches, random single-well profiles, and vertical reflectivity.
采用从10个二维/三维工业基准模型提取的15,742个256×256速度切片，使用32×256浅-深块对训练。

Combining well and structural constraints reduces standard deviation to 0-10 m/s and velocity errors to 0-50 m/s on in-distribution tests (SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE, Overthrust) and 0-100 m/s on OOD Marmousi.
联合测井与构造约束在分布内测试中将标准差降至0-10 m/s、误差降至0-50 m/s，在Marmousi测试中误差为0…

This proof-of-concept relies on idealized vertical reflectivity computed directly from true velocity models rather than migrated images, and exhibits velocity biases on out-of-distribution data without well calibration.
依赖由真实速度直接计算的理想垂向反射率，且在无测井校准时分布外测试存在速度偏差。

Replaces one-shot or independent patch-wise diffusion generation with an autoregressive-inspired, shallow-to-deep conditional diffusion scheme that propagates shallow velocity priors downward using explicit depth encoding and Gaussian blending.
将自回归思想与生成扩散模型结合，通过显式深度编码与高斯融合实现由浅入深的先验传播速度建模。

kc: Proposes a depth-progressive generative diffusion framework that constructs seismic velocity volumes incrementally from shallow to deep.
Designs a conditional training strategy using paired shallow-deep patches with random overlap, explicit depth encodings, well logs, and structural maps.
Introduces an overlap-based progressive inference algorithm with Gaussian-weighted blending to eliminate boundary stitching artifacts.
Demonstrates effective uncertainty quantification via ensemble sampling, showing strong spatial correlation between predicted standard deviation and velocity errors.
提出了一种由浅入深渐进式构建地震速度体的生成式扩散模型框架。
设计了结合随机重叠浅-深速度块对、显式深度编码、测井及构造约束的条件训练策略。
提出了基于重叠切片和高斯加权融合的渐进式推理算法，有效消除了边界拼接伪影。
通过集成采样实现了高效的不确定性量化，证明了预测标准差与实际速度误差具有强空间相关性。
me: Conditional generative diffusion model (IDDPM baseline with U-Net and self-attention) trained to predict deeper velocity patches conditioned on shallower patches.
Explicit depth positional encoding and multi-branch residual block conditioning for time, spatial priors, sparse well velocities, well locations, and structural reflectivity.
Mixed conditional and unconditional training strategy (5% dropout probability for well and structural conditions) to handle incomplete constraints at inference.
Depth-progressive inference with 10-step DDIM sampling, half-patch stride overlap, and Gaussian-weighted normalization across depth windows.
基于U-Net和自注意力机制的条件生成扩散模型，以浅层速度块为条件预测深层速度块。
采用显式深度位置编码与多分支残差块，融合时间步、空间先验、稀疏测井速度、井位及构造反射率。
采用混合条件与无条件训练策略（以5%概率随机丢弃测井和构造条件），以适应推理时的不完整约束。
结合10步DDIM采样、半块步长重叠及高斯加权归一化的深度渐进式推理算法。
de: Training dataset of 15,742 2D velocity patches (256x256) extracted and augmented from seven 2D (Otway, SEAM, BP1994, BP2004, BP2007, Hess, Sigsbee) and three 3D (SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE, Overthrust) benchmark models.
In-distribution synthetic evaluations on unseen 2D test sections from SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE (salt body), and Overthrust (faulted) models under four conditioning scenarios.
Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization test on the Marmousi velocity model.
Sensitivity analysis on the Overthrust model varying the initial shallow prior depth across 32, 64, 96, and 128 grid points.
训练数据集包含从7个二维和3个三维工业基准模型中提取并增强的15,742个256×256二维速度切片。
在SEAM Arid、SEG/EAGE（含盐丘）和Overthrust（含逆冲断层）测试切片上进行四种约束场景下的分布内评估。
在Marmousi速度模型上进行分布外（OOD）泛化能力测试。
在Overthrust模型上进行浅层先验深度（32、64、96和128个网格点）的敏感性分析。
li: Uses idealized structural constraints derived directly from vertical reflectivity of true models rather than realistic migrated seismic images.
Out-of-distribution tests on the Marmousi model show higher velocity errors and biases when well constraints are absent due to training manifold limitations.
Sparse single-well constraints have limited lateral influence in structurally complex regions when structural constraints are not included.
采用由真实速度模型直接计算的理想垂向反射率作为构造约束，而非实际偏移地震成像。
在Marmousi分布外测试中，受限于训练数据流形，缺乏测井约束时存在明显的速度偏差和较高误差。
在缺乏构造约束的情况下，单个稀疏测井约束在复杂构造区域的横向控制范围有限。

tm.why: The paper introduces a conditional generative diffusion model architecture with U-Net and self-attention blocks to progressively synthesize seismic velocity models from shallow to deep.
The probabilistic generative diffusion framework samples multiple latent noise realizations across depth windows to produce ensemble velocity predictions and quantify uncertainty.
The framework addresses the ill-posed subsurface velocity model building problem by integrating prior geological distributions with well-log and structural constraints.

ev.notes: Full 27-page preprint PDF analyzed, including equations, Algorithm 1, network architecture diagrams, four synthetic benchmark experiments, and manifold analysis.

sum: This study presents a real-time processing framework for offshore Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) using a 300-km-long submarine Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) cable in Central Chile. By adapting established EEW methodologies to DAS data, the authors demonstrate stable location and magnitude predictions within 5 seconds of alert declaration for M4+ events. Testing on 75 days of continuous data showed a 78.6% correct classification rate and a low missed alert rate of 3.8%. False alerts were primarily due to linear network geometry biasing locations of sub-M4 events. This work highlights the potential of submarine DAS to bridge the gap in offshore seismic monitoring and integrate with land-based networks for hybrid EEW systems.
本研究利用智利中部300公里海底分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆，构建了实时海域地震预警（EEW）框架。通过将现有EEW方法应用于DAS，系统在触发后5秒内即可对M4级地震进行稳定定位和震级预测。75天连续数据测试显示，系统正确分类率达78.6%，漏报率仅3.8%。该研究证实了海底DAS进行实时地震预警……

t: A real-time processing framework adapting established earthquake early warning (EEW) methodologies to ingest and process continuous Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data.
一种将现有地震预警（EEW）方法应用于连续分布式声学传感（DAS）数据输入的实时处理框架。
75 days of continuous DAS data and M4+ earthquake waveforms recorded along a 300 km submarine fiber-optic cable offshore Central Chile.
智利中部近海300公里海底光缆记录的75天连续DAS数据及M4级以上地震波形。
Stable location and magnitude predictions within 5 seconds of alert, achieving a 78.6% correct classification rate and a 3.8% missed alert rate.
警报发出后5秒内实现稳定定位和震级预测，正确分类率达78.6%，漏报率仅为3.8%。
Linear network geometry of the single cable biases event locations, causing false alerts for events below M4.
单根光缆的线性台网几何结构会导致定位偏差，从而对M4级以下地震产生虚警。
First demonstration of a real-time offshore EEW system using a long-range (300 km) submarine DAS cable under continuous operational conditions.
首次在连续运行条件下，利用300公里长距离海底DAS光缆实现实时海域地震预警。

kc: Developed a real-time processing framework adapting established EEW methodologies for DAS virtual sensors.
Demonstrated the feasibility of offshore DAS-based EEW using a 300 km submarine cable in Chile.
Evaluated system performance and robustness using 75 days of continuous offshore DAS data.
开发了适用于DAS虚拟传感器的实时地震预警（EEW）处理框架。
利用智利300公里海底光缆证实了基于DAS的海域地震预警可行性。
利用75天连续海域DAS数据评估了系统的性能和鲁棒性。
me: Real-time EEW processing framework adapted for DAS virtual sensors.
Magnitude and location estimation algorithms optimized for linear array geometry.
Continuous data stream processing and event classification.
适用于DAS虚拟传感器的实时EEW处理框架。
针对线性台网几何结构优化的震级与定位估算算法。
连续数据流处理与事件分类。
de: Continuous DAS data recorded over 75 days from a 300 km submarine fiber-optic cable offshore Central Chile.
Seismic waveforms of M4+ earthquakes recorded by the DAS observatory.
智利中部近海300公里海底光缆记录的75天连续DAS数据。
DAS观测站记录到的M4级以上地震波形数据。
li: Linear geometry of the single submarine cable biases event locations, leading to false alerts for sub-M4 events.
Adding sparse land-based stations does not significantly improve performance when overall network coverage is poor.
单根海底光缆的线性几何结构会导致定位偏差，从而对M4级以下地震产生虚警。
在整体台网覆盖较差时，引入稀疏的陆地台站并不能显著提升预警性能。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the feasibility of using a 300 km submarine Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) cable for earthquake early warning.
The primary application of the developed real-time DAS processing framework is Earthquake Early Warning (EEW).
The system performs real-time earthquake detection, location, and magnitude estimation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This paper presents an overview of the PRECODE mine-by experiment at BedrettoLab, Switzerland, which investigates brittle fracturing and Excavation Damage Zone (EDZ) evolution in Rotondo Granite. The tunnel was excavated using both drill-and-blast and line-drilling/rock-breaking methods to compare their impacts. By integrating acoustic emission, distributed acoustic and strain sensing, hydraulic monitoring, electrical resistivity tomography, and laboratory testing, the study characterizes short-term EDZ formation and long-term crack growth. Preliminary results reveal significant differences in acoustic emission activity and damage development between the two excavation techniques, while observations from the older Bedretto Tunnel indicate ongoing time-dependent fracturing. This coupled dataset enhances predictive modeling for nuclear waste repositories.
本文介绍了瑞士BedrettoLab的PRECODE开挖试验，研究结晶岩中开挖损伤区（EDZ）的脆性破裂与演化。试验对比了钻爆法与线钻落石法的影响，整合了声发射、分布式传感、水力及电阻率监测和室内测试。初步结果表明，不同开挖方法的声发射活动和EDZ发育差异显著，且老隧道中存在持续的时间相关破裂，为核……

t: Multidisciplinary in-situ monitoring combining acoustic emission, distributed fiber-optic sensing, electrical resistivity tomography, and hydraulic testing.
结合声发射、分布式光纤传感、电阻率断层成像和水力测试的多学科原位监测。
In-situ monitoring and laboratory testing data from the PRECODE tunnel in Rotondo Granite, Switzerland.
来自瑞士Rotondo花岗岩PRECODE隧道的原位监测与室内测试数据。
Preliminary results show distinct acoustic emission activity and damage development between drill-and-blast and line-drilling excavation methods.
初步结果显示，钻爆法与线钻落石法在声发射活动和损伤发育上存在显著差异。
The findings are specific to Rotondo Granite and require long-term monitoring to fully capture time-dependent fracturing.
研究结果特定于Rotondo花岗岩，且需要长期监测以完全捕获时间相关破裂。
Direct in-situ comparison of excavation methods on EDZ development combined with multi-scale, multi-physics monitoring.
直接原位对比不同开挖方式对EDZ发育的影响，并结合了多尺度、多物理场监测。

kc: Presents a comprehensive overview of the PRECODE mine-by experiment at BedrettoLab for EDZ characterization.
Compares the effects of drill-and-blast (D&B) versus line-drilling and rock-breaking (LDRB) excavation methods on rock damage.
Integrates multidisciplinary in-situ monitoring (AE, DAS, ERT) with laboratory-based time-dependent fracture testing.
介绍了用于开挖损伤区（EDZ）表征的BedrettoLab PRECODE开挖试验的全面概况。
对比了钻爆法（D&B）与线钻落石法（LDRB）开挖方式对岩石损伤的影响。
整合了多学科原位监测（声发射、分布式传感、电阻率断层成像）与室内时间相关裂缝测试。
me: In-situ acoustic emission (AE) monitoring to detect microfracturing.
Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) and distributed strain sensing (DSS) for high-resolution strain and wavefield measurements.
Electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) and hydraulic monitoring to characterize permeability and structural changes.
原位声发射（AE）监测以检测微破裂。
分布式声学传感（DAS）和分布式应变传感（DSS）用于高分辨率应变和波场测量。
电阻率断层成像（ERT）和水力监测以表征渗透率和结构变化。
de: In-situ monitoring data from the newly excavated PRECODE tunnel in Rotondo Granite, Switzerland.
Comparative datasets between drill-and-blast (D&B) and line-drilling and rock-breaking (LDRB) sections.
Long-term monitoring data from the 40-year-old Bedretto Tunnel and laboratory fracture mechanics tests.
来自瑞士Rotondo花岗岩中新开挖的PRECODE隧道的原位监测数据。
钻爆法（D&B）与线钻落石法（LDRB）区域之间的对比数据集。
来自有40年历史的Bedretto隧道长期监测数据及室内裂缝力学测试。
li: The study is site-specific to Rotondo Granite and results may vary for other crystalline or sedimentary host rocks.
Long-term stress corrosion and time-dependent fracturing processes require extended observation periods to fully quantify.
研究针对特定的Rotondo花岗岩，其结果在其他结晶岩或沉积围岩中可能有所不同。
长期的应力腐蚀和时间相关破裂过程需要更长的观测周期才能完全量化。

tm.why: The paper investigates brittle fracturing and excavation damage zone (EDZ) evolution in an underground laboratory environment.
The experiment utilizes distributed acoustic and strain sensing (DAS/DSS) for in-situ monitoring of the tunnel excavation.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the provided abstract and public metadata.

sum: This study investigates the shallow lithospheric 3-D S-wave velocity structure of the north-central Gulf of California (GoC) using one year of ambient seismic noise and 11 shallow earthquakes recorded across 18 broadband stations. Employing phase cross-correlations, time-scale phase-weighted stacking, and a two-stage laterally constrained surface wave inversion (periods 2.1–55.5 s), the authors resolve velocity structures down to ~25 km depth on a 20×20 km horizontal grid. The resulting model identifies three depth units (upper sedimentary crust, lower crystalline crust, and upper mantle) and reveals variable Moho depths (13–20 km) in the northern GoC thinning to ~11 km toward the center. Prominent low-velocity anomalies beneath San Felipe and the Delfín Basin confirm geothermal systems and partial melting. Relative velocity variations correlate with heat flow, gravity, magnetic anomalies, and radiated seismic energy, demonstrating a rheological transition from a weak, faulted northern lithosphere to a strong, rigid central lithosphere.
本研究利用18个宽频带台站记录的1年环境噪声和11次浅源地震数据，通过相位互相关、时间尺度相位加权叠加及两阶段横向约束面波反演方法（周期2.1–55.5秒），构建了加利福尼亚湾北中部浅层岩石圈的三维S波速度结构。模型识别出上地壳沉积层、下地壳结晶岩和上地幔三个深度单元，显示北部莫霍面深度在13–20……

t: Two-stage laterally constrained surface wave inversion using iterative least-squares for 2-D group velocity dispersion maps and covariance matrices, followed by a nonlinear conjugate gradient scheme to invert for 3-D S-wave velocity.
采用两阶段横向约束面波反演，先用最小二乘法求取二维群速度频散图及协方差矩阵，再通过非线性共轭梯度法反演三维S波速度。

Rayleigh wave group traveltimes (1–71 s) derived from 11 shallow earthquakes (97 paths) and one year (2022) of vertical-component ambient seismic noise cross-correlations (44 paths) across 18 broadband stations.
利用18个宽频带台站记录的11次浅源地震（97条路径）和2022年全年环境噪声互相关（44条路径）提取的瑞利波群走时数据…

Retrieves Vs between 1.8 and 4.2 km/s down to 25 km depth, identifying three seismic units, a variable northern Moho (13–20 km), a thinner central crust (~11 km), and geothermal low-velocity zones beneath San Felipe.
获得25 km深度内1.8–4.2 km/s的Vs结构，划分三个地震单元，揭示北部多变莫霍面（13–20 km）、中部薄…
