Ray density is insufficient to resolve structures smaller than 20 km horizontally, and vertical sensitivity and resolution degrade significantly at depths exceeding 20 to 30 km.
射线密度不足以分辨水平小于20 km的构造，且20–30 km深度以下的垂直敏感度和分辨率显著下降。

Resolves vertical crustal variations (upper and lower crust) and links 3-D Vs anomalies to lithospheric strength, explaining north-to-central differences in seismicity, radiated seismic energy, and heat flow.
精细分辨上下地壳垂向变化，并将三维Vs异常与岩石圈强度关联，解释了北中部地震活动性、辐射能量和热流的差异。

kc: Constructed a 3-D S-wave velocity model of the shallow lithosphere (down to ~25 km) in the north-central Gulf of California using combined ambient noise and earthquake surface-wave traveltimes.

Mapped three distinct seismic depth units and lateral variations in crustal thickness, showing a variable Moho (13–20 km) in the north and a thinner crust (~11 km) with a diffuse crust-mantle transition in the center.
Identified prominent crustal low-velocity anomalies beneath San Felipe and Delfín Basin, confirming deep heat sources and fluid presence for geothermal exploration.
Demonstrated a rheological transition from a weak lithosphere in the northern GoC (high seismicity, high heat flow, low radiated seismic energy) to a strong lithosphere in the central GoC.
结合环境噪声和地震面波走时，构建了加利福尼亚湾北中部浅层岩石圈（至约25 km深）的三维S波速度模型。
划分了三个不同的地震深度单元并揭示了地壳厚度的横向变化，显示北部莫霍面深度多变（13–20 km），而中部地壳较薄（约11 km）且壳幔过渡带呈弥散特征。
识别出San Felipe和Delfín盆地下方显著的地壳低速异常，证实了用于地热勘探的深部热源和流体存在。
论证了加利福尼亚湾北部软弱岩石圈（高地震活动性、高热流、低地震辐射能量）向中部坚硬岩石圈的流变学过渡。
me: Phase cross-correlation (fast-PCC) and time-scale phase-weighted stacking (ts-PWS) to extract Rayleigh wave empirical Green's functions from vertical-component ambient noise.
Frequency-time analysis (FTAN) via the Noisy Dispersion Curve Picking (NDCP) tool to measure fundamental-mode Rayleigh wave group velocity dispersion curves and traveltimes (1–71 s).

Two-stage laterally constrained surface wave inversion: first-stage iterative least-squares for 2-D dispersion maps and covariance matrices (58 periods from 2.1 to 55.5 s), followed by second-stage 3-D nonlinear conjugate gradient Vs inversion.
1-D neighborhood algorithm inversion (Geopsy) of the average dispersion curve to build a 14-layer initial reference model, validated via checkerboard and synthetic large-block resolution tests.
采用相位互相关（fast-PCC）和时间尺度相位加权叠加（ts-PWS）从垂直分量背景噪声中提取瑞利波经验格林函数。
利用基于时频分析（FTAN）的噪声频散曲线拾取工具（NDCP），测量基阶瑞利波群速度频散曲线和走时（1–71秒）。
采用两阶段横向约束面波反演：第一阶段利用迭代最小二乘法估算58个周期（2.1至55.5秒）的二维频散图及协方差矩阵，第二阶段采用非线性共轭梯度法反演三维Vs结构。
使用邻域算法（Geopsy）反演平均频散曲线以构建14层初始参考模型，并通过检测板和合成大块模型分辨率测试进行验证。
de: Continuous vertical-component ambient seismic noise from the year 2022 yielding 51 interstation paths (44 selected dispersion curves) across 14 RESBAN, 3 RESNOM, and 1 SSN broadband stations.
11 shallow earthquakes (Mw ≥ 4.5, depth < 10 km) relocated with double-difference methods, providing 97 earthquake-station trajectories.

Auxiliary geophysical datasets for joint interpretation: historical seismicity catalog (1901–2018, 1195 events), scaled radiated seismic energy (81 events, 2015–2021), marine heat flow measurements, and EMAG2/WGM2012 magnetic and Bouguer gravity anomalies.
2022年全年垂直分量连续背景噪声数据，来自14个RESBAN、3个RESNOM和1个SSN宽频带台站，构成51条台站间路径（筛选出44条频散曲线）。
经双差法重定位的11次浅源地震（Mw ≥ 4.5，深度 < 10 km），提供97条震源-台站路径。
用于联合解释的辅助地球物理数据集：历史地震目录（1901–2018年，1195个事件）、标度地震辐射能量（2015–2021年，81个事件）、海洋热流测量数据以及EMAG2/WGM2012磁异常和布格重力异常数据。
li: Coarse horizontal grid resolution (20×20 km cells) due to sparse station distribution and limited ray path density, preventing resolution of structures smaller than 10–20 km.
Loss of vertical structural resolution and sensitivity below 20–25 km depth, as well as smoothing artifacts near the Gulf margins where ray coverage drops.
Smoothness regularization in the inversion obscures sharp velocity discontinuities, making it difficult to distinguish a sharp Moho from a gradual crust-mantle transition zone.
受限于稀疏的台站分布和射线密度，水平网格分辨率较粗（20×20 km网格），无法分辨小于10–20 km的构造。
20–25 km深度以下垂直结构分辨率和敏感度下降，且在射线覆盖减少的海湾边缘存在平滑伪影。
反演中的平滑正则化模糊了尖锐的速度间断面，难以区分尖锐的莫霍面与渐变的壳幔过渡带。

tm.why: The study performs a two-stage laterally constrained surface wave tomography using Rayleigh wave group traveltimes to determine a 3-D S-wave velocity model.
The authors use one year of ambient seismic noise cross-correlations with phase cross-correlation and time-scale phase-weighted stacking to extract empirical Green's functions.

The 3-D S-wave velocity model is used to investigate crustal thickness, Moho variations, geothermal anomalies, and the rheological transition from weak to strong lithosphere in the Gulf of California.

ev.notes: Full 59-page GJI accepted manuscript PDF was read and analyzed, including all 13 main figures, methodology equations/workflows, resolution tests, and geological interpretations.

sum: This study investigates how groundwater level variations affect seismic ground motion using a stratified 2D poroelastic model consisting of an air-saturated layer over a water-saturated layer above an elastic half-space. The authors extend Knopoff's global matrix method to the generalized de la Cruz and Spanos (dCS) poroelasticity theory, which incorporates viscous shearing and a slow S-wave. Calibrated with geotechnical parameters from the Valley of Mexico and excited by a strong-motion wavelet from the 2017 Mw 7.1 Puebla-Morelos earthquake, the model evaluates responses to obliquely incident P- and SV-waves. Results show that seismic amplification, resonant frequencies, and signal duration vary non-monotonically with water depth, particularly for vertical motion. Intermediate groundwater levels (e.g., 75%) yield the strongest vertical amplification (up to 10.46) and challenge the standard 2/3 vertical-to-horizontal (V/H) engineering rule, highlighting the importance of explicit water-table stratification over effective-fluid homogenization.
本研究采用双层孔隙弹性模型（空气饱和层位于水饱和层之上，下伏弹性半空间）探讨了地下水位变化对地震地面运动的影响。作者将Knopoff全局矩阵法扩展至广义de la Cruz和Spanos（dCS）孔隙弹性理论，结合墨西哥谷的岩土参数与2017年Mw 7.1地震强震记录，计算了倾斜入射P波和SV波的响……

t: Extends the Knopoff global matrix method to the generalized de la Cruz and Spanos (dCS) poroelasticity theory to solve 2D P-SV wave propagation across air- and water-saturated porous layers.
将Knopoff全局矩阵法扩展至dCS孔隙弹性理论，求解双层孔隙介质中的2D P-SV波传播。
Uses a 40 m porous layer calibrated to Valley of Mexico clays and a 5 s bedrock strong-motion wavelet from the 2017 Mw 7.1 Puebla-Morelos earthquake at station CUP5.
采用墨西哥谷40米粘土层参数，以及2017年Mw 7.1地震在CUP5台站的5秒基岩强震子波。
Vertical resonance frequency shifts from 1.5 Hz (dry) to 10 Hz (85% water level). In the time domain, maximum vertical amplification reaches 9.33 (S-wave) and 10.46 (P-wave) at 75% groundwater level.
垂直共振频率从1.5 Hz升至10 Hz；75%水位时垂直放大达峰值，S波为9.33倍，P波达10.46倍。
The linear poroelastic formulation omits clay-specific attenuation mechanisms and nonlinear sediment behavior under strong ground shaking.
线性孔隙弹性模型忽略了粘土特有的衰减机制及强震下的非线性沉积物行为。
Explicitly models a moving water table as two distinct air- and water-saturated poroelastic layers using dCS theory, avoiding unrealistic effective-fluid homogenization of partially saturated soils.
用dCS理论将地下水位显式建模为空气和水饱和双层结构，克服了等效流体均匀化方法的局限。

kc: Extended the Knopoff global matrix method to the generalized de la Cruz and Spanos (dCS) poroelasticity theory for layered media.
Explicitly modeled the water table as a sharp interface between air-saturated and water-saturated porous layers rather than using an effective homogeneous fluid.
Demonstrated that vertical ground motion amplification and duration vary non-monotonically with groundwater depth, peaking at intermediate levels (around 75%).
Provided a physics-based explanation for why vertical-to-horizontal (V/H) spectral ratios exceed the conventional 2/3 engineering rule in fluid-stratified soils.
将Knopoff全局矩阵法扩展到层状介质的广义de la Cruz和Spanos（dCS）孔隙弹性理论。
将地下水位明确建模为空气饱和层与水饱和层之间的物理界面，而非使用等效均匀流体近似。
证明垂直地面运动放大倍数和持时随地下水深度呈非单调变化，在中等水位（约75%）达到峰值。
从物理机制上解释了流体分层土壤中垂直与水平（V/H）谱比为何会超过常规的2/3工程经验值。
me: Generalized de la Cruz and Spanos (dCS) poroelasticity theory accounting for solid-frame and filtration displacements and four wave modes (fast/slow P and S).
Poroelastic extension of the Knopoff global matrix method (8N + 2 linear system) with no-slip fluid boundary conditions.
Frequency-domain transfer function computation and time-domain synthesis via inverse Fast Fourier Transform (IFFT).
采用广义de la Cruz和Spanos（dCS）孔隙弹性理论，考虑固体骨架和渗流位移以及四种波模（快/慢P波和S波）。
扩展Knopoff全局矩阵法（构建8N+2线性方程组），并施加流体无滑移边界条件。
计算频域传递函数，并通过逆快速傅里叶变换（IFFT）合成时域地震响应。
de: Geotechnical and mineralogical soil parameters calibrated from the Valley of Mexico (40 m clay-rich porous layer over basaltic half-space).
Strong-motion P-wavelet extracted from the 19 September 2017 Mw 7.1 Puebla-Morelos earthquake recorded at reference bedrock station CUP5.
基于墨西哥谷岩土和矿物学观测校准的土壤参数（玄武岩半空间之上的40米富粘土孔隙层）。
提取自2017年9月19日Mw 7.1 Puebla-Morelos地震在基岩参考台站CUP5记录的强震P波子波。
li: Uses a linear poroelastic formulation that omits clay-specific attenuation mechanisms and nonlinear sediment behavior under strong shaking.
Assumes a simplified 1D/2D planar horizontally stratified geometry without lateral heterogeneities.
采用线性孔隙弹性公式，忽略了粘土特有的衰减机制以及强震下沉积物的非线性行为。
假设了简化的水平成层平面几何结构，未考虑横向非均匀性。

tm.why: The paper directly evaluates site effects, seismic amplification, signal duration, and vertical-to-horizontal spectral ratios in shallow soils under incident P and S waves.
The study models wave scattering across the water table interface and attenuation due to fluid pressure diffusion and slow poroelastic waves.
The authors extend the Knopoff global matrix method to solve the generalized de la Cruz and Spanos (dCS) poroelastic wave propagation equations in layered media.

ev.notes: Full 28-page GJI manuscript PDF including Appendices A and B was analyzed.

sum: Following the 2004 Mw 9.2 Sumatra–Andaman earthquake, the Andaman–Nicobar region has experienced ongoing large-scale postseismic deformation. This study searches 17 years of continuous GPS displacement time series along the Andaman–Nicobar arc for slow slip events (SSEs). By detrending linear and exponential postseismic motions, the authors find no evidence of tectonic SSEs (Mw > 7) across the regional network. However, they report two unprecedented, localized, multi-week horizontal transient excursions in April–June 2020 (~3.5 cm southeast) and June–July 2023 at a single GPS station (HBAY) on Little Andaman Island. Because the displacements almost fully reversed, lacked vertical motion, were absent at neighboring stations, and showed no accompanying seismic tremor, multipath artifacts, or hydrological/atmospheric triggers, a tectonic SSE origin is deemed unlikely. This confirms the regional absence of resolvable short-term SSEs while documenting an enigmatic local deformation transient.
2004年苏门答腊-安达曼大地震后，安达曼-尼科巴地区持续发生大规模震后形变。本研究利用GAMIT软件处理了该地区17年的连续GPS时间序列，通过线性与指数去趋势方法分离瞬态信号以搜寻慢滑移事件（SSE）。结果显示该俯冲带不存在Mw>7的构造慢滑移事件，但发现小安达曼岛HBAY站在2020年4-6月……

t: Processed daily GPS observations in ITRF2014 using GAMIT, subtracted pre-2004 interseismic velocity, and fitted combined linear and exponential functions to detrend non-linear postseismic deformation and isolate transients.
用GAMIT处理ITRF2014下GPS日解，扣除震间速度，结合线性和指数函数去趋势以分离瞬变信号。

17-year continuous GPS displacement time series (2006–2023) across the Andaman–Nicobar islands, supplemented by Hut Bay accelerometer data, Port Blair broadband seismic data, GRACE hydrology, and meteorological records.
安达曼-尼科巴17年连续GPS序列（2006-2023），配合强震仪、宽频带地震、GRACE水文及气象数据。

No megathrust SSEs (Mw > 7) were found, but station HBAY recorded a 3.5±0.7 cm southeastward transient in April–June 2020 and a smaller one in June–July 2023, both largely reversing to initial positions.
未发现Mw>7的慢滑移事件，但HBAY站在2020和2023年记录到3.5±0.7厘米及更小的可恢复东南向瞬变。
The island GPS network is ~100 km landward of the trench and may miss shallow or small SSEs, and the physical cause of the HBAY transients remains unknown.
距海沟约100公里的岛链台网易漏检浅部小SSE，且HBAY瞬变成因不明。
First multi-decade GPS search for SSEs in the Andaman–Nicobar sector and discovery of unprecedented, localized, reversible multi-week horizontal crustal transients at Little Andaman.
首次在安达曼弧段开展近二十年GPS慢滑移搜索，并发现局部可逆水平瞬变信号。

kc: Analyzed 17 years (2006–2023) of continuous GPS data in the Andaman–Nicobar region, confirming the absence of resolvable megathrust slow slip events (Mw > 7).
Identified two anomalous, multi-week, largely recoverable horizontal displacement transients (up to 3.5 cm) in 2020 and 2023 at station HBAY on Little Andaman.
Systematically ruled out multipath errors, hydrological loading, cyclone pressure variations, and seismic swarms/tremors as sources of the HBAY transients.
分析了安达曼-尼科巴地区17年（2006–2023）的连续GPS数据，证实该区缺乏可分辨的俯冲带慢滑移事件（Mw > 7）。
在小安达曼岛HBAY站发现了2020年和2023年两次异常的、持续数周且基本可恢复的水平位移瞬变（最大达3.5厘米）。
系统排除了多路径误差、水文负载、气旋气压变化以及地震群/颤动作为HBAY瞬变源的可能性。
me: Daily GPS data processing in ITRF2014 using GAMIT software and pre-2004 interseismic velocity subtraction.
Time-series detrending using combined linear and exponential decay functions to isolate transient signals from postseismic deformation.
Elastic dislocation modeling (Coulomb 3.3), RINEX quality/multipath analysis (TEQC), GRACE hydrological load estimation, and seismic power spectral density (PSD) analysis.
利用GAMIT软件获取ITRF2014框架下的GPS日解，并扣除2004年之前的震间速度。
结合线性函数与指数衰减函数对时间序列去趋势，从震后形变中分离瞬态运动信号。
开展弹性位错建模（Coulomb 3.3）、RINEX数据质量与多路径分析（TEQC）、GRACE水文负载估算及地震功率谱密度（PSD）分析。
de: Continuous GPS time series (2006–2023) from CSIR-NGRI, IGS, and earlier regional networks across the Andaman–Nicobar Islands.
Strong-motion accelerometer records at Hut Bay (HUTB) and broadband seismic waveforms at Port Blair (~120 km away).
GRACE satellite hydrological estimates, local meteorological daily rainfall, and integrated barometric pressure sensor data at HBAY.
安达曼-尼科巴群岛CSIR-NGRI、IGS及早期区域台网的连续GPS时间序列（2006–2023年）。
Hut Bay（HUTB）强震加速度计记录及距离约120公里的布莱尔港宽频带地震波形数据。
GRACE卫星水文估算数据、当地气象站日降雨量以及HBAY站集成气压传感器数据。
li: Uniform interseismic velocity assumption based solely on pre-2004 campaign data at Port Blair introduces uncertainty in regional postseismic deformation estimates.
Sparse landward island GPS network (~100 km from the trench) cannot detect small-magnitude or shallow trenchward slow slip events.
The physical mechanism driving the recoverable 2020 and 2023 horizontal transients at HBAY remains unexplained.
仅基于布莱尔港2004年前流动观测数据假设弧段震间速度均匀，给区域震后形变估算带来不确定性。
距离海沟约100公里的稀疏岛链GPS台网无法探测小震级或浅部近海沟慢滑移事件。
驱动HBAY站2020年和2023年可恢复水平瞬变的物理机制仍未得到解释。

tm.why: The paper specifically investigates slow slip events (SSEs), postseismic deformation, and transient horizontal displacements along the Sumatra–Andaman subduction zone.
It examines multi-decade postseismic crustal deformation and plate-interface coupling kinematics along the Andaman–Nicobar subduction arc.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 12-page PDF text, metadata, equations, and all 7 main figures.

sum: Plate tectonics is modeled either discretely as rigid spherical polygons meeting at trivalent junctions, or continuously using Bercovici-Wessel smooth shape functions with boundary half-width $\delta^*$. This paper proves a limit theorem formally bridging both frameworks. By generalizing shape functions via signed geodesic distance to remove star-shapedness assumptions, the author shows they converge almost everywhere, exponentially in $1/\delta^*$, to discrete plate indicator functions. Under explicit structural and metric hypotheses (positive reach, separation, bounded junction sectors), the sharp plate mosaic forms a regular trivalent CW decomposition of the sphere. Furthermore, a component-counted weighted Euler characteristic $\chi_w^{\delta^*}(\tau)$ built from level-set covers equals $V - E + F = 2$ for all $\delta^*$ below an explicit threshold $\delta_0(\tau)$. The residual $|\chi_w - 2|$ defines a novel Topological Diffuseness Index (TDI) to audit plate tectonic reconstructions and quantify diffuse plate boundaries.
本文提出了连接离散板块构造与连续形状函数模型的数学极限定理。通过引入符号测地线距离推广Bercovici-Wessel形状函数，证明了当边界半宽$\delta^* \to 0$时，连续场以指数速率几乎处处收敛于离散板块指示函数。在满足正则CW复形、正可达性及几何分离等假设下，基于水平集连通分量计数的……

t: Generalizes Bercovici-Wessel plate shape functions using signed geodesic distance and proves convergence of a component-counted weighted Euler characteristic to V-E+F=2 using positive-reach offset topology and a planar junction comparison lemma.
用符号测地线距离推广板块形状函数，结合正可达偏移拓扑与平面交汇引理证明加权欧拉示性数收敛于2。

Evaluates theoretical geometric constants and topological counts on the deduplicated present-day PB2002 plate boundary network (52 plates, 150 arcs, 100 trivalent junctions) and checks a deep-time reconstruction at 851 Ma.
在PB2002现今板块边界网络（52板块、150弧、100三联点）上测量几何常数，并检验851 Ma重建模型。
Proves that χ_w^(δ*)(τ) = V - E + F = 2 for all δ* < δ_0(τ), and measures a non-vacuous threshold δ_0(0.15) ≈ 2.8 km on the PB2002 network with component counts (52, 150, 100).
证明在δ* < δ_0(τ)时χ_w = V-E+F = 2；测得PB2002网络在τ=0.15时的阈值δ_0 ≈ 2.…
The single-crossing property in the Planar Junction Lemma relies on numerical certification over >10^6 rays rather than a symbolic proof, and δ_0(τ) vanishes linearly as τ approaches 1/3.
平面交汇引理中的单次穿越性质依赖百万条射线的数值认证，尚缺符号证明；τ趋近1/3时δ_0趋于0。

Establishes the first rigorous mathematical limit theorem connecting continuous plate shape functions to the discrete CW topology of plate boundary networks and defines the Topological Diffuseness Index.
首次建立连接连续板块模型与离散边界网络拓扑的严格极限定理，并定义了全新的拓扑弥散指数（TDI）。

kc: Generalizes Bercovici-Wessel plate shape functions using signed geodesic distance, eliminating wedge-shadowing artifacts on concave plates.
Proves almost-everywhere exponential convergence of normalized continuous shape functions to discrete plate indicator functions as boundary half-width approaches zero.
Establishes that the component-counted weighted Euler characteristic on level-set covers exactly equals V - E + F = 2 below an explicit threshold width.
Introduces the Topological Diffuseness Index (TDI) to quantify boundary diffuseness and audit digital plate tectonic reconstructions.
利用符号测地线距离推广了Bercovici-Wessel板块形状函数，消除了凹形板块上的楔形阴影伪影。
证明了当边界半宽趋于零时，归一化连续形状函数以指数速率几乎处处收敛于离散板块指示函数。
证明了在显式阈值宽度以下，基于水平集覆盖连通分量计数的加权欧拉示性数严格等于 V - E + F = 2。
提出了拓扑弥散指数（TDI），用于量化边界弥散度并审计数字板块构造重建模型。
me: Signed geodesic distance parameterization and partition-of-unity normalization for continuous plate shape functions.
Algebraic and differential topology using finite regular trivalent CW complexes, Čech multinerves, and Federer's positive-reach tubular neighborhoods.
Component-counted weighted Euler characteristic and planar blow-up analysis at trivalent junctions (Planar Junction Lemma).
采用符号测地线距离参数化与单位分解归一化构建连续板块形状函数。
结合有限正则三价CW复形、Čech多神经复形及Federer正可达管状邻域理论进行代数与微分拓扑分析。
定义了计入连通分量的加权欧拉示性数，并在三联点处利用平面爆破分析（平面交汇引理）传递拓扑性质。
de: Present-day plate boundary network PB2002 (52 plates, 150 boundary arcs, 100 triple junctions) used to measure geometric constants and verify threshold bounds.
Neoproterozoic-Phanerozoic full-plate reconstruction (Merdith et al., 2021 at 851 Ma) audited to demonstrate detection of annular plate topology violations.
应用现今板块边界网络PB2002（52个板块、150条边界弧、100个三联点）测量几何常数并验证阈值下界。
审计了新元古代—显生宙全板块重建模型（Merdith et al., 2021，851 Ma），展示了对环形板块拓扑违规的检测能力。
li: The single-crossing property on the realizable curve in the Planar Junction Lemma is certified numerically over 10^6 rays rather than by a closed symbolic proof.
The admissible threshold width shrinks linearly to zero as the level-set threshold approaches 1/3.
The Topological Diffuseness Index (TDI) is not proven to be monotone in boundary half-width and can experience integer cancellations.
平面交汇引理中可实现曲线上的单次穿越性质目前通过超过10^6条射线的数值验证，尚缺闭合符号证明。
当水平集阈值趋近于1/3时，容许的半宽阈值线性衰减至零。
拓扑弥散指数（TDI）随边界半宽的单调性未经证明，且可能出现整数相消现象。

tm.why: The paper develops a mathematical limit theorem connecting continuous kinematic models of Earth's lithospheric plates to the discrete topology of plate boundary networks and plate tectonic reconstructions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 27-page preprint PDF. The paper is a purely mathematical and theoretical companion paper containing rigorous proofs and two unnumbered summary tables (on p. 4 and p. 22), with main figures located in the companion paper (Kim, 2026).

sum: Land seismic data in Saudi Arabia often suffer from complex near-surface statics, strong multiples, and aliased surface-wave noise in sparse low-fold surveys. This study presents a comprehensive reprocessing case study of 20 legacy 3D land blocks (19 blocks at ~700 fold, 1 sparse block at 60 fold) targeting Jurassic and Permian hydrocarbon reservoirs. The advanced workflow integrates three core methodologies: (1) first-break travel-time tomography for near-surface velocity modeling and statics correction, replacing legacy two-layer refraction statics; (2) VSP-guided cascaded surface-related and interbed multiple attenuation; and (3) 5D Full Wavefield Regularization (FWR) to simultaneously interpolate reflection and surface wavefields for de-aliased noise suppression in the sparse block. Results demonstrate a shift in statics range from -30..-60 ms to -80..-130 ms, a 10 dB bandwidth boost across 25–80 Hz, and a five-fold signal-to-noise ratio improvement, unifying two small closures into a larger, drilling-validated hydrocarbon trap.
沙特陆上地震数据常受复杂近地表静校正、多次波及低覆盖稀疏采集混叠噪声困扰。本研究对20个旧三维区块（含1个60次覆盖稀疏区块）开展了重处理研究，旨在刻画侏罗系和二叠系储层。新流程集成了三项关键技术：利用初至走时层析成像替代传统双层折射静校正；采用零偏VSP引导的自由表面与层间多次波级联衰减；应用五维……

t: Combines first-break travel-time tomography for near-surface statics, VSP-guided cascaded surface and internal multiple attenuation, and 5D full-wavefield regularization (FWR) using anti-leakage Fourier transforms to suppress aliased surface-wave noise in sparse blocks.
结合初至走时层析静校正、VSP引导级联多次波衰减及五维全波场规则化（FWR）压制稀疏区块混叠面波噪声。

Twenty 3D seismic blocks in east-central Saudi Arabia (19 blocks ~700 average fold; Block 09 sparse at 60 fold) plus a zero-offset vibroseis VSP (6–118 Hz sweep) targeting Jurassic and Permian reservoirs.
沙特中东部20个三维地震区块（19个平均约700次覆盖，1个60次稀疏覆盖）及一口零偏VSP数据。

Tomographic statics shifted time corrections from -30..-60 ms to -80..-130 ms, boosted the 25–80 Hz frequency bandwidth by 10 dB, increased overall S/N five-fold (from 1 to 5), and revealed a larger unified structural trap.
静校正量由-30..-60 ms增至-80..-130 ms，25–80 Hz频宽提升10 dB，信噪比提升5倍并揭示统…

Two-layer refraction statics fail with velocity inversions and 4 km uphole spacing, while conventional 5D reflection wavefield regularization (RWR) aliases surface-wave noise in sparse land geometries.
双层折射静校正无法处理速度反转，且传统五维反射波规则化（RWR）在稀疏采集中会导致面波混叠。

Integrates tomographic statics, VSP-guided internal/surface demultiple, and 5D full-wavefield regularization across a 20-block mega-merge, successfully regularizing a 60-fold sparse block to 640 fold and validating new hydrocarbon reserves.
在20个区块大拼接中集成层析静校正、VSP引导去多次波与5D FWR，将60次稀疏区块规则化至640次并获钻井验证。

kc: Replaced legacy two-layer refraction statics with first-break travel-time tomography, shifting static corrections from -30..-60 ms to -80..-130 ms and resolving structural undulations.
Implemented a VSP-guided demultiple workflow combining time-frequency median filtering, Radon transform, and wave-equation internal multiple prediction with adaptive subtraction.
Applied 5D Full Wavefield Regularization (FWR) to a 60-fold sparse seismic block, increasing nominal fold to 640 and improving average S/N ratio from 1.3 (RWR) to 2.2.
Achieved a 10 dB boost in the 25–80 Hz frequency band and a 5-fold overall S/N ratio improvement, revealing a unified wider structural closure validated by post-drilling.
用初至走时层析静校正替代传统双层折射静校正，使静校正量从-30..-60 ms变为-80..-130 ms，消除了构造假象。
实施了VSP引导的多次波衰减流程，结合时频中值滤波、Radon变换及波动方程层间多次波预测与自适应相减。
对60次覆盖稀疏区块应用五维全波场规则化（FWR），将覆盖次数提升至640次，平均信噪比从1.3提升至2.2。
在25–80 Hz频段实现10 dB能量提升，整体信噪比提高5倍，揭示了更宽大的统一构造圈闭并获钻后验证。
me: First-break travel-time tomography using iterative ray tracing and model reconstruction for near-surface static corrections.
Zero-offset VSP wavefield separation (FK median filtering) and deterministic deconvolution (STD and TTD) to extract surface-related (SRM) and interbed multiples (IRM).

Cascaded demultiple workflow using nonlinear time-frequency filtering for near offsets, kinematic SRM prediction, velocity-dependent Radon filtering, and horizon-guided internal multiple adaptive subtraction.
5D Full Wavefield Regularization (FWR) using anti-alias anti-leakage Fourier transform across CMP-X, CMP-Y, XL-OFF, IL-OFF, and time to regularize both reflection and surface waves.
基于迭代射线追踪与模型重构的初至走时层析成像近地表静校正方法。
利用零偏VSP波场分离（FK中值滤波）和确定性反褶积（单道参考STD和逐道TTD）提取自由表面多次波（SRM）和层间多次波（IRM）。
级联多次波衰减：近偏移距非线性时频滤波、运动学SRM预测、速度相关Radon滤波及层位引导的层间多次波预测与自适应相减。
五维全波场规则化（FWR）：在CMP-X、CMP-Y、XL-OFF、IL-OFF及时间域使用抗混叠抗泄漏傅里叶变换同步规则化反射波与面波。
de: 20 merged 3D land seismic blocks in east-central Saudi Arabia (19 blocks with ~480–972 nominal fold; Block 09 sparse with 60 nominal fold, 480 m source line spacing, 720 m receiver line spacing).
Single-well zero-offset VSP acquired with a vibroseis source (200 ft offset, 6–118 Hz linear sweep, 2 ms sample rate, 16 s sweep, 22.1 s record length).
Target geological formations: Late Jurassic anhydrite/carbonate shelf reservoir (Target 1) and Early Permian aeolian/fluvial clastic reservoir (Target 2).
沙特中东部20个拼接三维陆上地震区块（19个区块名义覆盖次数480–972；09号稀疏区块仅60次覆盖，炮线距480 m，检波线距720 m）。
单井零偏VSP数据，采用可控震源采集（井源距200英尺，6–118 Hz线性扫描，采样率2 ms，扫描长度16 s，记录长度22.1 s）。
目标储层：晚侏罗世硬石膏/碳酸盐岩陆棚储层（目标1）和早二叠世风成/河流相碎屑岩储层（目标2）。
li: Legacy 2-layer refraction statics fail under velocity inversions and rely on sparse 4 km uphole spacing that aliases high-frequency topography.
Conventional 5D Reflection Wavefield Regularization (RWR) smears and aliases surface-wave noise when applied to sparse low-fold land data.
Underlying field seismic datasets from Saudi Aramco are proprietary and not publicly accessible.
传统双层折射静校正无法处理速度反转，且受限于4 km稀疏微测井间距，导致高频地形变化混叠。
传统五维反射波场规则化（RWR）在处理稀疏低覆盖陆上数据时会导致面波噪声涂抹和混叠。
研究所用的沙特阿美油田实际地震数据受商业保密限制，无法公开获取。

sum: This paper presents a network-based coherence method, a simple cross-spectral technique applicable to seismic and acoustic networks, to enhance coherent signals and suppress individual sensor noise. It also introduces a phase-based acoustic source localization method using interstation phase differences for non-impulsive signals. The authors demonstrate these methods using data from Mount Spurr, Alaska, where seismic network coherence reveals weak, ephemeral tremor during 2024–2025 unrest, and from the I53US infrasound array, where array coherence identifies monochromatic and frequency-gliding noise, attributing a ~2 Hz signal to a nearby power plant. These methods serve as valuable tools for data quality control, volcano monitoring, and noise assessment.
本文提出基于台网相干性的跨谱方法，通过增强多台站相干信号检测微弱地震声学源，并引入利用相位差定位非脉冲信号的方法。在Spurr火山应用中，该方法揭示了活跃期的微弱震颤；在I53US次声台阵中，成功识别出单频和扫频噪声，并将约2 Hz of的持续信号定位至附近发电厂。该方法适用于数据质控、火山监测和噪……

sum: Tsunami fragility functions link hazard intensity to building risk, yet rarely handle disaggregated predictions or uncertainty propagation. This paper proposes a Bayesian ordinal regression model trained via variational inference to estimate building-level damage states (Survived, Damaged, Destroyed) and their 95% credible intervals. Using 2011 Tohoku Earthquake and Tsunami survey data, the model combines maximum inundation depth with engineered spatial proxies for terrain traversal cost, land-use roughness (via Dijkstra's algorithm), and wood/non-wood building shielding. Generalization is tested across three out-of-distribution case studies: Ishinomaki (2011 Tohoku, weighted F1 = 0.755), Ukai Town (2024 Noto Peninsula, F1 = 0.593), and Palu City (2018 Sulawesi, F1 = 0.764). Results show strong spatial generalization within the same event, whereas exogenous events exhibit higher uncertainty and misclassifications driven by omitted multi-hazard processes such as prior seismic shaking, coastal collapse, and regional building code variations.

sum: This study utilizes deep learning and a dense Large-N seismic array to construct an enhanced, high-resolution earthquake catalog for an active saltwater-disposal region in Oklahoma. The authors identify four persistent, low-magnitude (ML = -0.69 to 2.83) seismic clusters near mapped faults. By analyzing local injection histories, they find that wells within 8–10 km exhibit strong short-term temporal correlation with seismicity, independent of injection rate or well distance. The study demonstrates how high-resolution catalogs can capture short-term variations in seismic response that regional networks miss, suggesting that temporal similarity metrics can complement traditional injection-rate and distance criteria for monitoring and mitigating induced seismicity.
本研究利用深度学习和密集台阵构建了俄克拉荷马州废水注入区的高分辨率地震目录。研究识别出四个持续活动的低震级（ML = -0.69 至 2.83）地震群。分析表明，8-10公里范围内的注水井与地震活动具有强烈的短期时间相关性，且该相关性与平均注入速率或距离无关。这表明高分辨率目录能捕捉到区域台网无法解……

sum: This study investigates the link between forearc seismic structure and megathrust behavior between 43.6°N and 45.2°N in central Cascadia, where low plate coupling and elevated microseismicity occur. Integrating over three decades of amphibious controlled-source seismic experiments (1989, 1996, 2012, and 2021 CASIE21/Cascadia2021), the authors invert ~418,500 Pg/Pn and ~76,300 PmP travel-time picks for 3D P-wave velocity structure and subducting slab Moho geometry. The model resolves along-strike variations in the Siletz terrane backstop, a 50-km-long high-velocity mafic dike, low-velocity zones along the Alvin Canyon Fault, and nine circular high-velocity anomalies atop the subducting slab interpreted as seamounts. Moho depth varies across the Alvin Canyon Fault and deflects ~1.5 km beneath the upper-plate dike load. The authors conclude that subducted seamounts and slab offsets roughen the plate interface, driving slope failures, localized seismicity clusters, elevated fluid pressures, lower plate coupling, and persistent megathrust rupture barriers.
本研究利用1989至2021年间四次海陆联测主动源地震实验数据（约41.85万个Pg/Pn和7.63万个PmP走时），反演了中卡斯卡迪亚弧前（43.6°N–45.2°N）的三维P波速度结构与俯冲板片莫霍面形态。模型揭示了Siletz地体后挡板几何形态的变化、长约50 km的高速基性岩脉、沿Alvin……

t: Joint 3D tomographic inversion of Pg, Pn, and PmP travel times for P-wave slowness and subducting Moho depth using shortest-path ray tracing (500 m grid, 100 m water grid) and jumping inversion (1 km grid).
利用最短路径射线追踪与跳跃反演法，联合反演Pg、Pn和PmP走时以获取三维P波速度与俯冲莫霍面深度。

Over three decades of active-source shore-crossing seismic data (1989, 1996, 2012, 2021 CASIE21 OBS and Cascadia2021 nodes), totaling ~418,500 Pg/Pn and ~76,300 PmP picks, including >388,000 new picks.

After 8 iterations, RMS misfits dropped to 142 ms (Pg), 140 ms (Pn), and 130 ms (PmP), resolving 9 subducting seamounts, a 50-km-long mafic dike, Alvin Canyon Fault low-Vp zones, and ~1.5 km Moho deflection.

Tomography lacks vertical resolution to separate the megathrust from the slab crust top (~1 km apart), and smoothing smears 1-km-tall seamounts vertically up to three times their initial height.

将粗糙的俯冲界面地形和断层错动与孔隙流体压力变化、板块闭锁减弱、无震蠕滑以及44.5°N附近的持久巨型逆冲破裂分段边界联系起来。

sum: This paper presents an automated workflow for 3D near-surface imaging of railway tracks using passing trains as seismic sources. To handle the complex moving source, the method filters cross-correlations based on the angle relative to the train's path, separating cases where the train is near or far from a dense 2D seismic array. Local dispersion curves are extracted from array subsets (patches) using Matched Field Processing. This approach yields broadband Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves extending above 70 Hz, providing high-resolution 3D phase velocity models of the near-surface (down to ~1 m depth). The method successfully images variations in the ballast layer, demonstrating its utility for monitoring critical railway infrastructure.
本文提出利用通过列车作为震源对铁路下方进行三维浅地表成像的自动工作流。该方法根据夹角筛选互相关，区分列车远近情况，并利用匹配场处理提取台阵子集的局部频散曲线。该方法获得了超70 Hz的高频雷利波频散曲线，构建了约1米深的高分辨率三维速度模型，成功重建了道砟层厚度变化，适用于铁路基础设施监测。

sum: Low-frequency earthquakes (LFEs) are challenging to detect due to emergent onsets and low signal-to-noise ratios, especially offshore. This study develops a multi-station deep learning framework based on a modified 1-D U-Net architecture trained on 50,100 curated LFEs from six global tectonic regions (Nankai, Hikurangi, Cascadia, Parkfield, Alaska, and Mexico). Raw three-component waveforms are decomposed into logarithmic amplitude and sign (polarity) channels, while emergent arrival uncertainties are modeled using probabilistic Gaussian labels (sigma = 0.2 s). Station features are extracted via shared-weight encoders and combined via mask-aware arithmetic averaging across up to six stations. Evaluated on family-split held-out test sets, the model achieves F1-scores between 0.70 and 0.91 across regions. When calibrated and applied to continuous ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data in the Guerrero seismic gap, the workflow recovers 21 matched-filter cataloged LFEs and identifies 25 new offshore candidates located within a negative residual gravity anomaly.
针对低频地震（LFE）初至缓慢及信噪比低导致的检测难题，本文提出一种基于改进U-Net的多台站深度学习检测框架。研究汇编了全球六个构造区（南海海槽、希库朗伊、卡斯卡迪亚、帕克菲尔德、阿拉斯加和墨西哥）共50,100个LFE事件，将三分量波形分解为对数振幅和符号相位通道，并采用高斯概率标签（σ=0.2……

t: A modified 1-D U-Net processes dual-channel (log-amplitude and sign) three-component waveforms from up to six stations via shared-weight encoders and mask-aware arithmetic mean fusion, trained with probabilistic Gaussian arrival labels (sigma = 0.2 s).
采用共享权重1D编码器与掩码感知算术平均融合多达6台站的对数振幅与符号双通道波形，结合高斯标签训练U-Net。

Demonstrated via ablation experiments in Hikurangi that Gaussian labeling and multi-station fusion progressively improve F1-score from 0.69 to 0.83.
Detected 21 previously cataloged LFEs and 25 new offshore LFE candidates from continuous OBS records in the Guerrero seismic gap, validated by spectral and synthetic comparisons.

构建了改进型U-Net架构，结合对数振幅与符号相位分解、高斯概率标签（σ=0.2 s）以及最多6个台站的掩码感知特征融合策略。

tm.why: The paper develops a modified multi-station U-Net deep learning architecture with probabilistic Gaussian labels and log-amplitude/sign feature transformation for detecting low-frequency earthquakes.
The core objective is automated detection and cataloging of low-frequency earthquakes from continuous seismic data, recovering 21 cataloged events and identifying 25 new offshore candidates.
The study specifically targets low-frequency earthquakes (LFEs), a key member of the slow earthquake family occurring along subduction zones and plate boundaries.

sum: In Bayesian inverse problems, direct conditional generative models trained on paired data often under-represent posterior variability, leading to mode collapse or artificial transitions. This paper proposes joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching formulation that learns a continuous transport from an augmented source state (Gaussian reference coordinate zx, observation y) to an augmented terminal state (target x, Gaussian likelihood-side residual coordinate zy). Rather than replacing target uncertainty, zy gives the transport an observation-side degree of freedom that couples generated samples to observation consistency while preserving variability in weakly constrained directions. The authors theoretically establish topological obstructions for direct conditional flows and validate joint twist-flow on 2D multimodal toy benchmarks against MCMC, CelebA image restoration tasks, and 2D seismic velocity-model inversion conditioned on reverse-time migration (RTM) images simulated from the Compass model. Results demonstrate significantly improved posterior support coverage and realistic geological uncertainty without sacrificing observation consistency.
针对贝叶斯反问题中直接条件生成模型在配对训练下易丢失后验多样性与模态坍塌的问题，本文提出联合扭转流（joint twist-flow）增强流匹配方法。该方法学习从增强源状态（高斯参考坐标zx，观测y）到增强终端状态（目标变量x，高斯似然侧残差坐标zy）的连续传输，赋予传输观测侧自由度以耦合观测一致性……

t: Joint twist-flow learns a continuous velocity field via flow matching that transports an augmented source state (Gaussian noise zx, observation y) to an augmented terminal state (target x, Gaussian likelihood-side coordinate zy).
通过流匹配学习连续速度场，将增强源状态(zx, y)传输至包含似然侧残差坐标的终端状态(x, zy)。

Evaluated on 2D analytical multimodal priors against MCMC, CelebA 64x64 image restoration tasks, and 800 2D velocity slices (6.4 km by 3.2 km) from the 3D Compass synthetic seismic dataset paired with noisy RTM images.
采用二维多模态解析先验、CelebA图像数据集及3D Compass模型800个二维地震速度与RTM切片。

Joint twist-flow reduces Wasserstein and KS distances on 2D multimodal benchmarks, increases diversity in weakly constrained image components, and improves seismic shot-record coverage from 89.8% to 95.3% with comparable posterior-mean RMSE (0.0921 vs 0.0919).
显著降低二维基准W1与KS距离，在保持后验均值精度(RMSE 0.0921)的同时将地震道集覆盖率提升至95.3%。

Generated samples are not guaranteed to achieve perfect posterior calibration in all high-dimensional settings, and the observation-side scale parameter sigma_y is currently fixed rather than adaptive.

Introduces an augmented flow-matching state coupling target generation with a likelihood-side residual coordinate zy, overcoming the topological connectedness obstruction of one-way conditional flow decoders.

kc: Proposes joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching parameterization (zx, y) -> (x, zy) for amortized fixed-observation posterior sampling.
Formulates a continuous-time flow-matching objective on the augmented state and interprets the auxiliary coordinate zy as a likelihood-side residual coordinate.
Formalizes topological obstructions (mode dropping, spurious bridges, off-support mass) for direct conditional transport under disconnected multimodal posteriors.
Demonstrates superior posterior support preservation and uncertainty quantification on 2D toy problems, image restoration, and RTM-conditioned seismic velocity inversion.
提出联合扭转流（joint twist-flow），通过增强流匹配参数化 (zx, y) -> (x, zy) 实现固定观测下的摊销后验采样。
构建了增强状态上的连续时间流匹配目标函数，并将辅助坐标 zy 解释为与观测一致性相关的似然侧残差坐标。
从理论上形式化了非单射反问题产生不连通多模态后验时，直接条件传输不可避免的三类拓扑失效模式。
在二维多模态玩具问题、图像恢复及基于RTM图像的地震速度模型反演中验证了该方法对后验支撑集和结构化不确定性的保持能力。
me: Augmented continuous-time flow matching learning a velocity field transporting s0 = (zx, y) to s1 = (x, zy) along linear probability paths.
Theoretical topological analysis of conditional fiber maps and least-squares residual energy interpretation of invertible endpoint maps.
U-Net velocity field parameterization integrated via Euler ODE solver over t in [0, 1] for posterior sample generation.
Acoustic wave-equation forward modeling and linearized Born adjoint reverse-time migration (RTM) using Devito and JUDI.jl.
增强连续时间流匹配：沿线性插值概率路径学习将 s0 = (zx, y) 传输至 s1 = (x, zy) 的联合速度场。
条件纤维映射的拓扑阻碍理论分析，以及可逆端点映射的增广最小二乘残差能量解释。

CelebA 64x64 image restoration under three degradation operators: Fourier low-pass filtering, Gaussian blur-downsampling, and center blur-masking.

2D seismic velocity inversion using 800 slices (6.4 km x 3.2 km, 512x256 grid) from the 3D Compass synthetic dataset with 64 sources, 512 receivers, 15 Hz Ricker wavelet, and 12 dB SNR Gaussian noise.
具有标量非线性观测的二维解析先验玩具反问题（双月、圆环、三角簇），并与MALA MCMC参考后验样本进行定量对比。
CelebA 64x64人脸图像在傅里叶低通滤波、高斯模糊下采样和中心模糊掩码三种退化算子下的图像恢复实验。
基于3D Compass合成数据集800个二维切片（6.4 km × 3.2 km，512×256网格，64炮、512检波器、15 Hz雷克子波、12 dB信噪比）的RTM条件化地震速度反演。

在高维反问题中，生成的后验样本集尚未建立完美的概率校准保证，不能直接作为高风险工程决策的唯一依据。

tm.why: The paper develops an amortized posterior sampler for Bayesian inverse problems that prevents undercoverage and preserves multimodal posterior variability.
It introduces a continuous-time generative flow-matching neural architecture and applies it to 2D seismic subsurface velocity-model inversion conditioned on RTM images.
The work formalizes topological obstructions in direct conditional transport for non-injective inverse problems and provides a least-squares residual interpretation of augmented transport.

sum: This study compiles paleoseismic data from 20 active fault segments in Yunnan, China, to characterize major earthquake recurrence patterns and estimate time-dependent probabilities. By fitting the data to four renewal models (including Weibull and lognormal), the authors calculate the probability of a major earthquake occurring within the next 30 years. They find that approximately half of the segments exhibit quasi-periodic recurrence, with the Weibull model providing the best fit overall. Five segments are identified as having relatively high earthquake probabilities, corresponding to earlier expected next-event times. The study provides a long-timescale baseline for seismic hazard assessment in Yunnan, though it operates under simplified assumptions that exclude multisegment ruptures and stress interactions.
本研究收集云南20个活动断裂段的古地震数据，利用四种更新过程模型拟合复发时间，计算了未来30年大地震的时变概率。结果显示，约半数断裂段呈准周期性复发，Weibull模型拟合效果最好。研究识别出5个高发震概率断裂段，其下一次地震预期时间较早。该成果为云南地震危险性评估提供了长期尺度基准，但未考虑多断层……

t: Fitting paleoseismic recurrence interval data from 20 fault segments using four types of renewal processes to estimate time-dependent earthquake probabilities.
利用四种更新过程模型拟合古地震复发间隔数据以估算时变发震概率。
Paleoseismic recurrence interval data compiled from 20 active fault segments in Yunnan Province, China.
收集自中国云南省20个活动断裂段的古地震复发时间数据。
Approximately half of the segments show quasi-periodic recurrence, with Weibull being the best-fit model, and five segments showing relatively high 30-year earthquake probabilities.
约半数断裂段呈准周期性复发，Weibull为最佳模型，5个断裂段概率较高。
The analysis uses restrictive assumptions, neglecting multisegment ruptures, stress interactions, and magnitude-specific modeling.
采用简化假设，未考虑多断层破裂、应力相互作用及震级建模。
First systematic comparison of multiple renewal models and time-dependent probability estimations across 20 active fault segments in Yunnan.
首次系统对比多种更新模型并估算云南20个活动断裂段的时变概率。

kc: Compiled paleoseismic recurrence data for 20 active fault segments in Yunnan, China.
Evaluated and compared four renewal process models, finding Weibull to be the best-performing model.
Calculated 30-year time-dependent earthquake probabilities and estimated next-event time distributions for each segment.
收集并整理了中国云南省20个活动断裂段的古地震复发数据。
评估并对比了四种更新过程模型，发现Weibull模型表现最好。
计算了各断裂段未来30年的时变发震概率，并估算了下一次地震的时间分布。
me: Renewal process modeling (Weibull, lognormal, and other renewal models).
Time-dependent probability calculation for a 30-year forecasting window.
更新过程建模（Weibull、对数正态及其他更新模型）。
针对30年预测窗口的时变概率计算。
de: Paleoseismic recurrence interval data from 20 active fault segments in Yunnan Province, China.
来自中国云南省20个活动断裂段的古地震复发间隔数据。

Does not account for stress interactions between faults.
Does not incorporate magnitude-specific modeling.

sum: This study investigates the temporal gap between the initiation of subduction and the subsequent onset of arc volcanism using advanced two-phase flow numerical modeling. By simulating the coupled dynamics of solid rock deformation and melt migration, the authors explore how various parameters, such as subduction velocity, slab dip angle, and volatile content, control the time lag. The modeling results provide quantitative constraints on the transport rates of fluids and melts from the dehydrating slab to the overriding crust, shedding light on the early-stage evolution of subduction zones and the mechanisms triggering initial arc magmatism.
本研究利用先进的双相流数值模拟方法，探讨了俯冲启动与随后弧火山作用开始之间的时滞。通过模拟固体岩石变形与熔体运移的耦合动力学过程，作者研究了俯冲速度、板块倾角和挥发分含量等不同参数对时滞的控制作用。模拟结果定量约束了流体和熔体从脱水板块向覆侧地壳的运移速率，揭示了俯冲带早期演化阶段的特征以及触发初始……

t: Two-phase flow numerical modeling of coupled solid deformation and melt/fluid migration in subduction zones.
俯冲带中固体变形与熔体/流体运移耦合的双相流数值模拟。
Synthetic numerical simulations with varying subduction parameters such as velocity, slab age, and volatile content.
改变俯冲速度、板块年龄和挥发分含量等俯冲参数的合成数值模拟。
Quantitative determination of the time lag between subduction initiation and the onset of arc volcanism.
定量确定了俯冲启动与弧火山作用开始之间的时滞。
Simplified 2D geometry and idealized mantle wedge chemistry.
简化的二维几何结构和理想化的地幔楔化学成分。
First systematic quantification of the volcanic time lag using coupled two-phase flow dynamics.
首次利用耦合双相流动力学系统定量化研究火山时滞。

kc: Investigates the time lag between subduction initiation and arc volcanism using 2D/3D two-phase flow numerical models.
Quantifies the influence of subduction parameters (e.g., speed, dip angle, thermal state) on melt generation and migration timescales.
Provides a physical mechanism for the delayed onset of initial arc magmatism in young subduction zones.
利用二维/三维双相流数值模型研究了俯冲启动与弧火山作用之间的时滞。
定量分析了俯冲参数（如速度、倾角、热状态）对熔体产生和运移时间尺度的影响。
为年轻俯冲带中初始弧岩浆作用的延迟发生提供了物理机制。
me: Two-phase flow numerical modeling coupling solid matrix deformation and magma/fluid migration.
Thermodynamic modeling of slab dehydration and mantle wedge melting.
耦合固体基质变形与岩浆/流体运移的双相流数值模拟。
板块脱水和地幔楔熔融的热力学模拟。
de: Synthetic numerical experiments varying subduction velocity, slab age, and volatile content.
改变俯冲速度、板块年龄和挥发分含量的合成数值实验。
li: Simplified geometry and potential omission of complex 3D toroidal flow or highly heterogeneous mantle chemistry.
简化的几何结构，且可能忽略了复杂的三维环流或高度非均匀的地幔化学成分。

tm.why: The paper uses numerical modeling to investigate the geodynamic processes of subduction initiation and the resulting arc volcanism.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors' known research profiles, and general geodynamic modeling concepts.

sum: This paper presents an unsupervised deep learning framework for five-dimensional (5D) seismic data reconstruction. The method integrates implicit neural representation (INR) with a Transformer backbone and short-time Fourier transform (STFT) based time-frequency feature learning. By parameterizing the seismic wavefield as a continuous mapping from 4D spatial coordinates to amplitudes, and using a novel 4D positional encoding scheme, the model captures global long-range dependencies and high-dimensional spatial structures. It predicts real and imaginary components of the time-frequency spectrum, reconstructing waveforms via inverse STFT. Tested on synthetic and field 5D datasets, the proposed method outperforms conventional methods (POCS, damped rank reduction) and baseline INR approaches in recovering amplitude, phase, and azimuthal anisotropy without requiring labeled training data.
本文提出一种用于五维（5D）地震数据规则化重建的无监督深度学习框架。该方法将隐式神经表示（INR）与Transformer架构以及基于短时傅里叶变换（STFT）的时频特征学习相结合。通过将地震波场参数化为从4D空间坐标到振幅的连续映射，并设计新型4D位置编码，该模型能有效捕获全局长程依赖和高维空间结……

t: An unsupervised framework combining implicit neural representation, a Transformer backbone, and STFT-based time-frequency learning to map 4D spatial coordinates to seismic amplitudes.
结合隐式神经表示、Transformer骨干网络和基于STFT的时频学习的无监督框架，将4D空间坐标映射为地震振幅。
Synthetic 5D seismic data and field 5D seismic data with irregular spatial sampling geometries.
具有不规则空间采样几何分布的合成5D地震数据和实际野外5D地震数据。
Achieved lower normalized root-mean-square errors and superior reconstruction of reflection structures, spectra, and azimuthal anisotropy compared to POCS and rank-reduction methods.
相比于POCS和降秩方法，实现了更低的归一化均方根误差，并更优地重建了反射结构、频谱和方位各向异性。
Introduces a small incremental computational cost due to the inverse short-time Fourier transform (ISTFT) workload.
由于引入了逆短时傅里叶变换（ISTFT）计算，带来了一定的额外计算开销。
Integrates 4D positional encoding in a coordinate-guided Transformer with STFT-based spectral prediction for self-supervised 5D seismic reconstruction.
将4D位置编码引入坐标引导的Transformer中，并结合基于STFT的谱预测，实现了自监督5D地震数据重建。

kc: Developed an unsupervised deep learning framework for 5D seismic data reconstruction integrating implicit neural representation and Transformers.
Designed a novel 4D positional encoding scheme extending sinusoidal Transformers to shot and receiver coordinates.
Incorporated STFT-based time-frequency feature learning to improve spectral recovery and amplitude-phase consistency.
开发了一种结合隐式神经表示与Transformer的无监督深度学习5D地震数据重建框架。
设计了一种新型4D位置编码方案，将正弦Transformer扩展到炮点和检波点坐标。
引入了基于STFT的时频特征学习，以提高频谱恢复和幅相一致性。
me: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) mapping 4D spatial coordinates to seismic amplitudes.
Transformer backbone with self-attention for capturing global long-range dependencies.
Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) and Inverse STFT (ISTFT) for spectral-domain prediction.
将4D空间坐标映射到地震振幅的隐式神经表示（INR）。
利用自注意力机制捕获全局长程依赖关系的Transformer骨干网络。
用于谱域预测的短时傅里叶变换（STFT）和逆短时傅里叶变换（ISTFT）。

Field 5D seismic data to evaluate amplitude, phase, and azimuthal anisotropy recovery.

tm.why: The paper proposes an unsupervised deep learning framework integrating implicit neural representation and a Transformer backbone for seismic data reconstruction.
Seismic data regularization and reconstruction from irregular spatial sampling is a classic geophysical inverse problem.
