sum: Slow slip events (SSEs) occur near or overlap with megathrust earthquake zones, yet their mutual stress interactions throughout the seismic cycle remain poorly quantified. This study develops a 3-D non-planar rate-and-state friction model of the Costa Rica subduction zone, constrained by GPS inversions of 10 SSEs (2003–2019) and the 2012 Mw 7.6 Nicoya earthquake. The model successfully reproduces northern, southern, and shallow SSE patches surrounding the locked seismogenic zone. Results reveal a reciprocal stress transfer mechanism: SSEs episodically load the earthquake patch by ~0.01–0.05 MPa toward failure, while decadal-scale preslip unlocking of the earthquake patch late in the interseismic period transfers stress back onto adjacent SSE zones. Consequently, late-cycle SSEs exhibit substantially higher peak slip velocities, larger stress drops, and greater cumulative slip without large changes in duration or recurrence interval. Systematically tracking SSE source variations may thus provide an observational proxy for long-term megathrust unlocking.
本研究针对哥斯达黎加俯冲带构建了基于速率-状态摩擦定律的三维非平面断层地震与慢滑移事件（SSE）序列模型，并利用2003至2019年间10次SSE及2012年Mw 7.6尼科亚地震的GPS反演数据对摩擦参数进行约束。模型重现了环绕孕震区的北部、南部和浅部SSE斑块特征。结果表明，快慢滑移间存在双向应……

t: 3-D non-planar quasi-dynamic earthquake and slow slip sequence modeling using a triangular boundary integral element method within the rate-and-state friction framework.
采用基于速率-状态摩擦定律的三维非平面三角形边界积分方程法模拟慢滑移与地震序列。
Model parameters are calibrated using GPS and seismic slip inversions of 10 SSE episodes from 2002 to 2019 and the 2012 Mw 7.6 Nicoya earthquake on the Slab 2.0 fault geometry.
基于Slab 2.0几何模型，利用2002–2019年10次SSE和2012年Mw 7.6地震的GPS及地震反演数据标定…

Northern and shallow SSEs exhibit substantially higher peak slip velocities, larger slip, and greater stress drops late in the interseismic period due to ~0.7 m decadal preslip unlocking on the earthquake patch, while loading ~0.05 MPa onto the seismogenic zone.
震间晚期地震斑块预滑解锁使北部和浅部SSE峰值速率、滑动量及应力降显著增加，且SSE向地震区加载约0.05 MPa应力。

Assumes linear (a-b) scaling, constant normal stress across SSE patches with an abrupt boundary contrast, omits seamount roughness, and underestimates late-stage earthquake zone locking rate relative to geodetic inversions.
假设(a-b)线性分布与正应力突变边界，忽略海山粗糙度，且模拟的震间晚期孕震区闭锁率偏低。
First data-constrained 3-D model quantifying reciprocal stress interactions between multiple surrounding SSE patches and a megathrust earthquake zone throughout the Costa Rica seismic cycle.
首次建立受观测约束的三维模型，定量揭示哥斯达黎加俯冲带多斑块SSE与大地震间的双向应力调制机制。

kc: Developed a data-constrained 3-D non-planar earthquake and SSE sequence model for the Costa Rica subduction zone reproducing northern, southern, and shallow SSE patches alongside Mw 7.6 earthquakes.
Demonstrated that decadal-scale preslip unlocking of the megathrust earthquake patch late in the cycle increases peak slip velocity, stress drop, and cumulative slip of nearby SSEs.
Quantified episodic SSE stress loading (~0.01–0.05 MPa) onto the seismogenic patch, showing it drives fault stress to its peak value prior to nucleation.
建立了受观测约束的哥斯达黎加俯冲带三维非平面地震与慢滑移序列模型，成功重现了环绕Mw 7.6地震破裂区的北、南及浅部SSE斑块。
证明了震间晚期大地震斑块的十年尺度预滑解锁过程会增大邻近SSE的峰值滑动速率、应力降和累积滑动量。
量化了SSE对孕震斑块的周期性应力加载（约0.01–0.05 MPa），揭示其在震前将断层平均应力推至峰值并促进地震成核的作用。
me: 3-D non-planar quasi-dynamic boundary integral element modeling (TriBIE) using triangular elements (~1 km grid size) based on Slab 2.0 geometry.

Rate-and-state friction law coupled with radiation damping approximation, parameterized with spatial variations in (a-b) and effective normal stress contrast (3.5 MPa for SSEs vs. 55 MPa for the earthquake patch).
基于Slab 2.0断层几何与三角形网格（平均网格约1 km）的三维非平面准动态边界积分方程模拟（TriBIE）。
耦合辐射阻尼近似的速率-状态摩擦定律，结合空间变化的摩擦参数(a-b)以及SSE区（3.5 MPa）与地震区（55 MPa）的有效正应力对比。
de: GPS and seismic slip inversion results of 10 SSE episodes between 2002 and 2019 and the 2012 Mw 7.6 Nicoya earthquake used to calibrate friction parameters.
Multi-cycle numerical simulations analyzed over a representative 55-year interseismic period (t = 67–122 yr) divided into early and late stages.
利用2002至2019年间10次SSE事件及2012年Mw 7.6尼科亚地震的GPS与地震滑动反演结果标定断层摩擦参数。
对代表性55年震间期（t = 67–122年，划分为早期和晚期阶段）开展多周期数值模拟与源参数对比分析。
li: Assumed a linear relationship between friction parameter (a-b) and average observed SSE slip, neglecting sediment heterogeneity and normal-stress dependence.
Prescribed an abrupt effective normal stress contrast between SSE and earthquake patches and omitted subducting seamount roughness, resulting in overly concentrated slip in the southern SSE patch.
The chosen nucleation size (h* = 15 km) produces a lower late-stage inter-SSE locking rate in the earthquake zone than suggested by geodetic inversions.
假设摩擦参数(a-b)与观测平均SSE滑动量呈线性关系，忽略了俯冲沉积物非均质性及正应力依赖性。
在SSE与地震斑块边界设定了突变的有效正应力且未考虑俯冲海山粗糙度，导致模拟的南部SSE滑动过于集中在单一斑块。
所选成核尺寸（h* = 15 km）使模拟的震间晚期地震区闭锁率低于大地测量反演结果。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates slow slip events (SSEs) and their stress interactions with megathrust earthquakes using rate-and-state friction modeling.
The study simulates full 3-D earthquake sequences, preslip unlocking, and nucleation processes on the Costa Rica subduction interface.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all 4 main figures and text sections.

sum: Manual picking of long-period (~20 s) teleseismic P and S wave arrivals is too labor-intensive to keep pace with expanding global seismic archives. Here, the authors adapt the attention-based Earthquake Transformer neural network (resampled to 4 Hz with a 1.25 s Gaussian target window) and train it on 65,295 legacy hand-picked waveforms (1976–2009). Applying the model to 5.86 million 3-component seismograms from 2010 to 2023 produces the Global Long-wavelength Body-wave Catalog (GLoBoCat), containing over 2.1 million P and 1.9 million S picks (1.20M P and 1.44M S after quality thresholding). GLoBoCat vastly improves lower-mantle raypath coverage, especially in the southern hemisphere, and confirms that the S-to-P travel-time residual ratio doubles from ~3 to ~6 in the lowermost mantle. Comparing overlapping picks with short-period (~1 s) ISC arrivals reveals a steeper slope for delayed arrivals (especially P waves), contradicting standard wavefront healing predictions.
针对全球长周期（~20秒）体波人工拾取难以应对海量波形数据的问题，本文改进了基于注意力机制的Earthquake Transformer深度学习模型（4 Hz采样），利用65,295条历史人工拾取波形进行训练。将其应用于2010-2023年间586万条三分量记录，构建了包含超过210万个P波和196……

t: Adapted the attention-based Earthquake Transformer neural network (5 CNN blocks, 2 LSTM blocks) to 4 Hz 3-component long-period seismograms with a 1.25 s Gaussian probability target to jointly pick P and S onset times.
将注意力机制Earthquake Transformer适配至4 Hz长周期三分量波形，以1.25秒高斯分布为目标联合拾…
Trained on 65,295 legacy 3-component waveforms (1976–2009) and applied to 5,864,311 records from 5,617 stations and 5,880 earthquakes (Mw ≥ 5.5) between 2010 and 2023 from the IRIS DMC.
使用65,295条历史波形训练，并应用于IRIS DMC 2010–2023年间5,880次地震的5,864,311条记…

Generated 2,109,961 P and 1,965,807 S picks (p > 0.1), finding δtS/δtP doubles from ~3 to ~6 in the lowermost mantle and long-vs-short period residual slopes steepen from 3.18 to 10.12 for late P arrivals.
获得超210万P和196万S拾取；最下地幔δtS/δtP从~3倍增至~6；晚到P波长短周期残差斜率从3.18陡增至10.…
Larger uncertainties in long-period P picks and the small number of mutual S picks in the ISC catalog prevent uniquely identifying the physical cause of the observed apparent dispersion.
P波拾取不确定性较大且与ISC共有的S波数量较少，目前难以唯一确定视频散的物理成因。

First joint deep-learning picker for global long-period teleseismic P and S onset times and first systematic comparison linking long-period P/S catalogs with short-period ISC arrivals in the lower mantle.
首次实现全球长周期P和S波联合深度学习拾取，并首次系统对比了下地幔长周期与短周期ISC走时。

kc: Adapted the Earthquake Transformer architecture to jointly pick teleseismic long-period (~20 s) P and S wave onset times at 4 Hz without velocity models or synthetics.
Produced and openly released GLoBoCat (2010–2023), containing ~4 million P and S picks (over 2.6 million high-quality picks), greatly expanding southern hemisphere lower-mantle coverage.
Demonstrated that the S-to-P travel-time residual ratio stays around 3 in the mid-mantle (30°–80°) and doubles to ~6 near the base of the mantle.
Discovered an asymmetric correlation between long-period GLoBoCat and short-period ISC travel-time residuals across early vs. late arrivals, opposite to wavefront healing predictions.
改进了Earthquake Transformer架构，无需速度模型或理论地震图即可在4 Hz采样率下联合拾取远震长周期（~20秒）P波和S波初至。
构建并公开了2010–2023年GLoBoCat目录（含约400万个初至，超260万高质量拾取），极大改善了南半球下地幔的射线覆盖。
证实S波与P波走时残差比在中地幔（30°–80°）保持在~3，而在最下地幔翻倍至~6。
发现长周期GLoBoCat与短周期ISC走时残差在早到和晚到震相间存在非对称相关性，其斜率变化与波前愈合理论预测相反。
me: Modified Earthquake Transformer (5 CNN blocks, 2 LSTM blocks, global attention layer, two decoders) operating on 1,500-second, 4 Hz, 3-component (R, T, Z) waveforms filtered to GRFO response.
Trained from scratch using binary cross-entropy loss and Adam optimizer against Gaussian target probability functions (σ = 1.25 s) derived from legacy semi-automated cluster picks.
Dynamic summary-ray outlier removal within 2° spatial/distance neighborhoods and 5° epicentral distance bands, followed by Monte-Carlo Kendall's Tau regression for δtS/δtP and ISC comparisons.
改进Earthquake Transformer（5个CNN块、2个LSTM块、全局注意力层及双解码器），输入为滤除仪器响应并转换为GRFO响应的1500秒、4 Hz三分量（R, T, Z）波形。
以历史半自动聚类拾取转换的高斯概率分布（σ = 1.25 s）为目标，使用二元交叉熵损失和Adam优化器从头训练模型。
在2°空间/震中距邻域和5°距离带内利用动态综合射线法剔除异常值，并采用蒙特卡洛抽样回归分析δtS/δtP及长短周期走时对比。
de: Training/validation/test dataset (60%/20%/20%) of 65,295 three-component LH waveforms (1976–2009, Mw ≥ 5.5) with both P and S onset picks from Houser et al. (2008).
Inference dataset of 5,864,311 records from 5,617 stations and 5,880 GCMT earthquakes (2010–2023) retrieved from the IRIS DMC.
Cross-catalog comparison using 101,302 P and 3,363 S common source-receiver pairs between GLoBoCat and the short-period ISC bulletin.
训练/验证/测试集（60%/20%/20%）包含来自Houser等（2008）的65,295条同时具有P和S初至拾取的三分量LH波形（1976–2009年，Mw ≥ 5.5）。
推理数据集包含从IRIS DMC获取的2010–2023年间5,880次GCMT地震、5,617个台站的5,864,311条波形记录。
利用GLoBoCat与短周期ISC目录共有的101,302对P波和3,363对S波震源-台站对进行跨目录长短周期对比分析。
li: Larger picking uncertainties in long-period P waves (~1.79 s) and a small number of mutual S picks in the ISC catalog (N = 3,363) hinder uniquely pinpointing the physical cause of the apparent dispersion.
The ML model currently only picks direct P and S arrivals and has not yet been trained on reflected or diffracted phases (e.g., PP, SS, ScS, Pdiff, Sdiff).
Travel-time residual ratios are path-integrated quantities affected by unmodeled 3D crust and upper-mantle heterogeneity rather than isolated local lower-mantle velocity ratios.
长周期P波拾取不确定性较大（~1.79秒）且与ISC共有的S波匹配数较少（N = 3,363），难以唯一确定视频散的物理机制。
当前机器学习模型仅拾取直达P波和S波，尚未扩展至反射或绕射震相（如PP、SS、ScS、Pdiff、Sdiff）。
走时残差比是沿射线路径的积分量，受未校正的三维地壳和上地幔非均质性影响，并非直接的局域下地幔速度比。

tm.why: The paper adapts the attention-based Earthquake Transformer deep-learning architecture to automatically pick long-period P and S wave arrival times.
The primary output is GLoBoCat, a global catalog of over 4 million long-wavelength P and S wave travel-time measurements spanning 2010–2023.
The catalog is analyzed to investigate lower mantle velocity structure, S/P travel-time residual ratios, and apparent dispersion relative to short-period arrivals.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page Seismica PDF article, including all methods, equations, figures (Figs. 1–4), and discussion sections.

sum: This study investigates the 2 May 2025 Mw 7.4 Drake Passage earthquake, the largest recorded event at the transition between the southernmost Chilean Trench and the Shackleton Fracture Zone (SFZ). Due to sparse regional station coverage, the authors relocated the sequence using manual P- and S-wave arrivals from the ASAIN network and global stations, and refined focal depths by identifying teleseismic pP and sP phases with SeisBench deep-learning models. They also reprocessed a 1997 multichannel seismic reflection profile (IT97-245) crossing the epicentral area. Results show seismicity concentrates at 15–35 km depth, with the mainshock nucleating at ~25 km, explaining the minimal tsunami. Combining hypocenters, heterogeneous focal mechanisms, back-projection results, and reflection imaging, the authors infer a composite rupture involving either a steepened subduction thrust interface or intraslab faulting interacting with steep southwest-dipping SFZ structures, highlighting complex stress partitioning at plate boundary transitions.
本研究分析了2025年5月2日德雷克海峡Mw 7.4地震（智利海沟最南端与沙克尔顿断裂带SFZ转换带最大记录地震）。针对台站稀疏问题，结合ASAIN台网与全球台站P/S波到时进行重定位，利用SeisBench深度学习模型识别pP和sP深度相以约束震源深度，并重新处理了穿过震中区的1997年多道地震反……

t: Events were relocated with LocSAT using IASPEI91 and manual regional/global P and S picks, while focal depths were refined using SeisBench deep-learning models to probabilistically identify pP and sP depth phases.
采用LocSAT和IASPEI91模型结合人工拾取重定位，利用SeisBench深度学习识别pP和sP相约束深度。

The study integrates P/S arrivals from the regional ASAIN network and global stations, ISC/GCMT catalogs, GSN back-projection products, and a reprocessed 1997 multichannel seismic reflection profile (IT97-245).
整合ASAIN区域台网和全球台站到时、ISC/GCMT目录、反投影及重处理的IT97-245多道反射剖面。
Relocated seismicity concentrates between 15 and 35 km depth (aftershock median 26–29 km), with the Mw 7.4 mainshock nucleating at ~25 km depth and outlining a ~60° SW-dipping structure.
重定位地震集中在15-35 km深度，Mw 7.4主震起始于约25 km深处，勾勒出约60°南西倾构造。

Sparse station coverage yields 15–20 km longitudinal errors, poor seismic penetration below 9 s TWT obscures deep faults, and data cannot discriminate between interface and intraslab mainshock scenarios.
台站稀疏致经度误差达15-20 km，9秒以下反射穿透差，且无法区分板间与板内破裂情景。

First integrated seismological and multichannel seismic reflection analysis of the largest recorded earthquake (Mw 7.4) at the Chile Trench–Shackleton Fracture Zone subduction-to-transform transition.
首次综合地震学与多道反射地震数据解析智利海沟-SFZ转换带最大记录地震（Mw 7.4）。

kc: Relocated the 2025 Mw 7.4 Drake Passage mainshock (~25 km depth) and aftershocks (clustering at 15–35 km depth) using regional ASAIN data and deep-learning depth phase (pP, sP) picking.
Reprocessed vintage multichannel seismic reflection line IT97-245 across the epicentral region to image the accretionary wedge, subducting Antarctic plate, and a strike-slip basin linked to the SFZ.
Proposed a hierarchical, composite rupture model involving low-angle subduction interface or intraslab faulting coupled with steep (55–60°) SW-dipping transpressive structures of the SFZ.
利用区域ASAIN数据和深度学习深度相（pP、sP）拾取，重定位了2025年德雷克海峡Mw 7.4主震（约25 km深）及余震（集中于15–35 km）。
重新处理了穿过震中区的IT97-245多道地震反射剖面，揭示了增生楔、俯冲南极板块以及与SFZ相关的走滑盆地结构。
提出了分级复合破裂模型，包含低角度俯冲界面或板内破裂，以及与之耦合的SFZ高倾角（55–60°）西南倾压扭性构造。
me: Hypocentral relocation using the LocSAT algorithm and IASPEI91 velocity model with manually reviewed P and S arrivals.
Probabilistic multi-station focal depth estimation using deep-learning models in SeisBench to identify teleseismic pP and sP depth phases.
Time-migration reprocessing of multichannel seismic reflection profile IT97-245 and synthesis with GCMT/USGS focal mechanisms and GSN P-wave back-projection.
基于人工核查的P波和S波到时，使用LocSAT算法和IASPEI91速度模型进行震源重定位。
利用SeisBench中的深度学习模型识别远震pP和sP深度相，实现概率化多台站震源深度估计。
对多道地震反射剖面IT97-245进行时间偏移重处理，并结合GCMT/USGS震源机制和GSN P波反投影进行综合分析。
de: P- and S-wave arrival times from the Argentine–Italian Antarctic Seismographic Network (ASAIN) and selected global FDSN stations, plus ISC and GCMT catalogs.
Multichannel seismic reflection profile IT97-245 acquired in 1997 across the southernmost Chilean margin and SFZ.
Teleseismic P-waveforms from the Global Seismographic Network (GSN) used for depth-phase picking and EarthScope back-projection products.
阿根廷-意大利南极地震台网（ASAIN）和选定全球FDSN台站的P波与S波到时，以及ISC和GCMT目录数据。
1997年采集的横跨智利陆缘最南端与SFZ的IT97-245多道地震反射剖面数据。
用于深度相拾取和EarthScope反投影产品的全球地震台网（GSN）远震P波波形。
li: Sparse regional station coverage in the Scotia Sea and Pacific Ocean causes large east–west horizontal location uncertainties (15–20 km in longitude).
Seismic reflection penetration below 9 s TWT is degraded by the deformed accretionary wedge and seafloor multiples, preventing direct imaging of the deep SFZ reflector.
Available seismological and structural constraints cannot definitively distinguish between an interface-hosted thrust rupture and an intraslab rupture scenario.
斯科舍海和太平洋区域台站稀疏，导致东西向水平定位不确定性较大（经度误差达15–20 km）。
9秒双程走时以下的地震反射穿透力受变形增生楔和海底多次波限制，无法直接成像深部SFZ反射面。
现有的地震学和构造约束无法完全区分主震是板块界面逆冲破裂还是板内破裂。

tm.why: The study relocates the 2 May 2025 Mw 7.4 earthquake sequence using regional arrival times and refines focal depths using deep-learning-identified pP and sP depth phases.
The paper investigates the rupture characteristics, focal mechanisms, and P-wave back-projection energy release across the subduction-transform transition.
It integrates multichannel seismic reflection imaging with relocated seismicity to characterize the structural architecture of the southernmost Chilean Trench and Shackleton Fracture Zone transition.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 12-page GRL PDF, including full text, citations, and all three main figures.

sum: Reconstructing past dynamic topography is challenging because mantle convection evolves over time. This study tests whether Neogene–Quaternary intraplate basalts across six Western Mediterranean volcanic provinces preserve the upper-mantle thermal structure responsible for regional dynamic support. The authors combine 48 newly acquired and published geochemical analyses with calibrated shear-wave tomographic models (SL2013sv, CSEM) and residual depth measurements augmented by 13 marine seismic reflection and wide-angle profiles. Rare earth element (REE) inverse modeling and major-element thermobarometry of primitive, asthenosphere-derived (type-2) basalts indicate melting beneath a thinned lithosphere of 60–70 km at ambient to +50°C potential temperatures (1,275–1,394°C). These estimates independently match tomographic constraints and observed residual bathymetric/topographic anomalies of ~0.5 km. The novelty lies in demonstrating that lithospheric thinning—rather than strong sub-plate thermal anomalies—dominates Western Mediterranean dynamic support, validating dated basalts as quantitative archives of transient mantle structure.
本研究结合西地中海六个火山省的新老玄武岩地球化学数据（含48个新采样）、标定后的剪切波层析成像模型（SL2013sv和CSEM）以及13条新增海洋地震反射/广角剖面的残余水深测量，探讨板内玄武岩是否记录了区域动力地形对应的上地幔热结构。通过对受岩石圈混染最少的原始玄武岩进行稀土元素（REE）反演建模……

t: Polybaric isentropic REE inverse modeling (INVMEL-v12) and major-element thermobarometry estimate asthenospheric potential temperature and lithospheric thickness from olivine-reconstructed primary basalt compositions, which are compared against calibrated shear-wave tomography and seismic residual depths.
利用多压等熵稀土反演建模与主量元素温压计从重建原始玄武岩中估算潜温和岩石圈厚度，并与标定层析成像及地震残余水深对比。

138 screened Neogene–Quaternary mafic rock analyses (including 48 new XRF/ICP-MS samples from Spain), calibrated SL2013sv and CSEM tomographic models, and 29 marine wide-angle/reflection seismic profiles across Western Mediterranean basins.
138个筛选镁铁质岩石数据（含西班牙48个新样品）、SL2013sv与CSEM层析模型及29条海洋地震剖面。

REE inverse modeling of asthenospheric type-2 basalts yields lithospheric thicknesses of 60–70 km and potential temperatures from ambient to +50°C, matching tomography and explaining ~0.5 km positive residual depth anomalies via lithospheric thinning.
2型玄武岩反演得出岩石圈厚60–70 km、潜温比正常地幔高0–50°C，岩石圈减薄解释了约0.5 km正残余地形异常。

Oceanic crust ages in the Western Mediterranean are uncertain because thick halite deposits obscure magnetic anomalies, and present-day thermal structure cannot directly reconstruct Late Miocene uplift.
巨厚石盐掩盖磁异常导致洋壳年龄不确定，且现今结构无法直接重建晚中新世抬升。

Quantifies that lithospheric thinning (to 60–70 km) dominates Western Mediterranean dynamic support without requiring large sub-plate temperature anomalies, validating dated basalts as archives of transient dynamic topography.
量化证实岩石圈减薄主导西地中海动力支撑而无需高地幔温度异常，验证了定年玄武岩重建古动力地形的可行性。

kc: Presents 48 new XRF and ICP-MS whole-rock geochemical analyses of Neogene–Quaternary basalts from Spain, integrated into a screened regional database of 138 mafic samples.

Demonstrates via REE inverse modeling and major-element thermobarometry that Western Mediterranean lithosphere is thinned to 60–70 km with modest asthenospheric potential temperature anomalies (ambient to +50°C).

Augments the regional marine residual depth database with 13 seismic reflection/wide-angle profiles and a new regional sediment time-depth relationship accounting for Messinian evaporites, showing lithospheric thinning accounts for ~0.5 km of dynamic uplift.
提供了西班牙48个新近纪-第四纪玄武岩样品的XRF和ICP-MS全岩地球化学新数据，并整合成包含138个镁铁质样品的区域筛选数据库。
通过稀土元素反演建模和主量元素温压计证明，西地中海岩石圈减薄至60–70 km，软流圈潜温异常温和（正常地幔温度至偏高50°C）。
利用13条地震反射/广角剖面及考虑墨西拿蒸发岩的新区域沉积时深关系扩充了海洋残余水深数据库，证明岩石圈减薄可解释约0.5 km的动力抬升。
me: Geochemical screening (MgO > 9 wt.%, K2O/Na2O < 1, (Nb/La)npm > 0.75) and olivine-addition primary melt reconstruction to Fo = 90.
Rare earth element (REE) polybaric isentropic melt inverse modeling (INVMEL-v12) via grid search over potential temperature (Tp) and lithospheric thickness (Dtop).
Major-element empirical thermobarometry (Plank & Forsyth, 2016) with H2O and CO2 corrections.
Residual depth anomaly calculation using marine seismic reflection/wide-angle profiles, regional porosity-compaction time-depth calibration, and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
地球化学筛选（MgO > 9 wt.%，K2O/Na2O < 1，(Nb/La)npm > 0.75）及通过橄榄石增量法重建与Fo = 90平衡的原始熔体成分。
利用INVMEL-v12软件包对潜温（Tp）和岩石圈厚度（Dtop）进行网格搜索的稀土元素（REE）多压等熵熔融反演建模。
包含H2O和CO2校正的主量元素经验温压计计算（Plank & Forsyth, 2016）。
利用海洋地震反射/广角剖面、区域孔隙度-压实时深标定及蒙特卡洛不确定性传播计算残余水深异常。
de: 138 screened Neogene–Quaternary mafic igneous rock analyses across 6 Western Mediterranean provinces (including 48 newly analyzed Spanish samples via XRF and ICP-MS).
Calibrated shear-wave velocity tomographic models SL2013sv and CSEM evaluated at 125–175 km depth.

29 marine seismic wide-angle and multi-channel reflection profiles (16 legacy from Holdt et al., 2022, plus 13 newly added) and 31 time-depth pairs across the Algerian-Balearic, Liguro-Provençal, and Tyrrhenian basins.
西地中海6个火山省138个经过筛选的新近纪-第四纪镁铁质火成岩分析数据（含通过XRF和ICP-MS新测试的48个西班牙样品）。
在125–175 km深度评估的标定剪切波速度层析成像模型SL2013sv和CSEM。
跨越阿尔及利亚-巴利阿里、利古里亚-普罗旺斯和第勒尼安盆地的29条海洋广角和道集地震反射剖面（含13条新增剖面）及31对时深测量数据。
li: Oceanic crust age in the Western Mediterranean is uncertain because thick Messinian halite deposits obscure magnetic and basement constraints.
Present-day mantle thermal structure cannot directly reconstruct Late Miocene uplift, only providing calibration for the magnitude of support.
Type-1 and low-SiO2 basalt samples experience metasomatized lithospheric-mantle or pyroxenitic source influence, violating simple peridotite melting assumptions.
由于巨厚的墨西拿石盐沉积掩盖了磁异常和基底约束，西地中海洋壳年龄存在较大不确定性。
现今地幔热结构无法直接重建晚中新世的抬升历史，仅能为地表支撑量级提供现今标定。
1型和低硅玄武岩样品受到交代岩石圈地幔或辉石岩源区的影响，偏离了简单的橄榄岩熔融假设。

tm.why: The paper constrains upper-mantle thermal structure, lithospheric thickness, and regional dynamic topography across the Western Mediterranean using basalt geochemistry, seismic tomography, and residual depth profiles.
The authors compare geochemically derived potential temperatures and lithospheric thicknesses against calibrated shear-wave earthquake tomographic models (SL2013sv and CSEM).

ev.notes: Full 39-page PDF analyzed, including main text, equations, 17 figures, and 8 data/summary tables.

sum: This study analyzes 6,409 high-resolution shear-wave splitting (SWS) measurements from 465 broadband seismic stations to investigate seismic azimuthal anisotropy across the northeastern Tibetan Plateau and western North China Craton. The results reveal a complex double-layer horizontal anisotropy structure in the central study area. The upper layer's anisotropy is attributed to ductile flow in the middle-to-lower crust that bifurcates around the rigid Alxa Block. The lower layer's anisotropy, with NW-SE fast orientations, aligns with the absolute plate motion of the Eurasian plate. Spatial coherence analysis suggests that asthenospheric flow, modulated by the Ordos and Sichuan cratonic keels, is the dominant source of anisotropy. This work provides critical observational constraints on the lithosphere-asthenosphere coupling and deformation mechanisms in a major tectonic transition zone.
本研究利用465个宽频带地震台站的6409个高分辨率剪切波分裂（SWS）测量数据，系统分析了青藏高原东北缘与华北克拉通西部的地震方位各向异性。研究在中心区域发现了复杂的双层水平各向异性结构：上层各向异性源于中下地壳韧性流绕过阿拉善地块的流动分叉；下层各向异性呈西北-东南走向，与欧亚板块绝对运动方向一……

t: Shear-wave splitting analysis of teleseismic phases from a dense broadband array to resolve azimuthal variations and double-layer anisotropy.
利用密集台站的远震剪切波分裂分析，解析方位角变化和双层各向异性。
6,409 high-resolution shear-wave splitting measurements from 465 broadband seismic stations spaced at less than 50 km in NE Tibet and western NCC.
青藏东北缘与华北克拉通西部465个台站的6409个剪切波分裂测量数据。
Discovery of a double-layer anisotropy structure: upper layer crustal flow bifurcating around the Alxa Block, and lower layer asthenospheric flow modulated by cratonic keels.
发现双层各向异性：上层地壳流绕阿拉善分叉，下层软流圈流受克拉通根部调制。
Potential trade-offs in double-layer anisotropy modeling and limited vertical resolution inherent to shear-wave splitting measurements.
剪切波分裂方法垂直分辨率有限，双层各向异性建模可能存在多解性。
First high-resolution, dense-array SWS study in this region resolving complex double-layer anisotropy rather than relying on station-averaged single-layer assumptions.
首次在该区利用高密度台站解析出双层各向异性，而非传统的单层假设。

kc: Obtained 6,409 high-resolution shear-wave splitting measurements from 465 broadband stations in NE Tibet and western NCC.
Identified a complex double-layer horizontal anisotropy structure with a crustal upper layer and an asthenospheric lower layer.
Revealed the bifurcation of crustal flow around the Alxa Block and the modulation of asthenospheric flow by cratonic keels.
获取了青藏高原东北缘和华北克拉通西部465个宽频带台站的6409个高分辨率剪切波分裂测量数据。
识别出复杂的双层水平各向异性结构，包括地壳上层和软流圈下层。
揭示了中下地壳流绕阿拉善地块的分叉现象，以及克拉通根部对软流圈地幔流的调制作用。
me: Shear-wave splitting (SWS) analysis of teleseismic phases.
Azimuthal variation analysis of splitting parameters to detect double-layer anisotropy.
Spatial coherence analysis of splitting parameters to infer the depth of anisotropy.
远震相的剪切波分裂（SWS）分析。
分裂参数随方位角变化的分析，用于检测双层各向异性。
分裂参数的空间相干性分析，用于推断各向异性深度。
de: Seismic waveform data from 465 broadband seismic stations spaced at less than 50 km.
A dataset of 6,409 high-resolution shear-wave splitting measurements.
来自台站间距小于50公里的465个宽频带地震台站的地震波形数据。
包含6409个高分辨率剪切波分裂测量值的数据集。
li: Shear-wave splitting has limited vertical resolution, making the exact depth of the anisotropic layers difficult to constrain precisely without complementary methods.
剪切波分裂的垂直分辨率有限，在没有互补方法的情况下，难以精确约束各向异性层的确切深度。

tm.why: The paper uses shear-wave splitting measurements to analyze seismic azimuthal anisotropy in NE Tibet and the North China Craton.
The study interprets anisotropy in terms of crustal ductile flow, lithospheric blocks, and asthenospheric mantle flow modulated by cratonic roots.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) of long-offset ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data at the crustal scale is notoriously prone to cycle-skipping. This study presents the first crustal-scale application of time-domain extended-source FWI (ES-FWI) using the 2001 SFJ-OBS dataset from the eastern Nankai Trough, Japan. ES-FWI expands the search space by introducing scattering sources, estimated via multidimensional deconvolution of data residuals using the MINRES solver, to match observed waveforms from an initial traveltime tomography model. Through alternating-direction optimization with an augmented Lagrangian formulation across two frequency bands (1.5–5 Hz and 1.5–8.5 Hz), the perturbation embedded in the scattering sources is transferred to the velocity model. A final classical FWI step further reduces residual misfits in the linear regime. The resulting model outperforms standard FWI and matches complex Laplace-Fourier FWI benchmarks using a much simpler workflow, clearly resolving the subduction megathrust, décollement, Enshu fault, and accretionary wedge thrusts.
本研究首次将时域扩展源全波形反演（ES-FWI）应用于日本南海海槽东段2001年SFJ-OBS长偏移距地壳尺度数据。针对长偏移距数据易发生周波跳跃的难题，该方法引入散射源扩展搜索空间，利用MINRES求解器对数据残差进行多维反褶积以重构波场，并通过增广拉格朗日交替方向优化逐步更新背景速度模型，最后结……

t: Bi-level time-domain extended-source FWI using MINRES-based multidimensional residual deconvolution to reconstruct wavefields with scattering sources, followed by alternating-direction model updates and a final classical FWI refinement.
采用基于MINRES多维反褶积的时域扩展源全波形反演重构波场并交替更新模型，最后结合传统FWI精细化。

2001 SFJ-OBS active-source dataset in the eastern Nankai Trough comprising 90 OBSs (1-km spacing) and 1,404 air-gun shots (100-m interval), initialized from a first-arrival traveltime tomography model.
南海海槽东段2001年SFJ-OBS数据集（90台OBS、1404个气枪炮点），以初至波走时层析模型为初始模型。
Sequential inversion of [1.5, 5 Hz] and [1.5, 8.5 Hz] bands converged in 8 and 4 MINRES iterations, accurately resolving the Nankai megathrust, décollement, Enshu fault, and accretionary wedges.
两频带反演中MINRES仅需8次和4次迭代即收敛，清晰重建了俯冲大断层、滑脱面、远州断层及增生楔构造。

Wavefield accuracy away from receivers strongly depends on the initial model, MINRES iterations add computational overhead, and acoustic 2D assumptions introduce some seaward-dipping overfitting artifacts.
远离接收器波场依赖初始模型精度，MINRES求解计算开销大，二维声波近似易产生过拟合伪影。
First crustal-scale application of time-domain ES-FWI to ultra-long-offset OBS field data, achieving comparable accuracy to Laplace-Fourier FWI with a substantially simpler multiscale workflow.
首次将时域ES-FWI应用于长偏移距OBS地壳成像，以大幅简化的流程达到拉普拉斯-傅里叶FWI同等的精度。

kc: First application of time-domain extended-source FWI (ES-FWI) to crustal-scale seismic imaging using ultra-long-offset OBS field data.
Accurate solution of the data-domain normal equation for multidimensional deconvolution using the MINRES Krylov solver to prevent numerical artifacts.
Demonstration that a hybrid ES-FWI + FWI workflow achieves superior velocity reconstruction over classical FWI with a much simpler multiscale strategy than Laplace-Fourier FWI.
High-resolution imaging and geological validation of key structures in the eastern Nankai Trough, including the megathrust, décollement, and accretionary wedge faults.
首次将时域扩展源全波形反演（ES-FWI）应用于超长偏移距OBS实际资料的地壳尺度地震成像。
采用MINRES Krylov子空间求解器精确求解数据域法方程以实现数据残差多维反褶积，避免了数值伪影。
证明了ES-FWI结合传统FWI的混合流程比单独传统FWI重建精度更高，且比拉普拉斯-傅里叶域FWI流程显著简化。
高分辨率重建并地质验证了南海海槽东段的关键构造，包括俯冲大断层、滑脱面及增生楔逆冲断层系。
me: Time-domain extended-source full-waveform inversion (ES-FWI) formulated as a bi-level alternating-direction optimization problem.
Multidimensional deconvolution of data residuals solved via the minimal-residual Krylov-subspace method (MINRES) with bandpass filtering preconditioning.
Augmented Lagrangian method with time-offset data windowing and distance-based source-domain weighting operators.
Staggered-grid O(dt^2, dx^4) time-domain acoustic finite-difference wavefield modeling with free-surface boundary conditions and PMLs.
Final classical FWI refinement step using diagonal pseudo-Hessian preconditioned steepest-descent once in the linear regime.
将时域扩展源全波形反演（ES-FWI）构建为双层交替方向优化问题（波场重构与模型更新）。
采用带通滤波预条件的最小残差Krylov子空间法（MINRES）求解数据残差的多维反褶积。
结合增广拉格朗日方法以及时间-偏移距数据加窗和源域距离加权算子稳定反演。
采用含自由地表边界条件和PML吸收边界的交错网格O(dt^2, dx^4)时域声波有限差分正演模拟。
进入线性域后，使用对角伪Hessian预条件最速下降法进行最后的传统FWI精细化反演。
de: 2001 SEIZE France Japan OBS (SFJ-OBS) 2D active-source seismic dataset from the Tokai segment of the eastern Nankai Trough.
90 ocean-bottom seismometers (vertical geophones processed as reciprocal sources) spaced 1 km apart and 1,404 air-gun shots at 100 m intervals along a 140 km profile.
Initial P-wave velocity model derived from first-arrival traveltime tomography (FATT) by Górszczyk et al. (2017).
Two-scale sequential frequency inversion ([1.5, 5 Hz] with 60 km max offset; [1.5, 8.5 Hz] with 105 km max offset) validated against legacy towed-streamer PSDM images.
日本南海海槽东段东海（Tokai）区域2001年SEIZE法日联合OBS（SFJ-OBS）二维主动源地震数据集。
沿140公里测线布设的90台海底地震仪（间距1公里，垂直检波器作为互易震源处理）和1404个气枪震源（间距100米）。
采用Górszczyk等（2017）通过初至波走时层析成像（FATT）建立的初始P波速度模型。
两阶段多尺度频率顺序反演（[1.5, 5 Hz]最大偏移距60公里；[1.5, 8.5 Hz]最大偏移距105公里），并与拖缆叠前深度偏移剖面对比验证。
li: Strong dependence of reconstructed wavefields away from receivers on the kinematic accuracy of the starting model; smoothed starting models degrade deeper reconstructions.
High computational overhead from solving the data-domain Hessian via MINRES, requiring one forward and one adjoint simulation per inner iteration.
Acoustic, constant-density (1 g/cm^3), 2D approximation neglects elastic, attenuation, density, and 3D propagation effects, potentially causing data overfitting and seaward-dipping artifacts.
远离接收器处的重构波场强烈依赖于初始模型的运动学精度，过于平滑的初始模型会导致深部成像质量下降。
使用MINRES迭代求解数据域Hessian矩阵带来显著计算开销，每次内部迭代需一次正演和一次伴随模拟。
二维常密度（1 g/cm^3）声波近似忽略了弹性、衰减、密度变化及三维传播效应，可能导致数据过拟合及倾向海侧的伪影。

tm.why: The core of the study is developing and applying time-domain extended-source full-waveform inversion (ES-FWI) to reconstruct crustal P-wave velocity models.
The paper formulates a bi-level alternating-direction optimization problem using augmented Lagrangian methods and MINRES Krylov solvers to mitigate FWI nonlinearity and cycle-skipping.
The methodology is applied to image and interpret tectonic structures of the eastern Nankai Trough subduction zone, including the megathrust, décollement, and accretionary wedges.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF read and analyzed, including mathematical formulations in Section 2, experimental setup and Nankai Trough case study in Section 3, all 9 figures, and Table 1.

sum: The tectonic origin of the Ulleung Basin in the East Sea (Japan Sea) has remained controversial due to thick sediment cover and weak magnetic signatures. By compiling a new high-resolution marine magnetic anomaly map and performing 2-D magnetic forward modeling, the authors identify coherent ENE-WSW magnetic lineations corresponding to Chrons C6An.1n–C5Dn (20–17 Ma) with a half-spreading rate of 20 km/Myr. Towards spreading cessation (17.2–17.0 Ma), eastward migration of the rotation pole caused fan-shaped asymmetric spreading. Crucially, the basin's western bounding transform fault, the East Korea Fracture Zone (EKFZ), spatially coincides with the modern Ulleung Major Thrust (UMT). Under regional E-W compression since ~4 Ma, this rheological weakness facilitated compressional inversion and incipient underthrusting beneath the Korean Peninsula. This work links Miocene back-arc opening to Late Cenozoic inversion, documenting a rare example of transform-to-thrust reactivation across an oceanic-continental boundary in a continental back-arc setting.
受厚沉积层和微弱磁异常限制，东海（日本海）郁陵盆地的构造起源长期存在争议。本研究编制了全新的高分辨率海洋磁异常图并结合二维正演模拟，识别出20–17 Ma期间（C6An.1n–C5Dn期）呈ENE-WSW走向的磁异常条带，半扩张速率为20 km/Myr。研究表明盆地西界的古转换断层（东韩断裂带）与现……

t: Compiled multi-source shipboard scalar and vector magnetic data using crossover corrections, and conducted 2-D magnetic forward modeling with a 1-km-thick source layer (3 A/m) across GPTS models.
利用交叉点校正整合多源船载标量与矢量磁测数据，并采用1 km磁性层进行二维磁异常正演模拟。

Marine proton precession and shipboard three-component magnetometer datasets from JAMSTEC, NCEI, KHOA, and KIGAM, combined with GEBCO 2024 bathymetry, World Gravity Map, and GlobSed sediment thickness grids.
整合了日美韩多机构的海洋磁测数据，以及GEBCO水深、全球均衡重力异常和沉积物厚度网格。
Identified ENE-WSW magnetic lineations matching Chrons C6An.1n to C5Dn (20–17 Ma) with a half-spreading rate of 20 km/Myr, bounded to the west by the reactivated East Korea Fracture Zone.
识别出20–17 Ma（C6An.1n–C5Dn）的ENE-WSW向磁条带，半扩张速率20 km/Myr，西界为复活的东…
Anomaly amplitudes are low (~70 nT) due to thermal demagnetization from high heat flow (~120 mW/m²) and thermal blanketing by up to 10 km of thick sediments.
受高热流和厚达10 km沉积物的热退磁影响，磁异常幅值较低（约70 nT）且局部受火山干扰。
Documents previously undetected seafloor spreading lineations in the Ulleung Basin and provides a rare natural example of transform-to-thrust reactivation in a continental back-arc setting.
首次揭示郁陵盆地海底扩张磁条带，并提供了大陆弧后盆地古转换断层向逆冲断层复活的罕见实例。

kc: Compiled a new high-resolution marine magnetic anomaly grid for the Ulleung Basin, resolving previously undetected low-amplitude (~70 nT) seafloor spreading lineations.
Demonstrated via 2-D forward modeling that seafloor spreading occurred between 20 and 17 Ma (Chrons C6An.1n to C5Dn) at a half-spreading rate of 20 km/Myr.
Identified late-stage (17.2–17.0 Ma) asymmetric fan-shaped spreading driven by eastward migration of the rotation pole and clockwise rotation of SW Japan.
Established that the East Korea Fracture Zone (a fossil oceanic transform boundary) reactivated as the Ulleung Major Thrust under Late Cenozoic E-W compression.
编制了郁陵盆地全新的高分辨率海洋磁异常网格，识别出此前未被发现的低幅值（~70 nT）海底扩张磁条带。
通过二维正演模拟证明海底扩张发生于20至17 Ma（C6An.1n至C5Dn期），半扩张速率为20 km/Myr。
揭示了扩张末期（17.2–17.0 Ma）受旋转极东移和西南日本顺时针旋转驱动的不对称扇形扩张。
证实作为古大洋转换边界的东韩断裂带在晚新生代东西向挤压下复活为郁陵主逆冲断层。
me: Compilation and crossover error correction (X2SYS and vector merging) of multi-agency shipboard proton precession and three-component magnetometer data.
2-D magnetic forward modeling using a 1-km-thick magnetic source layer (3 A/m) calibrated against multiple Geomagnetic Polarity Time Scales (GPTS 2020, 2012, 2004, CK95).
Integration of bathymetry, sediment thickness, and isostatic gravity anomalies to map basement depth and Moho/crustal thickness variations.
汇总多机构船载质子旋进和三分量磁力仪数据，并进行交叉点误差校正（X2SYS和矢量融合）。
采用1 km厚磁性源层（3 A/m）结合多种地磁极性年表（GPTS 2020等）进行二维磁异常正演模拟。
综合水深、沉积物厚度和均衡重力异常数据，绘制基底深度及地壳厚度变化图。
de: Marine magnetic data from JAMSTEC (DARWIN), NCEI (GEODAS), KHOA, and KIGAM.
Global grids including GEBCO 2024 bathymetry, World Gravity Map isostatic gravity anomalies, and GlobSed sediment thickness.
来自JAMSTEC (DARWIN)、NCEI (GEODAS)、KHOA和KIGAM的海洋磁测数据。
GEBCO 2024水深、世界重力图均衡重力异常以及GlobSed全球沉积物厚度等网格数据。
li: Magnetic anomaly amplitudes are severely subdued (~70 nT) due to high heat flow (~120 mW/m²) and thermal blanketing by up to 10 km of sediments.
Magnetic lineations are locally obscured or disrupted near late-stage volcanic edifices and fracture zones.
受高热流（~120 mW/m²）和厚达10 km沉积物的热屏蔽效应影响，磁异常幅值显著减弱（~70 nT）。
在晚期火山机构和断裂带附近，磁异常条带局部被掩盖或打断。

tm.why: The paper investigates the seafloor spreading history, crustal thickness, and tectonic inversion of the Ulleung Basin in the East Sea using marine magnetic and gravity anomalies.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, 5 figures, and references.

sum: Open-ocean tsunami observations are sparse due to high infrastructure costs. This study demonstrates an end-to-end tsunami warning framework using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on a 400-km submarine telecommunication cable array (ABYSS observatory, ~26,664 channels) offshore Chile during the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka transoceanic tsunami. By applying a two-step common-mode instrumental noise removal and spatiotemporal median filtering (300–2000 s period, 2400 m window), coherent tsunami strain signals were recovered despite open-ocean amplitudes of only ~4 cm. Revealing strong spatial variability in cable sensitivity, the authors derived empirical channel-dependent strain-to-water-elevation conversion coefficients (1×10^7 to 5×10^7 m/strain) using DART-constrained simulations. Injecting calibrated DAS records as internal time-varying boundary conditions into a forward shallow-water tsunami propagation model (pCOMCOT) accurately reproduced coastal tide-gauge waveforms and provided 5 to 15 minutes of early warning lead time.
本研究利用智利近海400公里海底通信光缆分布式声学传感（DAS）阵列（约26664个通道），成功捕获了2025年7月29日堪察加Mw 8.8级地震引发的跨洋海啸。通过两步共模仪器噪声去除与时空滤波，在远洋海啸振幅仅约4厘米的情况下提取出相干海啸信号。针对光缆灵敏度的空间差异，作者结合DART浮标约束……

t: Suppresses common-mode DAS noise using low-sensitivity reference segments, applies spatiotemporal median filtering, empirically converts strain rate to water elevation, and injects cable records as internal time-varying boundary conditions into a pCOMCOT forward shallow-water model.
利用低灵敏参考段压制共模噪声并做时空滤波，经经验系数转换为水位后作为内部时变边界条件驱动pCOMCOT前向模拟。

2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka transoceanic tsunami recorded on the 400-km, 26,664-channel ABYSS submarine DAS array offshore central Chile (15 m spacing), alongside 8 Pacific DART buoys and 5 Chilean coastal tide gauges.
智利近海400公里（26664通道）ABYSS海底DAS阵列记录的2025年堪察加Mw 8.8海啸数据，及DART浮标与…

Coherent ~1,000 s tsunami signals (~4 cm RMS open-ocean height) were recovered with empirical conversion factors of 1×10^7 to 5×10^7 m/strain, accurately reconstructing coastal tide-gauge waveforms with 5–15 min warning lead time.
成功恢复约4厘米振幅、千秒周期的相干海啸波场，重构的沿岸海啸波形与验潮站吻合，实现5至15分钟预警提前量。

Cable strain response varies by over two orders of magnitude locally, requiring empirical calibration; near-field tsunamis will face additional challenges from seismic-wave contamination and DAS amplitude saturation.
光缆响应存在超两个数量级的局部差异需经验标定；近场海啸将面临地震波干扰和DAS振幅饱和问题。

First direct open-ocean observation of a coherent tectonic tsunami wavefield along hundreds of kilometers of submarine telecom cables and the first end-to-end DAS-driven coastal tsunami wave height forecast.
首次利用数百公里海底通信光缆直接观测到相干远洋构造海啸波场，并首次实现端到端的沿岸海啸波高预测。

kc: Recovered coherent open-ocean transoceanic tsunami wavefields (~4 cm amplitude, ~1000 s period) across 400 km of submarine telecom cables using DAS.

Characterized strong short-wavelength spatial heterogeneity in cable tsunami sensitivity and established empirical channel-dependent strain-to-water-elevation calibration coefficients (1×10^7 to 5×10^7 m/strain).
Developed a forward wavefield-reconstruction framework by injecting calibrated DAS time series as internal boundary conditions in pCOMCOT, achieving 5–15 min coastal warning lead times.
利用400公里海底通信光缆DAS阵列，提取出振幅仅约4厘米、周期约1000秒的相干远洋跨洋海啸波场。
揭示了光缆海啸灵敏度显著的短波长空间异质性，建立了通道依赖的经验应变-水位转换系数（1×10^7至5×10^7 m/strain）。
开发了将校准DAS时间序列作为内部边界条件注入pCOMCOT的前向波场重构方法，实现了5至15分钟的沿岸预警提前量。
me: Two-step common-mode noise suppression using weakly sensitive reference cable segments, followed by 300–2000 s zero-phase bandpass filtering and 2400-m spatial median filtering.
Empirical channel-wise calibration matching observed DAS strain-rate RMS to DART-constrained synthetic water-elevation-rate RMS, smoothed with an 8-km 2D geographic median filter.
Forward tsunami wavefield reconstruction using parallel linear shallow-water equations (pCOMCOT) driven by 520 internal boundary forcing stations along the cable.
采用基于弱灵敏参考段的两步共模噪声压制，结合300-2000秒零相位带通滤波和2400米滑动空间中值滤波。
将观测DAS应变率均方根与DART约束的合成水位变化率均方根匹配以获取经验校准系数，并应用8公里二维地理中值滤波。
利用沿光缆分布的520个重构站点作为内部时变边界条件，驱动并行线性浅水方程（pCOMCOT）进行前向海啸波场重构。
de: Continuous DAS strain-rate recordings from the ABYSS submarine observatory offshore central Chile (3 GTD cable segments: SER.N, SER.S, CCN.N; ~400 km total length; 26,664 channels at 15 m spacing) during the 29 July 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka tsunami.
Deep-ocean DART buoy tsunami waveforms (stations 21415, 21416, 21419 for source slip inversion; 5 additional stations including 32402 for validation) and 5 Chilean coastal tide-gauge records.
Synthetic Pacific-wide tsunami propagation simulations (EasyWave on ETOPOv2 2-min grid) and regional wavefield reconstruction simulations (pCOMCOT on GEBCO 2024 15-arcsec grid).
2025年7月29日堪察加Mw 8.8海啸期间智利中部近海ABYSS海底观测网（SER.N、SER.S、CCN.N三段光缆，总长约400公里，15米间距共26664个通道）的连续DAS记录。
太平洋深海DART浮标记录（3个台站用于震源反演，5个台站用于验证）以及智利沿岸5个验潮站的水位记录。
太平洋尺度的合成海啸传播模拟（基于ETOPOv2网格的EasyWave）及区域波场重构数值实验（基于GEBCO 2024 15角秒网格的pCOMCOT）。
li: Channel-to-channel sensitivity variations exceed two orders of magnitude and cannot be explained by existing physics-based compliance/Poisson models, requiring empirical event-based calibration.
Operational conversion will require validation across independent events and may need transfer functions dependent on incidence angle and frequency.
Near-field tsunami scenarios remain untested and face challenges from seismic-wave contamination, unmeasured seafloor permanent deformation, and DAS amplitude saturation.
通道间灵敏度变化超过两个数量级，现有物理模型无法解释，目前需依赖基于特定事件的经验校准。
业务化转换需独立数据集验证，且可能需要考虑依赖入射角和频率的传递函数。
近场海啸场景尚未验证，将面临地震波污染、海底永久形变信息缺失及DAS振幅饱和等挑战。

tm.why: The paper directly uses a 400-km submarine telecommunication cable instrumented with DAS (~26,000 channels) to detect and reconstruct a transoceanic tsunami wavefield.
The primary target of the fiber-optic sensing and forward wavefield reconstruction is oceanic tsunami propagation and coastal sea-level forecasting.
The study evaluates the instrumentation response, common-mode noise suppression, and spatial sensitivity transfer function of the ABYSS submarine cable observatory.

ev.notes: Full 19-page Research Square preprint PDF including Main text, Methods, References, and Figures 1-3 used for evaluation.

sum: This paper addresses a critical issue in statistical seismology: the comparison of new earthquake forecasting models against weak or 'under-implemented' Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) benchmarks. To ensure that improvements claimed by new models are scientifically interpretable and genuine, the author proposes the POGA (Parity of information, Optimization, Generality, and Assessment) test. This framework provides a systematic way to evaluate model comparisons, ensuring that the benchmark model is fully optimized and has access to the same information, thereby making model advancements truly meaningful.
本文针对统计地震学中一个关键问题展开讨论：新型地震预测模型常与未充分优化或受限的“低配版”ETAS基准模型进行对比。为了确保新模型所宣称的性能提升具有科学可解释性与真实性，作者提出了POGA（信息对等、优化、通用性与评估）测试框架。该框架为评估模型对比提供了系统性方法，确保基准模型得到充分优化并享有……

t: The POGA (Parity of information, Optimization, Generality, and Assessment) test framework designed to standardize and rigorous-up earthquake forecasting model comparisons.
提出POGA（信息对等、优化、通用性与评估）测试框架，用于规范和严格化地震预测模型的对比。
No specific dataset is analyzed; the study focuses on the methodology of benchmarking earthquake forecasting models like ETAS.
未分析具体数据集；本研究侧重于ETAS等地震预测模型基准测试的方法学。
Establishes a conceptual framework (POGA) to prevent misleading claims of outperforming ETAS due to under-implemented benchmarks.
建立了POGA概念框架，以防止因与未充分优化的基准对比而产生误导性的性能提升结论。
The framework's effectiveness relies on the community's willingness to adopt standardized benchmarking protocols.
该框架的有效性取决于学术界对采用标准化基准测试协议的意愿。
Introduces the concept of 'under-implemented ETAS' and provides the POGA test as a formal solution for fair model evaluation.
首次提出“未充分实现/低配ETAS”概念，并提供POGA测试作为公平模型评估的正式解决方案。

kc: Identifies the issue of 'under-implemented ETAS' benchmarks in earthquake forecasting literature.
Proposes the POGA (Parity of information, Optimization, Generality, and Assessment) test framework for rigorous model comparison.
指出了地震预测文献中将新模型与“未充分实现/低配”ETAS基准进行对比的问题。
提出了用于严格模型对比的POGA（信息对等、优化、通用性与评估）测试框架。
me: POGA (Parity of information, Optimization, Generality, and Assessment) test framework for statistical model evaluation.
用于统计模型评估的POGA（信息对等、优化、通用性与评估）测试框架。
de: Conceptual framework and methodological discussion on earthquake forecasting model benchmarking (no specific new dataset introduced).
关于地震预测模型基准测试的概念框架与方法学讨论（未引入具体的新数据集）。

本文主要属于概念和方法学讨论，其在实际中的应用取决于学术界的共识以及POGA测试的具体实现细节。

The paper proposes a framework (POGA test) for evaluating and comparing statistical models of earthquake occurrences.

sum: Static comparisons between energy release rate and fracture energy are widely used to predict earthquake arrest and build synthetic seismicity populations. This study tests the static arrest criterion against 2D fully dynamic rupture simulations (using fdfault) one rupture at a time across 60 antiplane and 60 in-plane cases on a 120 km fault with linear slip-weakening friction and stochastic initial shear stress. In 22 of 120 cases, the static criterion predicted arrest whereas the dynamic rupture spanned the fault; no disagreements occurred in the opposite direction. Where both calculations arrested, dynamic ruptures were systematically longer in 41 of 42 antiplane and 38 of 40 in-plane cases, with a median length ratio of 1.08 in both modes. While halving along-strike grid spacing confirmed all 22 disagreements, in-plane results showed sensitivity to across-fault grid resolution. This event-by-event benchmark highlights systematic underprediction by static arrest rules.
本研究在含线性滑移弱化摩擦和随机初始剪应力的120公里断层上，针对60个反平面和60个平面内算例，逐一对比了静态止裂长度与二维全动态破裂模拟（使用fdfault）。在120个算例中，有22个静态准则预测止裂但动态破裂贯穿了断层，且无反向分歧。在两者均止裂的算例中，动态破裂长度在两种模式下均系统性偏长……

t: 2D dynamic ruptures are simulated on a 120 km fault with linear slip-weakening friction using finite-difference code fdfault, and compared individually against static arrest lengths determined from crack-tip static stress intensity factors.
用fdfault模拟120公里断层上的二维动态破裂，并与基于裂尖静态应力强度因子的静态止裂长度逐一对比。

Sixty antiplane and sixty in-plane 2D synthetic ruptures generated using zero-mean stochastic initial shear stress fields with Hurst exponent 1, correlation length 2.03 km, and three standard deviations (0.343, 0.393, 0.443 times strength drop).
基于Hurst指数为1、相关长度2.03公里、三种标准差的随机初始剪应力场生成的60个反平面和60个平面内算例。

In 22 of 120 cases, static criteria predicted arrest while dynamic ruptures spanned the fault. Where both stopped, dynamic lengths exceeded static lengths in 41/42 antiplane and 38/40 in-plane cases (median ratio 1.08).
120个算例中22个静态预测止裂但动态贯穿断层；均止裂时动态长度更长，两种模式中位比值均为1.08。
Calculations only test 2D geometry, one fault length, one slip-weakening distance, and one correlation length; in-plane results also exhibit sensitivity to node count across the fault.
仅测试了二维、单一断层长度、滑移弱化距离和相关长度，且平面内结果对法向网格数敏感。
Tests the semi-dynamic/static arrest rule against fully dynamic simulations one random stress field at a time with pre-fixed criteria, rather than only comparing aggregate population distributions.
以预设规则逐个随机应力场对比静态止裂准则与全动态模拟，而非仅对比总体震级分布。

kc: Performed a paired, rupture-by-rupture benchmark of static arrest criteria against 2D dynamic rupture simulations across 60 antiplane and 60 in-plane cases.
Demonstrated a one-sided classification bias where 22 of 120 cases predicted to arrest statically actually spanned the 120 km fault dynamically.
Quantified that among arrested ruptures, dynamic lengths exceed static lengths with a median ratio of 1.08 in both antiplane and in-plane modes.
Evaluated numerical sensitivity to grid spacing along strike (200 m vs. 100 m) and across the fault (71 vs. 141 nodes).
针对60个反平面和60个平面内算例，开展了静态止裂准则与二维动态破裂模拟的逐事件配对基准对比。
揭示了单向分类偏差：120个算例中有22个静态预测止裂的算例在动态模拟中贯穿了120公里断层。
量化了在止裂事件中，反平面和平面内模式下动态破裂长度均大于静态长度，中位比值均为1.08。
评估了沿走向（200米与100米）和垂直断层方向（71与141节点）网格间距的数值敏感性。
me: 2D elastodynamic finite-difference rupture modeling using the fdfault solver with linear slip-weakening friction.
Static crack growth calculation using the semi-dynamic stress intensity factor arrest rule of Ampuero et al. (2006) applied at both crack tips.
Generation of zero-mean stochastic initial shear stress fields with Hurst exponent 1 and a correlation length of five antiplane nucleation half-lengths.
Pre-registered statistical sign tests and grid refinement sensitivity tests along and across the fault.
使用fdfault有限差分求解器和线性滑移弱化摩擦准则进行二维弹性动力学破裂模拟。
在裂纹两端应用Ampuero等(2006)的半动态应力强度因子止裂规则计算静态裂纹扩展长度。
生成Hurst指数为1、相关长度为5倍反平面成核半长的零均值随机初始剪应力场。
开展预先设定的统计符号检验以及沿断层走向和垂直断层方向的网格加密敏感性测试。
de: 60 antiplane and 60 in-plane 2D numerical rupture simulations on a 120 km fault across three normalized stress standard deviations (0.343, 0.393, 0.443).
An initial exploratory set of 30 antiplane ruptures used to establish the one-sided disagreement hypothesis.
Grid refinement reruns at 100 m along-strike spacing and comparison of 71 vs. 141 across-fault nodes for in-plane ruptures.
Sensitivity experiment applying an empirical fracture energy correction factor to the stochastic earthquake population model of McLaskey et al. (2026).
在120公里断层上针对三个归一化应力标准差（0.343、0.393、0.443）开展的60个反平面和60个平面内二维数值破裂模拟。
用于建立单向分歧检验规则的30个反平面破裂探索性算例集。
沿走向100米网格间距的加密重算，以及平面内破裂在垂直断层方向71与141个节点的对比实验。
将经验断裂能修正系数应用于McLaskey等(2026)随机地震群模型的敏感性实验。
li: Simulations are restricted to 2D geometry, a single fault length (120 km), one slip-weakening distance (0.4 m), and one correlation length (2.03 km).
In-plane rupture lengths and fault-spanning classifications are sensitive to across-fault grid spacing (71 vs. 141 nodes).
Full dynamic rupture simulations were not run directly on the rough stress fields of the McLaskey et al. (2026) population model.
模拟局限于二维几何结构、单一断层长度（120公里）、单一滑移弱化距离（0.4米）和单一相关长度（2.03公里）。
平面内破裂长度和贯穿分类对垂直断层方向的网格间距（71与141节点）较为敏感。
未在McLaskey等(2026)地震群模型的粗糙应力场上直接运行全动态破裂模拟。

tm.why: The paper directly compares static arrest lengths with 2D fully dynamic earthquake rupture simulations across a 120 km fault.
The study investigates linear slip-weakening friction, fracture energy, stress intensity factors, and random shear stress fields on faults.
The author uses the finite-difference elastodynamic code fdfault and evaluates grid spacing sensitivity along and across the fault.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 15-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including the main text (pages 1-9) and Supporting Information with Figures S1-S2 and Table S1 (pages 10-15).

sum: Imaging shallow crustal structures in volcanic areas typically relies on costly active-source surveys, while passive earthquake reflection imaging struggles with irregular source-receiver geometries and complex wavefields. This study introduces an integrated simulation-processing-migration workflow tested on a 1D layered velocity model of the Campi Flegrei caldera, Italy. Using discrete-wavenumber modeling (AXITRA), 400 microearthquakes (1–3 km depth, M 1–3) are simulated across 13 stations. Exploiting cylindrical symmetry, traces are sorted by hypocentral distance into Common Receiver Gathers to identify reflected and converted phases (PP, SP, SS, PS) via Podvin-Lecomte eikonal traveltimes. A 2D multi-phase Kirchhoff Pre-Stack Depth Migration (KPSDM) is applied to a subset of 12 events and 3 stations, followed by Shifted Total Variation (STV) regularization and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) envelope extraction. The workflow suppresses artifacts and recovers four major discontinuities (at ~2.7, 4.2, 7.6, and 9.1 km depth) robustly under noise and model perturbations.
针对火山区被动源地震反射成像受限于观测几何不规则和复杂波场的难题，本文以意大利Campi Flegrei破火山口为参考，提出了集波形模拟、震相识别与偏移成像于一体的工作流。研究利用AXITRA模拟了1-3 km深度的400个微震在13个台站的三分量记录，按震源距排序构建共接收点道集，结合Eikona……

t: The workflow integrates Podvin-Lecomte eikonal traveltimes with 2D multi-phase (PP, SP, SS, PS) Kirchhoff Pre-Stack Depth Migration, refined post-migration via Shifted Total Variation (STV) regularization and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) envelope peaking.
将Podvin-Lecomte走时计算与二维多震相（PP、SP、SS、PS）基尔霍夫叠前深度偏移结合，利用STV正则化和…

Using the AXITRA discrete-wavenumber code, 400 synthetic microearthquakes (M 1–3, depths 1–3 km) are simulated in a 6-layer 1D Campi Flegrei velocity model across 13 stations, with 12 events and 3 stations projected onto a 2D migration line.
利用AXITRA在Campi Flegrei六层1D模型中模拟13个台站记录的400个微震，筛选12个事件和3个台站投影…

The STV-PCA post-processing successfully recovers four major subsurface interfaces at 2.7 ± 0.3 km, 4.2 ± 0.2 km, 7.6 ± 0.3 km, and 9.1 ± 0.1 km, closely matching the true model depths of 2.8, 4.1, 7.6, and 8.8 km.

Recovering shallow interfaces (e.g., 0.7 km) fails due to excluding transmission waves above sources and sparse sampling, while 2D projection of 3D geometries and unmodeled multiples degrade coherence.
因排除透射波且浅部采样不足，未能恢复0.7 km浅界面；3D向2D投影及多次波限制了连续性。

Combines multi-phase passive Kirchhoff migration (PP, SP, SS, PS) with Shifted Total Variation regularization and PCA within an integrated simulation-to-extraction workflow for volcanic caldera imaging.
首次将多震相被动源KPSDM与平移全变分（STV）正则化及PCA融合，用于火山口地壳不连续面定量提取。

kc: Developed an end-to-end passive seismic imaging workflow combining complete-wavefield synthesis, kinematic phase identification, and multi-phase Kirchhoff pre-stack depth migration (KPSDM).
Introduced a post-migration refinement combining Shifted Total Variation (STV) regularization and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to suppress velocity-mismatch and multiple artifacts.
Demonstrated reliable recovery of four major crustal interfaces (2.8, 4.1, 7.6, and 8.8 km) in a synthetic Campi Flegrei model despite sparse station coverage and source parameter uncertainties.
开发了集全波场模拟、运动学震相识别和多震相基尔霍夫叠前深度偏移（KPSDM）于一体的被动源地震成像工作流。
提出了结合平移全变分（STV）正则化和主成分分析（PCA）的偏移后处理方法，有效压制了速度失配和多次波假象。
在台站稀疏及震源参数存在不确定性的条件下，成功恢复了Campi Flegrei合成模型中2.8、4.1、7.6和8.8 km处的四个主要地壳界面。
me: Discrete-wavenumber full-wavefield synthetic seismogram generation using the AXITRA code across varying focal mechanisms and magnitudes.
Common Receiver Gather (CRG) construction sorted by hypocentral distance, with FilterPicker onset detection, cross-correlation alignment, polarity correction, and Automatic Gain Control (AGC).
Theoretical traveltime calculation for primary reflected and converted phases (PP, SP, SS, PS) using the Fast-Marching Method and Podvin-Lecomte Algorithm.
2D Multi-phase Kirchhoff Pre-Stack Depth Migration (KPSDM) weighted by geometrical spreading and Kirchhoff incidence/reflection angles.
Post-migration Shifted Total Variation (STV) regularization guided by a smoothed background velocity model, followed by PCA and Hilbert envelope interface depth estimation.
利用AXITRA离散波数法程序生成不同震源机制和震级的全波场合成地震图。
按震源距排序构建共接收点道集（CRG），结合FilterPicker初至拾取、互相关对齐、极性校正和自动增益控制（AGC）。
采用快速行进法（FMM）和Podvin-Lecomte算法（PLA）计算PP、SP、SS和PS一次反射及转换震相的理论走时。
实施顾及几何扩散和基尔霍夫入射/反射角加权的二维多震相基尔霍夫叠前深度偏移（KPSDM）。
以平滑背景速度模型为引导进行偏移后平移全变分（STV）正则化，并利用PCA和希尔伯特包络提取界面深度。
de: Synthetic database of 400 microearthquakes (M 1–3, depths 1–3 km, 1 MPa stress drop) recorded by 13 surface stations in a 6-interface 1D velocity model of Campi Flegrei.
2D migration experiment projecting 12 homogeneous-magnitude (Mw ~ 1) earthquakes and 3 stations onto a best-fit vertical plane.

Sensitivity and robustness tests incorporating band-limited Gaussian noise (1–50 Hz, SNR = 10), hypocentral errors (20–100 m horizontal, 30–150 m depth), and velocity/interface perturbations (up to ±8% and 200 m).
基于Campi Flegrei含6个界面的1D速度模型，模拟了由13个地表台站记录的400个微震（震级1-3，深度1-3 km，应力降1 MPa）合成数据集。
选取12个相近震级（Mw ~ 1）的地震和3个台站投影至最佳拟合二维垂直剖面进行偏移成像实验。
开展敏感性与稳健性测试，引入带限高斯噪声（1-50 Hz，SNR=10）、震源位置误差（水平20-100 m，深度30-150 m）以及速度和界面深度扰动（最高±8%和200 m）。
li: Assumes a simplified 1D horizontally layered velocity model and projects a 3D source-receiver geometry onto a 2D profile, neglecting 3D lateral heterogeneities.
Fails to recover the shallowest interfaces (e.g., 0.1 and 0.7 km) because transmission paths above the sources are excluded and shallow wavefield sampling is limited.
Does not explicitly migrate or suppress free-surface and internal multiples prior to migration, nor does it correct for earthquake focal mechanism radiation patterns during KPSDM.
假设了简化的1D水平层状速度模型并将3D观测几何投影到2D剖面，忽略了真实火山环境的三维横向不均匀性。
未能恢复最浅部界面（如0.1和0.7 km），因为排除了震源上方的透射波分析且浅部波场采样受限。
未在偏移中显式处理自由地表和层间多次波，也未在偏移过程中校正地震震源机制辐射花样的影响。

tm.why: The paper develops a multi-phase Kirchhoff pre-stack depth migration workflow to image shallow crustal discontinuities using reflected and converted body-wave phases (PP, PS, SP, SS) from local earthquakes.
The study uses the Campi Flegrei volcanic caldera in southern Italy as its target test-site to image shallow volcanic deposits, supercritical fluid-bearing formations, and deeper magmatic sills.
The workflow incorporates Shifted Total Variation (STV) regularization and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to suppress migration artifacts and stabilize structural interface extraction.

ev.notes: Full 60-page unedited manuscript PDF read and analyzed, including equations, methodology, synthetic setup, and all 12 figures.

sum: This study introduces the Basin Sloshing Index (BSI), a dimensionless metric inspired by fluid mechanics to characterize long-period ground motion and persistent resonance in large sedimentary basins. Defined as BSI = 2πQ(L/λ)—where L is basin scale, λ is seismic wavelength, and Q is the attenuation quality factor—the index measures the ratio of inertial dominance to damping. Using representative parameters for the Kanto Basin (L = 100 km, λ = 5 km, Q = 100) yields BSI ≈ 12,500, which matches the dimensionless value of jiggling cake batter in a pan (L = 20 cm, λ = 5 cm, Q ≈ 500). This high BSI explains 5–10 s band amplification, prolonged shaking exceeding 100 s, and long-term dynamic flattening of basin geomorphology. Furthermore, whole-Earth free oscillations yield BSI ≈ 2,500, placing basin resonance and planetary oscillations on the same dimensionless worldline.
本研究受流体力学启发，提出无量纲“盆地晃动指数”（BSI = 2πQL/λ），结合盆地尺度L、地震波长λ和衰减因子Q来统一解释大型沉积盆地的长周期地震动与持久共振。应用关东盆地典型参数计算得BSI约为12,500，与烤盘中蛋糕糊晃动系统的BSI完全一致，表明长周期下固体地球呈现强惯性主导的类流体行为……

t: Defines a dimensionless Basin Sloshing Index BSI = 2πQ(L/λ) combining basin spatial scale L, seismic wavelength λ, and attenuation quality factor Q to measure the ratio of inertial to damping forces.
定义结合盆地尺度L、波长λ和衰减因子Q的无量纲盆地晃动指数BSI = 2πQ(L/λ)，衡量惯性与阻尼之比。
Uses representative literature parameters for the Kanto Basin (L = 100 km, λ = 5 km, Q = 100), a 20 cm pan of cake batter (λ = 5 cm, Q ≈ 500), and PREM whole-Earth free oscillations.
采用关东盆地文献代表值（L=100 km, λ=5 km, Q=100）、20 cm烤盘蛋糕糊及PREM地球自由振荡参数…

Both the Kanto Basin and the cake-pan system yield BSI ≈ 12,500 (12,566), while whole-Earth free oscillations yield BSI ≈ 2,500 (1,500–3,000), placing all three in the same inertia-dominated sloshing regime.
关东盆地与蛋糕糊系统的BSI均为约12,500，地球自由振荡BSI约为2,500，均处于惯性主导区。
The study only introduces the conceptual dimensionless index; detailed numerical modeling, regional parameterization, and basin-specific validations are left for future research.
仅提出无量纲概念框架，精细数值模拟、区域参数化及具体盆地验证有待未来研究。
Introduces the first single dimensionless index (BSI) in seismology to intuitively quantify basin sloshing tendency and link basin resonance to fluid sloshing and global free oscillations.
首次提出单一无量纲指数直观量化盆地晃动趋势，连通盆地共振、流体晃动与地球自由振荡。

kc: Formulates the dimensionless Basin Sloshing Index (BSI = 2πQL/λ) to quantify basin resonance tendency.
Demonstrates that the Kanto Basin (BSI ≈ 12,500) shares the exact dimensionless regime as a cake-batter sloshing analogy.
Connects basin-scale long-period ground motion and whole-Earth free oscillations (BSI ≈ 2,500) along a unified inertia-dominated worldline.
提出无量纲盆地晃动指数（BSI = 2πQL/λ）以量化盆地共振趋势。
证明关东盆地（BSI ≈ 12,500）与烤盘蛋糕糊晃动比拟模型处于完全相同的无量纲惯性主导区。
将盆地尺度长周期地震动与全地球自由振荡（BSI ≈ 2,500）统一在同一惯性主导的世界线上。
me: Dimensionless scaling analysis inspired by fluid mechanics (Reynolds and Froude numbers).
Order-of-magnitude estimation of BSI using representative physical scales and attenuation factors Q.
Comparative analogy modeling between viscoelastic solid Earth systems and macroscopic fluid-like oscillators.
受流体力学（雷诺数和弗劳德数）启发的无量纲量纲分析。
利用代表性物理尺度和衰减因子Q进行BSI数量级估计。
粘弹性固体地球系统与宏观类流体振子之间的类比建模。
de: Literature-derived parameters for the Kanto Basin (L = 100 km, λ = 5 km, Q = 100 from 3D velocity models).
Empirical oscillation decay parameters for a 20 cm cake-pan system (λ = 5 cm, effective Q ≈ 500).
PREM-based parameters for whole-Earth free oscillations (L ≈ 6,371 km, λ ≈ 10,000 km, Q ≈ 300–500).
基于文献三维速度模型的关东盆地代表性参数（L = 100 km, λ = 5 km, Q = 100）。
20厘米烤盘蛋糕糊系统的经验振荡衰减参数（λ = 5 cm, 有效Q ≈ 500）。
基于PREM模型的全地球自由振荡参数（L ≈ 6,371 km, λ ≈ 10,000 km, Q ≈ 300–500）。
li: Relies purely on simplified order-of-magnitude back-of-the-envelope estimates without 3D numerical wave propagation simulations.
Lacks rigorous continuum mechanics derivation linking viscoelastic wave equations to the scalar BSI definition.
Does not validate the index across diverse sedimentary basins or observational strong-motion datasets.
仅依赖简化的数量级估算，缺乏三维数值波传播模拟验证。
缺乏将粘弹性波动方程与标量BSI定义联系起来的严格连续介质力学推导。
未在多个不同沉积盆地或实际强震观测数据集上验证该指数。

tm.why: The paper proposes a dimensionless index to explain amplified long-period ground motion and prolonged shaking (>100 s) in large sedimentary basins like the Kanto Basin.
The proposed Basin Sloshing Index directly relies on the seismic quality factor Q to quantify damping versus inertia in long-period basin resonance.

ev.notes: Full 7-page English translation preprint PDF evaluated directly.

sum: The 2025 M7.8 Mandalay earthquake ruptured ~480 km of the Sagaing Fault in Myanmar. Combining Sentinel-1, ALOS-2, and Sentinel-2 geodetic imagery with 3D dynamic rupture simulations (SeisSol) and teleseismic back-projection, this study demonstrates that subsurface fault geometry and slip amplitude could be anticipated from pre-event observations. Asymmetric cross-fault deformation reveals a helix-shaped fault geometry dipping east in the north and west in the south. Comparing coseismic slip with interseismic slip deficit supports a minimally slip-predictable behavior where slip equals or exceeds accumulated deficit. The authors generate an ensemble of 180 dynamic rupture models constrained by static slip, validated against teleseismic, strong-motion (NPW), and near-fault CCTV observations. The preferred model shows bilateral initiation transitioning to southward supershear rupture at depth while remaining subshear near the surface, driven by low fracture energy (0.83 MJ/m²) and stress heterogeneity, reconciling seemingly contradictory near-field CCTV and seismic station records.
本研究结合空间大地测量（Sentinel-1/2、ALOS-2）、远震反投影、近场强震与监控视频及SeisSol三维动力学破裂模拟，研究了2025年缅甸曼德勒M7.8级地震（破裂长约480公里）。同震与震间形变揭示实皆断层呈北段东倾、南段西倾的螺旋状几何形态。同震滑移等于或超过震间滑移亏损，符合“最……

t: Piece-wise linear triangular elements invert geodetic offsets for static slip on a curved 3D mesh, which initializes an ensemble of 180 3D ADER-DG (SeisSol) dynamic rupture simulations with linear slip-weakening friction.
用三维曲面三角形单元反演大地测量静态滑移，以此约束并生成180个SeisSol三维动力学破裂模拟集合。

Sentinel-1A and ALOS-2 SAR data, Sentinel-2 optical imagery, regional teleseismic array waveforms (AK, AU, EU), near-fault strong-motion station NPW records, and near-field CCTV video slip-rate estimates.
Sentinel-1/2与ALOS-2卫星大地测量数据、区域台阵远震波形、NPW近场强震记录及CCTV监控视频。

The fault ruptured ~480 km with peak slip ~5.5 m (Mw 7.81) on a helix-shaped geometry. The preferred dynamic model (GOF 0.72, fracture energy 0.83 MJ/m²) features deep southward supershear and shallow subshear rupture.
破裂长约480公里，峰值滑移5.5米（Mw 7.81），断层呈螺旋状；优选动力学模型呈深部超剪切、浅部亚剪切。
Dynamic rupture parameterizations are non-unique with trade-offs among normal stress, strength drop, and weakening distance, constrained by sparse near-fault observations and a 1D velocity model.
动力学摩擦与初始应力参数存在多解性折衷，受限于稀疏近场台站和一维速度结构假设。

Demonstrates predictability of helix fault geometry and minimum coseismic slip from pre-event geodesy, and resolves conflicting near-field subshear CCTV and supershear seismic records via depth-dependent rupture speeds.
证明震前形变可预测螺旋断层几何与最小同震滑移，并用深度依赖破裂速度调和了近场视频与强震记录的矛盾。

kc: Reveals a 3D helix-shaped subsurface geometry of the Sagaing Fault from asymmetric coseismic and interseismic surface displacements.
Demonstrates that the 2025 M7.8 Mandalay earthquake obeys a 'minimally slip-predictable' model where segment-averaged coseismic slip equals or exceeds the accumulated interseismic slip deficit.

Generates an ensemble of 180 physics-based 3D dynamic rupture simulations (plus 180 bimaterial models) constrained by static geodetic slip and validated against teleseismic, strong-motion, and CCTV records.

Reconciles conflicting near-field subshear CCTV slip-rate observations and fast seismic arrival times at station NPW via depth-dependent rupture propagation (supershear at depth, subshear near the surface).
基于不对称的同震和震间地表位移，揭示了实皆断层三维螺旋状的地下几何形态。
证明2025年曼德勒M7.8地震遵循“最小滑移可预测”模型，即断层段平均同震滑移量等于或超过累积的震间滑移亏损。
构建了由静态大地测量滑移约束的180个三维动力学破裂模型集合（及180个双材料模型），并利用远震、强震和监控视频记录进行了验证。
通过深度依赖的破裂传播模式（深部超剪切、浅部亚剪切），调和了近场CCTV亚剪切滑移率观测与NPW地震台快速初至时间之间的矛盾。
me: Space-geodetic processing of SAR azimuth offsets, InSAR line-of-sight displacements, and optical image cross-correlation to retrieve 3D surface displacements.
Linear geodetic slip inversion using piece-wise linear triangular dislocation elements in a 1D layered elastic half-space with hybrid discrete Laplacian smoothing.
3D spontaneous dynamic rupture modeling using the ADER-DG solver SeisSol with linear slip-weakening friction and prestress derived from dynamic relaxation of the static slip model.
Time-domain, phase-weighted relative teleseismic back-projection using regional arrays in Australia, Alaska, and Europe.
处理SAR方位向偏移、InSAR视线向位移及光学影像互相关，反演三维同震地表位移场。
在一维分层弹性半空间中，利用分片线性三角形位错元和混合离散拉普拉斯平滑进行大地测量静态滑移反演。
使用ADER-DG求解器SeisSol进行三维自发动力学破裂模拟，采用线性滑移弱化摩擦准则及由静态滑移动力学松弛导出的初始应力场。
利用澳大利亚、阿拉斯加和欧洲区域台阵数据进行时域相位加权相对远震反投影。
de: Sentinel-1A TOPS SAR azimuth offsets, ALOS-2 ScanSAR interferograms, and Sentinel-2 optical imagery (COSI-Corr) spanning the ~480 km rupture.
Teleseismic P-waveforms from Alaska (81 stations), Australia (62 stations), and Europe (31 stations) arrays filtered between 0.4–2 Hz.
Near-fault strong-motion records from station NPW (2.6 km from the fault) and kinematic slip-rate/trajectory observations derived from a near-fault CCTV camera.
Two ensembles of 180 3D dynamic rupture simulations (reference 1D velocity structure and ±10% bimaterial velocity contrast) plus localized deep barrier tests.
覆盖约480公里破裂带的Sentinel-1A方位向偏移、ALOS-2干涉图和Sentinel-2光学影像（COSI-Corr）。
来自阿拉斯加（81个台站）、澳大利亚（62个台站）和欧洲（31个台站）台阵的0.4–2 Hz带通滤波远震P波波形。
距断层2.6公里的NPW强震台记录，以及由近断层CCTV监控视频提取的滑移率脉冲和弯曲滑移轨迹数据。
两个各包含180个三维动力学破裂模拟的集合（一维参考速度模型和±10%双材料速度对比模型）以及局部深部障碍体测试。
li: Frictional parameterization and initial stress conditions suffer from non-unique trade-offs among effective normal stress, strength drop, and critical slip-weakening distance.
Sparse near-fault instrumentation limits the ability to constrain fine-scale spatial variations in dynamic parameters or apply full Bayesian inversions.
The dynamic simulations rely on a 1D layered velocity model and linear slip-weakening friction rather than 3D heterogeneous structure or enhanced thermal/fluid weakening laws.
摩擦参数化与初始应力条件在有效正应力、强度降和临界滑移弱化距离之间存在非唯一性折衷。
近断层观测台站稀疏，限制了对动力学参数小尺度空间变化的约束能力及全贝叶斯反演的应用。
动力学模拟采用了简化的一维分层速度模型和线性滑移弱化摩擦律，未纳入三维非均匀结构或增强的热/流体弱化机制。

tm.why: The paper investigates the coseismic slip, 3D dynamic rupture ensemble, and supershear propagation of the 2025 M7.8 Mandalay earthquake.
The study explores linear slip-weakening friction, fracture energy, prestress heterogeneity, and interseismic slip deficits on the Sagaing Fault.
The authors run 360 3D dynamic rupture simulations using the ADER-DG solver SeisSol on high-performance computing architectures.

sum: Despite being within 30 km of the 1956 Ms 7.4 Amorgos earthquake rupture, Amorgos Island experienced unexpectedly low damage compared to Santorini. To resolve this paradox, this study presents the first comprehensive geophysical site characterization of Amorgos, combining passive Ambient Vibration Arrays (AVAs), single-station MHVSR, active Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW), and seismic refraction tomography. Additionally, the authors compare seismic responses between Amorgos, Santorini, and Anafi using 46 local earthquakes (M > 3.2), including the early 2025 Santorini-Amorgos seismic crisis. Results show that Amorgos features shallow sedimentary basins (< 30 m) with stiff soils (Vs > 350 m/s) and widespread competent bedrock lacking topographic or site amplification. Furthermore, Amorgos recordings exhibit 1.5–3 times shorter Arias durations and strong attenuation above 6 Hz—the resonant frequency band of traditional Cycladic masonry buildings—explaining the mitigated 1956 impacts while questioning historical macroseismic intensity IX reports at Potamos.
尽管阿莫尔戈斯岛距1956年Ms 7.4级大地震破裂带不足30公里，其震害却远轻于圣托里尼岛。本研究首次对该岛开展综合地球物理场地表征，结合被动源背景噪声台阵（AVA）、单台H/V谱比（MHVSR）、主动源多道面波分析（MASW）及地震折射层析成像，并利用2025年初圣托里尼-阿莫尔戈斯地震序列等4……

t: Joint inversion of broadband Rayleigh and Love wave dispersion curves (derived from MSPAC and F-K analysis of passive AVAs and active MASW) with MHVSR curves, complemented by P/S-wave traveltime refraction tomography and earthquake HVSR/spectrogram analysis.
将被动源台阵与主动源MASW提取的宽频带瑞利/勒夫波频散曲线与MHVSR联合反演，并结合折射层析成像与地震动时频分析。

Passive circular arrays (AVAs), 6 linear MASW profiles, and 11 MHVSR stations on Amorgos, combined with waveforms from 46 local earthquakes (M 3.2–6.1, 2003–2007 and the 2025 swarm) across Amorgos, Santorini, and Anafi.
阿莫尔戈斯岛3个圆形台阵、6条MASW测线和11个H/V测点，以及2003-2007年和2025年震群的46次地方震波形…

Amorgos basins have shallow (<30 m), stiff sediments (Vs > 350 m/s, Vp > 600 m/s), while bedrock stations show flat HVSR, 1.5–3 times shorter Arias durations than Santorini/Anafi, and strong energy attenuation above 6 Hz.
阿莫尔戈斯盆地沉积层浅（<30 m）且坚硬（Vs>350 m/s），基岩无场地放大，地震动持时短1.5-3倍，且6 Hz…

Available seismic records and station coverage cannot conclusively disentangle rupture directivity or normal-fault footwall effects, nor can geophysical data fully explain historical macroseismic intensity IX at Potamos.
现有台站密度与数据尚不足以完全区分破裂方向性与正断层下盘效应，也无法仅靠场地效应解释波塔莫斯IX度历史烈度。

First comprehensive active/passive geophysical site characterization of Amorgos Island combined with 2025 seismic crisis recordings to explain divergent near-fault impacts of the historic 1956 Ms 7.4 earthquake.
首次对阿莫尔戈斯岛开展主被动源综合地球物理表征，并结合2025年地震危机数据揭示1956年大地震近断层震害差异机制。

kc: Conducted the first comprehensive geophysical site characterization of Amorgos Island using AVAs, MASW, MHVSR, and P/S-wave seismic refraction tomography.
Demonstrated stiff soil conditions (Type B, Vs > 350 m/s, shallow basins < 30 m) and flat bedrock responses without topographic amplification across Amorgos.

Compared local earthquake recordings from 2002–2007 and the 2025 seismic crisis across Amorgos, Santorini, and Anafi, highlighting strong caldera-rim amplification on Santorini versus short durations and high-frequency (> 6 Hz) attenuation on Amorgos.

Reassessed the 1956 Ms 7.4 earthquake macroseismic patterns, attributing low Amorgos damage to geological attenuation, short shaking duration, and possible footwall effects while questioning the reliability of intensity IX at Potamos.
结合背景噪声台阵（AVA）、主动源面波（MASW）、H/V谱比（MHVSR）和折射层析成像，首次对阿莫尔戈斯岛进行了全面的地球物理场地表征。
证实阿莫尔戈斯岛沉积盆地浅（<30 m）且土质坚硬（Vs > 350 m/s），基岩场地谱比平坦且无明显地形放大效应。
对比了2002-2007年及2025年地震危机在阿莫尔戈斯、圣托里尼和阿纳菲的记录，揭示圣托里尼破火山口边缘强烈的放大与方向性效应，以及阿莫尔戈斯极短的持时与高频（>6 Hz）衰减。
重新评估了1956年Ms 7.4地震的宏观烈度分布，将阿莫尔戈斯的轻度震害归因于地质衰减、短持时及潜在的下盘效应，并质疑了波塔莫斯IX度烈度的可靠性。
me: Passive surface-wave dispersion analysis using 400-m double-circle Ambient Vibration Arrays (AVAs) processed with MSPAC (0.5–2 Hz) and high-resolution Capon F-K (2–5 Hz) methods.
Active-source Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) along 24-channel linear profiles processed with F-K analysis (> 4 Hz) for both Rayleigh (vertical/in-line) and Love (cross-line) waves.
Joint inversion of broadband Rayleigh/Love phase-velocity dispersion curves and averaged MHVSR curves using a combined Guided Monte Carlo and Simplex Downhill protocol in HV-Inv.
P- and S-wave first-arrival picking and nonlinear traveltime refraction tomography using the Refrapy Python package.
Earthquake Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (EHVSR) directional polar analysis, PGA, Arias significant duration (D5-95%), and normalized time-frequency spectrogram computation.
利用直径400米双圆环背景噪声台阵（AVA），结合修正空间自相关法（MSPAC，0.5–2 Hz）和高分辨率Capon频率-波数法（F-K，2–5 Hz）提取被动源面波频散曲线。
利用24道线性测线开展主动源多道面波分析（MASW），通过F-K分析提取高频（>4 Hz）瑞利波和勒夫波频散曲线。
使用HV-Inv软件，结合引导蒙特卡洛与单纯形下山优化算法，对宽频带瑞利/勒夫波频散曲线与MHVSR曲线进行联合反演。
利用Refrapy软件包拾取P波和S波初至，并开展线性时间项分析与非线性走时折射层析成像。
计算地震动水平与垂直谱比（EHVSR）及方位角极坐标分布、峰值地面加速度（PGA）、Arias显著持时（D5-95%）以及归一化时频谱图。
de: Field campaign on Amorgos across Aegiali, Katapola, Arkesini, Chora, and Potamos featuring 3 circular AVAs (11–12 SmartSolo 3C nodes each), 6 linear 24-channel MASW profiles, and 11 single-station MHVSR points.

Catalogue of 46 regional/local crustal earthquakes (3.2 <= M <= 6.1) recorded by permanent Greek network stations (AMGA, ANAF, CMBO, THRA, AKRO, THERA) during the Jan–May 2025 crisis (14 events, Mw >= 4.4) and temporary GFZ CYCNET/Z3 stations (AMOE, AMOW, AMOS) from 2003–2007 (32 events).

Historical macroseismic archival records from the 1956 earthquake, including the 1956 Military Engineering report from the Syros State Archives, municipal telegrams, and resident interviews in Potamos.
在阿莫尔戈斯岛五个主要定居点开展野外地球物理勘探，包含3个圆形背景噪声台阵（各11-12个三分量节点）、6条24道线性MASW测线和11个单台MHVSR测点。
收集了46次地方地壳地震（3.2 <= M <= 6.1）波形记录，包括希腊永久台网记录的2025年1-5月地震危机事件（14次，Mw >= 4.4）及2003-2007年GFZ临时台网记录的32次事件。
调研了1956年大地震历史宏观震害档案，包括锡罗斯国家档案馆的1956年军事工程报告、市政电报以及波塔莫斯村居民访谈记录。
li: Ambient-noise and moderate-earthquake analyses do not directly capture potential nonlinear site responses during M > 7 strong shaking.
Existing station density and earthquake dataset size are insufficient to definitively separate normal-fault footwall/hanging-wall effects from source rupture directivity for the 1956 event.
Historical documentary records from 1956 have gaps and possible population-density biases between northern and southern Amorgos.
基于背景噪声和中等强度地震的分析无法直接捕捉7级以上强震动下潜在的非线性场地响应。
现有的台站密度和地震数据集规模尚不足以完全区分正断层上下盘效应与1956年地震破裂方向性效应。
1956年的历史文献档案存在缺失，且阿莫尔戈斯岛南北人口密度差异可能导致宏观烈度统计偏差。

The authors use ambient vibration arrays (AVAs) with MSPAC and F-K processing alongside microtremor horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (MHVSR) to characterize subsurface shear-wave velocity profiles.
The study performs joint inversions of Rayleigh/Love surface-wave dispersion curves and MHVSR, complemented by active-source P- and S-wave seismic refraction traveltime tomography.
