sum: Standard probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) estimates ground-motion exceedance probabilities at single locations rather than anywhere across a continuous region. This study develops a framework for area-based PSHA by integrating multivariate normal ground-motion fields over densely discretized grids. Using 16,416 peak ground acceleration (PGA) observations from the 2019 Ridgecrest aftershock sequence, the authors constrain a twice-differentiable Matérn spatial covariance function (η = 7.9 km, ν = 1.1). They benchmark three stochastic samplers, demonstrating that Importance Sampling using Elementary Events (ISEE) combined with covariance matrix eigenvalue truncation is vastly more efficient than Direct Monte Carlo or Subset Simulation, with flat unit coefficient of variation across low probabilities. Applied to the San Francisco Bay Area using 924,761 NSHM23 M3.5+ sources at 2-km spacing, the 10-year probability of PGA exceeding 0.1g, 0.4g, and 0.8g somewhere in the region exceeds 99%, 99%, and 93%, respectively, dominated by moderate (M3.5–6.5) earthquakes.
传统概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）仅针对单一位置，本文提出了评估区域内任一位置发生强震动概率的区域PSHA方法。基于2019年Ridgecrest余震序列的16,416条PGA记录，构建了二阶可微的Matérn空间协方差模型（η=7.9 km，ν=1.1）。基准测试表明，结合协方差矩阵特征值截断的基……

t: Estimates regional ground-motion exceedance probabilities by modeling shaking across a discretized grid as a multivariate normal distribution with a Matérn covariance function, evaluated via Importance Sampling using Elementary Events (ISEE) and covariance matrix eigenvalue truncation.
利用Matérn协方差多元正态分布建模离散网格震动场，结合特征值截断与ISEE重要性采样计算区域超越概率。

Uses 16,416 PGA observations (1,744,860 station pairs) from 120 Ridgecrest aftershocks (M3.3–5.0) to fit the Matérn correlation model, plus 924,761 M3.5+ ruptures from NSHM23 across 6,868 Bay Area grid points.
使用Ridgecrest余震的16,416条PGA记录拟合相关模型，并结合NSHM23中924,761个M3.5+震源与…

ISEE achieves constant unit coefficient of variation across all thresholds with 1,000–10,000 samples. In the Bay Area, 10-year probabilities of PGA exceeding 0.1g, 0.2g, 0.4g, and 0.8g are >99%, >99%, >99%, and 93%, respectively.
ISEE仅需千至万次采样即可稳定收敛；湾区10年内某处PGA超0.1g、0.4g和0.8g的概率分别为>99%、>99%…

Uses a single ergodic GMM (BSSA14), transfers Ridgecrest spatial correlations to the Bay Area, and applies grid spacing (0.02°), eigenvalue truncation, and constant-φ approximations that slightly underestimate hazard.
使用单一遍历性GMM和异地相关模型，且网格间距与矩阵截断等近似略微低估了概率。

First computationally tractable framework integrating continuous spatially correlated ground-motion fields over an entire region to compute area-wide exceedance probabilities, identifying the requirement for twice-differentiable (Matérn ν > 1) spatial correlation.
首次建立对连续空间相关震动场进行区域积分的高效PSHA框架，并阐明二阶可微Matérn相关函数的必要性。

kc: Formulates a rigorous area-based PSHA methodology that integrates continuous spatial fields of ground shaking using a discretized grid of multivariate normal distributions.

Establishes a well-constrained Matérn spatial correlation model (η = 7.9 km, ν = 1.1) from dense nodal and network recordings of 2019 Ridgecrest aftershocks, showing that smooth derivatives (ν > 1) are required for grid convergence.
Demonstrates that Importance Sampling using Elementary Events (ISEE) paired with 99%-variance eigenvalue truncation of covariance matrices achieves threshold-independent statistical efficiency.

Computes 1- to 30-year regional shaking probabilities for the San Francisco Bay Area, showing 10-year exceedance probabilities >99% for 0.4g and 93% for 0.8g, driven primarily by M3.5–6.5 earthquakes.
建立了一套严格的区域概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）方法，利用离散化多元正态分布网格对连续空间地震动场进行积分。
基于2019年Ridgecrest余震的密集节点台阵和台网记录，建立了约束良好的Matérn空间相关模型（η = 7.9 km, ν = 1.1），证明空间导数连续性（ν > 1）是网格收敛的必要条件。
证明了基本事件重要性采样（ISEE）结合保留99%总变异的协方差矩阵特征值截断，可实现与超越阈值无关的高统计效率。
计算了旧金山湾区1至30年的区域震动概率，发现未来10年超0.4g和0.8g的概率分别达>99%和93%，且主要由M3.5–6.5中强地震主导。
me: Empirical ground-motion residual analysis using the BSSA14 NGA-West2 GMM and nonlinear least-squares fitting of a Matérn spatial covariance function.
Stochastic simulation benchmarking comparing Direct Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS), Subset Simulation (SS), and Importance Sampling using Elementary Events (ISEE).
Dimensionality reduction of spatial covariance matrices via eigenvalue decomposition truncation retaining 99% of cumulative total variation.
Area-based PSHA computation across 6,868 grid points (0.02° spacing) and 924,761 earthquake ruptures from NSHM23 using OpenSHA and NASA supercomputing.
利用BSSA14 NGA-West2地面运动模型进行经验地震动残差分析，并通过非线性最小二乘法拟合Matérn空间协方差函数。
对比直接蒙特卡洛模拟（MCS）、子集模拟（SS）和基本事件重要性采样（ISEE）的随机模拟基准测试。
通过保留99%累积总变异的特征值分解截断，对空间协方差矩阵进行降维。
利用OpenSHA和NASA超级计算机，在6,868个网格点（0.02°间距）和NSHM23的924,761个地震破裂源上进行区域PSHA计算。
de: 16,416 PGA observations (1,744,860 station pairs within 50 km) from 120 aftershocks (3.3 ≤ M ≤ 5.0) of the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence recorded by permanent networks and dense nodal arrays (~100 m spacing).
Numerical benchmarks in San Francisco (129 grid points at 0.01° spacing) using the 1957 M5.3 Daly City earthquake and a California Vs30 model.
San Francisco Bay Area case study using 924,761 M3.5+ shallow crustal ruptures within 300 km from the 2023 US National Seismic Hazard Model (NSHM23) and the 1967–2022 M4+ earthquake catalog.
来自2019年Ridgecrest序列120次余震（3.3 ≤ M ≤ 5.0）的16,416条PGA观测数据（50 km内共1,744,860个台站对），由固定台网和密集节点台阵（间距约100 m）记录。
以1957年M5.3 Daly City地震和加州Vs30模型为基础，在旧金山（0.01°间距，129个网格点）开展数值基准测试。
旧金山湾区案例研究，使用2023年美国国家地震危险性模型（NSHM23）中距研究区300 km内的924,761个M3.5+浅源地壳破裂，以及1967–2022年M4+地震目录。
li: Relies on a single ergodic GMM (BSSA14) rather than non-ergodic or regionally calibrated Bay Area path models, and omits the other three GMMs used in NSHM23.
Applies a spatial correlation model derived from Ridgecrest aftershocks to the San Francisco Bay Area, where dense nodal array observations are unavailable for local calibration.
Computational approximations—0.02° grid spacing, 99% eigenvalue truncation, and ignoring intra-event variability (φ) distance dependence beyond 105 km—slightly underestimate failure probabilities.
依赖单一遍历性地面运动模型（BSSA14），未采用非遍历性或针对湾区路径效应校准的模型，且未包含NSHM23中的另外三个GMM。
将基于Ridgecrest余震建立的空间相关模型直接应用于旧金山湾区，而湾区缺乏密集节点台阵数据来进行本地化校验。
计算简化（0.02°网格间距、99%特征值截断以及忽略105 km以外事件内变异性φ的距离依赖性）会导致失效概率被略微低估。

tm.why: The paper develops a methodology for area-based probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) to estimate the probability of strong ground shaking anywhere in a region, applied to the San Francisco Bay Area.

The study extensively benchmarks stochastic sampling and variance reduction methods (Direct Monte Carlo, Subset Simulation, and Importance Sampling using Elementary Events) to quantify rare exceedance probabilities over high-dimensional multivariate normal fields.

sum: Dynamic topography above subduction zones is widely inferred, yet its global controls remain poorly constrained. This study calculates water-loaded residual topography across 19 global back-arc basins (BABs) by correcting GEBCO bathymetry for sediment loading (GlobSed), crustal thickness (ECM1), and lithospheric cooling age. The resulting anomalies are compared against slab dip from the Slab2 model and reconstructed cumulative subducted water input since 170 Ma. Results reveal that 18 of 19 BABs show negative residual topography (up to -3,952 m in the Tyrrhenian Sea). Residual topography correlates strongly and negatively with intermediate-depth slab dip (r = -0.99 for continental–oceanic and r = -0.88 for ocean–ocean systems, both with slopes of -99 m/degree), and continental–oceanic basins are systematically deeper. Furthermore, anomalies covary with cumulative subducted water (r = -0.90 for active basins), providing key observational constraints on how slab geometry, overriding plate structure, and hydration-modified mantle wedge rheology govern slab-driven mantle flow.
本研究通过校正沉积物负载（GlobSed）、地壳厚度（ECM1）及岩石圈年龄热沉降，计算了全球19个弧后盆地的残余地形，并与Slab2板片倾角及170 Ma以来的累计俯冲水量进行对比。结果显示除阿留申盆地外，其余18个盆地均呈负残余地形。残余地形与俯冲板片倾角呈显著负相关（陆-洋和洋-洋系统的相关系……

t: Calculates water-loaded residual topography across 19 back-arc basins by correcting GEBCO bathymetry for GlobSed sediment loading and ECM1 crustal thickness, removing age–depth thermal cooling predictions, and performing orthogonal regression against Slab2 dip and subducted water.
校正水深数据的沉积物与地壳厚度并扣除热沉降，计算19个弧后盆地残余地形并与板片倾角和俯冲水量回归。

Global datasets for 22 back-arc basins (19 with residual topography, 15 with slab dip) combining GEBCO_2025 bathymetry, GlobSed sediment thickness, ECM1 1°×1° crustal model, oceanic age grids, Slab2 geometry, and 170-Ma subducted water flux.
整合22个弧后盆地的GEBCO水深、GlobSed沉积物、ECM1地壳、洋壳年龄、Slab2及俯冲水量数据。

Eighteen of 19 basins show negative residual topography (+67 m to -3,952 m). Anomalies correlate negatively with slab dip (r = -0.99 for CO-type, r = -0.88 for OO-type; slope -99 m/degree) and cumulative subducted water (r = -0.90).
18个盆地呈负残余地形，与板片倾角（陆-洋r=-0.99，洋-洋r=-0.88）及俯冲水量（r=-0.90）负相关。

Limited number of basins with complete slab constraints, unmodeled contributions from lithospheric flexure and mantle structure, Slab2 uncertainties, and omission of trench migration and convergence rates.
样本数量有限，且未考虑岩石圈挠曲、地幔结构、海沟迁移和汇聚速率的影响。

Provides the first global observational demonstration across 19 back-arc basins that negative residual topography scales systematically with intermediate-depth slab dip, overriding plate type, and cumulative subducted water.
首次在全球尺度观测证实弧后盆地负残余地形与板片倾角、上覆板块类型及累计俯冲水量显著相关。

kc: Compiled water-loaded residual topography for 19 global back-arc basins using continuous global sediment (GlobSed) and seismic crustal thickness (ECM1) datasets.
Demonstrated a robust negative linear correlation (-99 m/degree) between back-arc residual topography and intermediate-depth (200–300 km) slab dip.
Showed that continental–oceanic back-arc basins exhibit systematically more negative residual topography than ocean–ocean systems at comparable slab dips.
Identified a strong negative correlation (r = -0.90 in active basins) between residual topography and cumulative subducted water content since 170 Ma.
利用全球连续沉积物（GlobSed）和地震地壳厚度（ECM1）数据集，汇编了全球19个弧后盆地的水负载残余地形。
揭示了弧后盆地残余地形与中源深度（200–300 km）板片倾角之间存在稳健的负线性相关（斜率为-99 m/度）。
证明在相近板片倾角下，陆-洋俯冲系统的弧后盆地比洋-洋系统表现出系统性更负的残余地形。
发现活跃弧后盆地的残余地形与170 Ma以来的累计俯冲水量呈强负相关（r = -0.90）。
me: Isostatic bathymetry correction for sediment loading using Athy's exponential compaction law and for crustal thickness referenced to 7.1 km oceanic crust.
Removal of oceanic lithospheric thermal cooling age–depth predictions to isolate water-loaded residual topography.
Trench-perpendicular slab profile extraction from Slab2 to compute average intermediate-depth (200–300 km) slab dip angles.
Orthogonal linear regression between basin-averaged residual topography, slab dip, and 170 Ma cumulative subducted water flux across tectonic classifications.
采用Athy指数压实定律进行沉积物负载校正，并以7.1 km标准洋壳为参考进行地壳厚度均衡校正。
从校正后水深中去除大洋岩石圈热冷却年龄-深度预测值，提取水负载残余地形。
基于Slab2模型提取垂直海沟的板片剖面，计算200–300 km中源深度的平均板片倾角。
按构造背景分类，对盆地平均残余地形、板片倾角及170 Ma以来的累计俯冲水量进行正交线性回归分析。
de: Bathymetry from GEBCO 2025, sediment thickness from GlobSed, crustal thickness from ECM1 (1° × 1°), and oceanic crustal age grids.
Subduction zone slab geometry from the Slab2 model across 15 back-arc basins.
Plate tectonic reconstructions and cumulative subducted water content since 170 Ma.
Sensitivity tests using alternative crustal models (CRUST1.0), cooling models, and slab dip depth intervals (100–150 km vs. 200–300 km).
GEBCO 2025水深数据、GlobSed沉积物厚度、ECM1（1°×1°）地壳厚度以及大洋地壳年龄网格数据。
涵盖15个弧后盆地的Slab2俯冲带板片几何模型。
板块构造重建及170 Ma以来的累计俯冲水含量数据。
使用替代地壳模型（CRUST1.0）、热冷却模型及不同板片倾角深度区间（100–150 km与200–300 km）进行的敏感性测试。
li: The sample size of back-arc basins with well-constrained slab dip and residual topography is small (12 active basins: 4 CO-type, 6 OO-type, 1 AO-type, plus 1 extinct).
Residual topography estimates neglect potential contributions from lithospheric flexure, lateral conductive cooling in narrow continental basins, and upper mantle thermal/compositional heterogeneity.
Effects of trench migration and plate convergence rates on subduction dynamics are not explicitly modeled.
同时具备可靠板片倾角和残余地形约束的弧后盆地样本量较小（仅12个盆地：4个陆-洋型、6个洋-洋型、1个弧-洋型及1个消亡盆地）。
残余地形估算未考虑岩石圈挠曲、狭窄陆缘盆地侧向传导冷却以及上地幔热/化学不均一性的潜在贡献。
未明确量化海沟迁移速率和板块汇聚速率对俯冲动力学及地形的调制作用。

tm.why: The paper estimates residual topography across global back-arc basins and relates these anomalies to slab dip, overriding plate setting, and mantle wedge hydration to constrain subduction zone geodynamics.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF read and analyzed, including equations, Table 1, Figures 1–4, and all sections.

sum: Although cratons are stabilized by thick, viscous lithosphere, their long-term thickness evolution and its link to kimberlite magmatism remain debated. Kimberlites erupt almost exclusively through cratons exceeding 160–250 km depth (the 'kimberlite window') and increase markedly in frequency after 1500 Ma. This study conducts 27 2-D thermo-mechanical simulations using ASPECT over 3000 Myr, alongside spatiotemporal de-clustering and kernel density estimation of global kimberlite and carbonatite databases, plus pipe surface area analyses. Results show that hot Archean cratons initially underwent rapid gravitational flattening to depths shallower than 160 km. Subsequent secular cooling increased craton density and viscosity, driving convective self-compression that outpaced basal lithospheric dripping. Consequently, cratons gradually thickened back into the kimberlite window after ~2000–1500 Ma. This natural, non-forced convective self-compression provides a physical mechanism linking secular craton thickening to the post-1500 Ma surge in kimberlite eruptions and continuous carbonatite magmatism.
克拉通岩石圈的长期厚度演化及其与金伯利岩岩浆作用的联系尚存争议。本研究利用ASPECT开展了27组跨越30亿年的二维热力学数值模拟，并结合全球金伯利岩和碳酸岩年龄数据库的时空去聚类核密度估计及岩筒出露面积分析。结果表明，太古宙热克拉通最初因重力展平而减薄至160公里以上；随后长期冷却增加了克拉通密度……

t: The authors use the finite-element code ASPECT to run 27 2-D visco-plastic mantle convection models over 3000 Myr, combined with spatiotemporal de-clustering and area-weighted kernel density estimation of kimberlite ages and craton depths.
利用有限元代码ASPECT运行27组跨越30亿年的二维粘塑性地幔对流模型，结合时空去聚类与面积加权核密度估计。

The study analyzes a global compilation of ~1200 kimberlites, a carbonatite age compilation, surface exposure areas of 117 kimberlite pipes, and 27 synthetic geodynamic models exploring craton density, thickness, heating, and cooling.
分析了全球约1200个金伯利岩年龄、碳酸岩记录、117个金伯利岩筒出露面积，以及27组地球动力学数值模型。
Cratons flatten early to <160 km, then cool and become +1.2 to +1.4% denser than ambient mantle, driving self-compression that thickens the CBL by 20–30 km to exceed 160 km after ~1500–2000 Myr.
克拉通早期展平至160公里以内，随后冷却变密（+1.2%至+1.4%），在后15亿年自压缩增厚20–30公里并突破160…
In a hotter Archean mantle, higher temperatures may have shifted the kimberlite window deeper, and early Earth volatile availability and redox conditions remain poorly constrained.
早期热地幔中金伯利岩窗口可能更深，且早期挥发分丰度和氧化还原条件仍缺乏约束。

Unlike prior models imposing rapid horizontal shortening at the surface, these models let cratons naturally self-compress in a periodically varying mantle flow field over 1000–1500 Myr, linking thickening to kimberlite frequency.
不施加地表水平缩短强迫，而是让克拉通在周期性地幔流中自然自压缩缓慢增厚，从而解释金伯利岩喷发趋势。

kc: Demonstrates via 27 2-D geodynamic models that cratons undergo early gravitational flattening followed by slow cooling- and compression-driven thickening over 3000 Myr.
Evaluates and refutes preservation bias as the sole driver of post-1500 Ma kimberlite abundance using spatiotemporal de-clustering, carbonatite age comparisons, and 117 kimberlite pipe surface areas.
Links the timing of cratonic compositional and thermal boundary layers entering the 160–250 km kimberlite window after ~1500 Ma to the global surge in kimberlite eruption frequency.
通过27组二维地球动力学模型证明，克拉通在30亿年间经历了早期的重力展平，随后在冷却和压缩驱动下缓慢增厚。
利用时空去聚类、碳酸岩年龄对比以及117个金伯利岩筒地表出露面积数据，证明保存偏差并非15亿年后金伯利岩增多的唯一原因。
将15亿年后克拉通成分和热边界层进入160–250公里金伯利岩窗口的时间与全球金伯利岩喷发频率的激增联系起来。
me: 2-D thermo-mechanical finite-element mantle convection simulations using ASPECT v2.5 with visco-plastic dry/wet olivine rheology and periodic bottom velocity boundary conditions.
Spatiotemporal de-clustering of the global kimberlite database (100 km spatial radius and 10 Myr temporal window) and kernel density estimation (KDE).
Area-weighted KDE analysis of model cratonic compositional (CBL) and thermal boundary layers (TBL) exceeding 160 km and 200 km depths, plus 1-D hillslope diffusion topography calculation.
使用ASPECT v2.5开展二维热-力学有限元地幔对流模拟，采用粘塑性干/湿橄榄石流变学和周期性底部速度边界条件。
对全球金伯利岩数据库进行时空去聚类处理（100公里空间半径和1000万年时间窗口）及核密度估计（KDE）。
对模型中超过160公里和200公里深度的克拉通成分边界层（CBL）和热边界层（TBL）进行面积加权KDE分析，并利用一维山坡扩散方程计算地形异常。
de: Global compilation of ~1200 kimberlite eruption ages and locations, alongside a global carbonatite age database.
Compiled dataset ofemplacement ages versus present-day exposed surface areas for 117 kimberlite pipes across major cratons.

27 numerical experiments varying initial craton thickness (150, 180, 200 km), compositional buoyancy (0%, -0.5%, -1%), crustal radiogenic heating, mantle cooling, and a basal metasomatized weak layer.
全球约1200个金伯利岩喷发年龄和位置的汇编数据集，以及全球碳酸岩年龄数据库。
全球主要克拉通117个金伯利岩筒的侵位年龄与现今地表出露面积汇编数据集。
27组数值实验，系统改变初始克拉通厚度（150、180、200公里）、成分浮力（0%、-0.5%、-1%）、地壳放射性生热、地幔冷却以及底部交代弱化层。
li: Models are restricted to 2-D Cartesian geometry and do not include surface sedimentation or sea-level tracking when estimating topography.
The pressure-temperature depth of the kimberlite window, volatile (CO2-H2O) availability, and mantle redox conditions in a hotter Archean mantle are not dynamically coupled and remain uncertain.
Imposed periodic bottom boundary velocity cycles do not match the exact, non-periodic timing of Earth's historical supercontinent cycles.
模型局限于二维笛卡尔几何，在估算地形时未包含地表沉积过程或海平面变化。
更热的太古宙地幔中金伯利岩窗口的温压深度、挥发分（CO2-H2O）丰度及氧化还原条件未进行动态耦合，仍存在不确定性。
施加的周期性底部边界速度循环与地球历史上非完全周期性的超大陆旋回确切时间存在差异。

tm.why: The paper uses 2D geodynamic numerical models of mantle convection (ASPECT) to study the 3000 Myr thermal and mechanical thickness evolution of cratonic lithosphere.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, 5 figures, equations, and methods section.

sum: SeisBench distributes pretrained deep-learning seismic phase pickers exclusively in PyTorch, creating friction for operational models built in TensorFlow. Because retraining alters learned weights and picking behavior, this paper presents a reproducible four-step workflow to convert static TensorFlow/Keras phase pickers to PyTorch without retraining: (1) architectural alignment, (2) weight extraction and tensor layout transformation, (3) explicit key-based parameter mapping, and (4) staged layer-wise and dataset-scale validation. The authors demonstrate the workflow on the Earthquake Compact Convolutional Transformer (EQCCT), used operationally by the Texas Seismological Network. Evaluated across 100,000 three-component waveform windows from STEAD and TXED with TF32 disabled, the converted PyTorch models (now in SeisBench as EQCCTP and EQCCTS) achieve CPU and GPU mean absolute errors of ~1.5–1.8 × 10^-9, 100% identical threshold detection decisions, and 99.999% identical argmax pick locations.
SeisBench仅支持PyTorch格式的深度学习震相拾取模型，而重新训练TensorFlow模型会改变权重与拾取行为。本文提出无需重训练的四步转换工作流：架构对齐、权重提取与张量维度转换、显式键值参数映射及分阶段验证。作者将该流程应用于德州地震台网的EQCCT模型，并在100,000个STEAD……

t: A four-step conversion workflow: architectural alignment in PyTorch, HDF5 weight extraction and tensor layout transformation, explicit key-based parameter mapping, and progressive layer-wise to dataset-scale numerical validation with TF32 disabled.
四步转换法：PyTorch架构对齐、HDF5权重提取与张量转置重排、显式键值映射加载、禁用TF32的分阶段验证。

100,000 deterministic 6000-sample (100 Hz) three-component ZNE waveform windows containing catalog P and S arrivals, comprising 50,000 windows each from the TXED and STEAD datasets accessed via SeisBench.
通过SeisBench获取的TXED和STEAD数据集各5万个（共10万个）100Hz三分量6000采样点地震波形窗口。

Mean MAE between TensorFlow and PyTorch probability traces was 1.46×10^-9 to 1.82×10^-9 across CPU and GPU. Detection decisions at thresholds 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 were 100% identical, with 99.999% argmax pick agreement.
CPU和GPU上概率轨迹平均MAE为1.46×10^-9至1.82×10^-9，三个阈值下检测结果100%一致，拾取位置…
Evaluates only a single static architecture (EQCCT) under fixed preprocessing and omits runtime/memory benchmarks; models with dynamic graphs or custom operators require additional effort.
仅在固定预处理下验证了单一静态模型EQCCT，未测试运行时间与内存开销，难以自动处理动态图或自定义算子。
Provides the first systematic, retraining-free TensorFlow-to-PyTorch weight transfer workflow for seismic phase pickers and integrates the operational EQCCT models into SeisBench.
首次提出无需重训练的震相拾取模型跨框架权重无损迁移流程，并将业务化EQCCT模型集成至SeisBench。

kc: Developed a four-step workflow for converting static TensorFlow/Keras seismic phase pickers to PyTorch without retraining.
Converted the operational EQCCT P- and S-wave phase pickers and integrated them into the official SeisBench repository (v0.12) as EQCCTP and EQCCTS.
Demonstrated rounding-level numerical equivalence (MAE ~ 10^-9) and identical detection decisions across 100,000 STEAD and TXED waveform windows.
Identified that enabling GPU TensorFloat-32 (TF32) inflates cross-framework numerical differences by three orders of magnitude.
开发了无需重新训练即可将静态TensorFlow/Keras地震震相拾取器转换为PyTorch的四步工作流程。
成功转换了业务化运行的EQCCT纵横波拾取模型，作为EQCCTP和EQCCTS集成至SeisBench官方库（v0.12）。
在10万个STEAD和TXED波形窗口上验证了舍入级别的数值等价性（MAE约10^-9）及完全一致的检测决策。
发现启用GPU的TF32精度会使跨框架数值差异扩大约三个数量级，禁用后可恢复CPU级数值一致性。
me: Architectural alignment reproducing exact Keras computational graphs (Conv1D, patch encoder, Transformer MHA/MLP, output heads) in PyTorch.
HDF5 checkpoint flattening and systematic tensor layout transformations (e.g., dense kernel transposes, Conv1D axis permutations, MHA weight reshaping).
Explicit key-based parameter mapping to prevent silent positional loading errors on square matrices or terminal heads.
Staged validation comparing intermediate layer activations on random inputs followed by dataset-scale probability trace and phase-pick evaluation with TF32 disabled.
架构对齐：在PyTorch中精确复现Keras计算图（一维卷积、块编码器、Transformer多头注意力与MLP、输出头）。
权重提取与布局转换：展平HDF5检查点，执行系统的张量维度变换（全连接层转置、一维卷积核轴重排、多头注意力权重重塑）。
显式键值参数映射：通过键值严格对应加载参数，防止在方阵或末端输出头发生静默的位置加载错误。
分阶段验证：先利用随机张量对比中间层激活值，再在禁用TF32条件下对大规模真实数据集的概率轨迹与拾取结果进行评估。
de: Pretrained TensorFlow/Keras EQCCT P- and S-wave model checkpoints from the Texas Seismological Network (TexNet).
Layer-wise intermediate activation comparison using identical randomly generated NumPy tensors.
Dataset-scale validation on 100,000 60-second (6000-sample at 100 Hz) three-component ZNE earthquake waveform windows (50,000 from STEAD and 50,000 from TXED).
CPU (AMD Threadripper PRO 7985WX) and GPU (NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada) inference benchmarks evaluating MAE, MSE, max difference, detection rates at thresholds 0.1/0.3/0.5, and argmax pick times.
来自德克萨斯地震台网（TexNet）的预训练TensorFlow/Keras EQCCT P波和S波模型权重文件。
使用相同随机生成的NumPy张量进行逐层中间激活值对比实验。
基于SeisBench获取的100,000个100 Hz采样率、6000采样点三分量（ZNE）地震波形窗口（STEAD和TXED各50,000个）。
在CPU和GPU上分别测试MAE、MSE、最大绝对偏差、0.1/0.3/0.5阈值下的检测一致率以及argmax到时拾取位置。
li: Validated on only a single model architecture (EQCCT) using fixed preprocessing, waveform length, channel ordering, and inference settings.
Cannot automatically resolve architectural mismatches for models relying on dynamic computational graphs, custom operators, or quantized inference.
Does not benchmark computational runtime or memory consumption between TensorFlow and PyTorch implementations.
Evaluates numerical equivalence between frameworks rather than reassessing the true scientific phase-picking accuracy of EQCCT.
仅在单一模型架构（EQCCT）及固定的预处理、波形长度和推理设置下进行了验证。
对于依赖动态计算图、特定框架算子或量化推理的模型，无法自动解决缺乏直接等价算子的架构差异。
未报告TensorFlow与PyTorch实现之间的运行时间或内存占用性能对比。
仅评估同一训练模型在两个框架间的一致性，而非重新评估EQCCT本身的科学拾取精度。

tm.why: The paper develops a workflow for porting pretrained deep-learning seismic phase pickers (specifically EQCCT) from TensorFlow to PyTorch for integration into SeisBench.
The ported EQCCT models are operational P- and S-wave phase pickers and earthquake detectors used by the Texas Seismological Network.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF read and analyzed, including abstract, methodology, equations, validation metrics, Table 1, and Figures 1-3.

sum: Following the Moon-forming giant impact, Earth rotated rapidly with a day of 2.3 to 5 hours, making the planet highly oblate. Using the HERCULES planetary structure code coupled with canonical and high-angular-momentum lunar tidal evolution models, this study explores a previously neglected driver of early Earth dynamics: rotational despinning. Results show that low equatorial effective gravity caused the primary crust to be up to 10 times thicker at the equator than at the poles. As the Moon tidally receded and Earth became more spherical, surface area changes drove polar extension and equatorial convergence at rates comparable to modern plate boundaries and the Himalayas for millions to tens of millions of years. This shape-driven tectonic activity could have induced secondary crustal melting, felsic magma production, and eclogite delamination, explaining early lithological diversity and ancient mantle geochemical heterogeneities.
月球形成大撞击后，早期地球快速自转且呈明显扁球体。本研究结合HERCULES行星结构代码与月球潮汐演化模型，首次量化了自转减慢对早期地球动力学的影响。结果表明，低赤道有效重力使初始地壳在赤道处的厚度可达极地的10倍。随着月球潮汐退行和地球趋于球形，表面积变化在极区引起伸展、在赤道引起汇聚，其变形速率……

t: Combined equilibrium planetary structure calculations (HERCULES potential-field code with ANEOS equations of state) with analytical canonical and numerical high-angular-momentum lunar tidal evolution models to compute surface gravity, pressure, and crustal strain rates.
结合HERCULES行星平衡结构计算与解析及数值月球潮汐演化模型，计算地表重力、压力和地壳应变率。

Simulated Earth structures with core mass fraction 0.323, forsterite mantle (entropy 3.2 kJ/K/kg), and iron core (1.5 kJ/K/kg) across angular momenta up to 3 L_EM, paired with published lunar orbital simulations.
模拟核质量分数0.323、镁橄榄石地幔和纯铁核在不同角动量下的地球结构，结合月球轨道演化模拟数据。

Equatorial surface gravity was as low as ~4 m/s^2, yielding up to 10-fold thicker equatorial crust; subsequent despinning caused >100% area changes and convergence rates exceeding ~60 mm/yr for tens of millions of years.
赤道初始重力低至~4 m/s²，地壳厚达极地10倍；自转减慢引起超100%面积变化和超60 mm/yr的汇聚率。

Substantial uncertainty exists regarding the relative timing of magma ocean solidification versus lunar tidal evolution, and quantitative geodynamic tools for highly oblate evolving surfaces are currently lacking.
岩浆洋凝固与潮汐演化的相对时间存在不确定性，且缺乏针对高扁率演化表面的定量地球动力学工具。
First study to quantify how rapid post-impact rotation and despinning during lunar tidal recession shaped primary crust formation and drove global tectonic deformation on early Earth.
首次量化了大撞击后快速自转及月球退行引起的自转减慢对早期地球初始地壳形成和全球构造变形的驱动作用。

kc: Demonstrated that lower equatorial gravity on a rapidly rotating early Earth caused primary crust to be up to 10 times thicker at the equator than at the poles.
Quantified surface strain rates during lunar tidal recession, showing polar extension and equatorial convergence comparable to modern tectonic rates.
Proposed a novel mechanism for early felsic rock production, crustal delamination, and early mantle heterogeneity driven by planetary despinning.
证明了快速自转的早期地球因赤道有效重力较低，导致赤道初始地壳厚度可达两极的10倍。
量化了月球潮汐退行期间的地表应变率，揭示了与现代板块构造速率相当的极区伸展和赤道汇聚。
提出了由行星自转减慢驱动的早期长英质岩石生成、地壳拆沉和早期地幔不均一性形成的新机制。
me: Equilibrium planetary structure modeling across angular momentum steps of 0.1 L_EM using the potential-field code HERCULES v1.0 with ANEOS equations of state.
Surface effective gravity and local latitudinal/longitudinal strain rate calculations assuming the crust follows gravitational equipotentials.
Analytical canonical tidal evolution modeling (with constant, linear, and exponential k2/Q histories) and integration of high-angular-momentum orbital simulations.
使用势场代码HERCULES v1.0和ANEOS物态方程，以0.1 L_EM为角动量步长计算平衡行星结构。
假设地壳遵循重力等势面，计算地表有效重力及局部纬向/经向应变率。
结合解析经典潮汐演化模型（包含常数、线性和指数k2/Q演化历史）与高角动量轨道数值模拟结果。
de: HERCULES numerical models of an Earth-mass planet (core mass fraction 0.323) with isentropic forsterite mantle (3.2 kJ/K/kg) and iron core (1.5 kJ/K/kg) from 0.18 to 3.0 L_EM.
Simulated lunar orbital histories from canonical constant-angular-momentum equations and published high-angular-momentum simulations (Laplace plane instability and evection limit cycles).
从0.18到3.0 L_EM的地球质量行星（核质量分数0.323）的HERCULES数值模型，采用等熵镁橄榄石地幔和纯铁核。
基于经典角动量守恒方程的月球轨道演化序列，以及已发表的高角动量模拟数据（拉普拉斯平面不稳定性和出差共振极限环）。
li: Relative timescales of magma ocean solidification versus lunar tidal recession remain uncertain and uncoupled.
Surface deformation calculations neglect crustal yield strength and assume strain is accommodated locally on an equipotential surface.
Does not dynamically couple 3D mantle convection with an evolving oblate planetary geometry.
岩浆洋凝固与月球潮汐退行的相对时间尺度存在较大不确定性且未完全耦合。
地表变形计算忽略了地壳屈服强度，并假设应变在等势面上局部调节。
尚未将三维地幔对流模型与演化中的扁球体行星几何形状进行动态耦合。

tm.why: The paper models early Earth's planetary structure, crustal thickness variations, and tectonic deformation driven by rotational despinning and geodynamic evolution.

ev.notes: Full 31-page PDF analyzed, including main text, equations, figures (Figs. 1-11 and A1-A4), and Appendices A and B.

sum: This paper evaluates the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) using a real-time test on the Kumamoto earthquake sequence. The FTLS is designed to assess in real-time whether an ongoing earthquake sequence is likely to lead to a larger event (foreshock behavior) or decay (aftershock behavior) based on spatial and temporal variations in the seismic b-value. By applying this system to the Kumamoto sequence, the authors test the operational feasibility and predictive power of the b-value traffic light methodology under real-time conditions, providing critical insights into operational earthquake forecasting and seismic hazard mitigation.
本文利用熊本地震序列对前震红绿灯系统（FTLS）进行了实时测试。FTLS旨在根据地震b值的时空变化，实时评估当前地震序列是可能引发更大地震（前震行为）还是逐渐衰减（余震行为）。通过将该系统应用于熊本地震序列，作者测试了b值红绿灯方法在实时条件下的操作可行性和预测能力，为地震危险性分析和实时地震预报提……

t: The study utilizes the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) to monitor real-time changes in the seismic b-value, which acts as a proxy for stress state to distinguish foreshocks from aftershocks.
该研究利用前震红绿灯系统（FTLS）监测地震b值的实时变化，以此作为应力状态的指标来区分前震和余震。
The method is tested using real-time or simulated real-time seismic catalog data from the Kumamoto earthquake sequence.
该方法使用来自熊本地震序列的实时或模拟实时地震目录数据进行了测试。
The paper presents the first real-time test results of the FTLS, evaluating its ability to correctly identify the nature of the Kumamoto sequence as it unfolded.
论文展示了FTLS的首次实时测试结果，评估了其在熊本地震序列发生时正确识别其性质的能力。
The approach is limited by the quality, completeness, and latency of the real-time seismic catalog used for b-value calculations.
该方法受限于用于计算b值的实时地震目录的质量、完整性和延迟。
This work represents the first prospective or real-time application and test of the FTLS on a major active earthquake sequence.
该工作代表了FTLS在主要活动地震序列上的首次前瞻性或实时应用与测试。

kc: Conducts a real-time test of the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) on a major earthquake sequence.
Evaluates the operational feasibility of using real-time b-value monitoring to distinguish foreshocks from aftershocks.
Provides empirical evidence regarding the predictive performance of the FTLS in active tectonic regions.
对一个主要地震序列进行了前震红绿灯系统（FTLS）的实时测试。
评估了利用实时b值监测来区分前震和余震的操作可行性。
提供了关于FTLS在活动构造区预测性能的经验证据。
me: Application of the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) algorithm.
Real-time estimation of spatial and temporal variations in the seismic b-value.
Statistical analysis of earthquake catalog data to assess stress state changes.
应用前震红绿灯系统（FTLS）算法。
实时估算地震b值的时空变化。
对地震目录数据进行统计分析以评估应力状态变化。
de: Seismic catalog data from the Kumamoto earthquake sequence.
Real-time or simulated real-time monitoring of seismic events to calculate b-values.
来自熊本地震序列的地震目录数据。
对地震事件进行实时或模拟实时监测以计算b值。
li: The performance of FTLS is highly dependent on the completeness and quality of the real-time seismic catalog.
Distinguishing real-time b-value fluctuations from noise or catalog artifacts remains challenging.
FTLS的性能高度依赖于实时地震目录的完整性和质量。
将实时b值波动与噪声或目录伪影区分开来仍具有挑战性。

tm.why: The paper tests the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS), which is designed for real-time seismic hazard assessment and operational earthquake forecasting.
The FTLS relies on monitoring real-time changes in the b-value, which is closely linked to stress state and earthquake source physics.

ev.notes: No PDF or abstract was available. The analysis is based on the paper's title, authors, and the established scientific context of the Foreshock Traffic Light System (FTLS) developed by the authors.

sum: This study presents a hierarchical paired field comparison of 8kg hammer and gun active sources in multichannel analysis of surface waves (MASW) across 13 matched shot locations using a 12-geophone array (5m spacing, 30m offset). All 26 gathers underwent phase-shift dispersion imaging, automated ridge tracking with quality thresholds, independent manual phase verification, trace/image stacking, and fixed-layer conditional shear-wave velocity (Vs) inversion with paired spatial-bootstrap uncertainty. While the hammer produced a higher 4.5–10 Hz spectral fraction (0.967% vs. 0.672%) and slightly longer individual mean maximum wavelength (30.14m vs. 29.45m), source-composite stacking reversed the ranking (gun 33.41m vs. hammer 32.14m). All 95% confidence intervals for wavelength, screening depth (~16–17m), and inverted layer Vs overlapped zero. The novelty lies in an individual-to-stack consistency framework that prevents isolated spectral energy metrics from becoming unsupported claims of deeper MASW investigation.
本研究提出了主动源多道面波分析（MASW）中8公斤大锤与震源枪的层级配对野外对比方法。基于13个匹配炮点和12道检波器排列（道距5m，最小偏移距30m），对26个道集进行相移频散成像、自动脊线提取、人工拾取验证、道集/图像叠加及带配对空间自助法不确定性的固定层条件横波速度（Vs）反演。大锤在4.5–……

t: Multichannel phase-shift dispersion imaging with automated continuous-ridge tracking (coherence >= 0.55, sharpness >= 1.60), verified by manual picking, combined into trace and image stacks, and inverted via fixed-layer least-squares with paired spatial-bootstrap uncertainty.
采用相移频散成像与自动连续脊线追踪并经人工验证，构建道集与图像叠加，结合配对空间自助法进行固定层反演。
13 paired 8kg hammer and gunshot MASW gathers (26 total) recorded using a SmartSeis system with 12 4.5Hz geophones at 5m spacing, 55m aperture, and 30m nearest source offset.
13组配对的8kg大锤与震源枪MASW单炮道集（共26个），采用12道4.5Hz检波器采集，道距5m、最小偏移距30m。

Individual mean maximum wavelength was 30.14m (hammer) vs 29.45m (gun); trace-stack composites yielded 32.14m (hammer) and 33.41m (gun). Conditional Vs differences ranged from -17.6 to +14.1 m/s across four layers, with all 95% confidence intervals including zero.
单炮平均最大波长大锤为30.14m、震源枪为29.45m；叠加后分别为32.14m和33.41m，四层反演Vs差异的95…
Unequal field stack counts precluded raw amplitude comparison, fixed-layer inversions omit structural non-uniqueness, and ~32-33m maximum wavelengths restrict reliable depth resolution to ~10-17m.
野外叠加次数不等阻碍原始振幅对比，固定层反演忽略结构非唯一性，32-33m最大波长限制可靠深度在10-17m。

Introduces a hierarchical individual-to-composite source-performance consistency test with paired bootstrap inference, preventing raw spectral power from being misinterpreted as superior MASW depth resolution.
提出从单炮到组合叠加的震源性能层级一致性检验框架，防止将低频能量优势误判为探测深度优势。

kc: Developed a reproducible individual-to-composite consistency framework for evaluating active MASW sources across waveform, dispersion, stack, and inversion levels.
Implemented an automated dispersion-ridge extraction algorithm with coherence and sharpness thresholds paired with independent manual verification.
Demonstrated via 13 paired hammer and gun gathers that greater low-frequency spectral power does not automatically translate into longer usable wavelengths or deeper resolved Vs structure.
开发了从单炮到组合叠加的可复现一致性框架，在波形、频散、叠加和反演多层级评估主动MASW震源性能。
实现了结合相干性与尖锐度阈值的自动频散脊线提取算法，并辅以独立的人工拾取质量控制。
通过13组配对大锤和震源枪数据证明，更高的低频谱能量占比并不直接转化为更长的可用波长或更深的有效反演横波速度结构。
me: Multichannel phase-shift dispersion imaging paired with continuous trajectory automated ridge extraction (coherence >= 0.55, ridge sharpness >= 1.60).
Independent manual fundamental-mode picking for quality control and verification of automated paths.
Dual source-composite construction via normalized common-offset median trace stacking and normalized dispersion-image averaging.
Fixed-layer conditional Rayleigh-wave inversion using disba (global search + bounded least-squares) with 200 paired spatial-bootstrap replicates.
多道相移频散成像结合连续轨迹自动脊线提取算法（相干性>=0.55，脊线尖锐度>=1.60）。
独立的人工基阶模式拾取，用于对自动提取路径进行质量控制与验证。
通过归一化共偏移距中值道集叠加和归一化频散图像平均构建双重震源组合。
利用disba进行固定层条件瑞利波反演（全局搜索+有界最小二乘），并通过200次配对空间自助法重采样量化不确定性。
de: 26 active MASW shot gathers (13 8kg hammer and 13 gun) acquired at matched coordinates along a rolling line with 12 vertical 4.5 Hz geophones (5m spacing, 55m aperture, 30m nearest offset, 2000 Hz sampling, 2.0s record length).
在匹配坐标处滚动采集的26个主动源MASW炮集（13个8公斤大锤和13个震源枪），使用12个4.5 Hz垂直检波器（5m道距，55m孔径，30m最小偏移距，2000 Hz采样率，2.0s记录长度）。
li: Raw recorded amplitudes could not be directly compared due to unequal and variable field stack counts (3–7 for hammer vs. 1–4 for gun).
Inversions are conditional on fixed layer boundaries (0–2, 2–5, 5–9m over half-space), assumed densities, and fixed Vp/Vs, omitting full structural non-uniqueness.
Composite stacks average across a rolling spread and thus represent a line-wide average rather than a true 1D local sounding.
Maximum usable wavelengths (~32–33m) constrain reliable screening depth to ~10–17m, leaving the deep half-space weakly constrained.
由于野外叠加次数不同（大锤3–7次，震源枪1–4次），原始记录振幅无法直接用于对比震源绝对能量。
反演以固定层界面（0–2、2–5、5–9m及半空间）、假设密度和固定波速比为条件，未包含完整的结构非唯一性。
组合叠加对滚动排列进行了空间平均，代表测线整体平均响应而非严格的单点一维测深。
最大可用波长（约32–33m）将可靠勘探深度限制在约10–17m，深部半空间约束较弱。

tm.why: The paper extracts Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves and inverts them for 1D near-surface shear-wave velocity profiles using active MASW.
It conducts a paired field comparison of two active seismic sources (8kg hammer vs. gun) across a 12-geophone array geometry.
It propagates paired spatial-bootstrap and curve-perturbation uncertainties through dispersion extraction and conditional shear-wave velocity inversions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 25-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including full text, 5 tables, and 8 figures.

sum: Conventional array processing assumes point sources and incoherent noise, discarding valuable information contained in inter-sensor coherence loss. This paper introduces a probabilistic wavefield decomposition method that models the array-covariance matrix as a mixture of incoherently distributed energy densities over slowness using analytical characteristic functions, such as skew-normal signals and angular-harmonic ambient noise. Using a complex Wishart likelihood, the inverse problem is solved via variational Bayesian inference with normalising flows, implemented in the open-source package Topophone2. Applied to a synthetic abyssal hydroacoustic T-phase at a hydrophone triplet, the posterior accurately recovers distributed signal and noise parameters, quantifies information gain from adding a sensor, and strongly favours a distributed source over a point source via Bayes factors. Applied to an observed thermospheric infrasound return at array IS37 from an explosion, the method reveals that while cross-winds deflect the wavefield backazimuth, the energy distribution is skewed back towards the source.
传统台阵处理常忽略由慢度分布引起的传感器间相干性损失。本文提出一种概率波场分解方法，利用偏正态分布和角谐函数等具有解析特征函数的慢度能量分布混合模型来表征台阵协方差矩阵，并结合复Wishart似然函数与归一化流变分贝叶斯推断求解后验分布（集成于开源软件Topophone2）。在合成深海T波实验中，该……

t: The array-covariance matrix is modelled as a superposition of incoherently distributed slowness densities using analytical characteristic functions (skew-normal, angular-harmonic) under a complex Wishart likelihood, and inverted via variational inference with normalising flows.
将台阵协方差建模为具有解析特征函数的非相干慢度能量分布叠加，结合复Wishart似然与归一化流变分推断求解。

Two datasets are analysed: a KRAKEN-synthesised 5 Hz abyssal T-phase recorded at an IMS-style hydrophone triplet, and a 0.4–0.6 Hz thermospheric infrasound return from a 20 t Hukkakero explosion recorded at microbarometer array IS37.
合成5 Hz水听器三元组深海T波数据，以及挪威IS37微气压计台阵记录的20吨化爆0.4-0.6 Hz热层次声回波。

For the T-phase, adding a fourth hydrophone boosts noise-coefficient information gain by 142%, and Bayes factor ln K ≈ 218 favours a distributed source. At IS37, backazimuth is deflected 10° clockwise but skewed 11° anticlockwise towards the source.
增加第4个水听器使噪声系数信息增益提高142%，ln K≈218支持分布式源；实测次声回波偏转10°但向震源反向偏斜11…

Violations of Wishart independence assumptions cause over-confident posteriors, unmodelled sensor mismatches bias results, and the forward model is restricted to mutually incoherent scalar slowness distributions.
违反Wishart独立假设会导致后验过于自信，传感器失配会引起偏差，且模型仅限非相干标量波场。

Generalises array-covariance forward models to mixtures of analytical characteristic functions (including asymmetric skew-normal and angular-harmonic distributions) and performs full Bayesian inversion via normalising flows.
将台阵协方差正演推广至偏正态与角谐特征函数混合模型，并首次利用归一化流实现全概率贝叶斯反演。

kc: Generalised the array-covariance forward model to mixtures of incoherently distributed energy densities over slowness using analytical characteristic functions (skew-normal and angular-harmonic).
Formulated a probabilistic array-covariance inversion using a complex Wishart likelihood and variational inference with normalising flows.
Demonstrated Bayesian experimental design (KL information gain) and hypothesis testing (Bayes factors) on synthetic hydroacoustic T-phase array data.
Confirmed on observed thermospheric infrasound returns at IS37 that cross-wind-deflected energy distributions are skewed back towards the source direction.
Released the open-source Python software package Topophone2 implementing the methodology.
利用具有解析特征函数的偏正态和角谐分布，将台阵协方差正演模型推广至非相干慢度能量密度混合模型。
基于复Wishart似然函数与归一化流变分推断，建立了台阵协方差的概率反演框架。
在合成水声T波数据上展示了贝叶斯实验设计（KL信息增益）和模型假设检验（贝叶斯因子）。
通过对IS37台阵实测热层次声波回波的反演，证实了受侧风偏转的能量分布向震源方向偏斜。
发布了实现该方法的开源Python软件包Topophone2。
me: Analytical characteristic functions in slowness space (multivariate skew-normal distribution for signals, 2D cylindrical angular harmonics for coherent environmental noise).
Complex Wishart likelihood formulation for sample-covariance matrices averaged over independent time windows or Slepian multitapers.
Variational Bayesian inference using normalising flows (GeoPVI) to maximise the evidence lower bound (ELBO).
Kullback-Leibler divergence for quantifying experimental design information gain and learned harmonic mean estimator for Bayes factor model comparison.
慢度空间解析特征函数建模（信号采用多元偏正态分布，相干环境噪声采用二维柱面角谐展开）。
针对多时间窗或Slepian多锥度平均样本协方差矩阵的复Wishart似然函数构建。
利用归一化流变分贝叶斯推断（GeoPVI）最大化证据下界（ELBO）以逼近后验分布。
采用Kullback-Leibler散度量化实验设计信息增益，并利用学习调和平均估计器计算贝叶斯因子进行模型比较。
de: Synthetic abyssal T-phase at a 3-sensor (and 4-sensor) IMS-style SOFAR hydrophone array at 600 km range around 5 Hz, simulated via KRAKEN normal modes.
Observed infrasound thermospheric return at microbarometer array IS37 (Norway) around 0.4–0.6 Hz from a ~20 t surface chemical explosion at Hukkakero, Finland (321 km range).
利用KRAKEN简正模程序合成的600 km震中距、5 Hz频段IMS型三元（及四元）水听器台阵深海T波数据。
挪威IS37微气压计台阵记录的321 km外芬兰Hukkakero约20吨地表化爆产生的0.4–0.6 Hz热层次声回波实测数据。
li: The complex Wishart likelihood assumes Gaussian wavefields and independent realisations; overlapping windows or spectral variations can make the posterior over-confident unless mitigated by effective degrees of freedom.
Unmodelled inter-sensor differences (timing offsets, gain mismatches, polarity reversals, unequal self-noise) and unmodelled non-planar array geometry bias the posterior.
The forward model is restricted to mutually incoherent slowness components, neglecting partial coherence in scattered wavefields and vector wavefield polarisation.
复Wishart似然假设高斯波场和独立样本，重叠窗口或频谱变化会导致后验分布过于自信。
未建模的传感器差异（时钟偏差、增益失配、极性反转、不等自噪声）及非平面台阵几何会引入后验偏差。
正演模型仅限于慢度分量间相互非相干的标量波场，忽略了散射波场的部分相干性及多分量矢量偏振。

tm.why: The paper formulates array covariance decomposition as a Bayesian inverse problem solved via variational inference with normalising flows to support uncertainty quantification, experimental design, and hypothesis testing.
The core methodology inverts inter-sensor array-covariance matrices from hydrophone triplets and microbarometer arrays to estimate slowness distributions of incoming signals and ambient noise.
The method is demonstrated on ocean hydroacoustic T-phases and atmospheric thermospheric infrasound returns along with anisotropic environmental noise fields.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF (including 9 pages of main letter and 8 pages of supplementary material) was read and analysed in detail.

sum: This study evaluates whether flow-zone-indicator (FZI)-based rock typing improves the empirical calibration of the modified Schlumberger-Doll Research (SDR) model for estimating permeability in the heterogeneous Arbuckle Group carbonates, Kansas. Using 470 depth-matched core-permeability and NMR measurements, the authors grouped FZI values into five distinct rock types using K-means clustering. Compared to a global model, rock-type-specific calibration dramatically reduced the testing root mean square log-transformed error (RMSLE) from 1.215 to 0.240–0.427 and increased the coefficient of determination (CD) from -0.106 to 0.578–0.924. The results demonstrate that while rock typing highly improves calibration performance, practical field application requires a permeability-independent method to assign rock types, as FZI calculation initially depends on measured permeability.
本研究评估了基于流动带指数（FZI）的岩石打样是否能改善改进的SDR模型在堪萨斯州Arbuckle群非均质碳酸盐岩渗透率估算中的经验校准。利用470个深度匹配的岩心渗透率和核磁共振（NMR）测量数据，研究人员通过K均值聚类将FZI分为5种岩石类型。与全局模型相比，特定岩石类型的校准将测试均方根对数误……

t: K-means clustering of Flow Zone Indicator (FZI) values calculated from core permeability and NMR porosity to define rock types for SDR model calibration.
利用岩心渗透率和核磁共振孔隙度计算流动带指数（FZI），并通过K均值聚类定义岩石类型以进行SDR模型校准。

sum: This study presents glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) models incorporating geodynamically consistent 3D mantle viscoelastic structures and a reconstructed Antarctic ice history from 1900 to 2020. By integrating GNSS crustal motion data and GRACE gravity measurements, the authors show that a mantle rheology featuring a weak asthenosphere and temperature-dependent viscosity can simultaneously explain both decadal-scale GIA in West Antarctica and million-year timescale mantle convection. This reconciles a long-standing discrepancy in mantle viscosity estimates across different timescales.

sum: This study applies a new time-lapse seismic tomography method using differential P, S, and S-P arrival times from the Hebei seismic network to image spatiotemporal Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs changes surrounding the 2012 Ms4.8 Tangshan and 2020 Ms5.1 Guye earthquakes. The authors observe coseismic Vp and Vs decreases in the source areas, spatially correlated with aftershocks and subsurface electrical structures, attributed to seismic damage. Notably, eight years after the 2012 event, Vp and Vs exceeded pre-earthquake levels, indicating a velocity overshoot. Vp/Vs remained stable or slightly decreased, suggesting dry cracks dominated postseismically. This work provides high-precision constraints on fault zone recovery processes.
本研究利用河北地震台网的地震相数据，采用结合P波、S波及S-P差分走时的时变地震断层成像新方法，反演了2012年唐山Ms4.8和2020年古冶Ms5.1地震震源区的Vp、Vs及Vp/Vs时空变化。结果显示，两次地震后震源区波速显著下降，且与余震分布及深部电性结构高度相关，归因于地震介质损伤。震后8年……

sum: This study utilizes a dense seismic array and GNSS data at Isunnguata Sermia, Greenland, to investigate the dewatering of weakly-connected subglacial cavities. By employing machine learning for event detection and matched field processing for localization, the authors identify a swarm of Low Frequency Icequakes (LFIs). This swarm coincides with local ice surface subsidence and minimum pressure in the efficient drainage system. The LFIs are interpreted as being generated by pressure diffusion from transient connections between weakly-connected cavities dewatering into the efficient drainage system. The observed swarm migration suggests a diffusion process likely driven by hydro-fractures at the ice-bed interface. This work provides the first observational constraints on transient cavity dynamics and subglacial hydrological model parameters.

sum: This paper addresses the temperature susceptibility of short-period seismometers, which is often overlooked or dismissed as random error. The authors develop a physical model linking the poles, zeros, and gain of a passive seismometer's transfer function to temperature-sensitive instrument components. They introduce a robust pole-zero fitting method for broadband calibration data. To validate the model, they perform a series of calibrations on S-13 seismometers at various temperatures in a vault near the Yellowknife Seismic Array. The results confirm the model's accuracy, demonstrating its utility for routine calibration in permanent seismograph networks. The fitting procedure is broadly applicable to all seismic sensors, while the temperature model applies to any passive seismometer.
本文针对短周期地震计易受温度影响的问题，建立了一个将传输函数极零点和增益与温度敏感物理部件相联系的模型。作者提出了一种鲁棒的极零点拟合方法，用于宽频带标定数据。通过在黄刀地震台阵附近的地下硐室中对S-13短周期地震计进行不同温度下的标定实验，验证了该模型的有效性。该方法有助于提高永久地震台网日常标定……

sum: This study evaluates deep-learning phase pickers on borehole microseismic arrays using the AMBER benchmark of eight downhole arrays. Under a leave-one-site-out (LOSO) protocol, the author compares a 2D U-Net in 'array' (with moveout) and 'per-trace' (without moveout) configurations. Results show no systematic advantage for the array configuration (median F1-mean 0.885 vs 0.878). Crucially, at the forge_19 site, the array model collapses (P F1 of 0.18 vs 0.76 for per-trace) because the site's large moveout (70 ms) is poorly represented in the training data (only 0.45% of training events). The study concludes that per-trace pickers are a safer default for unattended, zero-shot monitoring, while array-based models should only be used when the target site's moveout distribution is well-represented in the training set.

sum: This study investigates the timing, sequence, and triggers of large blocky landslide deposits in the Tovel Valley, Brenta Dolomites, Italy. By combining geomorphological mapping, LiDAR analysis, and cosmogenic 36Cl exposure dating of boulders from six deposits, the authors identify two main periods of Holocene landslide activity: a Mid-Holocene phase (around 5.21 ± 0.16 ka) and a younger phase (between 1.0 and 0.6 ka). The spatial and temporal clustering of these events suggests episodic triggering. While the triggers for the older phase remain uncertain, seismic shaking from regional far-field earthquakes is identified as the most plausible trigger for the younger cluster. This research highlights the integration of geomorphic analysis and cosmogenic dating to reconstruct landslide histories and assess regional hazards.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains derived products supporting a study on deep mantle plume conduits using full-waveform tomography. It includes frozen path configurations, least-cost paths beneath 49 hotspots and 300 ambient sites, near-optimal corridors, synthetic-conduit injection outputs, and classification tables. These products allow researchers to reconstruct the statistical analyses and tables of the main paper without needing the original massive tomographic models, facilitating reproducibility in mantle plume and geodynamic research.
